jobs.title: Partnership Manager
jobs.description:
Game communities are where players make friends, build worlds and create together. Most of the harm in them comes from a handful of users. Some are bullies who drive other players away. In a game built for kids, one of them can be an adult pretending to be twelve. Aiba builds the AI that finds them before a moderator has to, so the community stays a safe place to play and create. For studios, that means happier players, higher NPS and lower churn.

Our platform is called Amanda. It moderates chat, voice and images in real time, flags grooming, bullying and fake profiles, and gives moderators the tools to act fast. Teams at MoviestarPlanet, WildWorks and Rovio (Angry Birds) use it to keep their communities safe.

The timing is on our side. Rules like the DSA and COPPA have made online safety a requirement, not a nice-to-have. Game studios and social platforms now have to solve this, and they are coming to us to do it.

We are a small team in Oslo and Gjøvik. We need the person who turns our partners into a steady source of new customers.

The role in short

We have 3 to 5 prospective partners who could bring us customers. Today we don't work with them in a structured way. You change that. You own every partner relationship, build the method for how we work together, and make things happen.

You also measure it. You build the reporting that shows what each partner brings in. When the data shows a partner sends us the right customers, you double down.

What you'll do

  • Own the relationship with every prospective partner, from the first conversation to a partnership that delivers.

  • Build our partnership methodology: how we choose partners, work with them and follow up. There isn't one yet.

  • Set up reporting on the results of the partnership motion, and share it with the team.

  • Use the data to double down on the partners that bring in ICP opportunities.

  • Create the content partners need to recommend and sell Amanda.

  • Keep Aiba top of mind with every partner, so we're the first name they think of.

  • Run partner events and joint activities that keep the relationships active.

  • Work closely with sales and marketing, and hand warm opportunities to our Account Executives.

Who you are

  • You have 2 to 3 years of experience in partnerships.

  • You can turn a friendly intro into a partnership with real results.

  • You like numbers. You'd rather show what a partner delivers than talk about it.

  • You build relationships as easily with suits as with gamers in hoodies.

  • You act before anyone asks. Low ego, high agency.

  • You take feedback well, and you have a sense of humor. Both get used here.

  • Your English is great, spoken and written. More languages are a plus.

A bonus, not a must: startup or scale-up experience, a background in gaming or edtech, or knowledge of Trust & Safety.

Who this isn't for

If you want a partner program that's already built, with a playbook and a manager who plans your week, you won't like it here.

What you get

  • Starting at NOK 750,000+ base, plus commission paid quarterly

  • Commission on two things: how partnerships convert into business, and partner engagement, like the partner events you run

  • Real impact. You build the partner channel from scratch, and in a team this size, it visibly moves the company.

  • A fast track for your commercial career, in an industry that is growing fast

  • A product you don't have to oversell. It keeps players safe, kids included.

  • Conferences around the world, a passionate team, and the usual Norwegian basics: pension, paid holiday and parental leave

How to apply

Apply on The Hub. It takes two minutes. First a short call with The Hub's team, then you meet the team at Aiba.

This is one of three commercial roles Aiba is hiring for right now. The other two, Account Executive and Sales Development Representative, are on The Hub too.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Aiba.ai, we provide an advanced AI-powered platform designed to elevate player safety by moderating in-game chat in real time. As the gaming industry expands globally, the need for a scalable solution to combat harmful behaviors is critical. Our platform safeguards communities against online threats such as bullying, grooming, racism, radicalization, and other harmful content. Our AI technology, developed in collaboration with the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), combines machine learning algorithms and behavioral biometrics to ensure fast detection of harmful behavior. We analyze player interactions in real time, identifying threats as they occur, even when players use slang, dialects, or emojis. Aiba.ai efficiently manages large volumes of player reports, helping developers prioritize critical issues while reducing the burden on moderation teams. This saves time and resources, ensuring swift resolution of urgent matters and improving player experience. Our platform ensures compliance with key regulatory frameworks, including COPPA and the DSA, protecting players while keeping your game in line with evolving regulations. Our solution also leverages behavioral biometrics to track patterns of behavior, identifying repeat offenders and reducing harmful interactions over time. Aiba.ai is scalable, supporting both indie games and large multiplayer platforms. Our APIs are customizable and easy to integrate into existing systems, allowing you to tailor moderation based on your needs. Additionally, our platform supports multiple languages, making it ideal for global games with diverse player bases. We provide real-time moderation across languages, ensuring all players are protected, regardless of location or language. By offering advanced moderation and behavior detection, Aiba.ai helps developers create safer, more enjoyable player experiences. We reduce the burden on moderation teams, ensure regulatory compliance, and improve the health of gaming communities. Our commitment is to provide a robust, scalable solution that protects your players and helps foster a positive gaming environment.

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.description:
Game communities are where players make friends, build worlds and create together. Most of the harm in them comes from a handful of users. Some are bullies who drive other players away. In a game built for kids, one of them can be an adult pretending to be twelve. Aiba builds the AI that finds them before a moderator has to, so the community stays a safe place to play and create. For studios, that means happier players, higher NPS and lower churn.

Our platform is called Amanda. It moderates chat, voice and images in real time, flags grooming, bullying and fake profiles, and gives moderators the tools to act fast. Teams at MoviestarPlanet, WildWorks and Rovio (Angry Birds) use it to keep their communities safe.

The timing is on our side. Rules like the DSA and COPPA have made online safety a requirement, not a nice-to-have. Game studios and social platforms now have to solve this, and they are coming to us to do it.

We are a small team in Oslo and Gjøvik. We need the person who turns that interest into customers.

The role in short

You own the deal from the first call to the signed contract, and the customer relationship after it. Marketing brings you the leads. You bring the curiosity, the pitch and the close. This is not a cold-calling job.

One week you're on a video call with the founder of an indie studio. The next you're in a meeting room with the compliance team of one of the big names in gaming. A few weeks later you're at a games conference, making deals over coffee with people from all walks of life.

What you'll do

  • Run the full sales cycle: discovery, demo, proposal, negotiation and close.

  • Sell to Heads of Trust & Safety, community directors and studio CEOs, from indie studios to the largest gaming companies.

  • Shape Amanda around each community's problem. No two platforms have the same one.

  • Own your pipeline and your numbers. ARR is the metric that matters most.

  • Grow the customers you land. Many start with one problem and expand from there.

  • Travel to gaming and online safety conferences roughly every other month to meet customers and close deals in person.

  • Work closely with marketing, product and operations, and tell them what you hear from the market.

  • Write the playbook. There isn't one. What you learn becomes how Aiba sells.

Who you are

  • You have closed B2B software deals end to end for 3+ years.

  • You close as comfortably on a video call as across a table.

  • You build relationships as easily with suits as with gamers.

  • You act before anyone asks. Low ego, high agency.

  • You take feedback well, and you have a sense of humor. Both get used here.

  • Your English is greatexcellent, spoken and written. More languages are a plus.

A bonus, not a must: startup or scale-up experience, a background in gaming or edtech, or knowledge of Trust & Safety.

Who this isn't for

If you want a finished playbook, a fixed territory and a manager who plans your week, you won't like it here.

What you get

  • NOK 800,000+ base, plus commission paid quarterly. The more you close, the more you earn

  • A place in the equity program for key employees

  • Real impact. In a team this size, your deals visibly move the company.

  • A fast track for your commercial career, in an industry that is growing fast

  • A product you don't have to oversell. It keeps players safe, kids included.

  • Conferences around the world, a passionate team, and the usual Norwegian basics: pension, paid holiday and parental leave

How to apply

Apply on The Hub. It takes two minutes. First a short call with The Hub's team, then you meet the team at Aiba.

This is one of three commercial roles Aiba is hiring for right now. The other two, Sales Development Representative and Partnership Manager, are on The Hub too.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Aiba.ai, we provide an advanced AI-powered platform designed to elevate player safety by moderating in-game chat in real time. As the gaming industry expands globally, the need for a scalable solution to combat harmful behaviors is critical. Our platform safeguards communities against online threats such as bullying, grooming, racism, radicalization, and other harmful content. Our AI technology, developed in collaboration with the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), combines machine learning algorithms and behavioral biometrics to ensure fast detection of harmful behavior. We analyze player interactions in real time, identifying threats as they occur, even when players use slang, dialects, or emojis. Aiba.ai efficiently manages large volumes of player reports, helping developers prioritize critical issues while reducing the burden on moderation teams. This saves time and resources, ensuring swift resolution of urgent matters and improving player experience. Our platform ensures compliance with key regulatory frameworks, including COPPA and the DSA, protecting players while keeping your game in line with evolving regulations. Our solution also leverages behavioral biometrics to track patterns of behavior, identifying repeat offenders and reducing harmful interactions over time. Aiba.ai is scalable, supporting both indie games and large multiplayer platforms. Our APIs are customizable and easy to integrate into existing systems, allowing you to tailor moderation based on your needs. Additionally, our platform supports multiple languages, making it ideal for global games with diverse player bases. We provide real-time moderation across languages, ensuring all players are protected, regardless of location or language. By offering advanced moderation and behavior detection, Aiba.ai helps developers create safer, more enjoyable player experiences. We reduce the burden on moderation teams, ensure regulatory compliance, and improve the health of gaming communities. Our commitment is to provide a robust, scalable solution that protects your players and helps foster a positive gaming environment.

GENUINE is Europe’s leading TikTok Shop agency, and we’re right in the middle of the social commerce revolution. We don’t just make content. We build shopping experiences that sell, at the speed of a viral trend. We’re growing fast, and so does our Finance & Operations team.

Behind every viral LIVE and every creator campaign, a lot of money moves: platform fees, creator commissions, client payouts. You’ll help keep all of it clean, on time and under control. jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.description:
Game communities are where players make friends, build worlds and create together. Most of the harm in them comes from a handful of users. Some are bullies who drive other players away. In a game built for kids, one of them can be an adult pretending to be twelve. Aiba builds the AI that finds them before a moderator has to, so the community stays a safe place to play and create. For studios, that means happier players, higher NPS and lower churn.

Our platform is called Amanda. It moderates chat, voice and images in real time, flags grooming, bullying and fake profiles, and gives moderators the tools to act fast. Teams at MoviestarPlanet, WildWorks and Rovio (Angry Birds) use it to keep their communities safe.

The timing is on our side. Rules like the DSA and COPPA have made online safety a requirement, not a nice-to-have. Game studios and social platforms now have to solve this, and they are coming to us to do it.

We are a small team in Oslo and Gjøvik. We need the person who turns that interest into real sales conversations.

The role in short

You own the Education stage of our pipeline. Leads come in curious but cold. You warm them up, show them why Amanda fits their community, and turn the right ones into real opportunities for our Account Executives. You work from a set list of clearly defined ICP customers, so you always know where to spend your time.

Most of our pipeline starts at events. Before a conference, you fill the calendars of our management and sales team with the right meetings. Before a community dinner, you make sure the right people have a seat at the table. Afterwards, you follow up until a good conversation becomes a customer.

What you'll do

  • Nurture and warm up leads in the Education stage, and convert them into opportunities in the sales pipeline.

  • Work from a set list of clearly defined ICP customers. You'll know exactly who they are and why Amanda fits them.

  • Own our most important source of pipeline: events, conferences and community dinners around the world.

  • Book sales meetings for management and the sales team before every event.

  • Fill our community dinners with the right people.

  • Follow up after every event, so meetings and dinners turn into customers over time.

  • Work closely with our community director, and help create the marketing content that brings leads in.

  • Pick up the phone. Some outbound cold calling is part of the job, but it isn't the whole job.

Who you are

  • You have 1 to 2 years of experience as an SDR.

  • You love organizing. A packed event calendar with zero double bookings is a good week for you.

  • You write well, and you're comfortable on the phone.

  • You build relationships as easily with suits as with gamers.

  • You act before anyone asks. Low ego, high agency.

  • You take feedback well, and you have a sense of humor. Both get used here.

  • Your English is greatexcellent, spoken and written. More languages are a plus.

A bonus, not a must: startup or scale-up experience, a background in gaming or edtech, or knowledge of Trust & Safety.

Who this isn't for

If you want a pure cold-calling job, this isn't it. If you want a finished playbook and a manager who plans your week, you won't like it here either.

What you get

  • Starting at NOK 600,000+ base, plus commission paid quarterly

  • Commission on two things: how many of your sales-accepted leads become sales-qualified (SAL to SQL), and the ARR you and your AE pod sell each quarter

  • Real impact. In a team this size, the pipeline you build visibly moves the company.

  • A fast track for your commercial career, in an industry that is growing fast

  • A product you don't have to oversell. It keeps players safe, kids included.

  • Conferences around the world, a passionate team, and the usual Norwegian basics: pension, paid holiday and parental leave

How to apply

Apply on The Hub. It takes two minutes. First a short call with The Hub's team, then you meet the team at Aiba.

This is one of three commercial roles Aiba is hiring for right now. The other two, Account Executive and Partnership Manager, are on The Hub too.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

At Aiba.ai, we provide an advanced AI-powered platform designed to elevate player safety by moderating in-game chat in real time. As the gaming industry expands globally, the need for a scalable solution to combat harmful behaviors is critical. Our platform safeguards communities against online threats such as bullying, grooming, racism, radicalization, and other harmful content. Our AI technology, developed in collaboration with the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), combines machine learning algorithms and behavioral biometrics to ensure fast detection of harmful behavior. We analyze player interactions in real time, identifying threats as they occur, even when players use slang, dialects, or emojis. Aiba.ai efficiently manages large volumes of player reports, helping developers prioritize critical issues while reducing the burden on moderation teams. This saves time and resources, ensuring swift resolution of urgent matters and improving player experience. Our platform ensures compliance with key regulatory frameworks, including COPPA and the DSA, protecting players while keeping your game in line with evolving regulations. Our solution also leverages behavioral biometrics to track patterns of behavior, identifying repeat offenders and reducing harmful interactions over time. Aiba.ai is scalable, supporting both indie games and large multiplayer platforms. Our APIs are customizable and easy to integrate into existing systems, allowing you to tailor moderation based on your needs. Additionally, our platform supports multiple languages, making it ideal for global games with diverse player bases. We provide real-time moderation across languages, ensuring all players are protected, regardless of location or language. By offering advanced moderation and behavior detection, Aiba.ai helps developers create safer, more enjoyable player experiences. We reduce the burden on moderation teams, ensure regulatory compliance, and improve the health of gaming communities. Our commitment is to provide a robust, scalable solution that protects your players and helps foster a positive gaming environment.

jobs.title: har du erfaring med anbud, og liker å skrive tilbud som vinner?
jobs.description:
I Prima Assistanse jobber vi hver dag for at mennesker med funksjonsnedsettelser skal kunne delta i samfunnet på lik linje med alle andre, gjennom BPA (brukerstyrt personlig assistanse). Vi kaller det frihet til å leve. Vi er en betydelig aktør i et voksende marked, med en omsetning på ca. 800 MNOK, 11 kontorer over hele landet og 4000 assistenter. Vi har det gøy på jobb, og verdiene våre er humor, tillit, fleksibilitet og lagarbeid. Svært sentralt for oss er å utvikle det gode arbeidsmiljøet. Når folkene våre er fornøyde, blir kundene det også.

Stillingen som anbudskonsulent

Anbud og konsesjoner fra kommunene er et av Prima Assistanses viktigste satsingsområder. Vi deltar i 20–30 anbudskonkurranser/konsesjonsutlysninger i året, og kvaliteten på tilbudene våre er avgjørende for om vi vinner. Som anbudskonsulent blir du en av to i anbudsteamet og får selvstendig ansvar for egne tilbudsprosesser, fra gjennomgang av konkurransegrunnlaget til ferdig levert tilbud.

 

Skriving er kjernen i jobben. Du analyserer konkurransegrunnlag og kravspesifikasjoner og skriver besvarelser som svarer presist på krav og tildelingskriterier, gjerne med korte frister og begrenset sideantall. Du henter inn kunnskap fra ledere og fagpersoner i organisasjonen og gjør den om til tekst som er konkret, etterprøvbar og overbevisende for kommunens evalueringsteam. Du tilpasser og videreutvikler eksisterende tekster til hver konkurranse og kvalitetssikrer helheten før levering.

Hovedoppgaver

  • Planlegge, lede og gjennomføre konsesjons- og anbudsprosesser fra A til Å
  • Tolke konkurransegrunnlag og identifisere krav, muligheter og risikoer
  • Skrive treffsikre besvarelser som får frem våre konkurransefortrinn
  • Bidra til å utvikle gode og effektive tilbudsprosesser
  • Følge opp kontrakter etter tildeling

I tillegg bidrar du i arbeidet med selskapet kvalitetsarbeid (ISO), blant annet med internrevisjoner, og med likestillingsredegjørelse og åpenhetsrapport. Du rapporterer til leder for virksomhetsstyring.

Vi tror du har

  • Minst to års erfaring med offentlige anbud, som tilbyder, hos en offentlig oppdragsgiver eller i et rådgivningsmiljø
  • God forståelse for anskaffelsesregelverket
  • Høyere utdanning eller tilsvarende erfaring
  • Svært god skriftlig fremstillingsevne på norsk
  • En strukturert og analytisk tilnærming
  • Evne til å holde oversikt når flere frister sammenfaller
  • Konkurranseinstinkt og lyst til å vinne

Som ansatt i Prima Assistanse får du

  • Ansvar for viktige prosjekter i et selskap som satser på anbud
  • En erfaren anbudsansvarlig å lære av og sparre med
  • En profesjonell anbudsprosess med tidlig involvering av fagfolk og gjennomgang av hver evaluering
  • Muligheten til å påvirke prosesser gjennom for eksempel nye verktøy som AI
  • En jobb der suksess bidrar til at flere mennesker får frihet til å leve livet sitt slik de ønsker
  • Et uformelt og sosialt arbeidsmiljø med høy trivsel
  • Fine kontorlokaler på Brynseng med gode kollektivløsninger og egen parkering
  • Lønn etter kompetanse og erfaring

Synes du dette høres spennende ut? Vi gjør løpende intervjuer, så send søknaden din så snart som mulig. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

I Prima Assistanse ser vi stor verdi av å være en mangfoldig organisasjon. Derfor ønsker vi at du uavhengig av etnisitet, alder, kjønn, legning, funksjonsnedsettelse, utdanning eller bakgrunn søker på jobb hos oss. Gjennom verdiene våre "humor, tillit, fleksibilitet og lagarbeid" jobber vi hver dag for at alle skal få frihet til å leve! BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. Vi jobber hver dag for å bidra til at funksjonshemmede får den friheten og assistansen som er nødvendig for å kunne leve et selvstendig liv. Vi er opptatt av å levere et godt konsept, kvalitet i alle ledd, å ha profesjonelle medarbeidere og gode rutiner, slik at vi sammen bidrar til en suksessfull hverdag. For mer informasjon: www.prima-assistanse.no

jobs.title: Commissioning Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Fossefall is building the infrastructure needed to power Europe's AI future. As our GPU and AI data centre projects move from design and procurement into construction, testing and operational readiness, we need a Commissioning Manager who can turn our commissioning strategy into a coordinated, evidence-based delivery plan.

Reporting to the VP Commissioning, you will lead owner-side project commissioning from design review and factory testing through installation verification, start-up, integrated systems testing and handover. You will connect engineering, construction, suppliers, Operations and IT delivery, identify gaps early and provide clear recommendations on readiness and acceptance. The role is based in Oslo with a hybrid working model and regular travel to project sites and supplier facilities.

What you'll do

  • Develop and maintain the project Commissioning Plan, scope, schedule, resource plan and readiness gates, integrated with construction, utility availability and phased delivery.

  • Review designs and supplier documentation for testability, maintainability and operational requirements.

  • Coordinate the full L1-L5 commissioning process: factory testing, installation QA/QC and static tests, start-up and pre-functional checks, system or module SAT and integrated systems testing.

  • Review and coordinate test method statements, scripts, load profiles, acceptance criteria, sequences of operation and cause-and-effect coverage with engineering SMEs, contractors, OEMs and the independent Commissioning Authority where appointed.

  • Secure test prerequisites, including permanent or temporary power, load banks, thermal loads, cooling readiness, water quality, calibrated instruments, controls connectivity and safe working arrangements.

  • Coordinate electrical, mechanical and liquid-cooling systems, BMS, EPMS and DCIM, fire and life safety, security and ICT/OT interfaces. Align facility readiness with rack, server, cluster and platform delivery leads.

  • Use Omega365 as the system of record for commissioning scope, checklists, test evidence, digital sign-off, punch and NCR status, retests and readiness reporting.

  • Manage commissioning risks, blockers, changes and deferred tests. Escalate failed acceptance criteria and readiness gaps with clear evidence and recommended actions.

  • Prepare readiness recommendations, including RFC before L4, RFS following successful integrated systems testing and RFT after the agreed IT and service-validation scope.

  • Coordinate Operations training, O&M deliverables, handover, the final commissioning report and the outstanding-item register.

About you

  • Typically 5+ years of experience in commissioning or delivery of complex technical facilities, including responsibility for multidisciplinary commissioning.

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation, Energy Systems or a related technical discipline. Equivalent practical experience from commissioning complex technical facilities may compensate for formal education.

  • Strong working knowledge of power and cooling infrastructure, controls integration, functional testing, failure scenarios and integrated systems testing.

  • Experience leading contractors, OEMs and specialist test teams through clear plans, responsibilities, decisions and escalation, including teams without a direct reporting line.

  • The judgement to challenge test methods, assess evidence, manage cross-discipline interfaces and make clear recommendations on system readiness.

  • A structured, pragmatic and decisive working style. You communicate technical risks clearly and follow issues through to verified closure.

  • Fluent professional English, both written and spoken, and willingness to travel and work on site during critical testing periods.

  • Experience from owner-side commissioning in data centres or other mission-critical environments, modular facilities, GPU or AI infrastructure, liquid cooling or first-of-kind systems would be valuable. So would experience with Omega365 or comparable digital commissioning tools, Norwegian or another Scandinavian language and a relevant commissioning or project management certification, but none of these is required.

What success looks like

Within the first few months, project commissioning is governed by a clear and trusted plan, testing is prepared before site execution and readiness decisions are supported by complete, traceable evidence. Engineering, construction, suppliers, Operations and IT delivery understand their responsibilities and interfaces. Risks are surfaced early, defects and deferred tests are controlled and handover is completed without avoidable gaps between facility readiness and technology deployment.

Why Fossefall?

This is an opportunity to shape owner-side commissioning capability while Fossefall's AI infrastructure portfolio is being built. You will work across the physical and digital layers of high-performance AI facilities, influence how projects move from construction into reliable operation and collaborate with specialists across engineering, project delivery, operations and technology.

We are still small enough for individual judgement and ownership to matter. You will have room to improve how we work, contribute to critical delivery decisions and help build repeatable commissioning practices for future projects.

About Fossefall

Fossefall is a Nordic AI infrastructure company founded in 2025. We develop and operate AI factories powered by renewable energy, turning clean Nordic power into scalable, sovereign computing capacity for Europe, built in partnership with local communities, energy producers and technology leaders across the world. As a team, we are still small enough to know each other as people, and our culture is shaped by ownership, curiosity, warmth and collaboration.

Interested?

Make sure your CV is up to date for this role and tell us briefly why this opportunity is interesting to you and how your experience connects to what we are looking for. We review applications as they come in and keep the role open until we find the right colleague. Due to the nature of our business, background checks and/or security clearance may be required as part of the employment process.

Role Overview

Provide regional quality leadership for Civil, Structural and Architectural (CSA) works across multiple data center projects. Reporting to the Head of Quality, the role establishes consistent quality practices, checks their implementation through site audits and surveillance, and verifies that findings are properly closed.

Work with project management, site QA/QC, engineering, package teams and subcontractors to prevent recurring defects, reduce rework and maintain the inspection and test evidence needed for area handover and project completion.

Scope

  • Cover CSA works and associated quality records across the assigned regional portfolio, including new build, fit-out and external works.

  • Maintain inspection templates, audit arrangements and evidence requirements aligned with CTS procedures, approved designs and project specifications.

  • Provide functional support to site QA/QC teams and intervene early where inspections, workmanship or closeout are falling short.

Key CSA Experience

  • Experience should cover the following areas, as applicable to the assigned project scope:

  • Civil works: earthworks, formation and compaction, piling and foundations, underground drainage and services, roads, slabs and hard standing.

  • Concrete: reinforcement, cover, formwork, embedded items and anchor bolts, placement, compaction, curing, test records, surveys and controlled repairs.

  • Structural works: steelwork and precast installation, connections, welding and bolting records, tolerances, grouting and protective coatings.

  • Building envelope: roofing, cladding, waterproofing, insulation, air and vapour barriers, seals and specified performance testing.

  • Architectural works: partitions, ceilings, doors, raised floors, floor finishes, coatings and workmanship standards.

  • Passive fire protection: compartmentation, firestopping, fire doors and structural fire protection, including installation traceability and inspection before concealment.

  • MEP interfaces: openings, penetrations, builders' work, equipment bases, access provisions, room condition and cleanliness for area handover.

Key Accountabilities

  • Own the regional CSA audit plan, with site visits and surveillance targeted at project risk, critical activities and recurring defects.

  • Audit subcontractor quality plans, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and inspection arrangements to confirm they are in place before relevant work starts.

  • Verify that site teams establish benchmarks and first-of-kind installations, obtain the required acceptance and use them to maintain workmanship standards.

  • Check that hold and witness points are planned, notified and recorded, and that required releases are obtained from the authorized parties before work proceeds.

  • Priorities work that will become inaccessible, including concrete pours, backfilling, enclosed cavities, firestopping and building-envelope interfaces.

  • Issue clear audit findings against the applicable requirements. Agree action owners and due dates and verify closeout using objective evidence.

  • Challenge recurring defects and non-conformance reports (NCRs), require root-cause investigation and check that corrective actions prevent recurrence across projects.

  • Escalate significant quality risks and overdue actions to project leadership and the Head of Quality. Recommend work holds where required under agreed project procedures.

  • Check that project programmers allow time for inspections, internal and client walkdowns, snagging, repairs and verification before area handover.

  • Report regional performance, repeat defects and emerging risks to the Head of Quality, with clear actions and support required.

Core Responsibilities

  • Run weekly or fortnightly quality reviews with site teams covering audit actions, NCRs, inspection status, upcoming hold points and handover constraints.

  • Sample installed works against current issued-for-construction drawings, approved technical submittals, specifications and accepted benchmarks.

  • Review material certification, delivery and storage controls, survey results, test records and equipment calibration, checking traceability to the work inspected.

  • Verify that concrete defects, water ingress, coating failures and other non-conformities follow an agreed repair process, with required technical approvals and inspection evidence.

  • Work with Mechanical and Electrical Quality Leads to check that shared interfaces and area handover requirements have clear inspection responsibilities.

  • Review CSA handover records in ACC/BIM 360 or the project document system, including completed ITPs, test results, as-built records and relevant warranties.

  • Coach site teams, share practical lessons and issue quality bulletins to improve inspection quality and prevent repeat problems.

Role Interfaces and Authority

  • The role provides regional assurance and functional guidance through project management and site QA/QC teams. Site teams and subcontractors remain responsible for carrying out the work, day-to-day inspections, corrective actions and maintaining their records.

  • Design decisions, technical submittal approvals and acceptance of design changes or remedial solutions remain with the appointed engineering and approval authorities. Hold-point releases and client acceptance follow the agreed project procedures. The CSA Quality Manager checks that the required approvals and evidence are in place and escalates unresolved concerns.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Degree or diploma in Civil or Structural Engineering, Construction Management or a related discipline, or equivalent practical construction experience.

  • Proven experience in a lead CSA QA/QC role on complex construction projects, with data center or other mission-critical experience strongly preferred.

  • Sound practical knowledge of civil, structural and architectural construction methods, workmanship standards, inspection requirements and common defects.

  • Ability to interpret drawings, specifications and approved submittals, identify departures from requirements and support evidence-based resolution.

  • Experience planning and conducting construction audits, investigating NCRs, verifying corrective actions and reporting trends across projects.

  • Working knowledge of quality management systems and ISO 9001 principles. Internal or Lead Auditor training, or equivalent, is desirable.

  • Confident using ACC/BIM 360 or equivalent systems for inspections, issues, document control and handover evidence.

  • Clear communication and the confidence to challenge weak evidence, coach site teams and follow actions through to verified closure.

  • Experience across multiple sites or international projects is desirable.

Measures of Success

  • Audit actions and NCRs closed within agreed dates, supported by verified evidence.

  • Fewer repeat defects and improved inspection acceptance at the first submission.

  • Required inspections and hold-point releases completed before works are covered or progressed.

  • Complete, traceable CSA handover records and fewer outstanding quality issues at area handover.

jobs.description:
Stillingen er organisert i Mestring og aktivitet, i enhet Tjenester til hjemmeboende.

Vår tjeneste har 3 fysioterapeuter, 4 ergoterapeuter og kartleggings –og hverdagsmestringsteam med en fysioterapeut, en ergoterapeut og en sykepleier. I tillegg består virksomheten av dagsenter for eldre og personer med demens, praktisk bistand, demenskoordinator, kreftkoordinator, to allmennkliniske sykepleiere og næringsdrivende fysioterapeuter.

Vi har ledig følgende stilling: 

  • Ergoterapeut – 100 % vikariat 

Ledig fra: d.d. – 31.08.2027, med mulighet for forlengelse 

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Ergoterapi til brukere over 18 år.
  • Vurdering og iverksetting og evaluering av tiltak for egenmestring i hjemmet eller institusjon.
  • Kartlegging av innbyggere som søker om helsetjenester
  • Tilrettelegging av brukers hjemmeforhold, herunder utprøving, søking, formidling og tilpasning av tekniske hjelpemidler.
  • Bistå med fallforebyggende treningsgrupper.
  • Tverrfaglig oppfølging med utgangspunkt i brukerens egne mål.
  • Funksjonsvurdering og ADL-trening.
  • Undervisning og veiledning av brukere, pårørende og kollegaer. 

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Autorisert ergoterapeut.
  • Ønskelig med formal og/eller realkompetanse innenfor rehabilitering av voksne.
  • Erfaring fra tverrfaglig samarbeid.
  • God skriftlig og muntlig kommunikasjon, tilsvarende nivå C1.
  • Førerkort klasse B. 

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Vi ønsker medarbeidere som er motiverte, engasjerte og som kan bidra til god kvalitet i tjenesten.
  • Fleksibilitet og omstillingsevne vektlegges høyt.
  • Gode kommunikasjons –og samarbeidsevner, men evner også å jobbe selvstendig. 

Vi tilbyr:

  • Gode forsikrings- og pensjonsordninger.
  • Godt arbeidsmiljø og hyggelige kollegaer.
  • Fleksitid.

Personlig egnethet blir vektlagt ved alle ansettelser.

Politiattest må framlegges før tiltredelse.

Vår visjon er muligheter, miljø og mangfold. Sammen gjør vi det umulige mulig, velger grønt først og lar ulikhetene forme vår felles fremtid. Vi har et ansvar for fortid, nåtid og skaper et samfunn i takt med sin samtid, og vi legger til rette for at Aurskog-Høland er et godt sted å leve, bo og arbeide. 

Våre verdier som ligger til grunn for alt arbeid som skjer i kommunen er; Åpenhet, Tillit og Samhandling. 

Vår kommune har fokus på et inkluderende arbeidsliv og er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet. Likeverd, likestilling og mangfold er en del av kulturen vår, og vi har nulltoleranse for diskriminerende praksis og oppførsel.   

Etter søknadsfristen vil det bli utarbeidet en offentlig søkerliste, i samsvar med Offentleglova § 25. Vi gjør oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkeren kan bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har bedt om ikke å bli oppført på den offentlige søkerlisten. Søkere vil bli varslet i forkant dersom anmodning om unntak fra offentlighet ikke tas til følge. 

Alle attester/tjenestebevis og vitnemål må lastes opp sammen med søknad og CV i rekrutteringsportalen, EasyCruit innen søknadsfristen. Har du utdanning fra utlandet legger du ved godkjenning fra HK-dir. https://hkdir.no/utdanning-fra-utlandet. 

Ønskes ytterligere opplysninger om stillingen, ta gjerne kontakt med virksomhetsleder Kristin Kollerud Bjerke, tlf.: 907 29 127.

Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kommunen ligger under en time fra Oslo, Gardermoen og Charlottenberg, og kun 30 minutter fra Lillestrøm og store deler av Romerike. Vi er Oslos nærmeste villmark med et rikt dyreliv og et flott kulturlandskap, og med flere tettsteder der Bjørkelangen er kommunesenteret. Aurskog-Høland kommune er en fremtidsrettet organisasjon der medarbeiderne er den viktigste ressursen for at vi skal lykkes i å skape det mangfoldige og gode liv for våre innbyggere og gjester. Det gjør vi best sammen, og som ansatt er vi opptatt av å gi deg ansvar og spennende arbeidsoppgaver, samtidig som vi legger til rette for faglig utvikling. Aurskog-Høland ble som én av tre kommuner nominert som Årets kulturkommune 2023-2024, ligger på første plass på Romerike i saksbehandling av byggesaker, og havnet i 2022 på 14. plass over landets best styrte kommuner. Vi ønsker oss flere initiativrike og dyktige medarbeidere som setter pris på å bli utfordret og som aktivt bidrar i løsningen av kommunens oppgaver. Vi er en kommune i vekst. Det gir oss mange muligheter i tiden fremover. Vi kan tilby spennende og utviklende oppgaver.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a Data Engineer to develop, maintain and improve the data infrastructure and backend services supporting our RE:Flex platform.The role involves working with real-time IoT data, cloud infrastructure, databases and data pipelines to ensure reliable data collection, processing, storage and delivery.You will work closely with backend developers, DevOps engineers, machine learning engineers and other teams across the business, operations and finance. Alongside hands-on development, you will contribute to technical improvements, code reviews, troubleshooting, documentation and knowledge sharing.Key ResponsibilitiesData Engineering and Pipelines    Develop and maintain Python-based services for collecting and processing data from connected energy devices, including battery systems and meters.    Build and improve real-time and batch data pipelines using MQTT, Google Cloud Pub/Sub and other messaging technologies.    Integrate data from external APIs, energy market platforms and other relevant data sources.    Implement data validation, error handling, retry mechanisms and safe backfilling to improve data quality and reliability.    Develop and maintain data processing workflows, including aggregation and transformation of time-series data.Backend Development and Cloud Infrastructure    Develop and maintain backend APIs and services for accessing real-time and historical platform data.    Work with databases and storage solutions such as BigQuery, TimescaleDB, PostgreSQL and MongoDB, depending on application requirements.    Develop, deploy and maintain containerised applications using Docker and Kubernetes.    Contribute to cloud infrastructure improvements, primarily within Google Cloud Platform.    Support integrations between data services, backend applications and other platform components.Data Quality, Monitoring and Reliability    Monitor data pipelines, database performance and service reliability using tools such as Grafana and cloud monitoring services.    Investigate data inconsistencies, missing records, processing failures and other production issues.    Improve data processing performance, scalability and operational stability.    Implement appropriate data quality checks, logging, monitoring and alerting.    Support incident investigation, troubleshooting and implementation of technical fixes.Energy Market and Business Data    Support data processing and integration for energy market operations, including market prices, schedules, measurements and settlement information.    Develop and maintain data workflows used for operational reporting, revenue calculations and customer invoicing.    Work with market operations, finance and other business teams to understand data requirements and resolve discrepancies.    Help ensure data consistency and traceability across relevant systems and integrations.Technical Collaboration and Documentation    Participate in technical planning, architecture discussions and code reviews.    Coordinate with backend, DevOps, machine learning and other engineering teams on data-related implementations.    Support onboarding and knowledge sharing with other engineers.    Maintain technical documentation, data flow descriptions and operational procedures.    Contribute to continuous improvements in development practices, deployment processes and platform reliability.Required Qualifications    Relevant education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.    At least 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, backend development or a related software engineering role.    Strong programming skills in Python and good knowledge of SQL.    Experience developing data pipelines, backend services and REST APIs.    Experience working with relational or NoSQL databases and cloud-based data processing.    Familiarity with messaging systems, streaming data or asynchronous processing.    Practical experience with Docker and cloud infrastructure.    Understanding of software development practices, version control, testing and debugging.    Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical teams.    Professional working proficiency in English.Meriting Experience    Google Cloud Platform, particularly Pub/Sub, BigQuery and Cloud Storage.    MQTT, IoT telemetry or real-time data processing.    TimescaleDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or other time-series and NoSQL databases.    Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation.    Dagster, Airflow or similar data orchestration tools.    Monitoring and observability tools such as Grafana and Prometheus.    Experience with data reconciliation, reporting or invoicing integrations.    Knowledge of battery energy storage systems, energy flexibility services or Nordic electricity markets.    Experience supporting technical onboarding, documentation or cross-team coordination.What We Offer    The opportunity to contribute to Sweden's energy transition through real-world energy technology solutions.    Hands-on experience working with real-time data, cloud infrastructure and distributed energy systems.    A collaborative engineering environment with opportunities to contribute to technical decisions and platform improvements.    The opportunity to work across data engineering, backend development and energy market applications.

jobs.title: Spamedarbetare massör, hudterapeut eller spaterapeut Dalecarlia Hotel & Spa

Du har ett genuint intresse för människor och för ditt yrke. Du är serviceinriktad, lyhörd och har förmågan att skapa en lugn och trygg känsla för varje gäst. Du är en lagspelare som är flexibel, ordningsam och tar ansvar för helheten, från behandlingen till att spaet alltid är välkomnande och välskött. Hos oss är du delaktig, och dina idéer och din kunskap är värdefulla när vi utvecklar vårt erbjudande.Vi erbjuder En unik arbetsplats i en vacker miljö vid Siljan, ett engagerat team med stark gemenskap och möjlighet att utvecklas inom verksamheten.Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Kvalitetssamordnare till Hessleby som vill bidra till förändring
jobs.description: Statens institutionsstyrelse, SiS, är en myndighet som ansvarar för individuellt anpassad tvångsvård för ungdomar med komplex psykosocial problematik och för vuxna med missbruk.  SiS verkställer även sluten ungdomsvård. Det gör vi på ungdomshem och hem för vuxna med missbruk, över hela landet. Hos oss på SiS blir ditt arbetsliv en spännande utmaning. Oavsett var i vår organisation du arbetar, eller vilken tjänst du har, hjälper du till att skapa livsviktig förändring. SiS LVM-hem Hessleby som ligger i vacker skogsmiljö strax utanför Mariannelund tar emot män med alkohol-, narkotika- eller blandmissbruk . Vi har särskild kompetens för att ta emot klienter med psykisk ohälsa eller ett utåtagerande beteende. Vi har i uppdrag att bedriva vård för klienter med särskilda vårdbehov. ArbetsbeskrivningVill du vara med och bidra till en tryggare och mer rättssäker vårdmiljö för våra klienter? Sök jobbet som kvalitetssamordnare! Rollen som kvalitetssamordnare är ny inom SiS och syftet med rollen är att stärka hemmets förmåga att bedriva ett proaktivt, rättssäkert och systematiskt kvalitetsarbete. Ditt uppdrag blir att bidra till att kvaliteten i verksamheten utvecklas långsiktigt.Konkret innebär det:    Att hålla ihop och samordna hemmets systematiska kvalitetsarbete så att tidiga signaler om brister fångas upp och omsätts i förbättringsarbete.    Stötta hemmets chefer i hanteringen av avvikelser såsom lex Lex Sarah- IVO och JO- ärenden och bidra till att rättssäkra processer tillämpas i utredningsarbetet.    Stötta cheferna i hemmets arbete med att implementera nya styrdokument, metoder och arbetssätt.Rollen innebär att du arbetar självständigt men i nära samarbete med hemmets ledningsgrupp. Du kommer också att ingå i ett nätverk av kvalitetssamordnare på myndighetens alla hem, med möjlighet till dialog och erfarenhetsutbyte.KvalifikationerFör att trivas och lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har ett stort engagemang för kvalitetsfrågor med fokus på [barns, ungas och klienters]rättigheter. Du är analytisk, strukturerad och noggrann med god förmåga att driva och hålla ihop processer. Du har integritet med en god förmåga att balansera mellan stödjande och granskande roll. Vidare har du en god förmåga att arbeta självständigt samtidigt som du är kommunikativ och pedagogisk, för att kunna stötta chefer och medarbetare i utvecklingen av hemmets kvalitetsarbete.Du ska även ha:    Akademisk examen inom socialt arbete, beteendevetenskap eller motsvarande akademisk utbildning i kombination med arbetslivserfarenhet som vi bedömer är likvärdig    Erfarenhet av att arbeta med systematiskt kvalitetsarbete i verksamhet som regleras av SOSFS 2011:9    Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift.Det är meriterande om du också har:    Kunskap om förvaltningsrätt, lex Sarah och regelverk kopplat till tillsyn    Erfarenhet av att arbeta med behandling/HVB    Goda kunskaper om och erfarenhet av i datainsamling, dokumentation och analys.På SiS månar vi om ett gott medarbetarskap. Det innebär att du som medarbetare tar ansvar för ditt arbete, bidrar till utveckling och medverkar till ett gott samarbete. Läs mer om https://www.stat-inst.se/jobba-hos-oss/medarbetarskap-och-ledarskap/.Anställning: Tjänsten är ett vikariat på heltid tom 2027-08-31. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Välkommen att registrera din ansökan i vårt rekryteringsverktyg senast den 2026-12-13Tester och arbetsprover kan komma att ingå i rekryteringsprocessen. SiS arbetar aktivt mot all form av diskriminering och välkomnar alla sökande. För arbete på våra institutioner gör SiS registerkontroll innan anställning. Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Statens institutionsstyrelse tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande. OBS! Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ska du inte söka via rekryteringssystemet. Kontakta i stället den som står som kontaktperson i annonsen.

jobs.title: Machine operator
jobs.description: Plats: Kungälv, SverigeSkift: KvällsskiftVi har valt att göra något extraordinärt. Vi transformerar vår verksamhet i grunden och bygger vår framtid på ett tydligt syfte – att leverera en rökfri framtid. Swedish Match är ett dotterbolag till PMI och har varit en ledande aktör i branschen i över 200 år. Vi söker nu maskinoperatörer som ska övervaka produktionslinjer som förpackar nikotinprodukter i vår fabrik i Kungälv. Tjänsterna är tidsbegränsade med tillträde planerat till början av 2027. Du erbjuds ett betydelsefullt, roligt och stimulerande arbete med förmånliga anställningsvillkor. Du får möjlighet att arbeta på kvällsskiftet som består av inspirerande och kunniga kollegor. Om tjänstenSom maskinoperatör arbetar du med övervakning av produktionslinjen som förpackar snus och nikotinprodukter. I arbetet ingår även att genomföra kvalitetskontroller av produkterna, avhjälpa lättare fel samt påfyllning och beställning av material. Tillsammans med ditt arbetslag förväntas du att arbeta mot uppsatta mål för laget och avdelningen. Ansvarsområden och arbetsuppgifter    Säkerställa en stabil och effektiv produktion genom kontinuerlig övervakning av produktionslinjer.    Minimera produktionsstopp genom snabb felsökning och åtgärd av enklare maskinfel.    Beställa och fylla på material för att säkerställa ett jämnt produktionsflöde.    Bidra till en säker arbetsmiljö genom att följa säkerhetsrutiner och identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter.    Samarbeta med övriga produktionsavdelningar för att säkerställa ett smidigt produktionsflöde och nå uppsatta mål KvalifikationerKrav    Slutförd gymnasieutbildning, meriterande med teknisk inriktning.    Flytande i svenska, både i tal och skrift.    God datorvana och erfarenhet av Microsoft Office.    Fyllt 18 år.Meriterande    Erfarenhet som maskinoperatör inom livsmedels- eller tillverkningsindustrin.    Kunskaper inom maskindrift och enklare maskinunderhåll. Personliga egenskaper    Du trivs med att arbeta i team och samarbetar väl med andra personer.    Du kan arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter.    Du är flexibel och du kan skifta mellan olika prioriteringar i arbetet när det behövs.    Du har förmåga att hantera flera arbetsuppgifter samtidigt och har lätt för att lära dig nya arbetsuppgifter och rutiner.    Du är lösningsorienterad och är van vid att följa arbetsinstruktioner noggrant. RekryteringsprocessVi söker nu personer till tidsbegränsad anställning på heltid fram till och med 30 april, med möjlighet till förlängning. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande, så skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Som en del i vårt rekryteringsarbete genomgår våra slutkandidater en bakgrundskontroll, detta för att öka kännedomen om våra framtida medarbetare.

No certification needed. Languages will be tested during the recruitment day.Experience in classical and modern dance will be valued.A valid European passport.Enthusiastic, open-minded and team-oriented! jobs.title: Folkhögskollärare/gymnasielärare inom samhällskunskap och svenska
jobs.description: Din arbetsplatsIngesunds folkhögskola är en av Region Värmlands fem folkhögskolor och har cirka 150 studerande och cirka 30 anställda. Skolan har ett varierat kursutbud och erbjuder studier inom profilområdet musik, hantverk samt inom behörighetsgivande kurser på grund- och gymnasienivå. Skolan erbjuder en stimulerande arbetsmiljö där folkhögskolans idé och pedagogik ger stor frihet i det pedagogiska arbetet.Det finns kollektivtrafik till arbetsplatsen, men på grund av dess geografiska läge är tillgängligheten begränsad. Du behöver därför ha möjlighet att ta dig till och från arbetsplatsen i enlighet med arbetstidens förläggning.Dina arbetsuppgifterSom ämneslärare i samhällskunskap och i kombination med svenska ansvarar du för undervisning på Allmän kurs 1-3. På Allmän kurs kan de studerande läsa in både grundläggande och särskilda behörigheter till högskola och yrkeshögskola samt förbättra sina kunskaper i det svenska språket.Det kan även bli aktuellt att undervisa på uppdragsutbildningar som anordnas i samarbete med Arbetsförmedlingen och andra externa aktörer.Du ingår i kursens arbetslag och deltar i planering, utvecklingsarbete, antagningsprocesser, utvärderingar och kvalitetsarbete. Du är även med och organiserar skolgemensamma aktiviteter. Det är viktigt att du sätter kursdeltagarnas utveckling och behov i centrum och arbetar social- och specialpedagogiskt för att stärka kursdeltagarnas självtillit.Dina kunskaper och kompetenserVi söker dig som har pedagogisk och ämnesmässig kompetens samt folkhögskollärarexamen eller gymnasielärarexamen. Du har erfarenhet av, och trivs med, att undervisa unga vuxna med funktionsvariationer som är i behov av extra stöd.Vi är intresserade av dig som tycker om utmaningar i arbetet och som stimuleras av en flexibel miljö. Du är kreativ och ser möjligheter i nya arbetssätt och pedagogiska metoder. Du har god pedagogisk insikt och anpassar undervisningen utifrån deltagarnas olika behov och förutsättningar. Du trivs med att samarbeta i lärarlag, bygger förtroendefulla relationer och möter andra med lyhördhet och respekt. Vi värdesätter ett engagerat, lösningsorienterat och professionellt förhållningssätt.Vi ser det som meriterande om du har erfarenhet av och god kännedom om folkhögskolans pedagogik, metodik och utbildningsform. Tidigare arbete på folkhögskola samt specialpedagogisk kompetens är också meriterande. Om Region VärmlandVi är till för att alla som bor här ska må bra och för att vår region ska vara attraktiv och konkurrenskraftig. Vi gör skillnad inom hälso- och sjukvård, tandvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och kultur och bildning. Vi möter människor i livets största stunder och i alla de där vardagsögonblicken där emellan. Vår vision är livskvalitet i världsklass. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss och våra förmåner och följ oss på sociala medier. Vill du också jobba för alla i Värmland? Välkommen med din ansökan. ÖvrigtFrån 7 juni 2026 gäller EU:s lönetransparensdirektiv - för ökad öppenhet och rättvisa löner. Information om kollektivavtal finns på SKR:s webbplats, Kollektivavtal -SKRI samband med eventuell anställning kan vi komma att be dig som sökande att lämna ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister. Inför anställning inom psykiatrisk vård, vård av funktionshindrade, vård av barn eller ungdomar gör arbetsgivaren en kontroll i polisens misstanke och belastningsregister. Ett utslag i detta register kan komma att påverka din möjlighet till anställning.Har du skyddad identitet och vill göra en ansökan ber vi dig att kontakta Kompetensförsörjningsenhet HR via Regionens växel 010-831 50 00. Då får du hjälp att lämna in din ansökan utan att den hanteras i Varbi. Tänk på att endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Region Värmland tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

Våra kunder finns i hela Sverige och Norge och främst inom tillverkande industri och verkstadsindustri. Vi arbetar med ett brett utbud av tjänster, både för kollektivanställda och tjänstemän. Tack vare långsiktigheten i våra uppdrag har många en tryggad anställning på Ikett. Detta har lett till att flera anställda har jobbat hos Ikett i 20+ år. Under den tiden har de fått utvecklas, testa flera uppdrag med en trygg arbetsgivare i ryggen. Ofta är målsättningen att det ska leda till anställning hos kund.På Ikett finns det möjlighet att arbeta lokalt i ditt närområde, men även spännande resejobb i hela Sverige och Norge för dig som vill ut på resande fot.Hos oss får du:Engagerad personal genom hela rekryteringsprocessen som även har kontakt med dig när du börjar jobba hos vår kund.Trygghet där vi värnar om din säkerhet på arbetsplatsen.Möjlighet till utveckling.Målet med vårt arbete är nöjda kunder och skickliga medarbetare som trivs. Ikett är medlem i Almega Kompetensföretagen och har kollektivavtal med LO, Unionen och Akademikerförbunden. jobs.title: Intresseanmälan lokalvårdare Kommunfastigheter, Kumla kommun
jobs.description: Detta är en öppen intresseanmälan för att arbeta som lokalvårdare inom Kommunfastigheter, Kumla kommun. Genom att lämna en intresseanmälan registrerar du ditt intresse för framtida uppdrag hos oss. Vi rekryterar löpande när behov uppstår, men det finns inte alltid ett aktuellt vikariat att erbjuda vid ansökningstillfället. När behov finns kan vi komma att kontakta dig.Inom Kumla kommun har vi två lokalvårdsenheter med ca 25 medarbetare i varje enhet. Lokalvårdsenheterna tillhör Kommunfastigheter som ingår i Samhällsbyggnadsförvaltningen. Vi utför lokalvård i kommunens fastigheter såsom skolor, förskolor, idrottsanläggningar, offentliga verksamheter och äldreboenden.Du är representant för kommunfastigheter i den dagliga kontakten med våra hyresgäster och bör därför ha en naturlig förmåga att skapa och upprätthålla goda kontakter.1 plats(er). ARBETSUPPGIFTERDu förväntas genom god lokalvård tillse att fastigheterna ger ett gott och välvårdat intryck, både in- och utvändigt för att skapa en god och trivsam miljö för våra hyresgäster. På de allra flesta objekt har vi en kombiskurmaskin som ingår i det dagliga arbetet.Förutom daglig lokalvård innefattar tjänsten viss fastighetsskötsel som innebär till exempel byte av ljuskällor, lokala avloppsstopp, snöskottning och sandning eller tillsyn av fastigheter.KVALIFIKATIONERVi söker dig som har någon form av lokalvårdsutbildning eller några års erfarenhet som lokalvårdare. Du har lätt för att uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska. Du har ett genuint intresse för lokalvård och är öppen för förändringar.Du trivs med kundkontakter och bemöter hyresgäster och övriga på ett professionellt sätt. För att trivas i rollen behöver du vara ansvarstagande, flexibel och självständig. Det är av stor vikt att du kan planera ditt dagliga arbete, vara självgående och se vad som behöver göras och kunna prioritera om, när det behövs.  Det är meriterande om du har B-körkort för manuell växellåda, är cykelkunnig och har digitala kunskaper i Officepaketet. Om du har SRY-certifikat samt kunskaper om golvvård är detta även meriterande. Välkommen med din ansökan!Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.Varaktighet:, tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse. .Arbetstid: Normal arbetstid är måndag till fredag 06:00-16.00, men dessa tider kan variera. Även kvälls- och helgarbete kan förekomma. Du söker tjänsten via Offentliga jobbs elektroniska ansökningsblankett. Tillsättningen av tjänsten kommer grunda sig på de uppgifter du lämnar och därför är det av största vikt att du är noggrann när du fyller i din ansökan. I din ansökan ska du ange medborgarskap. Om du inte är medborgare i Sverige, EU, EES eller Schweiz måste du också kunna styrka att du har ett giltigt arbetstillstånd eller är undantagen från skyldigheten att ha arbetstillstånd. Anställningen kan ske först efter kontroll av arbetstillstånd, vilket krävs enligt utlänningsförordningen.Har du skyddade personuppgifter? Kontakta HR-avdelningen direkt på telefon 019-588 000 så hjälper vi dig med en säker ansökan. Innan anställning ska du visa giltig identitetshandling och i de fall som befattningen kräver det ett giltigt utdrag ur belastningsregistret.Vi undanber oss kontakt med annonsörer och bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag. Kumla kommun är en tillväxtkommun som ligger centralt i Örebro län och har drygt 22 600 invånare. I kommunen finns framgångsrika företag, ett rikt kultur- och fritidsutbud, god kommunal service samt utmärkta kommunikationer. Kumlas Vision 2040 innebär Kumla är en trygg, familjevänlig plats där människor känner en samhörighet och ett sammanhang. Den blomstrande och gröna småstaden har bostäder, men även de jobb, den service och det utbud som behövs för en komplett vardag.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, AI & Application Security
jobs.description:
We are looking for a seasoned Senior Security Engineer, focused on AI & Application Security, to join our Platform team in Amsterdam. Working in a bootstrapped and profitable scaleup, you'll take a proactive, hands-on, senior role securing our agentic AI products, owning an emerging and fast-growing area of security engineering, the risks that come specifically from building with LLMs and autonomous agents, while helping raise the bar on our broader application security practices.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. In 2025 alone, the DataSnipper platform delivered more than $1.4 billion in productivity savings to is customers. Backed by a $100 million Series B led by Index Ventures, at a $1 billion valuation, and as proud members of 1% for the Planet, we care about how we grow, not just how fast.

If you want to build AI that professionals trust with work that really matters, this is your chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and do the best work of your career along the way.



What You Will Do

  • Own AI-specific security as a discipline at DataSnipper: identify, assess, and mitigate the risks unique to LLM-based and agentic systems across our products and platform.

  • Translate security policies and risk requirements into concrete technical controls, standards, and guardrails, in partnership with Legal and technical teams.

  • Build a proactive AI security practice grounded in frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the broader OWASP GenAI Security Project (including agentic security), MITRE ATLAS, and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and adapt them to how we build.

The Mission: Why We Exist

Genomics is a science-led transatlantic TechBio combining large-scale genetic and health data with proprietary analytics to accelerate drug discovery and advance predictive, preventative healthcare. We are united by a single vision to help people live longer healthier lives, using the power of genomics.

Genomics aims to help people live longer, healthier lives in two ways: super-charging drug discovery and development for novel treatments with our AI-enabled advanced genetic analytics platform, and by helping people understand their personal risk of common chronic diseases through polygenic risk scores – giving doctors and health systems the chance to get the right people into the right prevention, screening and treatment programmes at the right time.

A Day in the Life

At Genomics, we tackle major scientific challenges in harnessing genomic data to improve human health.

This role is part of the Life Sciences team, working on a range of challenges spanning the therapeutic development cycle, with a particular focus on developing patient stratification strategies, advancing disease understanding using ‘omic data, and identifying novel biomarkers. The Scientist is an early-career member of the team, who will thrive in a highly collaborative team environment. With the team’s support, you will develop and execute innovative and rigorous scientific approaches, and will effectively communicate findings to both internal and external stakeholders.

For example, a Scientist may:

  • Apply and optimise risk tools for patient stratification that combine genetic information, through polygenic risk scores, with conventional risk factors, to find the individuals most at risk of disease onset or progression and those most likely to benefit from therapies.

  • Cluster genetic variants by their effects on disease-relevant traits to reveal distinct biological mechanisms, and use partitioned polygenic scores to define patient subgroups that share underlying causal biology.

  • Discover and validate novel biomarkers from clinical or ‘omic data, and apply them to stratify patient populations in large biobanks or clinical trials.

To be successful in this role, you will: bring a strong foundation in the application of statistical and computational techniques in biomedical science that you can apply in innovative ways, thrive on analysing vast and diverse sources of ‘omic data using leading statistical or AI/ML approaches to make meaningful insights into complex problems, and take pride in effectively sharing your findings with others.

  • Experience with software engineering practices (version control [Git & GitHub], testing, documentation, agentic coding)

It's a broad, hands-on role. You'll write infrastructure as code for a new service one day and address network vulnerabilities the next, then enhance our AI development harness and release a new feature, all within the same month.

 

You might be a platform engineer who loves shipping product, or a full-stack engineer who has run serious production infrastructure. Either works.

As deployments grow more complex, the team needs your depth in infrastructure and distributed systems. You'll strengthen the architecture and make the design decisions the platform will rest on for years. Those decisions should leave room to grow, because future products may bring much larger volumes of data than we handle today.

It has to stay dependable while we do it. Our software needs to be available around the clock, every day of the year, and data integrity is critical. Our clients use Atominvest to report to their own investors, so a wrong number matters as much as an outage. Security, reliability and audit-readiness matter too. If you enjoy getting those right without slowing everything else down, you'll find plenty of fun things to work on.

The machine that builds the product

We're becoming AI-native. Agents do more and more of the mechanical work of writing code, and engineers build the machine that builds the product: the architecture, the specs, the limits agents work within, and the evals that tell us whether their output is right.

I think that moves an engineer's leverage upstream. When code is cheap, the scarce things are judgement and understanding. Which problem is worth solving? What does good look like for the person using it? Is the output actually right? Did what we shipped help? The best engineers I've worked with always solved the end problem, with code as the medium. Now that's most of the job.

That's why product and user understanding sit at the centre of how we work. An engineer who knows our clients' workflows can point agents at the right problem and spot when the result is subtly wrong. Without that, agents just build the wrong thing faster.

Your part is the AI development harness that makes this safe. That means sandboxed environments with synthetic data, scoped and audited access to logs and alerts, and evals and validation gates in CI. It also means firm lines, enforced by tooling, that keep production deploys and secrets in human hands, and client data out of reach of development agents.

You'll also build the agent orchestration pipelines that run in three places: in how we build software, in AI workflows inside the product our clients use, and in the internal tools our implementation team uses to onboard and configure clients.

What you'll do

Build the machine that builds the product

Most of your time goes here.

  • Build our AI development harness. Self-service infrastructure, a reproducible development environment, and the sandboxes, guardrails and evals that let agents take on more of the work safely, with results we can measure.

  • Automate quality. Build the QA automation pipeline: automated tests, validation gates and release checks that give us confidence in every change, including the ones agents write.

  • Orchestrate agents across the business. Build pipelines that run agents reliably and safely in our product workflows and our internal implementation tools, not just in engineering.

Own the platform

  • Own our infrastructure. We're migrating to ECS. You'll strengthen our ECS architecture, see the move through in safe, reversible stages, bring every resource under infrastructure as code, and retire the old deployment model.

  • Build security into the platform. Tenant-scoped credentials, per-tenant secrets, least-privilege access, and the audit trail that SOC 2 and our clients' security teams expect.

  • Make production observable. Set up the monitoring, alerting and tracing we rely on, and build playbooks for on-call and incident response which is shared amongst the team.

Work across the stack

  • Make the application changes the harness needs, such as synthetic data, test hooks and the specs agents work from.

  • Ship product. Pick up application work in TypeScript and React alongside the team. Over time, you'll learn the codebase as well as the platform it runs on.

  • Grow the team around you. Write the design notes and runbooks, pair with and review the work of other engineers, and mentor those who want to grow into infrastructure, so the platform never depends on one person.

Your first six months

  • Get the first parts of "the machine" running, and show that they make the team faster without lowering quality.

  • At the moment all of our end to end testing is done manually by our Product team. That's a massive manual overhead that bottlenecks our product development. You'll help build our AI-powered QA automation pipeline, so every change, whether a person or an agent wrote it, is tested automatically before it reaches clients.

  • Strengthen the ECS architecture and complete the move with no disruption to clients.

  • Get the platform fully into code, with tenant isolation and least privilege designed in.

  • Put in place the monitoring and on-call foundations the team will build on.

How you'll work

You'll own this area rather than work through a ticket queue. You'll decide what to build and when it's good enough, write your decisions down so others can challenge them, and tell us when something isn't worth doing. You'll work closely with Product from the start of significant work, because the platform exists to serve clients and the engineers building for them.

You and I will work together every day. We'll shape the technical direction together and think through the hard calls, and you'll have a direct line to every decision that affects your work. I'll back your judgement, and I'll expect you to push back when you think I'm wrong.

This is an individual contributor role, but we expect you to multiply the team: leading different areas at different times, and delivering through others as well as through your own work.

You'll probably enjoy this if

  • You want a pure DevOps or SRE role.

What you'll bring

  • Full-stack product building. Senior TypeScript and Node.js, plus React, with a track record of shipping features end to end yourself, not just supporting the people who do.

  • Tooling you've built for AI agents, not just used: agent configuration and orchestration, MCP servers or similar integrations, evals, automated review.

TypeScript, Node.js, React and MongoDB Atlas, running on AWS. CircleCI and Bitbucket. AI coding agents are part of everyday work. You don't need experience of all of these.
