jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer (AI Data Platform)
jobs.description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command-and-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter-UAS systems.

About the role

The Staff Data Engineer (AI Data Platform) will design, build and operate the data platform that makes UFORCE’s operational data usable for AI model training and validation.

You will connect diverse data sources—from high-frequency telemetry and time series to imagery, video, documents and structured records—and make the resulting data discoverable, governed and reproducible. You will work hands-on across architecture, pipelines, data quality and platform operations, while helping other engineers and partner teams make sound technical decisions.

This is a staff-level individual contributor role for someone who combines strong engineering judgment with a practical approach to delivery. You will partner with ML, product, engineering, field and security teams to build a platform that works for real use cases and operating constraints. Model research and model performance decisions remain with the accountable ML and product owners.

What you’ll do

  • Design and deliver a data platform for ingesting, storing, discovering and preparing heterogeneous data for approved analytics and ML workflows.

  • Build reliable batch and streaming pipelines for priority data sources, with validation, schema evolution, retries, backfills, replay and appropriate handling of failed data.

  • Preserve the context needed to understand and trace data, including timestamps, source identity, format versions and provenance where available.

  • Establish data contracts, metadata, interfaces and ownership boundaries that make data easier to find, understand and use across teams.

  • Enable reproducible training and evaluation datasets, including source and transformation versions, labels, filters and split definitions.

  • Build data-quality checks for issues such as missing data, corruption, duplication and temporal misalignment. Work with ML partners to surface coverage, sampling and leakage risks.

  • Make data rights, classification, retention, permitted use and access restrictions visible and actionable.

  • Design for the environments the work requires, which may include cloud, on-premises, sovereign or disconnected deployments.

  • Instrument and operate data workflows with clear visibility into health, freshness, quality, throughput and cost. Document failure handling, recovery and operational ownership.

  • Apply appropriate access controls, encryption, auditability and data-handling practices in partnership with security and other stakeholders.

  • Lead technical decisions across teams, communicate trade-offs and risks, mentor engineers, and deliver reusable components in small, reviewable increments.

What success looks like

  • A coherent platform architecture and incremental roadmap support priority AI and product use cases, with clear interfaces and ownership.

  • Priority data sources are ingested reliably and traceably, with agreed measures for completeness, freshness, quality and recovery.

  • Approved datasets are discoverable, governed and reproducible from source data through transformations to training and evaluation outputs.

  • ML teams can assess data quality, provenance and known limitations before using a dataset, and issues can be traced back and corrected.

  • Platform workflows have actionable monitoring, documented recovery procedures and clear operational ownership.

  • Security, deployment and cost constraints are understood and incorporated into platform decisions.

  • Partner teams can use the platform effectively, and engineers are unblocked through clear designs, reusable tools and mentoring.

Success measures and numerical targets will be established with the hiring manager and partner teams once baselines and operating constraints are understood.

Required qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering or a related field.

  • Data platform experience — designed, built and operated production data platforms or data-intensive systems end to end.

  • Staff-level technical leadership — led architectural decisions and cross-team delivery, mentored engineers and communicated clearly with stakeholders.

  • Hands-on engineering — strong Python and SQL skills, or equivalent, with experience in testing, code review and production-quality software.

  • Data pipelines — built reliable batch and streaming pipelines, including validation, schema evolution, retries, backfills and replay.

  • Data modalities — worked with structured or semi-structured data and at least one relevant modality, such as telemetry, time series, imagery, video or documents; understands provenance and temporal alignment.

  • ML data foundations — experience with storage, cataloguing, lineage, quality controls and reproducible datasets, including versioning, splits and leakage or sampling risks.

  • Platform operations — experience with observability, incident response, recovery, reliability and cost management.

  • Security and governance — practical knowledge of access controls, encryption, auditability, retention and sensitive-data handling.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with robotics, connected-device fleets or other operational systems that produce high-frequency or multimodal data.

  • Experience designing data systems for constrained connectivity, offline, air-gapped or sovereign environments.

  • Experience supporting defence, regulated or other security-sensitive customers.

The nature of combat has changed.

Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.

And UFORCE is ready.

  1. Build and grow a strong partner network: Identify, prioritise and develop relationships with high-potential accounting firms and networks.

  2. Drive partnerships from discussion to activation: Lead partnership discussions, onboarding and launch, ensuring that Alan creates value for both accountants and their clients.

  3. Activate partners and generate business opportunities: Build engagement plans, support partner enablement and work closely with Sales to turn recommendations into qualified opportunities.

  4. Help scale the Accountant Partnerships model: Manage partner performance, share insights with internal teams and contribute to the development of scalable playbooks, tools and processes.

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We’re looking for someone who combines strong partnership and commercial skills with the ability to build trusted relationships in a complex and evolving B2B ecosystem.

  • 5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment

  • Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management

  • Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company

  • Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills

  • A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams

  • An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously

  • Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English

Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.

We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Experience limited to technology integrations, co-marketing or visibility partnerships would be less relevant for this role.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

Marketing Ops is one of Alan's highest-leverage functions.

It sits at the intersection of marketing strategy, data, and technology — turning systems into growth engines and ensuring every touchpoint with prospects and members is timely, relevant, and scalable.

Alan is growing fast across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. But today we're leaving value on the table. On the prospect side, we drive more traffic but can't convert it properly: no scoring, no intelligent routing, no nurturing that adapts to buying intent. On the member side, messaging is one of our primary touchpoints for engagement, retention, and trust — yet nobody operates it strategically. Personalization stays shallow, communication pressure goes unmonitored, and shipping a message often means filing an engineering ticket.

We need Marketing Ops leaders who can architect scalable systems, operate them strategically, and progressively embed AI into workflows — to raise quality, reduce manual execution, and unlock growth without scaling headcount linearly.

⭐️ The Marketing Ops job ⭐️

We are hiring two Marketing Operations Managers, each embedded in a different crew:

  • Growth Infrastructure — focused on prospect acquisition: building a unified lead engine that captures, scores, routes, and nurtures across all channels

  • Product Platform — focused on member lifecycle messaging: operating Alan's messaging stack as a scalable service across 1.7M+ profiles

Both roles share the same DNA: strong marketing ops fundamentals, data fluency, a product mindset, and the ability to be both hands-on and strategic. Crew placement will be determined based on the candidate's experience, interests, and fit during the hiring process.

Why is this role interesting?

  • Speed: marketing, product, and sales teams ship campaigns and messages confidently — Marketing Ops turns bottlenecks into force multipliers across every crew

  • Trust: clean data, governed attributes, proper segmentation, and enforced rules mean the right person gets the right message at the right time

  • Scale: as we grow to millions of members across multiple countries, we need operators who keep our platforms clean and the user experience protected — without scaling headcount linearly

  • AI at the frontier: this isn't a maintenance role — you'll identify high-priority use cases for AI agents, train and refine them to a senior marketer's quality bar, and drive real adoption

What will you do with us?

You'll be a partnership with marketers — not a service desk. You'll partner closely with engineers, data, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders (PMMs, sales, growth, product) within a PM-Tech duo crew model.

Regardless of crew, you will own a core set of capabilities:

  • Marketing Automation & CRM: own and optimize our marketing stack (Customer.io, CRM integrations); build automations that enable marketers to launch campaigns independently, at scale, across all geos

  • Data Model & Governance: maintain CRM data quality, attribute/event design, and database hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Segmentation & Lifecycle Design: design and maintain lifecycle stages, segmentation logic, routing rules, and re-engagement flows across multiple audiences and geos

  • Nurturing Infrastructure: own the nurturing stack and campaign processes; make launches autonomous and compliant

  • AI-First Operations: identify, build, and refine AI agents for email copywriting, lead scoring, next-best-action recommendations, and content generation — making marketers AI-powered, not replacing them

  • Performance Monitoring: track the full funnel from first touchpoint to conversion; identify leakage and prioritize from data

  • Documentation & Enablement: create playbooks, train teams on tools and processes, reduce the marginal cost of new campaigns

Then, depending on your crew:

Growth Infrastructure — you'll build a unified lead engine (no more tool-by-tool silos), design lead scoring and routing models, crack multi-channel activation (email, WhatsApp, Voice AI), build AI agents that pre-qualify and enrich leads, and maintain a live feedback loop with BDRs, AEs, and Inbound Sales.

Product Platform — you'll operate Customer.io and back-end triggered emails as one governed system, monitor communication pressure and enforce channel rules, define and enforce recipient lifecycle paths, drive 100% Design Studio adoption, and co-own outbound messaging strategy with PMMs and product teams.

By your first year, we'll know it worked when:

  • At least one AI agent is in production on a key use case (email nurturing, lead categorization, content generation), with a second scoped or live, and adoption is real

  • Any marketer or product Alaner can launch a campaign or ship a message without bottlenecking through ops or engineering

  • CRM data model, attributes, and segments are properly owned, documented, and clean — the data we see is data we can act on

  • Every contact has a documented path through our messaging — segmentation is sharp, messaging is relevant, and pressure is monitored

  • Marketing's contribution to acquisition and engagement is visible and quantifiable, from first touch to conversion


⭐️ Is it you we are looking for? ⭐️


You'll be a great fit for this opportunity if you:

  • Have 5+ years in Marketing operations, growth ops, CRM ops, lifecycle marketing, or lead generation in a tech environment (B2B, B2C, or B2B2C)

  • Have hands-on experience managing marketing automation platforms at scale (Customer.io, Braze, Iterable, HubSpot, Marketo, Pardot, Salesforce, or equivalent)

  • Have a strong understanding of CRM data models — attribute/event design and data hygiene as a sustained practice

  • Can frame and implement processes for lead scoring, nurturing, segmentation, and personalization

  • Have a product knack: you can define what's not working, identify what to build next, and see problems as opportunities to bring more value

  • Bring data fluency and analytical rigor: you read platform and campaign data, surface anomalies, and draw business insights

  • Can be both hands-on and think strategically — you drive the big picture while staying close to execution

  • Have strong stakeholder management skills — you'll partner daily with engineering, product, sales, and marketing teams

  • Can manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-moving environment

  • Communicate with excellent written and spoken English

  • Are impact-driven with a strong bias towards improving processes

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0-D level range.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Lyon, Marseille, Nantes, Biarritz, Annecy, Brussels, Madrid or Barcelona.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).

  • Transport. Generous transit benefit

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture.

jobs.title: Business Operations Intern – New HQ Project Lead (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Our Mission

At Omegga, we develop spectral intelligence: we combine AI and spectroscopy to make the invisible visible. We started with a clear objective: eliminate chick culling on a global scale through early, non-invasive in-ovo sex detection. This outdated practice still impacts billions of lives, and we're here to change that. We're not building for the niche; we're building for the global standard.

Today, our technology is the world's earliest commercially available in-ovo sex determination and is already running in live production. As a B2B company, we work directly with hatcheries, and our focus is on scaling performance, robustness, and deployment across an international customer base. Beyond this first application, our platform enables non-invasive material analysis across biological and industrial environments, from agriculture to food production and beyond.

Since closing our €10 million funding round in early 2026 (including IQ Capital, Capnamic and the EIC Fund), our team has quickly doubled to 30 people, bringing together expertise in AI, optics and industrial systems.

We are looking for people who take ownership, think in systems, and want to help turn a working product into the industry benchmark. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Mission

We're building our new headquarter, and we need someone to own it. Your challenge: build a fully operational home of a fast-growing deep-tech company from scratch. This isn't an internship where you support someone else's project. This one is yours.

  • Own the HQ Build-out: Drive the project from the first plan to the day the doors open: flooring, cabling, furniture and everything in between.

  • Bring People Together: Coordinate internal teams, contractors and service providers, collect quotes, and keep timelines and budget on track. On site, you're the go-to person.

  • Set Up Our Deep-Tech Hardware: Plan material needs and procurement, and work hand in hand with our engineering team to get our in-house hardware up and running.

  • Write Your Own Playbook: There's no template for this. Challenge assumptions, spot opportunities and find pragmatic solutions when plans meet reality.

  • Cross-functional Support: Beyond the HQ, help translate business updates into clear stakeholder communication in investor relation HR, PR and sales.

Why Us

  • Work That Matters: You're not optimizing ad clicks. You're helping a company that is ending chick culling in hatcheries today, and expanding AI-powered spectroscopy far beyond it.

  • Fair Compensation: A properly paid, full-time internship, because real work deserves real pay.

  • Team & Workplace: A team of 30 with short decision paths, currently based in Munich's Werksviertel and soon in the new headquarters you'll help build. We work hard, stay focused, and get things done together on site.

  • Perks Budget: Monthly budget to spend where it actually matters to you: fitness, mobility, or the occasional "I earned this" purchase.

  • Office: Free drinks, coffee, and snacks to keep you focused throughout the day.

Your Profile

Requirements: German at C1 level or higher, fluent English, and a valid class B driver's license for quick supply runs, whether to IKEA or the hardware store.

Beyond that, we care more about how you think, act and take ownership than about a perfect CV.

  • Confident communicator: You're comfortable with contractors, engineers, suppliers and senior stakeholders alike. You articulate your perspective clearly and challenge assumptions constructively.

  • Execution-driven: You follow through and care about outcomes, not just activity. No task is beneath you, and speed never comes at the expense of quality.

  • Independent & resourceful: You don't need a detailed roadmap to get started. You structure your own work, find the information you need, and know when to involve others.

  • Structured & pragmatic: You break complex problems into manageable steps, prioritize effectively, and keep track of budgets, deadlines and dependencies. When information is incomplete, you weigh the trade-offs, make a pragmatic call, and adapt when circumstances change.

  • Intellectually curious: You grasp new concepts quickly, ask the right questions, and enjoy figuring out things you haven't done before.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset: You see opportunities where others see problems. You take initiative, turn ideas into action, and when you see a chance to build or improve something, you have the room to pitch it and make it your own.

  • Self-reflective: You actively seek feedback, own your mistakes, and keep improving how you work.

Nice to have: Experience in project management, operations, procurement, entrepreneurship or coordinating external partners. Your mindset and potential matter more to us.

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

  • Tangible Impact: At the end of your internship, you can walk through our new headquarter and say: I built this.

  • Real Ownership: A business-critical project that's yours from start to finish.

  • Steep Learning Curve: Grow fast across entrepreneurship, project management and business operations, and learn to work with contractors, engineers and investors alike.

  • Real Responsibility: Real budgets, real negotiations, real operational decisions.

  • Freedom to Shape: Build your own approach instead of following predefined processes.

  • Founder Exposure: Work directly with the founding team of a venture-backed deep-tech company.

  • Insights into Deep Tech: See how a deep-tech startup sets up its hardware infrastructure and works with its investors.

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

Leading financial institutions like Carlyle Group, KKR, Ares, and BBVA use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive portfolio decarbonization.

We are looking for a customer-focused and analytically minded individual to join our Sustainability Data Advisory team in London, with a focus on financial institutions. You'll join a small team that operates like a startup within a startup at Watershed, working with some of the world's leading asset managers, private equity firms, banks, and insurers to accelerate their sustainability strategies.

You'll work directly with customers as a trusted advisor, leading measurement sessions and delivering advisory services that unlock the full value of our platform. You'll help customers measure financed emissions and use insights from their footprint to inform reporting and decision-making.

You will:

  • Advise teams at the world's largest financial institutions. Work directly with customers to measure financed emissions and strengthen their sustainable finance programs, supporting portfolio decarbonization and reporting across frameworks including TCFD, SFDR, CSRD, and LP reporting.

  • Deliver services that accelerate customer success. Lead measurement sessions and provide specialized advisory to help customers set up measurements, improve data quality, and unlock value from Watershed's platform. Support customers through emissions verification when needed.

  • Collaborate with science, engineering, and product teams to apply innovative measurement solutions, interpret the Partnership for Carbon Accounting Financials (PCAF) standards, and help customers make informed choices about how to measure emissions across asset classes.

jobs.title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to join our Revenue Operations team and act as a broad, senior partner to our revenue organisation. You'll run the complex analysis and modelling behind target setting and annual planning for the entire commercial organisation. You will also help the Director set and execute the revenue analytics strategy, and run the insights that shape how revenue leadership sees the business. As you ramp up, you will take on growing ownership of the forecasting cadence alongside the Director of Revenue Operations.

We are looking for someone with very strong analytical and modelling skills, which are the foundation of the role, especially in your first two quarters. Just as important, we want someone who is commercially minded and keen to grow into a generalist role, broadening from there into revenue insights and forecasting.


What You’ll Do

  • First 90 days: Scope the revenue analytics strategy and build the core dashboards.

  • First 180 days: Lead the analysis for the annual planning and target-setting cycle, and automate the core of revenue reporting and insights with AI tooling.

  • First 12 months: Take on co-ownership of the forecasting cadence with the Director of Revenue Operations.

 

What Will You Be Doing?

Run Complex Modelling & Analysis

  • Run complex analysis and modelling to support target setting and the annual planning process for the entire commercial organisation, made up of around 600 commercial roles across SDRs, AEs and Account Managers.

  • Build and maintain the models behind target setting: capacity, quota and productivity assumptions, and territory and segment allocation.

  • Frame the key planning questions, choose the method, pressure-test scenarios and sensitivities, and deliver clear recommendations to revenue leadership, explaining the trade-offs in plain language.

  • Work as the senior analytical partner to the other analyst on the team: stay hands-on in the models while setting the quality bar and documentation standards, so each planning cycle is repeatable and auditable.

Build the Revenue Analytics Strategy

  • Partner with the Director of Revenue Operations to define the revenue analytics strategy: what we need to build across Salesforce and Looker, and in what order.

  • Map the current reporting landscape — what exists, what's trusted, what's duplicated or out of date — and use that map to shape the build plan.

Founders Factory × Nua Materials

Co-Founder & CTO

Founders Factory builds and funds new startups together with exceptional founders and leading companies. Our founding team brings its own exit and IPO experience, and since 2015 our 300+ portfolio companies have raised more than USD 900m in follow-on funding.

For Nua Materials, we are looking for a technical Co-Founder & CTO to build a scalable product and company alongside the existing founder, starting from a validated concept.

The opportunity

New and more sustainable building materials already exist, yet many struggle to make the leap into real construction projects. For construction companies, housing providers and developers, information and evidence are fragmented, products are difficult to compare, and adopting unfamiliar materials creates additional technical, commercial and organisational risk. At the same time, regulatory pressure is increasing: key provisions of the revised EU Construction Products Regulation have applied since 2026, and Digital Product Passports for construction products are on the way.

Many existing solutions focus on documentation, evidence and certification — not on the actual selection and purchasing decision. This is where Nua Materials comes in. What you will build

As Co-Founder & CTO, you will own product and technology in the early stage.

  • Develop the Nua Score and build a robust data and system architecture across multiple external data sources.

  • Decide what to build now, what to add later, what to automate — and what deliberately should not become part of the product.

  • Work directly with early customers and partners, then build a small product and engineering team over time.

  • Trust in B2B: You build transparent, credible systems that can stand up to risk-sensitive enterprise customers, long decision cycles and demanding evidence requirements.

  • Founder mindset and market understanding: You have founded before, were one of the first technical hires at a startup, or have taken on comparable ownership. Business-fluent German, professional English and experience in the DACH market are important.

Especially relevant, but not required

  • Experience in ConTech or PropTech

  • Background in civil engineering or materials science, ideally with LCA/EPD experience

  • Experience with comparison platforms or marketplaces

What we offer

  • Capital and founder funding for the build phase

  • Hands-on support from Founders Factory across product, data, growth, fundraising, legal, finance and talent — building on existing market, customer and product work

  • Access to early prospective customers and partners across construction and housing, as well as our international network

What You’ll Do

AI at Perk

jobs.title: AI software Engineer - Project Tricorder
jobs.description:
Project Tricorder — Clinical Infrastructure for Field Operations

We're looking for a hands-on engineer to build two foundations of the Tricorder product: the evaluation harness and training data pipeline behind our AI models, and a clinical knowledge base grounded in tactical combat care, SNOMED CT and ICD-10.

About Project Tricorder - https://www.tricorder-systems.com/

Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. Care increasingly happens somewhere else - in the field, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward.

Tricorder builds the deployable clinical infrastructure for that world: a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It is a dual-use venture serving defence medical and civilian pre-hospital care.

Our prototype product is already in user testing. Edge AI sits at the core: multimodal language models that turn video, sensor data and clinical notes into patient records, drive predictions and inform data-driven learnings across deployments. To trust those models in the field, we need rigorous data and evaluation - that's where you come in.

What you'll do

You'll own two workstreams, working day to day with the founder and the FF build team.

1. Data pipeline and evaluation harness

Build the data foundations that tell us whether our models are good enough for clinical use.

  • Data labelling: design labelling schemas and guidelines, set up tooling, and run labelling with clinical input, including quality checks and inter-annotator agreement.

  • Data processing: build reproducible pipelines to ingest, clean, de-identify and transform multimodal data (video, sensor streams, text).

  • Video data organisation: structure, version and catalogue video datasets so clips, annotations and metadata stay searchable and traceable.

  • Training dataset preparation: assemble balanced, well-documented train, validation and test splits, with clear lineage from raw data to model input.

  • Eval harness: build an automated harness that benchmarks vision-language and NLP models against clinically meaningful metrics, tracks regressions and supports build-vs-buy model decisions.

2. Clinical knowledge base

Build the structured clinical knowledge base that turns unstructured input into coded, interoperable records.

  • Database design: design the schema and stand up the data store for clinical concepts and their relationships.

  • Clinical terminologies: ingest and map TC3, SNOMED CT, ICD-10 and related NHS standards, including cross-mappings between them.

  • Natural language processing: extract entities and relationships from clinical text and link them to coded concepts.

  • Document handling: parse and structure clinical documents (PDFs, notes, forms) into the database.

  • Clinical knowledge: work with clinicians to make sure the database reflects real-world clinical reasoning and pre-hospital workflows.

By the end of the first 3 months, we'd expect a working eval harness in use for model decisions, a labelled and versioned core dataset, and a first version of the knowledge base linked to the product.

What we're looking for

We don't expect one person to be expert in everything below. Strong candidates will be deep in one workstream and credible in the other.

Must-haves

  • Strong Python and data engineering skills, with a track record of shipping production data or ML pipelines, not just research notebooks.

  • Hands-on experience building ML evaluation frameworks, benchmarks or test harnesses, ideally for vision, video or language models.

  • Experience running data labelling and training-data preparation, including annotation tooling and quality control.

  • Working knowledge of databases and data modelling.

  • Practical NLP experience: entity extraction, entity linking or document parsing.

  • Comfort handling sensitive data under data protection and clinical safety constraints.

  • Pragmatism and speed: you can work with ambiguity, make good build-vs-buy calls and ship in weeks, not quarters.

Nice to have

  • Experience with SNOMED CT, ICD-10, dm+d or other NHS clinical terminologies and coding.

  • A background in health-tech, clinical informatics or another regulated domain such as defence.

  • Experience with video data at scale (frame sampling, temporal annotation, multimodal datasets).

  • Familiarity with FHIR or HL7 interoperability standards.

  • Experience working with LLMs and VLMs, including edge or on-device deployment.

  • Early-stage startup experience, especially as a founding or early engineer.

Probably not the right fit if

  • You need detailed specs and a large team around you to be effective.

  • You prefer pure research over building tools people use every day.

This is a high urgency opening, and we are flexible to consider applicants either on a more flexible consultancy agreement (rolling by mutual agreement, with a competitive day rate); or a long term permanent employment contract with shares as part of the package and scope to grow into a longer-term role as Tricorder builds its engineering team.

Most healthcare technology assumes a hospital: reliable power, connectivity and a clinician at a desk. But the moments that decide outcomes often happen elsewhere: at the point of injury, in transit, in remote and contested environments, and in the critical minutes before a patient reaches a ward.

Tricorder is building deployable clinical infrastructure for that world. It's a rugged, self-contained hardware and software platform that lets clinical teams capture, monitor and act on patient data anywhere, even when the network or the grid can't be relied on. It's a dual-use venture serving defence medical first and civilian pre-hospital and humanitarian care next.

Tricorder is being built inside Founders Factory's venture studio, with dedicated pre-seed investment and a six-month build programme. The founder, a former British Army officer, is in place, the founding engineer is incoming, and a few more team hires are underway.

What you'll do

You'll be Tricorder's senior clinical voice: the person who makes sure what we build works for a medic at the point of injury and keeps patients safe.

  • Shape clinical workflows: map how casualties are assessed, treated, handed over and evacuated, from the point of injury through to definitive care. Turn that into product requirements, and test prototypes against real resuscitation and trauma scenarios.

  • Protect patient safety: lead clinical risk management and act as (or help appoint) the Clinical Safety Officer under the NHS DCB0129 standard. Advise on the evidence needed for the medical device and regulatory pathway.

  • Be the medical face of the product: put your clinical name to Tricorder. Represent it to defence medical services, NHS and ambulance trusts, humanitarian organisations and investors, and help the founder carry the clinical story in pitches and pilots.

  • Open doors: use your network across defence medicine, the NHS and humanitarian response to secure clinical pilots, user testing and early design partners.

  • Guide clinical evidence: help design pilots and early studies, and review clinical claims, protocols and terminology across the product and its AI features.

  • Advise the team: be a sounding board for the founder and build team on clinical priorities. Help with clinical hiring as the company grows.

Who you are

Must-haves

  • You've served as a military medic or doctor. This is non-negotiable. You know operational medicine first-hand, from point-of-injury care to the field hospital.

  • A GMC-registered doctor with deep experience in resuscitation, trauma or emergency surgery, emergency medicine, or pre-hospital care.

  • Still active clinically, whether as a reservist, in the NHS, or in humanitarian or disaster response.

  • You're credible with senior defence medical leaders, NHS clinicians and investors, and comfortable being the named clinical lead for a product.

  • You can turn clinical reality into clear, practical product decisions, and you're happy working with engineers and designers at startup pace.

Nice to have

  • Experience advising or working with medtech or health-tech startups, ideally as a CMO, clinical lead or advisor.

  • Clinical Safety Officer training (DCB0129/DCB0160), or experience with medical device regulation (UKCA/CE, ISO 14971).

  • Leadership roles in defence medical services, such as a clinical lead, medical director or command role.

  • Experience with mass-casualty planning, deployed hospital care, or global health systems.

  • Familiarity with clinical AI, data standards or digital health interoperability.

Probably not the right fit if

  • You haven't served in a military medical role.

  • You're looking for a passive advisory title without hands-on involvement in the product.

Analysera och bryta ner frågeställningar i sina beståndsdelar och lösa komplicerade problem     är självständig, initiativtagande och har mod att agera efter din egen kompetens och roll. Du tar initiativ, sätter igång aktiviteter och uppnår resultat    har god samarbetsförmåga. Arbetar bra med andra människor. Relaterar till dem på ett lyhört och smidigt sätt. Du lyssnar och kommunicerar på ett konstruktivt sätt     har god pedagogisk förmåga. Du är välformulerad och engagerat i enskilda möten och i små och stora grupper. Lyssnar och är mottaglig för motparten och anpassar dig till situationen    är strukturerad och noggrann. Planerar, organiserar och prioriterar arbetet på ett självständigt och effektivt sätt. Sätter upp och håller tidsramar. Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.Mer informationAnställningen är tillsvidare med placering Borlänge. Tillsättning enligt överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar normalt provanställning. Möjlighet till distansarbete finns utifrån verksamhetens behov, upp till tre dagar per vecka. En anställning hos oss kan innebära placering i säkerhetsklass. En säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll enligt säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585) kan därför komma att genomföras. För en del av våra arbetsuppgifter i säkerhetsklass krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Vid frågor är du välkommen att kontakta tillförordnad sektionschef Magnus Lundberg, 010 – 495 34 08 Magnus.Lundberg@transportstyrelsen.se. ST, Anders Bodving och Saco-S, Ingela Svensson nås via vår växel på 0771-503 503.Vi vill inte att annonsörer och bemanningsföretag kontaktar oss.AnsökAnsök via vår webbplats och bifoga ett komplett CV samt ett personligt brev märkt med referensnummer TSG 2026-9967. Vi behöver din ansökan senast den 17 december 2026. Har du skyddade personuppgifter, ska du skicka in din ansökan per post, kontakta rekryterande chef för information om hur du går tillväga. Om du går vidare i anställningsprocessen ska alltid utbildnings-/examensbevis samt tjänstgöringsintyg som styrker de kunskaper och erfarenheter som är relevanta för tjänsten uppvisas. Välkommen att bli vår nya kollega!Kort om TransportstyrelsenTransportstyrelsen arbetar för att uppnå god tillgänglighet, hög kvalitet, säkra och miljöanpassade transporter inom järnväg, luftfart, sjöfart och väg. Vi tar fram regler, ger tillstånd och följer upp hur de efterlevs. Med hjälp av våra register arbetar vi bland annat med avgifter, tillstånd och ägarbyten.Läs mer om Transportstyrelsen

jobs.title: Köksansvarig till restaurang i Uppsala
jobs.description: Köksansvarig till restaurang i UppsalaVill du ta nästa steg i din ledarroll och vara med och utveckla ett köksteam? Energy Staffing är ett bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag inom hotell och restaurang. Vi rekryterar nu en köksansvarig för kunds räkning till en restaurang i Uppsala.Vi söker dig som kombinerar ett stort intresse för matlagning med förmågan att skapa struktur, motivera kollegor och hålla hög kvalitet även när tempot är högt.Om rollenSom köksansvarig leder du den dagliga driften i köket under ditt arbetspass. Du planerar och fördelar arbetet, säkerställer ett effektivt arbetsflöde och ser till att maten håller en jämn och hög kvalitet.Du samarbetar nära med restaurangchefen och övriga ledare. Genom ett närvarande ledarskap bidrar du till en trygg arbetsmiljö, god livsmedelssäkerhet och en bra upplevelse för gästerna.Dina arbetsuppgifter• Leda och fördela arbetet i köksteamet.• Planera, organisera och följa upp den dagliga produktionen.• Säkerställa att köket följer verksamhetens rutiner och kvalitetskrav.• Följa upp hygien, livsmedelssäkerhet och ordning i köket.• Coacha kollegor och bidra till ett välfungerande samarbete.• Identifiera förbättringar som stärker kvaliteten och arbetsflödet.Vi söker dig som• Har erfarenhet av en ledande roll i restaurangkök.• Är van vid att leda, motivera och utveckla ett köksteam.• Är strukturerad och kan planera och prioritera arbetet.• Arbetar noggrant med hygien och livsmedelssäkerhet.• Behåller lugnet och hittar lösningar när tempot är högt.• Har ett stort engagemang för matlagning, kvalitet och service.Du erbjudsDu får en ansvarsfull roll i en växande restaurangverksamhet med tydliga rutiner. Här finns möjlighet att utvecklas som ledare och bidra till både teamets och verksamhetens utveckling.Placering och rekryteringsprocessArbetsplatsen ligger i Uppsala.För kandidater som går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen ingår ett betalt provpass i Stockholm. Om du bor längre bort får du även ersättning för resan till provpasset. Den ordinarie arbetsplatsen är i Uppsala.Rekryteringen hanteras av Energy Staffing för kunds räkning.AnsökanSkicka ditt CV till mikael.davani@energystaffingsweden.com.Ange Köksansvarig i ämnesraden.Urval sker löpande. Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Säsongsjobb som stationschef hos PingoAC Malmö
jobs.description: Säsongsjobb som stationschef hos PingoAC – MalmöInför säsongen 2027 söker PingoAC tre stationschefer till våra nya stationer i Malmö. Tjänsten passar dig som vill ha ett självständigt jobb med kundkontakt, försäljning och eget ansvar.PingoAC erbjuder mobil AC-service för personbilar direkt på handelsplatsers parkeringar. Kunderna lämnar bilen hos oss och kan passa på att handla eller ta en fika medan vi servar bilens AC.Vi växer – vill du vara med på resan?Inför säsongen 2027 expanderar vi till fler handelsplatser runt om i Sverige. Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och utveckla PingoAC på din ort. Vi hoppas att samarbetet blir långsiktigt och att du som trivs hos oss vill komma tillbaka kommande säsonger.Du ansvarar för stationenSom stationschef arbetar du själv på plats och ansvarar för den dagliga driften. Du öppnar och stänger stationen, tar emot kunder, utför funktionstester och AC-service samt håller ordning på utrustningen. När flera kunder kommer samtidigt behöver du kunna prioritera arbetet och se till att alla får ett bra bemötande.Du behöver kunna kommunicera väl på svenska med kunder och förstå våra rutiner och instruktioner. Kunskaper i fler språk är meriterande.Kundkontakt och försäljning är en viktig delDu tar initiativ till samtal med kunder, lyssnar på deras behov och berättar om våra tjänster. Därför söker vi dig som trivs med kundkontakt och försäljning, är serviceinriktad och känner dig trygg i mötet med människor.Du är ansvarsfull, självgående och bra på att planera och fatta beslut. Arbetet sker utomhus på en handelsplats, så du behöver också trivas med praktiska arbetsuppgifter och varierande väder.Du får utbildning innan säsongenDu får utbildning i AC-service, utrustning och våra rutiner före säsongsstart. (måste vara tillgänglig 5 dagar för utbildning någon gång i Jan/Feb) Tidigare erfarenhet av AC-service är inget krav. Erfarenhet av försäljning, kundservice eller bilintresse är meriterande.Om tjänstenArbetsperioden är planerad till 1 maj–20 augusti 2027, men kan variera något beroende på när den aktuella stationen öppnar och stänger. Arbetstiderna följer stationens öppettider och kan omfatta både vardagar och helger.Du får fast månadslön. Utöver det har du möjlighet att få provision baserad på stationens resultat.Låter det intressant? Skicka din ansökan till jobb@pingoac.se och berätta lite om dig själv och varför du vill jobba hos oss.Rekrytering sker löpande, så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

jobs.title: Teknisk expert vintertester
jobs.description: Om uppdragetVi på Centio söker en teknisk expert med erfarenhet av vintertester till ett konsultuppdrag hos Trafikverket, avdelningen Fordonsresurser. Uppdraget innebär stöttning av projektledningen i leveransprojektet för nya lok och vagnar till nattågstrafiken till Norrland.Placering: Distans, med resor främst vid vintertester i övre Norrland samt vid fysiska möten med beställaren och/eller fordonsleverantören i Stockholm eller Madrid, uppskattat till högst en gång per månad. Omfattning: 25 %. ArbetsuppgifterStötta projektledningen i tekniska frågeställningar, analyser och granskningar av underlag från fordonsleverantören. I början av 2027 når projektet milstolpen Conceptual Design Review, där du förväntas kunna granska underlag kopplat till tekniska lösningar, fordonsegenskaper och beräkningar.Vara Trafikverkets representant för delaktighet i planering inför och uppföljning av vintertesterna, eftersom nattågen kommer att trafikera övre Norrland.Arbeta självständigt, men stämma av med projektledningen innan strategiska frågeställningar och vägval tas upp med fordonsleverantören.Överföra kunskap till anställda på Trafikverket avseende de arbetsuppgifter som utförs i uppdraget.Krav (OBS, obligatoriska)Minst tio års erfarenhet från seniora ansvarsroller inom teknik och underhåll i järnvägsfordonsbranschen. Med seniora ansvarsroller menas ledande befattningar med övergripande ansvar.Erfarenhet från minst två upphandlingsprojekt på leverantörs- eller beställarsidan av att kravställa och upphandla järnvägsfordon eller järnvägsfordonssystem.Deltagit som teknisk expert i minst en upphandling av tåg.Självständigt följt upp tekniska krav för järnvägsfordonens elektriska och mekaniska funktioner.Aktivt medverkat vid genomförande av vintertester av järnvägsfordon i övre Norrland under de senaste två åren.Medverkat med teknisk expertis i ombyggnadsprojekt av järnvägsfordon.God kunskap om regelverk kring godkännandeprocesser, TSD:er och nationella krav för järnvägsfordon.Muntlig kommunikation eller kommunikation via e-post ska ske på svenska.MeriterandeDeltagit som teknisk expert i minst en upphandling av nattåg.Personliga egenskaperHa lätt att samarbeta med övriga i projektteamet.Kunna arbeta effektivt och resultatinriktat.Om ossCentios övergripande mål är att vara ett konsultbolag som erbjuder smarta och hållbara lösningar som utvecklar samhället på ett positivt sätt. Vi erbjuder individuellt anpassade villkor och värdesätter engagemang, trivsel och balans mellan arbete och fritid.Vänligen skicka ditt CV på svenska. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

jobs.title: Distriktssäljare  Stockholm (Sollentuna)
jobs.description: Vill du sälja något som folk faktiskt längtar efter?Vi på Svenska Fiskbilen AB söker drivna distriktssäljare till vårt kontor i Sollentuna (Stockholm). Du säljer inte bara fisk – du säljer en livsstil.Känner du igen dig i att sälja larm, elavtal eller stå på event utanför köpcentrum och hela tiden behöva jaga nya kunder från noll? Var tolfte vecka återkommer du till dina kunder – och du får exakt samma provision när de handlar igen eller beställer via fiskbilen.se. Du som är 50+ med livserfarenhet och driv är varmt välkommen att söka!Se gärna vår korta presentationsfilm här: https://youtu.be/zfURE4rbPL4Skicka din ansökan idag – vi rekryterar löpande!

jobs.title: Livsmedelsarbetare sökes till Andersson & Tillman
jobs.description: Vill du arbeta inom livsmedelsproduktion? Nu söker vi fyra engagerade livsmedelsarbetare till Andersson & Tillman i Uppsala.Du kommer att arbeta med varierande arbetsuppgifter inom produktion och paketering av chark- och köttprodukter. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:     Packa livsmedel såsom chark, korv och kött    Hänga upp och knyta korv.    Placera produkter på rökvagnar.    Utföra övriga förekommande arbetsuppgifter inom livsmedelsproduktionen. Arbetet innebär en del tunga lyft, så du behöver ha god fysisk förmåga och trivas med ett fysiskt aktivt arbete. Tidigare erfarenhet är meriterande, men inget krav.
