jobs.title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS-SBR)---Master thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)============================================================================================================ Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.The Department of Process Engineering has a vacancy for aMaster thesis / Internship in modelling of densified activated sludge in sequencing batch reactor (DAS\-SBR)============================================================================================================Densified Activated Sludge (DAS), a hybrid system consisting of flocs and small granules (typically 200\~500 ?m in diameter), is a promising solution for the increasing stringent effluent quality standards and the intensification of biological processes in wastewater treatment. Compared to conventional activated sludge, DAS offers significant advantages to "do more with less" \- increasing treatment capacity without expanding the plant footprint. The improved settleability enables high biomass retention, thereby substantially increasing volumetric treatment capacity. The enrichment of slow\-growing bacteria, particularly nitrifiers, promotes microbial activities and provides greater flexibility for optimizing aeration strategies for enhancing nutrient removal.  The application of DAS in sequencing batch reactors (SBR) is being increasingly investigated and implemented worldwide, yielding many new valuable experimental findings and operational experience. However, a comprehensive understanding of long\-term performance of DAS\-SBR systems under dynamic conditions remains limited. Existing mathematical models do not yet adequately represent all relevant processes and characteristics, nor have they been calibrated and validated using real\-world operational data.This project aims to develop a DAS\-SBR model in , which can better represent the key biological and physical processes observed in practice. By calibrating and validating the model against real\-world datasets, the project seeks to improve the understanding of DAS\-SBR system and to provide a reliable tool for process analysis, optimization, and future design. **We are looking for** a motivated master thesis student or intern, who needs to be enrolled in a university for the entire thesis/internship duration, with interests in advanced technologies for biological wastewater treatment and modelling biological processes. Fluent spoken and written English are essential. Strong data analysis and programming skills and experience with modelling in Sumo are highly recommended. **The preferred starting date is** September/October 2026 onwards, not later than March 2027\. **At Eawag**, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it\-we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions. For further information about Eawag and its conditions of employment, please visit and . **Applications can be submitted until the position is filled** and will therefore be evaluated on a rolling basis. Applications should include a short letter (max. one page) describing your interests and their relevance to this position, a CV, and a list of lectures/transcripts of records from the university.For further information, please contact or . **We look forward to receiving your application.** Please send it through this webpage, as any other way of applying will not be considered. A click on the link below will take you directly to the application form.   Eawag: Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology  ******jid92ba563jm jit1148jm jiy26jm

Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.    Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.     Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab nach Vereinbarung eine/n:      Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören* das Sicherstellen eines authentischen \& neuzeitlichen Speisenangebotes unter Berücksichtigung der Saisonprodukte des Originallandes sowie das Erstellen der ükarte in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Küchenchef* die Zubereitung der Gerichte sowie der einwandfreie Umgang mit Produkten, Produktion\- und Kochtechniken* die Verantwortung der Einhaltung der Hygienerichtlinien sowie der Arbeitssicherheit* das Kochen in der offenen Showküche vor demSie sind ein ausgebildeter und berufserfahrener Koch mit fundiertem Fachwissen über die persischen Spezialitätenküche sowie umfangreichen Kochtechniken. Sie haben Erfahrung in der internationalen gehobenen Gastronomie und Hotellerie. Deutsch und Englisch beherrschen Sie fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist von Vorteil. Sie zeigen hohe Leistungsbereitschaft, sind leidenschaftlich und arbeiten auch unter Zeit\- und Arbeitsdruck ruhig, exakt und gästeorientiert. Unternehmerisches Handeln und Denken zeichnet Sie aus.  Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV\-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Darüber hinaus geniessen Sie Ermässigungen in unseren Restaurants sowie Vorzugskonditionen für Sie, Ihre Familie und Freunde für Übernachtungen in unseren Hotels. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.    Auch Ihre Mobilität unterstützen wir: Die Anreise mit öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln wird finanziell gefördert, und Parkplätze stehen zu attraktiven Konditionen zur Verfügung.    Wir investieren in Ihre Zukunft: Mit Zugang zur Beekeeper\-Mitarbeiterapp, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsangeboten, internen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten und erstklassigen Karriereperspektiven schaffen wir den Rahmen für Ihre persönliche und berufliche Entfaltung.    Sie erwartet die Chance, Teil eines Weltklasse\-Resorts zu sein, aktiv zum gemeinsamen Erfolg beizutragen und sich in einem inspirierenden Umfeld kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.    Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Motivationsschreiben, Arbeitszeugnissen und Foto.    Auszeichnungen:  Swiss Location Awards «Switzerland's Best Meeting Location»  World Spa Awards «Switzerland's Best Hotel Spa 2025»  LHW Membership Awards «Sustainability Leader»  Great Place To Work 2025  The New York Times'«52 Places to Go in 2018»   Travel \+ Leisure«500 List 2021»  Handelszeitung «Bester Arbeitgeber im Hospitality Sektor 2023»  Connoisseur Circle «Best Gourmet Hotel»  MICHELIN Wellness Award «Best Wellness Hotel»  GALA Spa Awards «Best Spa Concept»  MICHELIN Keys «3/3 Keys»    BÜRGENSTOCK HOTELS AG  Lukretia  Human Resources Manager  Bürgenstock 30  6363 Obbürgen  Telefon    ******jid15365bfjm jit1148jm jiy26jm

Vous êtes : \* Titulaire d'un diplôme d'infirmier·ère HES ou d'une formation reconnue comme équivalente. \* Au bénéfice d'une expérience clinique en gériatrie ou en EMS en Suisse. \* À l'aise dans l'accompagnement de personnes âgées présentant des situations de santé complexes. \* Une expérience ou une spécialisation complémentaire en lien avec la gériatrie constitue un atout. \* À l'aise avec les outils informatiques utilisés dans le domaine des soins ; la connaissance de Carefolio est un avantage. \* Rigoureux·se dans la tenue, le suivi et l'amélioration du dossier de soins informatisé. \* Doté·e d'un bon sens de l'organisation, de l'autonomie et des responsabilités. \* Reconnu·e pour vos qualités relationnelles, votre capacité d'écoute et votre esprit d'équipe. \* Adaptable et à l'aise dans un contexte institutionnel en pleine évolution. \* Domicilié·e dans la région ou disposé·e à assurer les éventuelles astreintes et interventions rapides sur site, selon les besoins du poste. \* La formation d'évaluateur·trice PLEX / Plaisir constitue un atout supplémentaire \*\*Nous vous offrons :\*\* \* Des horaires continus uniquement pour le personnel infirmier \* Une collaboration étroite avec une équipe dynamique engagée dans l'évolution des pratiques. \* Un EMS à taille humaine, fondé sur des valeurs de proximité, de respect et de bienveillance envers les résident·e·s. \* Des possibilités de formation et de développement professionnel. \* Des conditions de travail conformes à la CCT\\-SAN Vaud. \*\*Entrée en fonction\*\* 1er décembre 2026 ou à convenir Nous vous remercions de nous adresser votre dossier complet (CV, lettre de motivation, diplômes et certificats de travail) \*\*uniquement\*\* via le site JobUp. jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Content &amp; Rights Specialist (60–80 %)--- Content \& Rights Specialist (60–80 %)========================================**Pensum**: 60–80 % \| **Arbeitsmodell**: hybrid \| **Arbeitsort**: Deutschschweiz \| **Anstellung**: unbefristet \| **Start**: 01\.04\.2027 Wir suchen eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die internationale Video\- und Serieninhalte (Fiction, Streaming) von der Lizenzierung bis zur Veröffentlichung zuverlässig begleitet. Du baust unseren Lizenzkatalog auf, koordinierst Anlieferungen und stellst sicher, dass jede Serie rechtzeitig online und offline geht. Dabei verbindest du ein gutes Gespür für audiovisuelle Inhalte mit Verhandlungskompetenz und präziser Organisation. Das erwartet dich-----------------* Du bist unser Trendscout, screenst den internationalen Markt und findest die Serien, die junge Menschen an den Bildschirm fesseln* Du sichtest mit Gespür für Hooks, neue Erzählformate und unsere Zielgruppe und machst fundierte Empfehlungen, welche Titel unsere Bibliothek bereichern* Du entwickelst unser Angebot weiter und bringst eigene Ideen ein, welche Genres, Stoffe und Formate als Nächstes zu uns passen* Du verhandelst mit Lizenzgebern weltweit, holst Angebote ein und klärst die Rechtekette, von Musikrechten über Altersfreigaben bis zum Geoblocking* Du nimmst Anlieferungen ab, von Serien bis Begleitmaterial, koordinierst Untertitel, Synchronisationen und Übersetzungen und sorgst für einwandfreie Qualität, in enger Abstimmung mit dem Content\-Team* Du hast den Überblick über Laufzeiten und sorgst dafür, dass jede Serie zum richtigen Zeitpunkt online geht und wieder offline* Du vertrittst uns auf internationalen Fachmessen und pflegst ein Netzwerk, das uns die besten Titel zuerst zeigt Das bringst du mit------------------* Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im internationalen Lizenzgeschäft für audiovisuelle Inhalte.* Fundierte Kenntnisse im Lizenz\- und Urheberrecht sowie Erfahrung im Vertragsmanagement.* Kenntnisse vertikaler Content\-Formate und der wichtigsten Anbieter.* Verhandlungssicheres Englisch in Wort und Schrift.* Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen für Verhandlungen und Fachmessen. Das zeichnet dich aus---------------------* Du arbeitest sorgfältig, zuverlässig und behältst Fristen konsequent im Blick.* Du baust gerne Beziehungen auf und bewegst dich sicher im Austausch mit internationalen Lizenzgebern.* Du organisierst dich im Teilzeitpensum selbstständig und effizient.* Du entwickelst Lösungen eigenverantwortlich und bringst Dinge strukturiert zum Abschluss.* Du hast ein Gespür für Trends und Zielgruppen, interessierst dich für Vertical Content und kannst Inhalte fundiert beurteilen.* Du trittst in Verhandlungen sicher, verbindlich und partnerschaftlich auf. Interesse geweckt?------------------Du möchtest mit deinem Gespür für Content, Rechte und gute Deals ein attraktives Serienangebot mitgestalten? Dann freuen wir uns, von dir zu hören.Bitte sende uns deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen unter Angabe deines gewünschten Pensums, deiner Bruttojahressalärvorstellung sowie deines frühestmöglichen Startdatums.![Chiffre]()* Chiffre  8548 Ellikon an der Thur*jidf87a310jm jit1148jm jiy26jm

The Bank is looking for a pragmatic, commercially\-minded Legal Advisor to join its Legal \& Compliance function and provide hands\-on legal support across the business. Collegial and dynamic working environment within a stable bank. A Client that Finders know well, thus able to explain the culture and working environment to any potentially, suitable applicant.Description du poste**Position:**Reporting to the Head of Legal \& Compliance, you will provide day\-to\-day legal advice across the Bank, helping the business navigate legal and regulatory matters while taking a practical and solutions\-focused approach. You will work closely with colleagues across the business, particularly Commodity Trade Finance, Wealth Management, Financial Institutions and Compliance, and will also liaise with clients, external counsel and Swiss authorities where required.  **Key Responsibilities:** * Provide legal advice and practical guidance to the Bank's various departments on Swiss and international legal matters.* Draft, review and negotiate banking agreements, security documentation and other legal documents, particularly in relation to Commodity Trade Finance and Wealth Management.* Support the Bank on legal matters involving clients, counterparties, authorities, courts and bankruptcy offices.* Advise on client succession and estate\-related matters.* Review internal policies, directives and standard documentation and ensure they remain aligned with applicable legislation.* Monitor developments in Swiss banking legislation and regulation and advise the Head of Legal \& Compliance on their impact on the Bank.* Work with Compliance on cross\-functional legal and regulatory matters.* Coordinate external lawyers on specialist advice, disputes and litigation where required.* Conduct legal research and prepare opinions, reports and other legal documentation.* Provide legal and regulatory training to colleagues where appropriate.* Act as a deputy to the Head of Legal \& Compliance on legal matters when required.**Why Apply?**  A good opportunity for a Swiss\-qualified lawyer looking for a varied in\-house position within a specialist banking environment, rather than a narrowly defined legal role. You will have genuine exposure to the business, including Commodity Trade Finance, Wealth Management and Financial Institutions, within an international and multicultural organisation. The role offers considerable variety and the opportunity to take ownership of matters while working closely with experienced colleagues and senior stakeholders.Profil recherché**Profile:*** Swiss\-qualified lawyer, ideally with Brevet d'avocat* Proven experience in Swiss banking law* Commodity Trade Finance experience is essential* Good understanding of Swiss banking regulations and related regulatory/compliance matters* Strong legal drafting, research and analytical skills* Experience reviewing and negotiating commercial and banking documentation* Pragmatic, commercially\-minded approach with sound judgement* Well organised and able to manage multiple matters and deadlines* Strong communication and interpersonal skills* Fluent written and spoken French and English* Swiss resident\#LI\-SG1 j4id10497083jm j4it1148jm j4iy26jm

jobs.title: Manager - US Accounting and Reporting Group - USARG
jobs.description:
**Location:** Zurich
**Workload:** 100-100%
**Start Date:** 1. April 2027

**Your contribution to KPMG**



* Lead and conduct PCAOB integrated audits of Swiss based multinational companies or Swiss subsidiaries of U.S. companies
* Audit spin-offs, disposals, opening balance sheets and acquired businesses in connection with various business combinations
* Lead and support other transaction-based projects that require IFRS / US GAAP / PCAOB / SEC reporting expertise (comfort letters, agreed-upon procedures and reviews of registration statements)
* Lead and deliver accounting advisory and SOX advisory services to non-audit clients
* Coach Swiss-based audit teams on technical US accounting, auditing and reporting inquiries
* Conduct internal and external PCAOB / US GAAS trainings



**This is what makes you successful**



* Strong knowledge of US GAAS/PCAOB and SEC requirements and US audit methodology. Knowledge of IFRS and International Standards on Auditing (ISA) is a plus
* Highly motivated, curious and proactive team player with a positive attitude, client service oriented and excellent oral and written communication skills
* 5-10 years of recent integrated (PCAOB and US GAAP or PCAOB and IFRS) audit experience with a Big 4 firm and proficiency in researching accounting and auditing issues.
* U.S. CPA license
* Technology skills including Alteryx, AI tools and data analytics
* Strong project management and team leadership skills
* Ability to deliver high-quality services under tight deadlines
* Proficient English skills. Other languages are a plus.



**Your benefits**

**Unlock Your Potential**

We offer personalized training programs, a wide range of courses, and tailored career paths to help you fully realize your potential. Our offerings include specialized courses, mentoring programs, continuing education, the People Manager Academy, and much more. We encourage you to develop future-ready skills through digital learning, external programs, and support for professional qualifications. Surrounded by motivated and open-minded experts, you can exchange ideas, challenge perspectives, and help shape the future.
[Grow at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/grow-at-kpmg.html)



**Mentoring and Networking**

At KPMG, we support your professional and personal development through personalized mentoring programs and a collaborative culture.
From programs such as WoMentoring for early-career professionals to networking opportunities and social events, you will build meaningful relationships with colleagues and clients. We value diverse perspectives and believe they are key to innovation and professional growth.



**Flexible Working**

With us, you'll find the support and flexibility you need to balance your career and private life. You can benefit from hybrid working models, flexible working hours, the option to work from abroad (up to 10 working days per calendar year), and generous parental leave. You also have the option to purchase additional vacation days.
[Work at KPMG](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/careers/work-at-kpmg.html)



**Additional Benefits**

Successful employees need top-tier IT infrastructure and excellent mobility-not only at work but also in their private lives. KPMG covers your mobile phone bill, provides financial support for your mobile device and offers an SBB Half-Fare Travelcard. Parking spaces are also available at fair prices. Our lunch allowance supports your daily meals, and you benefit from additional discounts across various areas.



**Generous Parental Leave**

We offer generous parental leave: 18 weeks of maternity leave and 4 weeks of paternity leave, which can be taken within the first year after the birth or adoption of your child. Fathers may also apply for up to two additional months of unpaid leave.
To further support families, we offer places in holiday camps for children aged 6 to 15 during school holidays in cooperation with MS Sports. Additional support services are available through our Parents Circle.



**Inspired by Innovation**

At KPMG, you'll work with highly qualified, ambitious experts. In our inspiring environment, clear thinking and strong perspectives matter more than hierarchies-because good ideas always come first. We support you with cutting-edge tools and state-of-the-art AI technologies, enabling you to actively participate in and shape technological progress in your daily work.



**An inclusive culture**

Our commitment to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion is reflected in our policies and practices. Become part of a culture that celebrates individuality. In our various communities (KNOW, KNOW Young, Pride, and Internationals at KPMG), you can connect with like-minded colleagues.
[Values \& Culture](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/about/values-culture.html)



**Health \& Wellbeing**

We promote employee wellbeing with a strong focus on mental health. Our offerings range from practical self-care webinars to leadership training. In addition, we provide discounts on numerous fitness programs and sports activities-ideal for integrating movement into your workday.



**Pension Fund**

We offer above-average benefits to help you build a solid retirement plan.



**Our Commitment**

Quality and integrity are essential at KPMG to build trust and drive change. We are aware of the broader impact of our actions and provide trusted services with a consistent focus on ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance). In addition, we are actively committed to social responsibility by supporting volunteer work and promoting charitable projects through the KPMG Foundation.
[Commitment](https://kpmg.com/ch/en/about/commitment.html)



**Discover KPMG -- Become part of our team**

With 300 different auditing and advisory service opportunities, our people can choose the career path that suits them best. Through our competencies in business transformation as well as ESG consulting, we support our clients in today's biggest challenges. We are a purpose-led and values driven company where your insight can create opportunities for you and contribute to a better future. Do work that matters, supported by a community that values difference and cares about you. Gain learning that'll last you a lifetime and be recognized for the impact you make. Find opportunity everywhere with KPMG.

**Questions? We're here for you**

jobs.title: Järjestelmäasiantuntija rakennusautomaatioon, Helsinki
jobs.description: JÄRJESTELMÄASIANTUNTIJA RAKENNUSAUTOMAATIOON – HELSINKIOletko rakennusautomaation kokenut osaaja, jolle laadukas työnjälki on kunnia-asia? Etsimme Helsinkiin järjestelmäasiantuntijaa, joka hallitsee rakennusautomaatiojärjestelmien suunnittelun ja ohjelmoinnin sekä vie työnsä huolellisesti maaliin asti.Tässä tehtävässä pääset hyödyntämään vahvaa teknistä osaamistasi monipuolisissa rakennusautomaation asiantuntijatehtävissä. Arvostamme itsenäistä työotetta, vastuullisuutta ja halua tehdä asiat kunnolla – unohtamatta sujuvaa yhteistyötä muun tiimin kanssa.Mitä työ pitää sisällään?Järjestelmäasiantuntijana vastaat rakennusautomaatiojärjestelmien teknisestä suunnittelusta, toteutuksesta ja käyttöönotosta. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat automaatiojärjestelmien kytkentäpiirustusten laatiminen automaatiokeskuksille, mittalaitteille ja toimilaitteille sekä venttiilien määrittely automaatiotoimituksiin.Lisäksi tehtäviisi kuuluvat logiikka- ja käyttöliittymäohjelmointi, järjestelmäarkkitehtuurin suunnittelu sekä järjestelmien käyttöönottotestaukset. Opastat tarvittaessa myös loppukäyttäjiä järjestelmien käytössä.Työskentelet muun muassa Schneider EcoStruxure Building Operation- ja Siemens ABT/Desigo -järjestelmien parissa.Mitä odotamme sinulta?Sinulla on jo vahvaa kokemusta rakennusautomaatiosta ja talotekniikasta. Tehtävään soveltuva koulutus voi olla esimerkiksi insinöörin tai diplomi-insinöörin tutkinto, mutta ennen kaikkea ratkaisevat käytännön osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi.Olet huolellinen ja laatutietoinen ammattilainen, joka kantaa vastuun omasta työstään ja varmistaa, että lopputulos vastaa sovittuja vaatimuksia. Osaat työskennellä itsenäisesti, mutta toimit myös mielelläsi osana tiimiä ja autat tarvittaessa muita.Tehtävässä tarvitset sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa. jobs.title: Tekninen myyjä, Kuusamo
jobs.description: Oletko palvelühenkinen ja neüvokas? Saattaisit sopia myyntitehtäviin Würthille, juuri tuollaisena kuin olet. Meillä asenne ratkaisee ja siksi se, kuka olet tänään, ei vielä määritä sitä, mitä kaikkea voit tehdä huomenna.Hae meille tekniseksi myyjäksi Würthin myymälään. Sinun ei tarvitse olla valmis osaaja, sillä palkkaamme teknisiä myyjiä erilaisilla työ- ja koulutustaustoilla. Tärkeimpiä ominaisuuksiasi ovat asiakaspalveluhenkisyys, oma-aloitteisuus sekä halukkuus kehittyä ja oppia lisää käytännön teknisistä tuotteistamme.Teknisen myyjän tehtäviin kuuluu yritysasiakkaiden auttaminen ja ongelmien ratkaiseminen, esimerkiksi oikean kiinnitysratkaisun tai työkalun valinnassa, sekä uusien tuotteiden esittely ja myymälän avustavat tehtävät. Tehtäviin kuuluu myös asiakkaiden aktivoiminen puhelimitse. Würthin myymälöissä työ on itsenäistä tiimityötä kollegoiden kanssa, mutta myös yhteistyötä myyntiedustajien ja asiakaspäälliköiden kanssa.Würthin myymälät ovat auki arkipäivisin klo 6.30-17.00, joten myyjiemme työajat ovat kaupan alalla poikkeuksellisen mukavat. Tarjoamme vakituisen ja kokopäiväisen työn kiinteällä kuukausipalkalla. Meillä pääset työskentelemään mukavassa porukassa, luotettavassa ja vakavaraisessa yrityksessä.Würthillä et ole yksin, sillä autamme sinua kehittymään erinomaiseksi myyjäksi kouluttamalla ja tukemalla. Valmennukset ja koulutukset jatkuvat säännöllisesti koko uran ajan syventäen osaamistasi. Teknisen myyjän työ antaa myös hyvät valmiudet mahdollisiin myyntiedustajan tehtäviin.Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, hakuaika päättyy 9.12.2026. Lisätietoja avoimesta tehtävästä saat [wurth.fi/rekrytointi](http://wurth.fi/rekrytointi) sekä yhteyshenkilöltämme: Katariina Sadinmaa, puh. 044 477 0705.Jo 50 vuotta Suomessa toiminut Würth Oy on teknisen tukkukaupan markkinajohtaja ja osa maailmanlaajuista Würth-konsernia. Tuotevalikoimaamme kuuluvat työkalut sekä teollisuus- ja kiinnitystarvikkeet. Asiakkaitamme ovat mm. teollisuuden, rakentamisen ja kunnossapidon ammattilaiset. Suomen pääkonttorimme ja logistiikkakeskuksemme sijaitsee Riihimäellä, ja Würth centereitä on Suomessa jo 200. Würthiläisiä on Suomessa jo noin 1500, joten pääset osaksi suurta ja kirjavaa joukkoa, josta löytyy paljon luonnetta. We ü – juuri tuollaisena kuin olet!

jobs.title: ODMS Coordinator
jobs.description: Heb jij affiniteit met managementsystemen, kwaliteit en continue verbetering? Ben je organisatorisch sterk, communicatief vaardig en vind je het leuk om verschillende afdelingen te ondersteunen bij het verbeteren en bewaken van werkprocessen? Dan is deze functie als ODMS Coordinator een mooie uitdaging! Voor een internationale organisatie in de regio Terneuzen zijn wij op zoek naar een ODMS Coordinator. Wat ga je doen? Als ODMS Coordinator ondersteun je een afdeling bij het onderhouden, verbeteren en optimaal benutten van het Operations Discipline Management System (ODMS). Dit managementsysteem helpt de organisatie om werkprocessen, verantwoordelijkheden en afspraken goed vast te leggen en te bewaken. Je bent binnen de afdeling het aanspreekpunt voor het managementsysteem en werkt nauw samen met afdelingsverantwoordelijken, element owners en vakspecialisten. Je zorgt ervoor dat afspraken worden nageleefd, verbeterpunten worden opgepakt en wijzigingen goed worden doorgevoerd. Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden: Coördineren van activiteiten rondom het onderhouden en verbeteren van het ODMS binnen de afdeling. Ondersteunen van verschillende element owners bij hun verantwoordelijkheden binnen het managementsysteem. Adviseren en begeleiden van collega's bij wijzigingen in procedures, werkwijzen en managementsysteemvereisten. Bewaken en stimuleren van de Plan-Do-Check-Act-cyclus (PDCA) om continu verbeteringen door te voeren. Samenwerken met het afdelingsmanagement om verbeterkansen te signaleren en op te pakken. Coördineren, voorbereiden en begeleiden van Management System Reviews met het managementteam. Uitvoeren van interne audits op toegewezen onderdelen van het managementsysteem en signaleren van afwijkingen en verbeterpunten. Afstemmen met andere ODMS-collega's en vakspecialisten om een goede implementatie en naleving van het managementsysteem te ondersteunen. Wat kun jij? Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde mbo-4 opleiding, bij voorkeur in een administratieve ofbedrijfskundige richting. Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring. Je hebt affiniteit met managementsystemen, kwaliteitsprocessen en continue verbetering. Kennis van ISO-managementsystemen, projecten rondom kwaliteit of interne audits is een pré. Je communiceert gemakkelijk in het Nederlands. Daarnaast heb je voldoende basiskennis van het Engels om binnen een internationale werkomgeving te kunnen communiceren. Je werkt gestructureerd, bent organisatorisch sterk en neemt initiatief. Je kunt goed samenwerken met verschillende afdelingen en weet mensen op een prettige manier mee te nemen in veranderingen. Je hebt goede computervaardigheden en kunt overweg met het Microsoft Office-pakket. Ervaring met managementsystemen of digitale documentbeheersystemen is een pré. Wat krijg je? Een fulltime functie van 40 uur per week. Werken in dagdienst. Mogelijkheid om één dag per week vanuit huis te werken. Een marktconform salaris, passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring. 25 vakantiedagen. Een 13e maand. Reiskostenvergoeding en eventuele vergoeding van tunnelkosten. Een functie binnen een internationale, technische werkomgeving. Je gaat aan de slag bij een internationale organisatie in de chemische industrie, met een grote productielocatie in de regio Terneuzen. Op deze locatie werken professionals uit verschillende disciplines samen aan de ontwikkeling en productie van hoogwaardige materialen en innovatieve oplossingen. Veiligheid, kwaliteit en continu verbeteren staan centraal. Je komt terecht in een professionele, technische werkomgeving waar verschillende afdelingen nauw met elkaar samenwerken en waar jouw bijdrage aan goed ingerichte werkprocessen belangrijk is.

jobs.title: Forklift Operator
jobs.description:
TPCE (Toyota Parts Centre Europe) is Toyota's European distribution center. It supplies Toyota and Lexus parts to distributors throughout Europe. In addition, TPCE delivers directly to garages and dealerships in Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Germany, and Northern France. At the Diest facility, imported Toyota and Lexus automotive parts are stored, orders for dealers and distributors are picked and assembled, and shipments are prepared and dispatched. TPCE is a modern, highly automated distribution center specializing in automotive parts logistics.

Jobomschrijving

Toyota Diest is looking for forklift operators who are passionate about their profession and seeking a long-term career opportunity.

Are you the person we're looking for? Then Toyota is the right place for you!

As a Forklift Operator, your responsibilities include:

  • Order picking
  • Moving automotive parts and placing/removing them from warehouse racks
  • Stacking various pallets
  • ...

You will start working in a specific department, where you will learn all aspects of the operation. Over time, you will also become familiar with other departments. At Toyota, there is always room for growth and development! You will have the opportunity to develop into a fully-fledged Toyota team member. Who knows, you might even become Toyota's next supervisor or team leader.

Did you know that?

  • Toyota offers highly stable employment.
  • After approximately six months of employment, you may be offered a long-term contract.
  • Toyota grants permanent contracts to temporary agency workers twice a year.
  • More than 1,000 employees work at Toyota, making it one of the largest employers in the region.
  • Toyota encourages continuous development and promotes a culture based on teamwork and respect.
  • It is the ideal workplace for people who value innovation, people-oriented values, and a stable career.

Experience? Not necessary at all! We invest in our employees and provide comprehensive training. With the right attitude, you'll go a long way!

You are looking for a job where you can build a future. After positive performance evaluations, you may qualify for a permanent contract.

In addition:

  • You have experience operating a forklift.
  • You are able to work in a two-shift system (5:50 AM - 2:00 PM and 1:50 PM - 10:00 PM).
  • Do you enjoy rolling up your sleeves and staying physically active? Great! Then Toyota is the right place for you.
  • Safety is your top priority.
  • You can travel independently to work. While we encourage carpooling, you must also be able to commute on your own when your carpool partner is unavailable. Public transport is not an option, considering your work hours.

The Mission: Finding the Next "Airport"
 
Our core technology (Spatial Intelligence) is powerful, but we have only scratched the surface of its potential. Your mission is to explore Adjacent Markets to find our next major revenue stream.
 
You will act as a "Startup Founder" within Outsight. You will investigate verticals like Physical Security (Intrusion Detection), Retail (Shopping Paths), and Smart Buildings to answer two questions: Can we solve their problem? and will they pay for it?

Market discovery: Get out of the building. You will interview potential buyers in new sectors to understand their pain points. You will map the competitive landscape (e.g., "Why would a Mall buy Lidar instead of cheap cameras?"). Hypothesis testing: Design experiments to validate willingness-to-pay in new markets.
 
MVP definition & prototyping: Leverage our existing Platform to configure "Vertical MVPs." You won't ask engineering to build a whole new product for 6 months; you will hack together a solution to test a hypothesis with a design partner in 4 weeks.
 
Go-to-Market Strategy: A Security Director buys differently than an Airport Manager. You will define the Packaging, Pricing, and Positioning for these new offers.
 
Pilot Management: Oversee the first deployments in these new sectors, acting as both PM and temporary Solution Engineer to ensure the first customers succeed.
 
Go/No-Go Decisions: You own the business case. You must be brave enough to kill a project if the market isn't there, or pitch for resources to double down if it is.
 
What are the requirements for the role?
 
5+ years in Product Management, ideally in an early-stage startup or an Innovation Lab environment.
 
Commercially Minded: You understand that a product is only successful if it can be sold. You are comfortable discussing ROI and budgets.
 
The "Zero to One" Mindset: You are comfortable with ambiguity. You don't need a polished roadmap; you need a problem to solve.
 
Tech-Savvy: You can understand the capabilities of our Lidar platform well enough to know what can be "configured" quickly for a demo vs. what requires deep engineering.

Additionally, our Car Traffic Remote Monitoring product is trusted by several Tier 1 customers, including BMW.
 
 
Position Overview :
 
Outsight is seeking an exceptional Algorithm Engineer to join our innovative team. As an Algorithm Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in the development and optimization of state-of-the-art algorithms, ensuring real-time performance for our data processing applications.
 
This position offers a unique opportunity to work on challenging projects and contribute to the evolution of perception technology.
 
You will be working on one or several of Outsight’s core algorithms:
 
Clustering of 3D point cloud (split, merge, ...)
Classification of 3D point clouds
Semantic perception and point-wise 3D segmentation (ground detection, ...)
 
What will be your responsibilities? 
 
In this context, your mission will be to design and develop new modules used in the core functions to improve systems performance, always following those steps:
 
Analyze the problem to solve and do bibliography
Design and proposal of new modules/improvement of existing modules
Create an evaluation database to ensure the quality of your module
Development and integration to our C++ Software
SW testing (Unit testing, performance characterization, system testing, …) and documentation
 
What are the requirements for the role? 
 
To excel in this role, you should possess the following qualifications:
 
Education: Master's in Computer Science or a related field.
Experience: +2 years experience as Algorithm Engineer or in a similar role, showcasing a history of successful algorithm development.
Programming Skills: Proficiency in a programming language such as C++ with the ability to write clean and efficient code.
Domain Knowledge: An expertise in machine learning, deep learning, and data processing, with hands-on expertise in their practical application.
Problem-Solving: Exceptional problem-solving abilities and a creative mindset for algorithm design, emphasizing real-world applications.
Communication: Effective communication and collaboration skills, allowing you to work seamlessly within cross-functional teams.
Independence: The capability to work independently and take ownership of algorithmic projects while also being a collaborative team player.
Language Skills: Fluency in English is required, and French language skills are a valuable asset, given our international environment.
 
 
Why join us?
 
Be part of the team pioneering Spatial Intelligence solutions at unprecedented scale—the breakthrough technology transforming how the world’s most prestigious airports, infrastructure operators, and smart cities understand and optimize physical flows.
 
As a 7-time Gartner-recognized category-defining leader with dozens of global awards including “Edge AI Product of the Year,” “LiDAR Leader Award,” “CES Best of Innovation” and many more, we’re backed by 37 patents and deployments with the most prestigious (and challenging) customers across four continents.
 
Join our international team of world-class experienced engineers and business leaders solving humanity’s most complex spatial challenges, from passenger flow optimization to autonomous robotics coordination, while working at the cutting edge of 3D AI, LiDAR perception, and real-time analytics.
 
Supported by rock-solid investors including BNP Paribas, BPI France, Energy Innovation Capital and Demeter who back our long-term vision, this is your opportunity to shape how physical and digital worlds interact, with the resources, growth trajectory, and technical challenges that will accelerate your career in ways traditional companies cannot offer.

jobs.title: Senior Business Data Scientist - Data & Transformation services
jobs.description:
Ekimetrics is a global leader in Marketing & Commercial effectiveness and AI-powered solutions. Since 2006, we’ve been helping businesses optimize marketing and operations by combining AI with business and tech expertise across 4 domains: Marketing & commercial effectiveness, Customer analytics, Operational excellence, ESG & sustainability.
 
With a full in-house team and offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong, and Shanghai, we deliver tailor-made solutions that turn data into real positive impact, leveraging our unique combination of technology and services.
 
We excel at delivering AI impact at scale. Our mission is to harness this power to tackle the world’s most urgent issues. We commit to responsibility and frugality in AI, systematic AI impact at scale, and loyalty to our values and DNA. 

You join as Senior Business Scientist within our Data & AI Transformation Services (DATS). You bridge business, consulting, AI & data expertise: you frame high-value use cases, turn business needs into AI opportunities, and drive adoption. You work alongside AI, Data and Software Engineers.

Clients' Projects

  • Lead the day-to-day relationship with business and CDO/CIO sponsors, and understand their strategic and operational challenges.
  • Frame high-value Data & AI use cases and translate business needs into AI opportunities, from AI ambition and roadmap to Proof of Value and MVP.
  • Depending on the engagement, act as Data & AI Product Owner: own the product vision and backlog, prioritize with business sponsors, write and accept user stories, steer the squad's delivery with the Tech Lead from Proof of Value to MVP and production, and own the related delivery governance and planning.
  • Align business teams, leadership and ExCo around the AI roadmap and the transformation priorities.
  • Own the business value and adoption of the solutions built by the squad: operating model, usage, impact measurement, Responsible AI and governance. Challenge their feasibility and industrialization with the Tech Lead and the Tech Engineers; you do not build the models yourself, but you are technical enough to challenge and steer GenAI, LLM, agentic and ML solutions.
  • Contribute to the Transformation Cockpit: maturity measurement, adoption KPIs and steering of AI value over time.
  • Work within a multidisciplinary squad (Tech Lead, AI/Data/Software Engineers), apply Ekimetrics' DATS methods, templates and deliverables, and tailor them to each client.
  • Coordinate the business side of the squad and monitor delivery and profitability with manager support.

Strategic Projects

  • Develop and share best practices, methodologies and DATS assets (how-tos, templates, typical deliverables) across the Data & AI Transformation community.
  • Stay up to date with AI, GenAI, ML and agentic technologies, and with their impact on business models and operating models.
  • Contribute to internal AI initiatives, accelerators and thought leadership.

Business Development

  • Identify opportunities for Data & AI transformation within existing client accounts (upsell and cross-sell).
  • Contribute to account development, renewals and project scoping, alongside the Partner.
  • Contribute to RFPs, proposals and pitches.
  • Support the development of new DATS offerings and use cases.

Transversal & People Development

  • Contribute to recruitment, onboarding and development of Data & AI Transformation talent.
  • Mentor and coach Junior Business Scientists and interns.
  • Develop and deliver internal AI / Data training and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Profile

  • Senior level: you have already led client engagements, coordinated a team and contributed to business development.
  • Hybrid business-tech profile: you can connect business value, data, AI/GenAI, technology and adoption, and talk credibly with both sponsors and engineers.
  • Proven product ownership experience on data or AI products (backlog, prioritization, agile delivery).
  • Experience facing senior stakeholders and driving change or transformation, beyond the delivery of pilots.
Why join us?
 
At Ekimetrics, we believe your ideas truly matter. Here, your ideas are yours to build and bring to life. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit, encouraging you to push boundaries to achieve meaningful impact. But it’s not just about individual success—we thrive on collaboration and enriching one another.

Together, we’re constantly learning and growing, whether through personalized career paths and training, challenging projects, mentorship, or simply through the diverse perspectives we bring to the table.

And perhaps more importantly, we believe in enjoying what we do. Ekimetrics is a stimulating and safe environment where you can thrive as your authentic self.

In 2023, Ekimetrics obtained the “mission-driven company” status, reflecting our strong commitment to CSR.
Our purpose: Accelerate organizations’ transformation towards sustainability, through the application of data science and artificial intelligence.

We were also certified Great Place to Work© in France, the United Kingdom, and the United States in 2023, and our Hong Kong office received the Best Companies to Work for in Asia 2023© award.

Ekimetrics is part of the French Tech 120 ranking. We have been selected by La French Tech to join the prestigious group of the top 120 French scale-ups, recognized for their potential to become international leaders.
 
You will have access to:
 
·       The Eki.Academy training catalog, which contains programs that will enhance your skills on our solutions and jobs, learning paths on our digital platform, as well as programs dedicated to our priority challenges, including awareness of environmental issues with the Climate School;
·       A sporty, artistic, musical, playful, charitable, and committed life: from our private gym to art exhibitions, video games, and concerts, or even CSR challenges on our dedicated platform (Vendredi);

jobs.title: Product Owner (H/F/N)
jobs.description:
Les entreprises qui performent décident mieux. Depuis 2006, Ekimetrics aide les organisations à transformer leurs décisions en avantage concurrentiel durable grâce à des solutions d’IA. Notre double ambition est d’allier performance et durabilité, pour construire un leadership pérenne. 

Nos solutions sont une combinaison unique de People et de technologie. Notre plateforme Eki.Decisions complète l’expertise de nos équipes en marketing, efficacité commerciale et data science, pour connecter l’IA aux décisions qui structurent toute l’organisation. 

Avec une équipe 100% internalisée et des bureaux à Paris, Londres, New York, Hong Kong et Shanghai, nous nous engageons pour une IA responsable et frugale, pour garantir un avantage concurrentiel constant, et pour rester fidèles à nos valeurs et à notre ADN. 

Vous rejoignez l’équipe Produit – R&PD 

Au sein de l’équipe R&PD (Research & Product Development) nous concevons et industrialisons des solutions Data & IA SaaS à fort impact business, qui répondent aux enjeux de nos clients grâce à l’analytics, la data science et l’intelligence artificielle.

A ce titre, nous recrutons un·e Product Owner pour notre solution Marketing Effectiveness avec pour objectif de structurer la  roadmap produit, maximiser son adoption, son time-to-market et la valeur délivrée à nos clients. 

Votre rôle dans l’équipe 

Product Owner de notre solution Marketing Effectiveness (Eki.Decisions), vous transformez les besoins business, marché et utilisateurs en fonctionnalités concrètes, documentées et alignées sur une logique de plateforme commune. 

Vous travaillez au quotidien avec le Product Manager, les équipes engineering et data, ainsi que les équipes projet et delivery, pour construire une solution fiable, adoptée et scalable. 

Vos principales missions 

Piloter le backlog et le delivery 

  • Structurer, prioriser et maintenir le backlog de la solution 

  • Rédiger les user stories, spécifications fonctionnelles et critères d’acceptance 

  • Clarifier les besoins avec l’engineering et accompagner chaque livraison de bout en bout 

  • Suivre l’avancement, lever les blocages et sécuriser les engagements 

  • Animer les rituels agiles : refinement, sprint planning, reviews, rétrospectives, synchronisations produit/tech 

  • Rendre la roadmap, les priorités et les arbitrages lisibles pour toutes les parties prenantes 

Contribuer à la vision produit 

  • Co-construire la vision et la roadmap avec le Product Manager 

  • Traduire les enjeux business et marché en opportunités produit concrètes : fonctionnalités, parcours utilisateurs, briques mutualisées, standards d’expérience 

  • Prioriser selon la valeur business, l’impact client, la contribution à la platformisation et la capacité à accélérer le time-to-market 

Participer à la product discovery 

  • Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs et des clients sur le Marketing Effectiveness 

  • Maîtriser les usages, comportements et règles métier qui font la valeur de la solution 

  • Identifier les enjeux fonctionnels et opérationnels : expérience utilisateur, cohérence des parcours, adoption, scalabilité, industrialisation 

  • Conduire ou contribuer aux activités de discovery : interviews, retours terrain, analyses d’usage, benchmarks 

Faire adopter et améliorer en continu 

  • Accompagner le déploiement des nouvelles fonctionnalités auprès des parties prenantes clés, avec une communication claire sur ce qui est livré 

  • Mesurer l’impact : adoption, satisfaction, valeur délivrée aux clients 

  • Animer la boucle de feedback avec les équipes Produit, Business, Tech et Delivery 

  • S’appuyer sur les outils de tracking pour monitorer les usages et prioriser de façon data-driven 

  • Garantir la qualité : documentation produit, release notes, support, monitoring d’usage 

Collaborer en transverse 

  • Travailler avec les équipes Produit, Tech, Data, IA et Delivery pour assurer la cohérence des solutions émergentes avec la plateforme 

  • Servir de relais entre les équipes business, produit, engineering et delivery 

  • Participer aux démonstrations, formations internes, retours d’expérience et communications produit 

Votre profil 

Expérience 

  • 3 ans minimum en tant que Product Owner ou Product Manager 

  • Expérience sur des produits SaaS ou digitaux, idéalement dans un environnement data, IA ou tech

Compétences 

  • Forte appétence business : vous reliez les fonctionnalités à la valeur client et aux enjeux marché 

  • Aisance avec les profils tech : vous comprenez les enjeux d’un produit technique, sans avoir besoin d’être développeur·se 

  • Maîtrise du backlog : clarifier les besoins, prioriser des sujets complexes, suivre le delivery 

  • Logique de plateforme : mutualisation des usages, convergence des solutions, cohérence des parcours 

  • Sensibilité forte à l’expérience utilisateur, à l’adoption et à la qualité produit 

  • Capacité à vulgariser et à embarquer les parties prenantes autour d’une vision commune 

Savoir-être 

  • Organisé·e, rigoureux·se, autonome, curieux·se et orienté·e impact 

Langues 

  • Français et anglais courants, à l’écrit comme à l’oral 

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?  

Chez Ekimetrics, vos idées comptent vraiment et vous appartiennent: à vous de leur donner vie. Nous cultivons un esprit entrepreneurial qui vous encourage à repousser les limites pour créer un impact significatif. 

Mais il ne s’agit pas seulement de réussites individuelles : nous avançons ensemble, en nous enrichissant mutuellement. Ensemble, nous apprenons et progressons en continu, que ce soit à travers des parcours de carrière personnalisés, des projets stimulants, du mentorat, ou simplement grâce à la diversité des perspectives que chacun.e apporte.

Et surtout, nous croyons au plaisir dans le travail. Ekimetrics est un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, où chacun.e peut s’épanouir en étant pleinement soi-même.

En 2023, Ekimetrics a obtenu le statut d’entreprise à mission qui témoigne de notre ambition forte en matière de RSE. Notre raison d’être : Faire de la data science et de l’intelligence artificielle l’accélérateur de la transformation durable des organisations.

Ekimetrics fait partie du classement French Tech 120 ! Nous avons été sélectionnés par La French Tech pour rejoindre le prestigieux groupe des 120 scale-ups françaises les plus performantes, avec un fort potentiel pour devenir des leaders internationaux.  

Vous aurez accès :

  • Au catalogue de formation Eki.Academy qui contient des programmes qui vous feront monter en compétences sur nos solutions et nos métiers, des parcours apprenants sur notre plateforme digitale ainsi que des programmes dédiés à nos enjeux prioritaires, dont la sensibilisation aux sujets environnementaux avec la Climate School.
  • A une vie sportive, artistique, musicale, ludique, caritative et engagée : de notre salle de sport privatisée à nos expositions d’art, en passant par des jeux vidéo et des concerts, ou encore les défis RSE sur la plateforme Vendredi. Toutes ces initiatives sont portées par nos Eki.People.
  • De nombreux évènements et séminaires pour rester proche de votre communauté.
  • Des locaux chaleureux dans un quartier dynamique au cœur de Paris (Grands boulevards).

jobs.title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Our Security and IT team keeps the 360Learning platform secure, compliant and auditable for the 1,500 organisations that learn on it every day. As a Senior DevSecOps Engineer, your mission is to make our infrastructure secure by design, detectable by default, and provable at audit time.

360Learning runs its learning platform on Azure and Kubernetes, certified ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. Over the past two years the technical security workload has grown on every front: a larger and more regulated customer base sending their own scans and security assessments, a wider detection and response scope, more infrastructure to keep hardened and auditable, and a growing backlog of security engineering projects that never reach the top of the queue.

We are creating this position to add real technical capacity on the infrastructure side of security, and to move part of our security posture from manual effort to automated guardrails. You will be the bridge between security and platform engineering: deep enough in infrastructure to fix things yourself, and close enough to security operations to know what to look for.

“Ours is a small, senior team with a broad scope: information security, compliance, infrastructure governance and internal tooling, with dual audit accountability on ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type II. That means direct impact and no layers between you and the decision. Roughly half of this role is greenfield build work you will own end to end.” Guillaume Seigneuret, CISO and Hiring Coach.


Within 1 month, you will:

  • Complete our onboarding and learn how we work through our own platform and our Convexity culture

  • Map our Azure and AKS environment, our detection and logging coverage, and our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 control scope with the CISO and the Security Engineer

  • Meet the DevOps, platform engineering and IT teams you will work with daily

  • Shadow alert triage and one customer security assessment end to end

  • Be autonomous on our AKS and Azure environment and handle infrastructure related alerts end to end

  • Have shipped at least one concrete hardening or automation improvement in production

  • Own the infrastructure scope of vulnerability management, from triage to remediation follow up


    • Within 6 months, you will:

  • Have the honeypot live and producing high fidelity alerts

  • Have measurably widened SIEM connector coverage, with documented log sources and retention

  • Run infrastructure vulnerability remediation on a predictable cycle with SLA reporting


    • Within 12 months, you will:

  • Manage detection content as code, with reviewed and tested rules and documented runbooks

  • Have largely automated audit evidence on the infrastructure scope

jobs.title: SAP Fullstack Developer (SAP HCM / S/4HANA)
jobs.description:
SAP Fullstack Developer (SAP HCM / S/4HANA)

The Opportunity

We are partnering with a large enterprise organisation undergoing a significant SAP S/4HANA transformation programme and are looking for an experienced SAP Fullstack Developer to join a highly skilled delivery team. This role will focus on the design, development, enhancement and support of SAP solutions across the HR domain, with particular emphasis on SAP HCM modules including Organisational Management (OM), Personnel Administration (PA) and Time Management. You will work closely with functional analysts, technical teams and business stakeholders to deliver robust SAP solutions while supporting the transition towards modern SAP development practices and Clean Core principles.

Responsibilities

  • Analyse business and technical requirements and translate them into scalable SAP solutions.
  • Design, develop and maintain SAP applications within an SAP S/4HANA landscape.
  • Develop enhancements and custom solutions across SAP HCM modules including OM, PA and Time Management.
  • Collaborate with functional consultants to evaluate and recommend technical solutions.
  • Develop and maintain integrations between SAP and third-party applications.
  • Create and enhance CDS Views, OData services and SAP Fiori applications.
  • Perform technical testing, debugging and root cause analysis.
  • Support transport management and deployment activities through to production.
  • Produce and maintain technical documentation.
  • Provide support for incident resolution and bug fixing.
  • Share knowledge and mentor junior developers where required.
  • Ensure developments align with SAP best practices, development standards and Clean Core methodologies.

Essential

  • Strong experience in SAP ABAP development.
  • Experience with ABAP OO.
  • Proven SAP HCM experience including:
    • OM (Organisational Management)
    • PA (Personnel Administration)
    • Time Management
  • Knowledge of SAP S/4HANA environments.
  • Experience developing CDS Views.
  • Experience building OData services.
  • Knowledge of SAP Fiori and SAP UI5.
  • Experience with BAPIs and integrations.
  • Experience with WebDynpro.
  • Understanding of the SAP Enhancement Framework.
  • Experience throughout the full software development lifecycle.

Desirable

  • Experience with SAP RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model).
  • Exposure to SAP Build Code and ABAP Development Tools (ADT).
  • Experience working within SAP transformation programmes.
  • Understanding of Clean Core architecture principles.
  • Exposure to SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

What We're Looking For

We are particularly interested in speaking with:
  • SAP HCM Developers
  • SAP ABAP Developers
  • SAP Technical Consultants
  • SAP Fullstack Developers
  • SAP Fiori Developers with HCM experience
  • SAP S/4HANA Developers
Candidates with experience delivering enterprise-scale SAP solutions across HR processes and modern SAP technologies will be especially well suited to this opportunity.      

Personal Profile

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Able to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Able to prioritise multiple tasks within a complex environment.
  • Proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Comfortable working in evolving technical and business environments.

If you are interested apply or send your CV to Harry.rankin@g2recruitment.com

missions* Vous assurerez la supervision des vols DroneMed, en tant que télépilote/superviseur de vols.À ce titre, vous serez responsable de l'opération, de sa préparation jusqu'à sa clôture, et vos drone, carnet de vol, fiche mission et rangement du matériel.Gestion de la sécurité et amélioration continue* Animer le débriefing après chaque opération, consigner tout événement et remonter les anomalies observées sur le terrain.* Appliquer les consignes de sécurité, participer aux exercices PRU et aux formations, et proposer des améliorations des procédures.Missions complémentaires service de nouvelles lignes.Profil recherchéNous recherchons une personne rigoureuse, fiable et ingénieuse, qui aime le travail sur le terrain, au plus près des usagers.Formations et CertificatsVous avez déjà vos certificats de télépilote ? C'est un vrai atout :* l'attestation pour la catégorie ouverte (A1/A3) et la formation complémentaire A2 ;* le certificat théorique de télépilote (CATS) et une formation pratique aux scénarios STS.Vous ne les avez pas encore ? jobs.title: Sopimusasiantuntija
jobs.description: Suomalainen arki vaatii energiaa. Ja tekijöitä. Tule meille näyttämään kykysi ja rakentamaan polttamatonta ja joustavaa energiajärjestelmää! Me Helenissä tarjoamme helpompaa ja mutkattomampaa arkea kaikkialla Suomessa. Helen Oy on vähittäissähkönmyynnin markkinajohtaja Suomessa. Tarjoamme sähkön, lämmön ja jäähdytyksen lisäksi ratkaisuja alueelliseen sekä uusiutuvaan energiaan. Vähennämme suunnitelmallisesti päästöjämme kehittäen fiksumpaa energiajärjestelmää tavoitteena nettonollapäästöt sekä polttoon perustuvasta energiantuotannosta irtautuminen vuoteen 2040 mennessä. Päästäksemme kunnianhimoisiin tavoitteisiimme ja palvellaksemme asiakkaitamme entistä paremmin etsimme sopimusasiantuntijaa Asiakaslaskutus ja tiedonvaihto -tiimiimme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Mitä pääset meillä tekemään? Sopimusasiantuntijana varmistat, että sähkösopimuksiin ja sähköyhtiöiden väliseen tiedonvaihtoon liittyvät prosessit toimivat oikein ja asiakkaiden asiat etenevät sujuvasti. Työsi on tärkeä osa kuluttaja-asiakkaidemme sähkönmyynnin ja sähkönsiirron asiakkuuksien sekä sopimusten hallintaa. Vastaat sähköyhtiöiden välisestä Datahub-tiedonvaihdosta ja selvität tilanteita, joissa tieto tai prosessi ei ole edennyt odotetusti. Työssäsi seuraat sopimus- ja tiedonvaihtoprosessien toimivuutta ja selvität tilanteita, joissa kaikki ei ole mennyt suunnitellusti. Teet yhteistyötä muiden energia-alan toimijoiden kanssa, selvität asiakkaiden tilanteita ja viestit heille ratkaisuista. Lisäksi käsittelet laskutustietoja, teet sähkösopimuksia sekä korjaat sopimus- ja asiakastietoja järjestelmissä. Työ ei kuitenkaan ole vain yksittäisten tilanteiden ratkaisemista: tunnistat myös toistuvia ongelmia ja osallistut toimintatapojen ja prosessien kehittämiseen. Työssä yhdistyvät tarkkuutta vaativa asiantuntijatyö, ongelmanratkaisu, yhteistyö ja asiakastilanteiden selvittäminen. Kaikki tilanteet eivät tule valmiin kaavan mukaan, joten pääset käyttämään myös omaa harkintaasi ja selvittämään asioita aktiivisesti. Mitä odotamme sinulta? Tehtävässä auttaa aiempi kokemus energia-alasta, sopimusten hallinnasta, asiakasprosesseista tai muusta vastaavasta tarkkuutta vaativasta työstä. Työssä kohtaat myös vaihtelevia ja ajoittain kiireisiä tilanteita, joten arvostamme kykyä säilyttää huolellinen ja tarkka työote myös paineen alla. Erityiseksi eduksi katsomme Datahub-sanomaliikenteen, sähkömarkkinoiden menettelytapaohjeiden ja tiedonvaihdon käytäntöjen tuntemuksen. Myös CIS-asiakastietojärjestelmän tai muiden asiakas- ja sopimushallinnan järjestelmien tuntemuksesta on hyötyä. Haemme joukkoomme aktiivista ja oma-aloitteista tekijää, joka tarttuu asioihin ja ottaa vastuuta niiden etenemisestä. Arvostamme uteliasta ja kehittävää työotetta sekä halua ratkaista ongelmia, kyseenalaistaa totuttuja toimintatapoja ja löytää yhdessä entistä parempia tapoja toimia Millainen tiimi sinua odottaa? Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata ensimmäisenä työpäivänä. Saat tehtävään kattavan perehdytyksen ja ympärillesi ison joukon osaavia kollegoita. Tiimissämme työskentelee yhdeksän tiedonvaihdon sopimusasiantuntijaa ja yhdeksän asiakaslaskutuksen laskutusasiantuntijaa. Meillä tieto ja osaaminen kuuluvat kaikille. Autamme toisiamme, jaamme kokemuksiamme ja opimme jatkuvasti toisiltamme. Uskomme, että parhaat ratkaisut syntyvät silloin, kun erilaiset näkemykset uskalletaan tuoda avoimesti esiin. Emme halua tyytyä siihen, miten asiat tehdään tänään. Haluamme kehittyä, kokeilla uutta ja nostaa rimaa yhdessä. Siksi arvostamme ihmisiä, jotka ottavat omistajuutta, uskaltavat haastaa rakentavasti ja haluavat tehdä asioita huomenna vielä hieman paremmin kuin tänään. Toimistomme sijaitsee WeLandissä Ruoholahdessa, ja työskentelemme joustavasti hybridimallilla. Jäikö jokin vielä mietityttämään? Voit kysyä tehtävästä ja tiimistä tarkemmin tiimin esihenkilöltä Hanna Surakalta (+358503377313, hanna.surakka@helen.fi). Kohtasivatko energiamme? Mahtavaa! Voit lähettää hakemuksen ja ansioluettelosi helposti rekryjärjestelmämme kautta (helen.fi/rekry), viimeistään 10.12.2026 mennessä. Huomioithan, että haastattelemme sopivia ehdokkaita jo hakuaikana ja työsuhde alkaa heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian! Yhdistetään voimat!

jobs.title: Tech recruiter
jobs.description:
Great products are built by great engineers. Your mission: bring them to lemlist.

lemlist is the AI-powered sales engagement platform helping sales teams build pipeline smarter, not harder.

Bootstrapped from day one, we've grown from 0 to $60M+ ARR in 8 years without raising a single dollar. Today, 40,000+ sales teams use lemlist to book more meetings and close more deals.

We're building the next generation of outbound: AI-first, multi-channel, highly personalized, and deeply integrated into the way modern sales teams work. And we're just getting started.

 

Your mission

As a Tech Recruiter at lempire, you own full-cycle hiring for our engineering team: developers across the stack (full-stack, back-end, front-end). Your focus is dev hiring, though you support the wider function when needed. You partner closely with hiring managers and our CTO, run AI-first sourcing, deliver an outstanding candidate experience, and bring in the people who build our products. Hands-on from day one.

What you'll own

  • Full-cycle recruiting: from kickoff to offer on your dev roles, autonomously (full-stack, back-end, front-end).

  • AI-first sourcing: you run sourcing with AI tools (and our own products, including lemlist, for outreach), not just classic LinkedIn boolean. You automate the repetitive parts and spend your time where it actually moves the needle.

  • Screening: first-round interviews to assess skills, motivation and culture fit, including with senior engineers.

  • Hiring manager partnership: align on criteria with HMs, the CTO and founders, challenge when needed, keep the process moving.

  • Candidate experience: every interaction sharp, fast and memorable.

  • ATS ownership: clean pipelines, data and reporting.

  • Employer branding: help make lempire the place tech talent wants to join.

  • Process & tooling: test new AI-driven sourcing strategies and make hiring faster and better.

What you are not

  • Someone who only posts jobs and waits for inbound.

  • A pure coordinator who just books interviews.

  • A "yes" recruiter who passes every CV along with no point of view.

  • Someone who needs hand-holding on full-cycle recruiting.

  • Stuck in old-school sourcing: if boolean strings are your only tool, this isn't the role.

Key results

Within 3 months you will have

  • Developed a deep understanding of lempire, our tech stack and our hiring needs.

  • Taken over your engineering roles and built a solid pipeline on each.

  • Built strong relationships with your hiring managers.

  • Delivered your first hires with a clean, fast, AI-leveraged process.

Within 12 months you will have

  • Consistently hit your hiring targets on tech roles: time-to-hire under 30 days, offer acceptance rate above 90%, and strong new-hire retention.

  • Become the go-to person on tech hiring for your hiring managers.

  • Meaningfully improved our sourcing and process, especially through AI.

What's in it for you?

  • Real ownership on tech hiring from day 1.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Fulfilment
jobs.description:
About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. Our marketplace connects jewellers with suppliers of diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery in 70+ countries, with more than $300M in annual transactions and a $350B industry still waiting to be modernised. We are scaling fast, and we are only getting started.

Our Mission

For decades, the diamond trade has been slow, opaque and inefficient: hard to find stock, hard to trust prices, hard to know when anything will arrive. Nivoda exists to change that. We give businesses of every size, in every location, the same access to inventory, the same transparent pricing and the same reliable delivery as the biggest players in the industry.

The Fulfilment & Express Team

The Fulfilment & Express team is where Nivoda's promise to buyers is kept. We own how an order travels from supplier to jeweller: the delivery date we promise, the hubs that hold and check stock, the carriers that move it, and the returns and quality checks that protect every purchase. We are a remote-first team of product, engineering, design and QA who work closely with Operations, Customer Support, Sales and Supplier Experience. We are low on hierarchy and high on ownership, and we like solving problems where software meets the physical world.

About the Role

As our Senior Product Manager for Fulfilment & Express, you will own how Nivoda orders get from supplier to jeweller: accurately promised, reliably tracked and delivered fast. You will set the strategy and roadmap for a complex, operationally heavy product area that spans diamonds, gemstones, melee and finished jewellery, with physical hubs, carriers and suppliers behind every screen. Your work decides whether a jeweller trusts Nivoda with their next order, so this is a role with real commercial impact and plenty of room to lead.

What would YOU be doing?

  • Setting the fulfilment strategy for the next 2 to 4 quarters, making trade-offs explicit, including what we are choosing not to do and why

  • Owning the roadmap and the numbers: running quarterly planning, sizing opportunities and setting targets for delivery-as-promised, delivery date accuracy and delivery speed

  • Making our Promised Delivery Dates trustworthy by rolling out SLA-based, dynamic delivery dates across every category and route, and shaping how they are used for delay communications and, in time, shown to buyers

  • Scaling Express, our hub-based fast-delivery offer, including hub workflows (receiving, inventory and RFID put/pick, QC and dispatch), ready-to-wear jewellery, consignment flows and speed options such as same-day pickup

  • Owning jewellery returns and on-platform QC, from the manufacturer through to the hub, including hallmarking and consignment returns to suppliers

  • Improving the delivery experience through carrier and rate/transit integrations, consolidation, last-mile cost and efficiency, and clear order visibility for buyers

  • Translating hub operations, carrier behaviour, customs and supplier handling into clear product requirements, designing for the exceptions as much as the happy path

  • Turning support tickets, delay breaches, supplier performance data and customer feedback into prioritised problems, then deciding what to build, buy or fix operationally

  • Partnering daily with Engineering and Design, and closely with Operations, Customer Support, Account Management, Sales, Supplier Experience and Fintech so delivery, credit and payments feel like one journey for the buyer

  • Writing sharp PRDs and decision records, and reporting progress openly through our weekly updates

  • Mentoring other product managers and designers on working in operationally complex domains

What do we need from YOU?

  • 5 to 8 years in product management, including experience owning a complex product area end to end

  • Experience in fulfilment, logistics, supply chain or other operations-heavy products. You are comfortable where software meets warehouses, carriers, SLAs and customs

  • Strong systems thinking: you can map a multi-party process, find where promises break, and design for failure modes, delays and edge cases

  • Data fluency: you define the right metrics, query and interrogate data yourself (Snowflake, Mixpanel or similar) and use it to decide what to build next

  • Sound prioritisation and commercial judgement: you weigh impact, effort and risk honestly, say no clearly, and can explain the return on a fulfilment investment to leadership

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership: you build trust with engineers, operators and commercial teams, and influence without authority across time zones

  • Clear written communication: concise PRDs, roadmaps and updates that make decisions easy

  • Customer and operator empathy, and high agency: you spend time with jewellers, support teams and hub operators, you take ownership, and you follow things through to the outcome

Nice to have

  • Jewellery, diamond or luxury goods experience

  • Marketplace or B2B commerce experience, ideally two-sided with supply and demand constraints

  • Experience with carrier or shipping APIs, rate and transit tools, 3PL integrations, inventory systems or RFID

  • Experience building predictive or SLA-based estimates, such as delivery dates or ETAs

  • Experience with cross-border shipping, customs, duties or compliance (for example hallmarking and HS codes)


Our culture and what we offer

Nivoda is collaborative, high-growth and built on empowerment. You will have real ownership from day one, a team that wants you to succeed, and the chance to keep learning as the company scales. We are remote-first with flexible hours, and we trust you to do your best work your way.

Equal opportunity

À propos de Dastra

Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la compliance et à la gouvernance de l’IA.

Notre mission est claire : Faire de la protection des données une réalité opérationnelle, en plaçant la confiance au cœur des stratégies des entreprises.

Nous aidons les organisations à maîtriser leurs risques pour innover, en transformant des obligations réglementaires complexes (RGPD, IA) en processus simples, concrets et actionnables.

Le rôle

En tant que Data Migration Project Manager, tu pilotes les projets de migration des données clients vers Dastra, du cadrage jusqu'à la livraison.

À la croisée de la gestion de projet, de la data et du conseil client, ton rôle est majoritairement orienté pilotage et accompagnement client (environ 70 %), tout en étant suffisamment à l'aise avec la data et la technique pour comprendre, structurer et mapper les données.

Tes missions

Piloter tes projets de migration de A à Z

  • Piloter plusieurs projets clients simultanément, du cadrage à la livraison, en priorisant efficacement pour garantir un suivi fluide et de qualité.

  • Piloter le suivi et l’avancement des projets à travers des meetings clients

  • Comprendre les enjeux métier et Privacy du client afin d’adapter la stratégie de migration à son contexte et à ses besoins.

  • Accompagner le client dans les choix techniques et data nécessaires à sa migration

  • Sécuriser chaque étape de la migration, de la préparation des données jusqu’à leur intégration dans Dastra

Comprendre & structurer la data

  • Analyser et structurer les données sources du client

  • Construire le mapping entre les données clients et le modèle de données Dastra

  • Définir et paramétrer les règles de transformation nécessaires à la migration

  • Contrôler les données tout au long du processus de migration

  • Comprendre la logique des scripts et des flux de données

  • Maîtriser notre outil interne de migration

Notre outil interne automatise désormais une grande partie des transformations auparavant réalisées via des scripts spécifiques : nous ne cherchons donc pas un développeur, mais quelqu'un qui comprend suffisamment la technique pour prendre les bonnes décisions.

Collaborer avec les équipes Dastra

Tu travailles notamment avec :

  • les Sales, en avant-vente, pour apporter l’expertise Data Migration nécessaire au cadrage du projet et rassurer les prospects

  • les équipes Tech, sur les problématiques d'intégration et de fonctionnement de la plateforme ; 

  • les Privacy Success Managers, pour assurer une transition fluide après la migration et transmettre les enjeux et règles métier du client. 

Le profil recherché

  • Une connaissance des enjeux RGPD / Privacy et du métier de DPO, acquise dans un contexte professionnel

  • Une bonne culture IT & data : mapping, structuration de données, logique de scripts, compréhension des flux et architectures

  • À l'aise pour conseiller, challenger et vulgariser auprès d'interlocuteurs techniques et métier 

  • Anglais C2 indispensable 

Ce qui fera la différence

Tu es curieux·se, autonome et débrouillard·e : face à un nouvel outil ou une problématique que tu ne connais pas, tu cherches, tu comprends et tu proposes.

Tu apprécies autant comprendre comment fonctionne une plateforme que piloter un projet et accompagner un client jusqu'à sa réussite.
