jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter, en aan die kennis bouwen we bij Lefebvre Sdu al 200 jaar. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat doen we zo zorgvuldig dat andere legal AI-tools op onze data en software draaien. Vanuit ons Nederlandse kantoor bouwen we daarnaast voor Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, dat in Europa inmiddels goed is voor meer dan 100 miljoen euro ARR. Ruim 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, en we bouwen het op de standaard die hun vak vraagt. We zoeken een Senior DevOps Engineer die zorgt dat alles wat we bouwen veilig en soepel live gaat.

HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT

GenIA-L schuift steeds verder het dagelijkse werk van juristen en fiscalisten in, en dat vraagt om een platform dat soepel meebeweegt. Onze developers willen snel bouwen en veilig live gaan, zonder uren kwijt te zijn aan pipelines en repository-setup. Daar zorg jij voor. Onze infrastructuur draait op AWS, met Kubernetes via EKS, Terraform en Helm, en onze CI/CD loopt via GitHub Actions. In die pipelines borg jij bij elke release de secure coding-eisen van ISO 27001, van SAST en security scanning tot code quality checks en de OWASP Top 10. Nu ligt DevOps nog bij een extern team van 4 engineers. Binnen een jaar willen we die kennis volledig zelf in huis hebben, en daarin speel jij een hoofdrol. Je wordt het eerste aanspreekpunt voor de developers in Product & Technology, brengt structuur in hoe het team werkt en bouwt mee aan de volgende stappen, zoals de overstap van Helm naar ArgoCD. Je weet dat het gelukt is als de andere teams merkbaar minder tijd kwijt zijn aan hun deployments, de infrastructuur gezond is en je precies ziet wat er gebeurt. En als DevOps voelt als een vanzelfsprekend onderdeel van Product & Technology. De stack staat en de ambitie is helder. Wat nu nog ontbreekt, is het team dat dit zelf gaat dragen, en dat bouw jij mee op.


DIT ZOEKEN WIJ

Je bent een DevOps engineer die het liefst dicht bij de developers zit. Je bouwt een platform waar anderen zelf mee verder kunnen, vindt het vanzelfsprekend dat security in elke pipeline is ingebouwd en brengt graag rust en overzicht in een omgeving die in beweging is.
Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar hands-on ervaring met Kubernetes, idealiter met AWS EKS.

  • Je hebt veel gewerkt met AWS en Infrastructure as Code.

  • CI/CD en containers zijn een vertrouwd onderdeel van je werk.

  • Je zorgt voor duidelijkheid in technische processen en afspraken.

  • Ervaring met het bouwen en doorontwikkelen van een softwareproduct is een pré.

HIER TEKEN JE VOOR

Je rapporteert aan onze Lead Backend Engineer en bent de vaste sparringpartner van de developers in Product & Technology. Je krijgt veel vertrouwen, eigenaarschap en vrijheid, dus zie je iets wat beter moet, dan pak je het hier meestal gewoon zelf op. Daarbij is er ruimte voor een goede balans tussen werk en privé. Onze doorgroeipaden zijn nog in ontwikkeling, en omdat we tracks verwachten richting lead DevOps, principal engineering en engineering management, ben jij er vroeg bij.

  • Goed basissalaris en een standaard werkweek van 36 uur.

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 4% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris en een variabele winstdeling die kan oplopen tot 6% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris.

  • 23 vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk keuzebudget van 12%, waarvan 8% vakantiegeld en 4% vrij besteedbaar voor bijvoorbeeld extra vakantiedagen.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling via PGB, inclusief aanvullende partnerverzekering.

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding van €0,25 per kilometer of een OV-vergoeding, en we bieden een aantrekkelijke fietsregeling. Voor medewerkers met een reisafstand van minder dan 10 km of meer dan 60 km hebben we een aangepaste regeling.

  • Hybride werken: 2 dagen per week op kantoor in Den Haag, op dinsdag en donderdag.

  • Ruimte om te groeien. In je vak, in je rol, in de organisatie.

MEER WETEN?
Wij vertellen je graag alles over het team en de rol. Stuur jouw cv en je hoort binnen 2 werkdagen van ons. Eerst nog wat vragen? App of bel Nadine op 0628556265.

Een referentiecheck en een VOG horen bij het selectieproces.

jobs.description:

Let op: de stageperiode waarvoor wij zoeken is die van februari 2027 tot juni 2027 voor een periode van 15 tot 24 weken.

Jouw rol
Bij Heras bieden we je een leerzame en uitdagende stageplaats waarbij je volop kansen krijgt om waardevolle ervaringen op te doen die in het verdere verloop van je carrière nuttig zijn. Je gaat gecombineerd stage lopen op de afdeling Marketing en de afdeling Brand & Communications voor de Benelux.   • Ondersteuning van de marketing manager bij diverse projecten

  • Bijdragen aan verschillende evenementen zoals bijvoorbeeld een stagemarkt

Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van een stagiair bij Heras? De eerste indruk: dynamisch in plaats van stoffig - Heras Nederland


Jouw profiel

  • Je volgt momenteel een HBO- of MBO-studie Communicatie, Marketing of Journalistiek en zoekt een meewerkstage 2e, 3e of 4e jaars.

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift

  • Je bent creatief, werkt gestructureerd en bent in staat om het overzicht te behouden

  • Het tonen van eigen initiatief wordt zeer gewaardeerd

  • Flinke mate van zelfstandigheid

  • Je beschikt over goede sociale en communicatieve vaardigheden

Wat bieden wij jou?
Bij Heras bieden wij jou een meewerkstage binnen een zeer dynamische omgeving waarbij elke dag anders is met veel variatie en afwisseling. Je draagt je steentje bij aan een veilige omgeving en helpt om onze samenleving te beschermen. Je creëert jouw eigen toekomst bij Heras. Tenslotte zijn er volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien. Wij bieden het volgende;

  • Stagevergoeding van €500,- bruto per maand o.b.v. fulltime

  • 2 verlofdagen per maand

  • Goede persoonlijke begeleiding

  • Flexibiliteit en vrijheid

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23 per kilometer

Wie zijn wij?
Heras is Europa's toonaangevende aanbieder van 360° beveiligingsoplossingen, gespecialiseerd in perimeter- en technische beveiliging om te beschermen wat belangrijk is. We ontwerpen, installeren en onderhouden complete beveiligingssystemen die naadloos aansluiten op de bedrijfsvoering van onze klanten. Zo beschermen we mensen, locaties en kritieke infrastructuur. Gedreven door onze visie om de wereld veiliger te maken, zetten wij ons in voor kwaliteit, veiligheid en verantwoordelijkheid voor mens en milieu. Met meer dan 3.200 medewerkers ondersteunen wij klanten in uiteenlopende sectoren en landen. Als betrouwbare partner zijn wij één aanspreekpunt voor alle beveiligingsvraagstukken, en houden wij jouw wereld veilig.

Onze cultuur, werksfeer & waarden
Wij hebben binnen Heras een informele, open en toegankelijke cultuur. We zijn trots op ons werk, producten en dienstverlening. We hebben een no-nonsense mentaliteit, tonen ondernemerschap, zijn energiek en werken allemaal gedisciplineerd volgens de drie kernwaarden; betrokkenheid, betrouwbaarheid en deskundigheid. Heras is gewaardeerd op een Ecovadis Bronzen Ster en dat plaatst ons bij de duurzaamste 35% bedrijven van Nederland. jobs.title: Upper School Counsellor - Starting Academic Year 2027
jobs.description:
The International School of Bergen is seeking an experienced, compassionate, and highly skilled School Counsellor to join our vibrant IB World School in Norway.

Hva vi ser etter

Application

We welcome applications from suitably qualified and experienced counsellors who are genuinely committed to relocating to Norway and becoming part of our school community.

Please submit the following documents by email with the subject line "US School Counsellor Application" to laura.mcguffie@isbergen.no:

  • A current CV.

  • A covering letter explaining your relevant counseling experience, qualifications, experience working with children and young people, and motivation for working at the International School of Bergen.

  • Contact details for two professional referees, including your current or most recent employer.

Important - Relocation to Norway

Please only apply if you are seriously considering relocating to Bergen, Norway.

Candidates who are currently living outside Norway should be prepared to relocate and meet the relevant Norwegian immigration, visa and work permit requirements, where applicable.

As part of the application process, candidates may be asked to provide information regarding their nationality/passport country and current country of residence so that the school can establish the appropriate immigration and work permit requirements.

This is an on-site based position in Bergen, Norway.

Safeguarding

The International School of Bergen is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people.

All appointments must provide a police background check from your home country and any country you have resided in for 6+ months in the last 10 years. Police background checks must be no more than 3 months old and can be presented prior to appointment.

All staff are expected to uphold the school's safeguarding policies and Code of Conduct.

Previous applicants should reapply if you are still seriously interested in the position.

If you have any questions in regards to this position, please contact Peter Ledger, Director peter.ledger@isbergen.no or Laura McGuffie, HR and Finance Manager laura.mcguffie@isbergen.no

Applications will be reviewed as they are received. We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if a suitable candidate is identified, so early applications are encouraged.

Closing Date for applications is 27th November 2026

Arbeidsoppgaver

About the Role

The School Counsellor will provide proactive and responsive counselling services to students across the school while supporting the implementation of a whole-school wellbeing programme consistent with the philosophy of the International Baccalaureate.

The role includes:

  • Providing confidential individual and small-group counselling.

  • Supporting students with social, emotional, behavioural and mental health needs.

  • Delivering preventative wellbeing programmes and age-appropriate classroom guidance.

  • Promoting resilience, self-management, positive relationships and emotional wellbeing.

  • Working collaboratively with teachers to identify and support students requiring additional care.

  • Advising school leadership on student wellbeing, safeguarding and pastoral care.

  • Liaising effectively with parents and guardians to support student success.

  • Coordinating referrals to external professionals and Norwegian support services where appropriate.

  • Supporting crisis response and student reintegration following significant life events.

  • Maintaining accurate, confidential records in accordance with GDPR and Norwegian legislation.

  • Contributing to safeguarding procedures and child protection practices.

  • Supporting transitions between PYP and MYP where applicable), ensuring continuity of care.

  • Promoting inclusion, diversity, intercultural understanding and student voice.

The Successful Candidate Will Have

Essential

  • A recognised qualification in Counselling, School Psychology, Educational Psychology, Social Work or a related field.

  • Professional registration or eligibility for registration where applicable.

  • Experience working with children and adolescents in a school setting.

  • Strong understanding of child and adolescent development.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusting relationships with students, families and staff.

  • Commitment to safeguarding and child protection.

  • High levels of professionalism, integrity and confidentiality.

  • Excellent spoken and written English.

  • A genuine willingness and ability to relocate to Bergen, Norway.

Desirable

  • Previous experience within an IB World School.

  • Knowledge of the IB Learner Profile and IB Approaches to Learning (ATL).

  • Experience supporting internationally mobile or multilingual students.

  • Experience working within multicultural communities.

  • Knowledge of trauma-informed and restorative practices.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for someone who is:

  • Compassionate and approachable.

  • Calm and solution-focused.

  • Collaborative and reflective.

  • Culturally responsive and internationally minded.

  • An excellent listener with sound professional judgement.

  • Passionate about student wellbeing and inclusion.

  • Committed to continuous professional learning.

  • Open to embracing life and work within an international school community in Norway.

Vi tilbyr

Why Join Us?

Our school offers:

  • A welcoming and diverse international community.

  • Students representing many nationalities and cultures.

  • A collaborative and supportive staff culture.

  • Commitment to ongoing professional development.

  • Competitive salary and pension.

  • The opportunity to live and work in one of the world's most beautiful and family-friendly countries.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

About Our School

ISB is a co-educational private day school which is authorised to deliver the International Baccalaureate PYP and MYP programmes. The school currently has approximately 250 students enrolled from more than 30 nations and is experiencing expanding enrolment. Classes are small with a maximum of 20 students in each instructional group.

Our school is committed to developing internationally minded young people who embody the attributes of the IB Learner Profile. We believe that student wellbeing is fundamental to learning, and we are looking for a counsellor who shares our commitment to nurturing the academic, social, emotional and personal development of every learner.

Working collaboratively with students, families, teachers and school leaders, the successful candidate will play a central role in promoting wellbeing, inclusion, safeguarding and positive mental health across the school community.

jobs.title: Stage Développement C++ & Intelligence Artificielle générative
jobs.description:
Dans le cadre de l’évolution de notre logiciel Track Builder, outil d’aide à la génération de lignes ferroviaires destinées à la simulation, nous recherchons un(e) stagiaire de fin d’études pour concevoir un framework intelligent de migration et de compatibilité logicielle, développé en C++ et assisté par l’Intelligence Artificielle.

Le Track Builder évolue régulièrement, entraînant des modifications de son architecture, de ses modèles de données, de ses couches SIG (QGIS), de ses formats de configuration (XML/XSD) et de ses composants logiciels. Ces évolutions nécessitent de garantir la compatibilité des projets existants avec les nouvelles versions de l'application, tout en préservant l'intégrité des données.

L'objectif du stage est de concevoir un framework générique capable d'analyser les différences entre deux versions du logiciel, d'identifier les transformations nécessaires et d'automatiser la migration des projets existants.

Les principales missions seront :

  • Analyser l'architecture existante du Track Builder et identifier les éléments impactés par les évolutions de versions.
  • Concevoir et développer un framework générique de migration en C++, basé sur une architecture modulaire, des interfaces génériques et des design patterns adaptés.
  • Étudier et intégrer des mécanismes d'IA générative et de LLM pour analyser automatiquement les différences entre versions (code source, schémas XML/XSD, couches SIG, fichiers de configuration et templates).
  • Développer un moteur de validation automatique permettant de contrôler l'intégrité et la cohérence des projets après migration.
  • Étudier et mettre en œuvre des mécanismes de gestion des erreurs, de rollback et de sécurisation des migrations.
  • Participer à l'intégration du framework dans le processus de développement et le pipeline CI/CD du Track Builder.

Ce stage offre l'opportunité de travailler sur un sujet à forte dimension technique, mêlant génie logiciel, architecture C++, Intelligence Artificielle générative et automatisation, avec des applications concrètes dans le domaine ferroviaire.

Requirements

Nous recherchons un(e) étudiant(e) en dernière année d'école d'ingénieurs ou en Master 2 Informatique / Génie logiciel, préparant un diplôme de niveau Bac+5.

Compétences techniques requises :

  • Très bonne maîtrise du C++ et de la programmation orientée objet.
  • Bonnes connaissances en conception et architecture logicielle.
  • Maîtrise des algorithmes et des structures de données.
  • Utilisation des outils de gestion de versions (Git/SVN).
  • Connaissances en tests unitaires et qualité logicielle.

Compétences appréciées :

  • Framework Qt.
  • QGIS et systèmes d'information géographique (SIG).
  • Formats XML/XSD et bases de données GeoPackage/SQLite.
  • Python.
  • Outils et pratiques CI/CD.
  • Intelligence Artificielle générative, LLM et prompt engineering.
  • Analyse statique de code et conception de systèmes logiciels complexes.

Qualités attendues :

  • Esprit d'analyse et de synthèse.
  • Autonomie, rigueur et curiosité technique.
  • Capacité à proposer des solutions d'architecture et à prendre du recul sur des problématiques complexes.
  • Intérêt pour les nouvelles technologies et l'innovation.

Information importante : le stage est réservé aux candidats de nationalité française.

Une connaissance du domaine ferroviaire constitue un plus, mais n'est pas indispensable.

 

Benefits

Ce que nous offrons

Un stage où vous verrez la transformation d'une société de l'intérieur, avec les moyens de la faire avancer.

  • Un accès direct à la direction : rattachement au Vice-Président, plusieurs points par semaine, présence aux temps forts du CODIR, accès aux directeurs selon les sujets.
  • De l'impact réel : vos POC seront déployés et utilisés par les équipes, pas rangés dans un rapport.
  • Des moyens : un budget pour les outils et les POC dès le départ, élargi à mesure que les gains sont démontrés.
  • Un terrain de jeu rare : la simulation 3D temps réel, le ferroviaire, une société internationale de taille humaine en pleine transformation.

Le Groupe SOGECLAIR est convaincu que la diversité et l’inclusion sont des éléments essentiels de sa performance et s’engage à recruter sans discrimination.
Dans un souci de lisibilité, le masculin est utilisé dans cette annonce, mais nous encourageons les candidatures de toutes les personnes, sans distinction de genre, d’origine, de handicap ou de toute autre caractéristique.

Work @Sogeclair ✨ :

    • Un environnement de travail international et multiculturel 🌎
    • Des perspectives de mobilité interne
    • Un apprentissage permanent : Sogeclair Academy 🎓
    • Un package de rémunération : RTT, mutuelle, pack mobilité durable, politique cooptation, TR etc.

En savoir plus sur nous 💠 :

  • SOGECLAIR, fort de plus de 60 ans d'expertise, est un fournisseur de solutions innovantes pour une mobilité plus sobre et plus sûre. Présent à l'international, SOGECLAIR a étendu son influence au-delà des frontières, renforçant ainsi sa capacité à innover et à collaborer avec des partenaires du monde entier
  • Nos valeurs :
    • Confiance et esprit d'équipe 💙

jobs.title: Product Compliance Manager (m/f/d) (Produktmanager/in)
jobs.description: BERNER pushing the limits – for those who dare moreMaking a choice about your career and your employer is a choice about your future - a future where you will invest your passion and a large portion of your time, energy, and capacity.  Play a key role in ensuring that our products meet applicable legal and regulatory requirements and contribute to maintaining a compliant and market-ready product portfolio. You will combine your scientific or technical background with an interest in regulatory requirements, chemical product data and legislation. From monitoring regulatory developments and assessing product compliance to preparing Safety Data Sheets and maintaining chemical data, you will translate complex requirements into practical solutions for our products and business processes. Join our Product Compliance team and take an active role in securing product conformity while working closely with Product Management, Purchasing, Quality and our suppliers, as well as supporting our customers with product compliance-related topics.YOUR TASKS- Ensure that our products meet applicable legal and regulatory product compliance requirements- Monitor current and upcoming product legislation and assess its impact on different product groups and our portfolio- Assess chemical products regarding applicable regulatory requirements, particularly REACH, CLP, Biocidal Products Regulation, Detergents Regulation, Cosmetic Product Regulation and the Construction Products Regulation- Create, review and maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and ensure their regulatory compliance and quality- Maintain and ensure the quality of chemical, substance and compliance-related product data in relevant systems- Analyse product compositions, classifications and regulatory product information and derive necessary compliance measures- Review supplier documentation, clarify regulatory requirements with suppliers and verify the completeness and plausibility of provided compliance information- Prepare and maintain compliance-related documents, declarations and certificates- Maintain product and compliance data in SAP, PIM and other relevant systems- Work closely with Product Management and Purchasing during the creation and introduction of new products to identify and implement compliance requirements at an early stage- Support Master Data Management in defining and maintaining legally required product information- Support customers and our subsidiaries with product compliance-related questions and provide relevant regulatory documentation and information- Contribute to the implementation of new and changing regulatory requirements as well as the continuous improvement and digitalization of Product Compliance processesYOUR PROFILE- Academic degree or comparable qualification with a scientific, technical or regulatory background, for example in chemistry, chemical engineering, environmental sciences, materials science, life sciences or a related field- Strong analytical skills, a high level of accuracy and a structured, reliable working style- Enjoy working with chemical and technical data as well as complex legal and regulatory requirements- Ideally, knowledge of European chemical and product legislation, particularly: - REACH Regulation- CLP Regulation- Biocidal Products Regulation- Detergents Regulation- Construction Products Regulation- Cosmetic Product Regulation- Knowledge of PPE legislation is an advantage- Experience in creating and maintaining Safety Data Sheets is an advantage- Experience with SDS authoring via chemical compliance software such as Chemdox is an advantage- High affinity for data and confidence in handling and maintaining larger amounts of technical and regulatory product information- Confident user of Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint- Experience with SAP, PIM systems or comparable product data systems is an advantage- Strong communication and teamwork skills and confidence in collaborating with different business functions, suppliers, customers and external partners- Good English skills; German or additional European language skills are an advantage WHY BERNER? - Job bike leasing (JobRad)  - Commuting allowance  - Wellpass membership & corporate benefits  - Company pension scheme  - Opportunities for further training  - Technically modern equipped workplace  - Company restaurant in Künzelsau or meal vouchers in Cologne  - Attractive conditions for our products in the BERNER online shop Apply Now – We’re Excited to Meet You! Please submit your application via our online form, including your availability and salary expectations. The BERNER Group is a European trading company serving professionals in the mobility, construction, and industrial sectors. We are the leading B2B specialist and an innovative manufacturer of chemical products. Our purpose is: “We are pushing the limits of the possible for the shapers of a better tomorrow.” With our strong brands - BERNER, BTI by BERNER, and CCS - we empower our customers to keep their businesses running successfully. Join our team and shape the future with us! The BERNER Group as employer, dare to differentiate ourselves and provide every employee the opportunity to and enable them to dare to be more.  Together, we push our own limits and contribute to shape a better tomorrow.

jobs.title: PhD Student in Acute Leukemia Research - Department of Hematology / Oncology (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: ...you're in the middle of itThe Department of Hematology/Oncology  of the university hospital in Frankfurt offers a broad diagnostic and therapeutic spectrum for patients with solid tumors, as well as malignant diseases of the hematopoietic system and investigates its development, progression, as well as therapy resistance. The Max-Eder Junior Research Group (funded by the German Cancer Aid) lead by Dr. med. Anjali Cremer is dedicated to deciphering oncogenic signaling transduction mechanisms, identification and characterization of viability regulators, as well as the analyses of resistance mechanisms to targeted therapies in acute leukemia.Dr. med. Anjali Cremer's team investigate new therapeutic vulnerabilities, that overcome resistance mechanisms in acute leukemia. The lab itself is embedded in the excellent re-search infrastructure of the university hospital in Frankfurt. Leukemia research and re-search on clonal hematopoiesis is one of the main focusses of the Department of Hematology/Oncology, as well as of the Frankfurt Cancer Institute and the DKTK partner site Frankfurt. Moreover, there are multiple possibilities for collaborations with scientists from all over the world.The position is fixed-term for a period of three years .Your Role :- The project is based on a recently published study by Bröchtel et al., in which USP22 was identified as key regulator of MEIS1 expression in KMT2A-rearranged acute leukemia. jobs.title: Postdoc Researcher (f/m/d) in Evolutionary Genomics of Mammals (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description: Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN) , headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position at the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre (SBiK-F), starting as soon as possible :Postdoc Researcher (m/f/d)in Evolutionary Genomics of Mammals(Full time / part time ** ** options available)﻿Location: Frankfurt am MainEmployment scope: Full-time; part time options are availableType of contract: Temporary, limited to 2 yearsRemuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.The mission of the Senckenberg Biodiversity and Climate Research Centre is to study the complex interactions between biodiversity and climate change.There is an exciting opportunity for a talented and motivated applicant to join the working group of Prof. Dr. Axel Janke. The applicant will be closely involved in gene flow, evolutionary, population or phylo-genetics to study speciation in mammals (bears, giraffe, kangaroos or allies) at the genomic level and in MSc and BSc teaching. Strong own and proven research interests including other vertebrate groups will be considered.Your tasks- Conduct genomic research on mammalian evolution and speciation, including evolutionary, population and phylogenomic analyses- Investigate phylogenetic relationships, gene flow and genomic signatures (possibly QTL and GWAS, genetic load) of evolutionary and environmental processes using genomic and bioinformatic approaches- Apply and further develop bioinformatic methods for the analysis of genomic data, including population genomics, genome assembly and species distribution modelling- Organise and teach university courses and supervise BSc and MSc theses- Independently prepare and publish research results in peer-reviewed journals and contribute to the acquisition of third-party fundingYour profile- PhD degree in Biology, Genetics, Bioinformatics or a related field- Strong interest and proven skills in evolutionary, population or phylogenomics.- Knowledge of gene-flow analyses and/or drift processes is an advantage- Experience in population genomics, genome assembly and script programming, including R- Very good written and oral communication skills in English- Interest in species distribution modelling, paternal inference, conservation genetics and epigeneticsWe offer- access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations- an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution- flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension planSenckenberg is committed to diversity. We benefit from the different expertise, perspectives and personalities of our staff and welcome every application from qualified candidates, irrespective of ethnic or cultural origin, gender, religion or belief, age, sexual identity or disability. Women are particularly encouraged to apply, as they are underrepresented in the field of this position; in the case of equal qualifications and suitability they will be given preference. Applicants with a severe disability will be given special consideration in case of equal suitability. Senckenberg actively supports the compatibility of work and family and places great emphasis on an equal and inclusive work culture.How to apply?Please upload your application as a single PDF by 10 December2026 , including:- CV- Letter of motivation- Academic transcripts and certificates/credentials- Two relevant publications- Contact details of two potential referencesPlease compress the files where possible. If the two publications cause the file to exceed the upload limit, they may be uploaded separately.Please submit your application via our online application system. If you are viewing this vacancy on an external job platform, please visit our careers page and apply via the corresponding "Apply" button. Applications submitted by email cannot be considered.ContactSenckenberg Gesellschaft für NaturforschungSenckenberganlage 2560325 Frankfurt am MainFor specific questions about this role, please contact Prof. Dr. Axel Janke ataxel.janke@senckenberg.deFor data protection information on the processing of personal data as part of the application and selection process, please refer to the privacy policy on our homepage at https://www.senckenberg.de/en/imprint/Please visit our website at www.senckenberg.de for further information about the Senckenberg Gesellschaft für Naturforschung.

ISO 7/8).● Prozessbedienung: Sicheres Bedienen und Überwachen von manuellen sowie automatisierten Schweißanlagen und Schneidplottern.● Qualitätssicherung & Dichtheitsprüfung: Durchführung von Sichtprüfungen, Dichtigkeitskontrollen und präziser Prozessdokumentation gemäß GMP- und Reinraum-Richtlinien.● Reinraum-Prozesse: Durchführung von Primärverpackungs-, Schneid- und Schweißprozessen nach technischen Zeichnungen und Arbeitsanweisungen.Dein Profil:● Qualitätsbewusstsein: Sorgfältige, genaue Arbeitsweise und hohes Hygienebewusstsein für das Arbeiten im Reinraum.● Praxiserfahrung: Erfahrung im Produktions-, Montage- oder Fertigungsumfeld von Vorteil (technisches Verständnis und handwerkliches Geschick).● Anlagenbedienung: Kenntnisse in der Bedienung von CNC-gesteuerten Anlagen wünschenswert, aber keine Voraussetzung (zielgerichtetes Trainingsmodell vorhanden).● Schichtbereitschaft: Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im 2-Schichtbetrieb.● Sprachen: Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.Wir bieten Dir:● Attraktives Schichtmodell: 31h-Woche bei 100 % Gehalt für eine optimale Work-Life-Balance.● Aufstiegs- & Entwicklungschancen: Strukturierte Einarbeitung und individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten in einer aufstrebenden Sparte.● Hauseigenes 3CON Health Center: Betriebsarzt, Sportangebote und geförderte Heilmassagen (50 % Kostenübernahme).● Erstklassiges Betriebsrestaurant: Frisch zubereitete, regionale Menüs zu Vorzugspreisen.● Gelebter Teamgeist: Regelmäßige Sport-, Teambuilding- und Social-Events in einem sehr angenehmen Betriebsklima.● Exklusive Mitarbeitervorteile: Bike-Leasing sowie attraktive Vergünstigungen bei Partnerfirmen.Leistung, die sich lohnt:● Die Entlohnung richtet sich nach dem Kollektivvertrag für das Metallgewerbe. Da wir Spitzenleistungen auch hoch ansetzen, bringen wir eine ausdrückliche Bereitschaft zur deutlichen Überzahlung mit – dein tatsächliches Gehalt vereinbaren wir individuell basierend auf deiner Qualifikation und Berufserfahrung.

jobs.title: Dean (m/f/d): School of Science (Professor/in - Hochschulen)
jobs.description: The Executive Board and Provost of Constructor University invite applications for the position ofDean (m/f/d) of the School of Science(Full-time; 38.5 hours/week, limited to 5 years)The expected starting date is 01.09.2027.  A regular presence on campus in Bremen is required.About Constructor UniversityConstructor University (CU) is a private, research-driven, international university in Germany, with students from more than 100 countries. Three schools—Science,  Computer Science and Engineering, and Business, Social and Decision Sciences,   - offer interdisciplinary undergraduate, graduate and doctoral programs committed to excellence in teaching, research, and innovation in higher education.In 2022, CU has become part of the global Constructor ecosystem, with its three complementing pillars (Constructor Knowledge, including  CU; Constructor Tech, focusing on digital solutions for teaching and  learning; and Constructor Capital, an early-stage capital firm investing in Deep Tech, Software, and Edtech). About the School of ScienceThe School of Science brings together basic and applied research with research-led education in an international and interdisciplinary environment. With particular strengths in the natural and life sciences, including physics, chemistry, mathematics, and biological sciences, the School currently offers 6 Bachelor and 2 interdisciplinary Master programs to around 350 students. Students benefit from close interaction with faculty, access to modern laboratories and research facilities, and opportunities to participate in research from an early stage of their studies. Further development of the School of Science is a strategic objective of the university, particularly in the areas of physics and quantum sciences.Your ResponsibilitiesThe Dean of the School of Science is responsible for the academic leadership, strategic development, and effective management of the School. The Dean oversees academic staffing, including workforce planning, faculty recruitment, performance evaluation, and professional development, ensuring that the School has the expertise and capacity required to deliver its teaching and research objectives. The Dean is responsible for developing and managing the School's budget, allocating resources effectively, and ensuring financial sustainability. Working with faculty and university leadership, the Dean leads the development, review, and improvement of study programs, ensuring academic quality, relevance, innovation, and alignment with student needs and emerging scientific developments. The Dean also develops and implements the School's long-term strategy, identifying opportunities for research excellence, new academic programs, interdisciplinary collaboration, external partnerships, and revenue generation, while ensuring alignment with the University's overall mission, priorities, and institutional strategy. The Dean is accountable for the School's academic performance, financial management, and contribution to the University's success.Role RequirementsThe Dean is expected to provide academic leadership while fostering a collaborative, international, and innovative academic environment. Candidates should:- Demonstrate the ability to provide strategic leadership for the academic development of the School in alignment with the university’s mission and long-term goals- Lead and mentor a diverse faculty body while supporting professional development- Develop interdisciplinary collaboration both within and across schools- Strengthen the School’s international profile and academic partnerships- Foster innovation in digital and emerging forms of teaching and learning- Manage resources effectively, including budget planning and strategic allocation of funds- Represent the School within the university and externally to academic, scientific, and industry stakeholders.Your QualificationsDeans should radiate academic and intellectual gravitas and display evident leadership qualities. Their academic and scientific experience and insight should be at the level where they are respected as accomplished academics both within Constructor University and in the broader academic community. In particular, as senior academics and managers at Constructor University, Deans must- have a Ph.D. in a field of the school and teaching and research experience of at least ten years- hold a full professorship or equivalent- have a proven track record of hands-on experience with the European/German research grant landscape- exhibit previous personal involvement in relevant high-level academic administrative processes and leadership activities in a relevant academic or scientific institution- present evidence of strategic thinking and management- have an understanding of the economic and strategic context of academic and scientific activities in a university- possess excellent interpersonal and communication skills, and demonstrate the ability to work in and with teams- express familiarity with international higher education structures and landscapes- exhibit fluency in English, the medium of instruction at Constructor UniversityWhat you can expect at Constructor UniversityWe are an international, world-class private university embarking on an exciting journey of growth and expanding our portfolio. Join us and become a part of our global teams! We offer:- Individual on-boarding, career- and development planning- Company fitness program offers with EGYM Well Pass- In collaboration with Deutsche Dienstrad – Lease a company bike, whether it's a bicycle, road bike, or e-bike, for both private and business use.- 30 days of annual leave, plus additional days off for special occasions- Green campus with extensive dining options and recreation areas, take the tour: Campus (https://constructor.university/student-life/campus-life/campus/virtual-tour)- Constructor University has extensive programs on sustainability, environmental sustainability, equal opportunities and high ethical valuesConstructor University unequivocally guarantees the academic freedom of every member of the faculty, as well as every other member of the Constructor University community. We encourage diversity in the University in ethnic, cultural, social, religious, political, and national backgrounds, as well as in individual lifestyle. Constructor University offers full equality of opportunity to all qualified applicants and is an equal opportunity employer.Your ApplicationFor any further information regarding this position, please contact our Recruiter, Doro Hartmann, via Mail (job-application@constructor.university).Apply today - it's simple and uncomplicated. We look forward to getting to know you.A complete application includes the following materials:- Cover letter,- Curriculum vitae with a publication list,- Statement on your academic vision for the school of Science,- Copies of certificates and diplomas,- At least two potential referees (with contact data and affiliations) need to be mentioned in the CV.The deadline for submission of applications is January 03, 2027 (EOB).The review of applications will begin immediately.Please note that only applications submitted through the official application portal will be considered for recognition.Incomplete applications will not be considered.

Unser Ziel: Mehr Sicherheit und Lebensqualität für unsere Kunden. Dafür bieten wir spezialisierte Leistungen aus einer Hand. Von einer zertifizierten Alarmempfangsstelle und Notruf- und Serviceleitstelle über Sicherheits- und Gebäudedienste bis hin zu weltweiten Logistikdiensten profitieren Kunden von unserer langjährigen Expertise, einer persönlichen Beratung und zuverlässigem Service.Als Unternehmen von BAVADO betreibt die Alarmempfangsstelle GmbH eine eigene Notruf- und Serviceleitstelle nach DIN EN 50518. Mit modernster Technik und hohen Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards setzen wir individuelle Leistungen und Kundenanforderungen um. Das Team unserer Leitstelle betreut 24/7 technische Anlagen aus der D-A-C-H-Region und ist Dreh- und Angelpunkt sämtlicher Dienstleistungen.Für den Vertrieb in Österreich suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Unterstützung!Ihr Aufgabengebiet beinhaltet:- Sie betreuen und beraten unsere Kunden.- Sie erstellen Angebote und dokumentieren Ihre Kontakte im CRM System.- In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Vertriebsleitung, dem Marketing und der regionalen Niederlassung unterstützen Sie die Durchführung von Kampagnen.Dadurch zeichnen Sie sich aus:Als Dienstleistungsunternehmen haben wir einen sehr hohen Anspruch an die Qualität unserer Leistungen und damit auch an unsere Mitarbeiter.Mit einer organisierten und genauen Arbeitsweise kümmern Sie sich um die zuverlässige Ausführung Ihrer Aufgaben. Sie begeistern uns durch Teamfähigkeit und Flexibilität, um unser Team optimal zu unterstützen.Ihr Profil:- Sie haben eine Begeisterung für den Vertrieb.- Sie haben Freude am persönlichen und telefonischen Kundenkontakt.- Sie verfügen über Erfahrung im Bereich der sicherheitstechnischen Anlagen, wie Aufzug-, Einbruch- sowie sonstige Gefahrenmeldeeinrichtungen.- Sie zeigen Verhandlungsgeschick und Flexibilität.- Sie haben Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM Systemen.Wir bieten Ihnen:- Eine Tätigkeit in einem etablierten, wachsenden Unternehmen mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.- Einen verantwortungsvollen, abwechslungsreichen Aufgabenbereich.- Mobiles Arbeiten mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.- Eine umfassende und systematische Einarbeitung.- Individuelle Entwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.- Mitarbeiterangebote sowie Rabatte auf Produkte und Dienstleistungen namhafter Anbieter.- Eine interne App, in der wir unternehmensübergreifend alle Mitarbeiter über Neuerungen auf dem Laufenden halten.Wie geht es weiter?Bewerben Sie sich bitte direkt online, indem Sie auf den Jetzt-bewerben-Button klicken. jobs.title: Night Audit (Night-Auditor)
jobs.description: Night AuditStellenbeschreibungDie professionelle Betreuung unserer Gäste am Empfang ist zu jeder Zeit sehr wichtig – von der herzlichen Begrüßung beim Check-In bis zur Verabschiedung, sind Sie für die Frühaufsteher und Nachtschwärmer unter unseren Gästen da.Als Night Audit (m/w/d) Wien erwartet Sie ein abwechslungsreicher und verantwortungsvoller Aufgabenbereich in der Nachtschicht. Sie werden flexibel in unterschiedlichen Motel One Häusern in Wien eingesetzt und lernen dadurch verschiedene Standorte und Teams kennen. Diese Vielfalt sorgt für ein spannendes und dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld. Außerdem kümmern Sie sich um folgende Aufgaben:- Erstellung der Tagesabschlüsse- Kassenführung und -abrechnung- Bearbeitung von Reservierungsanfragen- FrühstücksvorbereitungBenefits:- Bonus-Programm: Je besser die Gäste ihren Aufenthalt bewerten, desto höher fällt der Bonus für das ganze Team aus.- International Karriere machen: Unsere nationalen und internationalen Hotels oder Neueröffnungen eröffnen zahlreiche Karrieremöglichkeiten.- Günstig übernachten in ganz Europa: Vorteile sichern! Mit günstigen Personalraten in unseren Hotels in ganz Europa und in New York sowie weitere attraktiven Rabatten.- Sich persönlich und fachlich weiterentwickeln: Mit einer umfangreichen Einarbeitung, jährlichen Schulungen und Coachings an der One University richtig durchstarten.- Gemeinsam feiern: Ob Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder unser jährliches internationales Fußballturnier – Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam mit dem Team.- Kostengünstig und nachhaltig zur Arbeit: Es kann zwischen einem Zuschuss zum ÖPNV oder einem kostenlosen Fahrrad gewählt werden.QualifikationenOb als Hotelprofi oder im Quereinstieg – Sie passen zu uns! Denn Persönlichkeit und Gastgeberqualitäten stehen bei uns an erster Stelle! Außerdem zeichnen Sie aus:- Ausbildung im Hotelfach bzw. Berufserfahrung in der Hotellerie/Gastronomie oder Interesse an einem Quereinstieg- Gastgeberqualitäten und Leidenschaft für die Hotellerie sowie ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein und Serviceorientierung- Offenes, kommunikatives und sicheres Auftreten sowie eine gute Ausdrucksweise in Deutsch & Englisch- Teamfähigkeit, Flexibilität und Bereitschaft hotelübergreifend zu unterstützen – Wir erreichen unsere Erfolge gemeinsam!Bei Vollzeit gilt die für die Position angegebene Vergütungsspanne brutto/Monat, zzgl. variabler Vergütungsanteile und Benefits. jobs.title: C# Softwareentwickler (m/w/x) Machine Vision (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description: Nur Coden ist dir nicht genug? Du willst unsere Maschine zum Leben erwecken, an der nächsten Smartphone-Generation mitwirken und die CPUs von Morgen prägen? Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi („Narodne novine“ broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-ispravak, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19,64/20, 151/22, 156/23) i Pravilnikom o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi („NN“ br. 6/19., 75/20).

Zapreke za zasnivanje radnog odnosa u školskoj ustanovi propisane su čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi („Narodne novine“ broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10-ispravak, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19,64/20, 151/22, 156/23)

Rok za podnošenje prijava je osam ( 8 ) dana od dana objave natječaja.

Uz pisanu prijavu na natječaj, koja mora biti vlastoručno potpisana, kandidati su obvezni priložiti u izvorniku, ovjerenoj preslici ili elektroničkom zapisu sljedeću dokumentaciju:

  • Životopis
  • Diplomu odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi (ako nije izvornik onda obavezno ovjerena preslika)
  • Dokaz o državljanstvu
  • Uvjerenje nadležnog suda da podnositelj prijave nije pod istragom i da se protiv podnositelja prijave ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od dana raspisivanja natječaja
  • Elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u bazi podataka Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužni su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve potrebne dokumente.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno čl. 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), čl. 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata ( NN 33/92,57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), čl.9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom ( NN 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) i čl. 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (84/21) dužni su se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno čl.9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/13, 152/14, 39/18), dužni su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, kao i dokaz o invaliditetu.

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno čl. 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji, a koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava, dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja i dokaze za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju iz članka 103. st. 1. Zakona.

Popis dokaza za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalaze se na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata, a koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjavaju uvjete za ostvarivanje tog prava, dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja i dokaze za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju iz čl. 49. st. 1. Zakona.

Popis dokaza za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalaze se na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Kandidati/kandidatkinje koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“ broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 02/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19) dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, i rješenje odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo te dokaz o tome na koji je način prestao radni odnos

Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave neće se razmatrati.

U prijavi kandidat mora obavezno navesti osobne podatke (ime i prezime, adresu stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela te e-mail adresu) te naziv radnog mjesta na koje se prijavljuje.

Kandidat prijavom na natječaj daje privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima tj. ispravama, a za potrebe provedbe natječajnoj postupka.

Kandidati koji su pravodobno dostavili potpunu prijavu sa svim prilozima odnosno ispravama i ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja dužni su pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju prema odredbama Pravilnika o zapošljavanju Osnovne škole Dr. Ivana Novaka Macinec koji je dostupan na poveznici: http://os-inovaka-macinec.skole.hr/skolski_dokumenti/op_i_akti. Kandidat koji nije pristupio procjeni odnosno testiranju smatra se da je odustao od prijave na natječaj i ne smatra se kandidatom.

Na web stranici škole http://os-inovaka-macinec.skole.hr/natje_aji objavit će se vrijeme i mjesto održavanja testiranja te će kandidati o vremenu i mjestu održavanja biti obavješteni putem elektroničke pošte.

Pravni izvori za pripremu kandidata:

  • Zakon o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 07/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 156/23)
  • Pravilnik o načinima, postupcima i elementima vrednovanja učenika u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 112/2010, 82/2019, 43/2020, 100/2021)
  • Pravilnik o kriterijima za izricanje pedagoških mjera (NN 94/2015, NN 3/2017, 22/2026)
  • Pravilnik o osnovnoškolskom i srednjoškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju (NN 24/15)
  • Protokol o postupanju u slučaju nasilja među djecom i mladima (Ministarstvo rada, mirovinskog sustava, obitelji i socijalne politike, ožujak 2026. godine)

Natječaj je otvoren od 23. studenog 2026. do 01. prosinca 2026. godine.

O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem web stranice škole (http://os-inovaka-macinec.skole.hr/natje_aji ) u roku od 15 dana od sklapanja ugovora s odabranim kandidatom.

Pismene prijave sa traženom dokumentacijom podnose se u zatvorenoj omotnici neposredno ili poštom na adresu škole: OŠ DR. IVANA NOVAKA MACINEC, Glavna 32, 40306 Macinec, sa naznakom „za natječaj – naziv radnog mjesta za koje se kandidat prijavljuje“.

Ravnateljica škole:

Božena Dogša, prof. v.r.

jobs.title: OPERATER/KA U PROIZVODNJI I PODEŠIVAČ/ICA STROJEVA
jobs.description:
Zapošljavamo više izvršitelja u proizvodnji elektroničkih komponenti, završene srednje tehničke škole.

Vaši zadaci i opis posla:

  • podešavanje i priprema strojeva za proizvodnju elekroničkih komponenti
  • posluživanje strojeva
  • evidentiranje podešavanja i parametara u sustavu
  • kontrola kvalitete komponenti tijekom proizvodnog procesa
  • praćenje rada strojeva i pravovremena intervencija u slučaju kvara ili zastoja
  • redovno održavanje strojeva i otklanjanje manjih kvarova
  • pokretanje strojeva nakon održavanja ili kvarova
  • čišćenje i održavanje rezervnih dijelova
  • provedba definiranih mjerenja i testova

Potrebne kvalifikacije i iskustvo:

  • srednja stručna sprema tehničkog usmjerenja (strojarski tehničar, računalni tehničar, tehničar za elektroniku, mehatronika, mehanika, elektrotehnika, kemija)
  • iskustvo u rukovanju i podešavanju strojeva (poželjno)
  • poznavanje rada na računalu i poželjno engleskog jezika
  • preciznost, odgovornost, orijentiranost na kvalitetu

A nudimo:

  • rad u tehnološki naprednoj i automatiziranoj proizvodnji
  • fokus na razvoj kompetencija uz stručna usavršavanja
  • financijske pogodnosti (plaćen trošak prijevoza, božićnica, jednokratni dodatak, dar za dijete, nagrade za radni rezultat, subvencioniranu prehranu)

Prijavom na natječaj kandidat potvrđuje da je upoznat s Politikom privatnosti SELK-a d.d., dostupnom na https://selk.hr/privacy-policy/. SELK d.d. obrađuje osobne podatke kandidata u svrhu provedbe selekcijskog postupka. U okviru selekcijskog postupka SELK d.d. može provesti provjeru podataka navedenih u prijavi/CV-u i profesionalnih referenci, u skladu s Politikom privatnosti.

Podnošenjem prijave na natječaj pristupnici natječaja su izričito suglasni i daju privolu Tehničkom veleučilištu u Zagrebu za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u prijavi na natječaj te dokumentaciji dostavljenoj s prijavom u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno odredbama Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka. Izrazi koji se koriste u ovom natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje, koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na sve rodove. U prijavi obvezno treba naznačiti točku natječaja i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se prijava odnosi. Prijave s dokumentacijom predaju se obavezno za točku 1. i 2. u roku od 30 dana od dana objave natječaja u ''Narodnim novinama'' Prijave na natječaj moraju biti vlastoručno potpisane te se dokazi o ispunjavanju uvjeta podnose isključivo u elektroničkom obliku na adresu e-pošte natjecaji@tvz.hr s naznakom: »Prijava na natječaj«, s naznakom radnog mjesta. Nepravovremene i nepotpune prijave, odnosno prijave bez traženih dokumenata kao i prijave koje nisu predane sukladno gore navedenim uputama i poslane na adresu e-pošte neće se razmatrati. O rezultatima izbora prijavljeni kandidati bit će obaviješteni objavom na internetskoj stranici www.tvz.hr

jobs.title: KUHAR/ICA
jobs.description:
U naš tim tražimo odgovornu, organiziranu i motiviranu osobu za rad na radnom mjestu kuhara.

Ako imate iskustva u pripremi hrane, poznajete pravila struke i važno vam je da svako jelo bude kvalitetno pripremljeno i lijepo prezentirano, pozivamo vas da nam se pridružite.

Opis posla:

  • priprema, kuhanje, dekoriranje i serviranje jela prema utvrđenim recepturama i standardima

jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ / ODGOJITELJICA
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju („Narodne novine“, broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13 i 98/19, 57/22, 101/23 i 22/26) i članka 41. Statuta Dječjeg vrtića Sušak, Upravno vijeće Dječjeg vrtića Sušak raspisuje

NATJEČAJ

za radno mjesto

ODGOJITELJ

- 1 izvršitelj na određeno vrijeme, u punom radnom vremenu od 40 sati tjedno

Kandidati moraju ispunjavati uvjete utvrđene člancima 24. i 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, člankom 2. st. 1. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja („Narodne novine“, broj 145/24 i 62/25) i člankom 10. Pravilnika o radnim mjestima Dječjeg vrtića Sušak:

- završen sveučilišni prijediplomski ili stručni prijediplomski studij odgovarajuće vrste, odnosno studij odgovarajuće vrste kojim je stečena viša stručna sprema u skladu s prijašnjim propisima, odnosno završen sveučilišni diplomski ili stručni diplomski studij odgovarajuće vrste.

Radni odnos u dječjem vrtiću ne može zasnovati osoba kod koje postoje zapreke utvrđene člankom 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju.

Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi koji se koriste u ovom natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje, koriste se neutralno i odnose jednako na oba spola.

Kandidati moraju priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju:

-vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu (zamolbu),

-životopis,

-dokaz o državljanstvu,

-dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi,

-dokaz o položenom stručnom ispitu (ukoliko ga kandidat posjeduje)

-dokaz o radnopravnom statusu (elektronički zapis iz matične evidencije Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje), ne stariji od mjesec dana od dana objave natječaja,

- dokaz o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno čl.25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (ne starije od 6 mjeseci): a) potvrda nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (čl.25.st.2. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju); b) potvrda nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak (čl.25.st.4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju); c) potvrda Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad da protiv kandidata nije izrečena mjera žurnoga izdvajanja djeteta iz obitelji ili mjera za zaštitu osobnih prava i dobrobiti djeteta u nadležnosti suda (čl.25.st.10. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju). Kandidati su istu dužni dostaviti prije potpisivanja ugovora o radu.

Dokaz o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti za obavljanje poslova predloženi kandidati su dužni dostaviti prije potpisivanja ugovora o radu.

Ako kandidat ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu, dužan je u prijavi pozvati se na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju dužan je uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju odnosno dokaze prema posebnom zakonu kao i rješenje ili potvrda o priznatom statusu, potvrda o nezaposlenosti Hrvatskog zavoda zapošljavanje izdanom u vrijeme trajanja natječaja te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod prethodnog poslodavca (rješenje, odluka, obavijest i sl.).

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti temeljem članka 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ broj: 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21) dužan je uz prijavu na natječaj osim dokaza o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja priložiti i sve potrebne dokaze iz članka 103. citiranog Zakona navedene na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja Republike Hrvatske :

https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843

i poveznici:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 48. stavak 1. do 3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ broj: 84/21) dužan je uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju, odnosno dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta sukladno članku 49. citiranog Zakona. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja Republike Hrvatske:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843,

a dodatne informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju, potražiti na slijedećoj poveznici:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ broj: 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), dužan je uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju, odnosno dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, kao i dokaz o invaliditetu.

Prijavom na natječaj kandidati daju izričitu privolu za prikupljanje, korištenje i obradu svih osobnih podataka, isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka, sve sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2018. godine o zaštiti pojedinaca u svezi s obradom osobnih podataka i slobodnog kretanja takvih podataka kao i ostalim propisima koji uređuju područje zaštite osobnih podataka te se smatra se da su prijava i priloženi dokumenti dostavljeni slobodnom voljom kandidata.

Za kandidate koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja Dječji vrtić Sušak zadržava pravo provođenja provjere znanja i vještina intervjuom. O održavanju intervjua kandidati će biti pravodobno obaviješteni. Ako kandidat ne pristupi intervjuu, smatra se da je povukao svoju prijavu.

Nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave neće se razmatrati. Osoba koja nije podnijela potpunu i pravodobnu prijavu ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj. O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni. Vraćanje natječajne dokumentacije vrši se na zahtjev kandidata.

Natječaj se objavljuje na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje, te mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Dječjeg vrtića Sušak.

Prijave s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja dostavljaju se u roku od osam dana od dana objave natječaja, poštom ili osobno, na adresu: Dječji vrtić Sušak, Braće Stipčić 32, 51000 Rijeka, s naznakom „Prijava na natječaj – odgojitelj“.

jobs.title: POMOĆNIK/ICA U NASTAVI
jobs.description: Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 07/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23) te sukladno uvjetima projekta Znanje svima u okviru Poziva na dostavu projektnih prijedloga „Osiguravanje pomoćnika u nastavi i stručnih komunikacijskih posrednika učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnoškolskim i srednjoškolskim odgojno-obrazovnim ustanovama, faza VII ( Europski socijalni fond PLUS – Operativni program „Učinkoviti ljudski potencijali“ 2021. – 2027.), Osnovna škola Ljudevita Gaja objavljuje NATJEČAJ za zapošljavanje osoba za obavljanje poslova pomoćnika/ice u nastavi CILJ PROJEKTA Projektom je predviđen odabir, edukacija i zapošljavanje osoba na poslovima pomoćnika u nastavi za učenike s teškoćama u razvoju radi postizanja boljih obrazovnih postignuća, uspješnije socijalizacije i emocionalnog funkcioniranja učenika. POMOĆNICI U NASTAVI Broj traženih osoba: -2 pomoćnika u nastavi na nepuno radno vrijeme, 25 sati tjedno Mjesto rada: Zaprešić, Ljudevita Gaja 2 Vrsta ugovora: ugovor o radu na određeno vrijeme za školsku godinu 2026./2027. Prijevoz: cijela naknada POSEBNI UVJETI - minimalno četverogodišnje srednjoškolsko obrazovanje - završen Program obrazovanja za stjecanje djelomične kvalifikacije PUN / SKP (pomoćnik/ica u nastavi), u trajanju od 250 sati ili osposobljavanje u trajanju 218, 220, 230 sati. Iznimno, odgojno-obrazovna ustanova može zaposliti pomoćnika u nastavi bez završene potrebne edukacije, a sukladno odredbama članka 107. stavka 13. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, uz uvjet završetka potrebne edukacije na razdoblje najdulje do 5 mjeseci - protiv osobe nije pokrenut kazneni postupak sukladno članku 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi Osim navedenih posebnih uvjeta kandidati moraju ispunjavati i sljedeće opće uvjete: •punoljetnost •zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se osoba prima •na natječaj se mogu ravnopravno javiti kandidati oba spola. OPIS POSLOVA Osnovna zadaća pomoćnika u nastavi je pružanje osobne stručne potpore učenicima s teškoćama u razvoju u osnovnim školama Grada Zaprešića, kako bi učenici s teškoćama u razvoju ravnopravno sudjelovali u svim nastavnim i izvannastavnim aktivnostima. Pružanje pomoći u socijalizaciji i savladavanju socijalno-psiholoških prepreka, senzoričkih i arhitektonskih barijera, te pomoć učenicima s komunikacijskim teškoćama. DODATNA ZNANJA I VJEŠTINE Poštivanje različitosti, afinitet prema djeci s teškoćama u razvoju, otvorenost, odgovornost, fleksibilnost, razvijene komunikacijske vještine, podjednaka sklonost individualnom i timskom radu, točnost u izvršavanju poslova, organiziranost, emocionalna stabilnost i dosljednost. POŽELJNO Osnovna razina znanja stranog jezika (engleski jezik, njemački jezik); iskustvo u neposrednom radu s djecom s teškoćama u razvoju; iskustvo u volontiranju. PRIJAVA NA NATJEČAJ Uz prijavu na natječaj kandidati trebaju priložiti: •životopis (vlastoručno potpisan, s navedenim podacima o volontiranju - naziv institucije / udruge / tvrtke gdje je ostvareno volontiranje, iskustvu u radu s djecom i znanju stranog jezika) •dokaz o državljanstvu •dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja (preslika svjedodžbe/diplome ili potvrda o stečenoj stručnoj spremi) •potvrda o završenom Programu obrazovanja za stjecanje djelomične kvalifikacije PUN / SKP (pomoćnik/ica u nastavi), u trajanju od 250 sati ili osposobljavanje u trajanju 218, 220, 230 sati •dokaz da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak sukladno članku 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (preslika, ne starija od mjesec dana od dana raspisivanja natječaja) •elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje, ne starije od mjesec dana od objave natječaja U prijavi obvezno navesti adresu stanovanja, kontakt broj mobitela i elektronsku poštu (e-mail). Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve potrebne dokaze u ostvarivanju istog, a prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate ostvarit će ukoliko ispunjava sve ostale propisane uvjete natječaja odnosno ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Prijavom na natječaj kandidati su suglasni da Osnovna škola Ljudevita Gaja, kao voditelj zbirke podataka, može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati njihove osobne podatke isključivo u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka, sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. godine o zaštiti pojedinaca u vezi s obradom osobnih podataka i o slobodnom kretanju takvih podataka i odredbama Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti osobnih podataka (NN 42/18). Sukladno Zakonu o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN br. 82/08 i 69/17) na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola pod jednakim uvjetima. Za kandidate prijavljene na natječaj koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete natječaja provest će se prethodna provjera sposobnosti putem intervjua. Ako kandidat ne pristupi prethodnoj provjeri sposobnosti, smatra se da je povukao prijavu na natječaj. S izabranim kandidatima/tkinjama za pomoćnika u nastavi, obrazovna ustanova - OŠ Ljudevita Gaja, Zaprešić, sklopit će pisani ugovor o radu u kojem će biti utvrđeni poslovi, trajanje, tjedno zaduženje te međusobna prava, obveze i odgovornosti ugovornih strana. Rok prijave je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Prijave na natječaj s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta dostavljaju se na adresu škole: Osnovna škola Ljudevita Gaja, Ljudevita Gaja 2, 10 290 Zaprešić s naznakom "NATJEČAJ ZA POMOĆNIKA U NASTAVI". Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće biti razmatrane. O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u zakonskom roku. Za sve informacije možete se obratiti na broj 01/3355-655. Natječaj je objavljen 25.11.2026. godine na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči Osnovne škole Ljudevita Gaja te na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i traje do 03.12.2026. godine. Svi kandidati koji se prijave na natječaj, a ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja biti će pozvani na razgovor putem obavijesti objavljene na web stranici škole.

jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ/ICA
jobs.description: Temeljem članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine, broj 10/97, 107/07 i 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23 i 22/26), Dječji vrtić „En ten tini“ na temelju odluke Upravnog vijeća Dječjeg vrtića „En ten tini“ od 13.11.2026. godine, raspisuje NATJEČAJ za zasnivanje radnog odnosa u Dječjem vrtiću „En ten tini“ za radno mjesto: Odgojitelj/ica – 1 izvršitelja/ica, rad na određeno puno radno vrijeme, ZAMJENA UVJETI: Prema članku 24. i 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine, broj 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23 i 22/26) i Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno-obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (Narodne novine, broj 145/24). -sveučilišni diplomski studij – sveučilišni/a magistar/magistra ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja -sveučilišni prijediplomski studij – sveučilišni/a prvostupnik/ica ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja -stručni prijediplomski studij – prvostupnik/ica ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja Izrazi iz teksta natječaja rodnog značenja koriste se neutralno i jednako su primjenjivi na muški i ženski rod. Za oglašeno radno mjesto mogu se prijaviti osobe oba spola koje ispunjavaju propisane uvjete. Uz pisanu vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu, koja sadrži: adresu stanovanja, kontakt broj, adresu elektroničke pošte, na natječaj kandidat treba priložiti sljedeće dokumente u preslici: •životopis •dokaz o stručnoj spremi, •dokaz o državljanstvu - preslika važeće osobne iskaznice, važeće putovnice ili domovnice (domovnice ne starije od 6 mjeseci), •potvrdu ili elektronički zapis o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje - ne starije od dana objave natječaja •uvjerenje da se protiv podnositelja prijave ne vodi kazneni postupak sukladno čl. 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju – ne starije od dana objave natječaja •uvjerenje da se protiv podnositelja prijave ne vodi prekršajni postupak sukladno čl. 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju – ne starije od dana objave natječaja •uvjerenje nadležnog Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad (prema mjestu prebivališta/stanovanja), sukladno čl. 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju da kandidatu nije izrečena mjera za zaštitu dobrobiti djeteta sukladno posebnom propisu - ne starije od dana objave natječaja. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja prema posebnim propisima dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo te priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu. Pozivamo kandidate iz članka 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine br. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23) koji prilikom zapošljavanja ostvaruju prednost pod jednakim uvjetima da se u prijavi na natječaj pozovu na to pravo i da, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja, dostave sve potrebne dokaze iz članka 103. Zakona potrebnih za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju, a koji dokazi su navedeni na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja (https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843) , a dodatne informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni pri zapošljavanju, potražiti na slijedećoj poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom ( Narodne novine br.157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine br. 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 02/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96. 82/01, 103/03, 148/13. 98/19) , uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti rješenje ili potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.). Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine br. 84/21) uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokumente iz čl. 49. St. 1 Zakona koji su navedeni na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja, uz popis dokumenata na slijedećoj poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Podaci o plaći: Osnovna bruto plaća radnika predstavlja umnožak osnovice za izračun plaće i koeficijenta složenosti radnog mjesta utvrđene Kolektivnim ugovorom za zaposlene u predškolskim ustanovama Grada Zagreba, uvećan za 0,5% za svaku navršenu godinu radnog staža. Kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj smatra se samo osoba koja podnese pravodobnu i potpunu prijavu, ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja te se odazove pozivu na razgovor. Dječji vrtić „En ten tini“ zadržava pravo izabranog kandidata tražiti potpisivanje izjave o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju odnosno izvršiti provjeru kod nadležnih institucija po službenoj dužnosti. Sukladno odredbama Uredbe (EU) 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. godine o zaštiti pojedinaca u svezi s obradom osobnih podataka i slobodnog kretanja takvih podataka, svi dokumenti dostavljeni na natječaj poslani su slobodnom voljom kandidata te se smatra da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka, a koji će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka. Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 (osam) dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnim stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje, na web stranici Dječjeg vrtića ''En ten tini'' i na oglasnoj ploči Dječjeg vrtića ''En ten tini''. Nepotpune, nepravodobne i nepotpisane prijave neće se razmatrati. Prijave na natječaj s traženom obveznom dokumentacijom dostavljaju se osobno ili preporučeno poštom na adresu sjedišta Dječjeg vrtića „En ten tini“ Ulica 144. brigade Hrvatske vojske 8, Novi Jelkovec, 10360 Sesvete (u zatvorenoj omotnici uz obaveznu napomenu ''ZA NATJEČAJ – ODGOJITELJ/ICA na određeno vrijeme, zamjena''). Prijave koje nisu u skladu s ovim natječajem, odnosno nepravodobne, nepotpune i nepotpisane neće se razmatrati. O rezultatu natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u roku 8 (osam) dana od dana donošenja odluke objavom na mrežnim stranicama DV “En ten tini”, na web stranici https://vrtic-ententini.zagreb.hr/. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje, na oglasnoj ploči Dječjeg vrtića ''En ten tini'' te na mrežnoj stranici Vrtića dana 25.11.2026 te je otvoren do 03.12.2026.
