jobs.title: Dagtilbud Område Øst søger en pædagogisk leder til Regnbuen i Mariager
jobs.description:
Regnbuen søger en pædagogisk leder til den 1. marts 2027, som trives med at drive udviklingsprocesser i samarbejde med de pædagogiske medarbejdere. En pædagogisk leder som brænder for at sikre alle børns trivsel, og som er optaget af at inddrage børnenes perspektiv. 

Om Regnbuen:

Regnbuen er i efteråret 2026 blevet udvidet med en tilbygning, så Regnbuen fremover har ca. 32 vuggestuebørn fordelt på 2 stuer og op til ca. 67 børnehavebørn fordelt på 3 stuer. 

Udvidelsen betyder også, at der er ansat flere pædagogiske medarbejdere. Regnbuen vil fra 1. januar 2027 ca. have 25 pædagogiske medarbejdere.

Regnbuen er i gang med en forandringsproces fra et mindre børnehus til et større, hvor der er fokus på organisering, samarbejde og kultur. En del af forandringen er en bevægelse fra en funktionsopdelt børnehave til en stueopdelt børnehave.

Regnbuen har en spændende arkitektur og en stor varieret legeplads. Børnehuset ligger i Mariager tæt på by, skov, fjord og skolen.  

Regnbuen er en del af Dagtilbud Område Øst, som har 5 børnehuse - 2 i Mariager og 3 i Hadsund. Lederteamet er kendetegnet ved en ambition om at tage fælles ansvar for, at alle børnehusene fungerer godt. Lederteamet sparrer sammen, inspirerer hinanden og værner om et trygt arbejdsmiljø.  

 

Opgaven i Regnbuen kalder på en pædagogisk leder, der sammen med de pædagogiske medarbejdere kan:

  • lede udviklingen fra et mindre børnehus til et børnehus med ca. 100 børn
  • implementere strukturforandringen i børnehaven
  • skabe et tæt samarbejde mellem de to vuggestuestuer
  • skabe en fælles kultur på tværs af vuggestue og børnehave
  • udvikle arbejdsgange og kommunikationsveje, som passer til Regnbuens størrelse og arkitektur

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet pædagog
  • enten har ledelseserfaring eller har stiftet kendskab med ledelse på anden vis fx gennem tillidshverv
  • forventningsafstemmer med de pædagogiske medarbejdere om, hvad du forventer af dem, og hvad de kan forvente af dig
  • arbejder struktureret i forhold til driftsopgaver
  • prioriterer dine arbejdsopgaver og danner overblik
  • kommunikerer dine tanker og refleksioner bag dine handlinger både til de pædagogiske medarbejdere og til forældrene
  • håndterer konflikter
  • ser drift, faglig ledelse og personaleledelse som tre ligeværdige opgaver
  • kommunikerer klart og reflekteret

Vi har:

  • den dejligste børnegruppe fuld af gode ideer med forskellige pædagogiske behov
  • en meget samarbejdsvillig og kompetent medarbejdergruppe
  • en engageret forældregruppe
  • et ambitiøst lederteam, der har et tillidsfuldt samarbejde, som arbejder med psykologisk tryghed

Stillingen er på fuld tid og aflønnes efter gældende overenskomst.

Startdato er den 1. marts 2027.

Ansøgningsfristen er 04.01.27. 

Vi udvælger kandidater til 1. samtale onsdag 06.01.27, hvor vi kontakter dem, som vi gerne vil se til en samtale.  

1. samtale er mandag 11.01.27 i tidsrummet fra 11.30-16.  

Mellem 1. og 2. samtale udfører rekrutteringskonsulent Rebekka Abl en personlighedstest for de kandidater, der går videre til 2. samtale. Der er testtilbagemelding tirsdag 19.01.27 i tidsrummet 12.30-15.  

2. samtale er mandag 20.01.27 i tidsrummet 12 -15.30. De kandidater, som går videre til 2. samtale møder inden 2. samtale en gruppe børn fra Regnbuen, som sammen med en pædagogisk medarbejder har forberedt en række spørgsmål til kandidaten. Det gør vi fordi det er vigtigt for os, at en pædagogisk leder kan inddrage børnenes perspektiv.

 

Om Mariagerfjord Kommune:Mariagerfjord Kommune er en af Danmarks smukkeste kommuner med en unik og varieret natur ved skov, strand og fjord. Vi ligger centralt mellem Aalborg og Aarhus og er på den måde et bindeled mellem Nordjylland og resten af landet. Vores mål er klart: Vi vil mere, og der er plads til flere. Derfor har vi fokus på at skabe de bedste rammer for vores cirka 42.000 borgere, for vores erhvervsliv og for udviklingen af kommunen. 

I Mariagerfjord Kommune ønsker vi, at alle vores 3.400 medarbejdere oplever sig som en vigtig del af fællesskabet. Vi har frihed til at bringe vores kompetencer og ideer i spil, så vi løser kerneopgaven bedst muligt og gør en forskel for vores borgere. Vi har fokus på psykologisk tryghed og viser respekt for hinandens forskelligheder. Alle tager vi et medansvar for fællesskabet og opgaven, og derfor lægger vi også stor vægt på et velfungerende samarbejde i MED-organisationen.   

Vi ser mangfoldighed som en styrke og opfordrer derfor alle interesserede ansøgere til at søge job hos os, uanset personlig baggrund.

jobs.title: Senior iOS Engineer, Foundations
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior iOS Engineer to join Raya Foundations, the platform team that owns the shared foundation every other Raya engineering team builds on. On the client side that means the architecture of our iOS codebase, its modularization and build system, shared libraries and design-system components, CI and release tooling, crash and performance infrastructure, and the AI-collaborative development tooling our iOS engineers use every day.

This is a senior client engineering role with deep technical impact across a large, long-lived swift iOS codebase. The ideal candidate has built and operated high-scale consumer iOS applications end to end, has been the engineer other iOS engineers come to for architecture and tooling, and is excited about modernizing a mature Swift codebase while keeping it shipping every week. Rather than owning one feature surface, you will partner with the product client teams, server engineering, and design to raise the engineering bar across the whole app.

We offer comprehensive medical and dental coverage, $50 a day food delivery budget, equity based employment, a great culture, learning opportunities, unlimited vacation, 12 weeks paid parental leave, and we pay all employees $1,000 a year to go somewhere in the world that they've never been because of our values of human connection, empathy, and curiosity.

Responsibilities

Own the architecture of Raya's iOS codebase: set the patterns and best practices for state management, SwiftUI adoption, navigation, networking, and concurrency, and solve the hard client-side lifecycle problems that span teams.

Drive modernization of a large, long-lived Swift codebase: modularization, SwiftUI alongside UIKit, Swift concurrency, and deliberate management of tech debt. Write the tech specs, make the trade-offs explicit, and sequence the work so it ships incrementally.

Build the shared foundation other iOS engineers build on: design-system components, shared libraries, networking and persistence layers, and the dev harness (build times, CI, test infrastructure, release tooling).

Build and roll out the AI-collaborative development tooling iOS engineers use every day, and set the standards for how we use it on the client.

Improve client production health infrastructure: crash and performance monitoring, alerting, release quality, and the security posture of the app.

Partner with server engineering on API design and client-server state sync, and with the product client teams so new features land on solid patterns.

Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code review, mentorship, and clear written specs.

Requirements

5+ years of professional iOS development experience, with strong proficiency in Swift, UIKit, and MVVM.

Strong experience with RxSwift or similar reactive programming frameworks, and with Redux-style state management patterns.

A track record of shipping consumer mobile apps to large audiences, with strong judgment on architecture, performance, and user experience.

Experience owning client platform or infrastructure work that other engineers depend on (modularizing a large iOS codebase, build and CI systems, shared libraries, design systems, or release tooling) and driving its adoption.

Proven ability to lead projects from concept through launch, balance speed and quality, and own what you ship after it ships.

You use AI coding tools in your daily work, help the team adopt them, and look for opportunities to improve the engineering harness.

What Sets You Apart

Deep experience with SwiftUI alongside UIKit and with Swift concurrency (async/await, actors, strict concurrency), including migrating a mature codebase to them. CoreData a plus!

Experience with Xcode build performance, Swift Package Manager or Bazel/Tuist, and CI/CD for iOS at scale.

Has built developer tooling, agents, or evals that other engineers adopted: code review agents, lint and architecture rules, test generation, or LLM-powered dev harnesses.

Occasional comfort or interest in shipping production backend code (Node.js/TypeScript) alongside the client, and designing the APIs mobile clients depend on.

Experience with mobile security: device trust, certificate pinning, secrets handling, or security remediation on the client.

jobs.title: Senior Category Lead Modern Art
Senior scientific project coordinator
jobs.employer: NORCE RESEARCH AS AVD NATURVITENSKAP BERGEN
jobs.description:
About the position

The research group DARWIN (Data, AI, and Robotics) at the NORCE Technology and digital systems division is looking for a senior scientist in a permanent 100% position with the main role of initiating and coordinating large national and EU research proposals for the research group and scientifically coordinating them as well as designing novel concepts and solutions for AI and robot deployments. The group has strong technological professional expertise in data science, AI, computer vision, machine learning, robotics, mechatronics, cybernetics, computer engineering, visual sensing, visualization, advanced maintenance and smart instrumentation.

The place of work and employment can be any NORCE location. Travelling is expected.

Work tasks

The main tasks of the position will be to drive new large national and EU research possibilities, initiate and coordinate scientific proposal writing and applications, carry out the scientific coordination and management of projects within AI and robotics. Additional tasks include carrying out technological research and development projects in collaboration with industrial partners and research organization in Norway and in Europe, as well as collaborative projects with other groups and divisions within NORCE.

Required skills, expertise and experience

  • Scientific background: minimum master’s degree in mechanical electronics, computer science and/or mechatronics or a related scientific area, with extensive knowledge in robotics, AI and perception systems.

  • Documented experience of at least 10 years in national and EU research funding programs with a track record on initiating scientific large national and EU project applications, writing scientific national and EU project proposals and coordinating national and EU projects is particularly relevant to the position.

  • Industrial experience is an advantage

  • Being and having a certified project management with IPMA, PMP or similar

  • Proficiency in English. Knowledge of the Norwegian language is an advantage.

  • Good team working skills while being proactive.

  • Excellent communication and organizational skills.

We offer

  • A good and professionally challenging working environment

  • Exciting interdisciplinary projects together with national and international partners

  • A nationwide network of researchers in NORCE

  • Exciting, varied and flexible workday

  • Interdisciplinary work in teams with experts in other fields

  • Great opportunities for professional and personal development in a new and expansive competence environment

  • A social and creative work environment where you have a large influence on your own workday

  • Good pension and insurance schemes, good welfare schemes and competitive wages

How to apply

Please upload your application by pressing the application button. Your application should be written in English and must include the following:

  • CV

  • A cover letter with a description of your professional qualifications and motivation to apply for the position

  • Names and contact information of two references

  • Copy of diplomas, transcripts and relevant certificates from your higher education

Application deadline: 3 January 2027

Further information about the position can be obtained by contacting research leader Nabil Belbachir, tel. 401 08 137, or nabe@norceresearch.no.

At NORCE, we are committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply for available positions regardless of gender, age, disability, or ethnic background.

Candidates are expected to openly offer relevant information about themselves during the recruitment process. Furthermore, one can expect background checks to be conducted on candidates in the final phase of the recruitment process. NORCE uses external actors to carry out such background checks.

NORCE is subject to the Security Act and there are strict requirements for our employees to have a security-conscious behavior. For this position, you must satisfy the security clearance requirements for SECRET/NATO SECRET.

Further information about security clearance can be found on the National Security Authority's (NSM) website: NSM.no

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vil du bruke kunnskapen din til noe som virkelig betyr noe? I NORCE blir du med på et lag som leverer viktig forskning og bærekraftige løsninger – regionalt, nasjonalt og globalt.

Vi er et av Norges største forskningsinstitutter, med over 800 ansatte i 10 byer langs Norges kyst. Hos oss er kunnskap, nytenkning og godt samarbeid nøkkelen til å lykkes.

Sammen med næringsliv og offentlig sektor skaper vi verdier og utvikler innovative løsninger på mange av de store utfordringene samfunnet står overfor. Det gjør vi med vår ekspertise og ledende kunnskapsmiljøer innen energi, helse, klima, miljø, samfunn og teknologi. Vi deler ikke bare din lidenskap for kunnskap. Vi kombinerer den med lang erfaring, unik bredde og sterke nettverk som gir gjennomslag nasjonalt og internasjonalt.

jobs.description: Kotirinki-yrittäjä, kotisiivous- ja kotiapupalvelutEtsimme asiakaspalveluhenkistä ja motivoitunutta Kotipalveluyrittäjää liittymään osaavien Kotirinki-yrittäjien joukkoon. Jos tunnet kutsumusta auttaa ihmisiä arjessa ja haluat rakentaa omaa yrittäjyyttäsi tuetusti ja kannustavasti tämä voi olla juuri sinulle!Joustavat aikataulut ja itsenäisyys: Päätä itse, milloin ja kuinka paljon haluat työskennellä. Tämä työ joustaa elämäntilanteesi mukaan mahdollisuus rauhallisiin aamuihin, aikaisiin iltapäiviin tai vapaiden viikonloppujen suunnitteluun on omissa käsissäsi.Vahva tuki markkinointiin ja asiakashankintaan: Saat käyttöösi valmiin verkkokaupan ja nautit Kotiringin tekemästä markkinointi- ja myyntityöstä, joka tukee yrityksesi kasvua. Vaikutat omaan menestykseesi omilla paikallisilla markkinointitoimilla ja aktiivisella asiakastyöllä.Valmis konsepti ja helppokäyttöiset työvälineet: Kotiringin kehittämät järjestelmät tekevät yrittäjyydestä yksinkertaista. Hallinnolliset työt, kuten laskutus ja työvuorosuunnittelu, hoituvat muutamalla klikkauksella, joten aikaa jää itse työlle, asiakkaille ja omasta vapaasta ajasta nauttimiseen.Koulutus ja jatkuva tuki: Oli sinulla aiempaa kokemusta alalta tai ei, Kotirinki kouluttaa sinut tuottamaan kotipalveluitamme konseptimme mukaisesti. Tukemme ja kattavat ohjeemme varmistavat, että onnistut laadukkaan palvelun tuottamisessa yrittäjänä.Kenelle Kotirinki-yrittäjyys sopii? Tämä mahdollisuus on sinulle, joka: Haluat itsenäisyyttä ja vapautta päättää omasta ajankäytöstäsi. Nautit asiakkaiden auttamisesta ja heidän arkeensa vaikuttamisesta. Olet oma-aloitteinen ja haluat kehittää itseäsi yrittäjänä. Etsit tasapainoa työn ja muun elämän välille.Kotirinki on kotimainen ketju, joka on tarjonnut palveluita asiakkaiden kotiin jo vuodesta 2002. Ketjussa toimii jo yli 80 tyytyväistä yrittäjää. Toimimme mikrofranchising-toimintamallilla, eli jokainen palveluntuottajamme on itsenäinen paikallinen pienyrittäjä. Kotirinki-ketjuun liittymisessä et joudu maksamaan kallista liittymismaksua, vaan aloituskustannukset koostuvat työvälineistä ja -vaatteista sekä muista yrityksen perustamiseen liittyvistä kustannuksista.Testaa vastaammeko me sinun haaveisiisi paremmasta työstä ja sujuvammasta arjesta: Hyppää uudenaikaiseen kotipalvelutyöhön! Käy tekemässä onnellisuustestimmeNyt on täydellinen hetki hypätä mukaan kasvavaan kotipalvelualaan tukea, asiakkaita ja etuja heti alusta alkaen. Vapaita koulutuspaikkoja vuoden 2027 koulutuksiin!Hae mukaan jo tänään ja kerro, miksi juuri sinä olisit sopiva Kotipalveluyrittäjäksi. Haastattelut käynnistetään jo hakuaikana ja paikat täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Hakemuksen ja infopaketin löydät sivuiltamme,Tervetuloa nauttimaan siistimmästä arjesta kanssamme!Avainsanoja: siivous, kotiapu, kotipalvelu, kotisiivous, lisätyö, osa-aikatyö, lisäansio, lisätulo, kotipalvelu, asiakaspalvelu, asiakaspalvelutyö, yrittäjä, yrittäjyys, siivousala, puhtausala, siivooja, lähihoitaja, sairaanhoitaja, kotihoiva, siistijä, kokoaikatyö, hoiva-avustaja, kodinhuoltaja, päivätyö, laitoshuoltaja, puhtausala, hoitoala, kotipalveluala, siivoustyö, avointyöpaikka, palvelutyö, yrittäjyys, kotipalvelutyö,

jobs.title: Bilmekaniker med fagbrev
jobs.description:
Vi søker en dyktig og selvstendig bilmekaniker med fagbrev til en jobb på Askøy. Dette er en jobb som passer for deg som ønsker videreutvikle deg som mekaniker, og på sikt ønsker større oppgaver på verkstedet.

Hva vi ser etter

  • Fagbrev som bilmekaniker er et krav.

  • Praktisk erfaring fra verksted og god teknisk innsikt.

  • Gode ferdigheter i feilsøking og bruk av diagnoseverktøy.

  • Førerkort klasse B.

  • God arbeidsmoral, punktlighet og evne til å jobbe selvstendig.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Utføre service, vedlikehold og reparasjoner på person- og varebiler.

  • Feilsøking og diagnose av mekaniske og elektriske feil.

  • Oppfølging og dokumentasjon av utført arbeid.

  • Samarbeid med verkstedleder og kolleger for god fremdrift og kvalitet.

  • Bidra til et ryddig og sikkert arbeidsmiljø.

Vi tilbyr

  • Gode vilkår og konkurransedyktig lønn etter avtale.

  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø og profesjonell oppfølging fra vår rådgiver.

Vi behandler søknader fortløpende og oppfordrer kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke snarest.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nordvest Bemanning AS er et bemanningsbyrå med lang erfaring innen formidling og utleie av faglært arbeidskraft. Vi rekrutterer i dag medarbeidere til et bredt utvalg av fagområder. Selskapet ble etablert i 2005, og har siden den gang hatt en positiv utvikling i forhold til kunder og oppdrag. Vårt hovedkontor ligger på Askøy like utenfor Bergen og vi er i dag et team på 150 medarbeidere.

Nordvest Bemanning AS is a recruitment agency with great experience in provision and hiring of skilled labour. We are currently recruiting employees for a wide range of specialist areas. The company was established in 2005, and since then has had a positive development in relation to customers and assignments. Our head office is located on Askøy just outside Bergen and we are at the moment a team of 150 co-workers.

jobs.title: Customer Marketing Manager, EMEA
jobs.description:
Horizon3.ai is seeking a customer-focused, data-driven Customer Marketing Manager to build engagement, adoption, retention, expansion, and advocacy across our EMEA customer base. You will create programs that help customers realize more value from Horizon3, strengthen customer relationships, and turn successful outcomes into credible customer proof.

This role brings together customer lifecycle marketing and customer advocacy. You will develop regional customer communications and campaigns while building a repeatable advocacy engine across customer stories, references, third-party reviews, speakers, and other strategic opportunities. You will work closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product Marketing, Product, and the broader Marketing team to turn customer needs and business priorities into useful, measurable programs.

The ideal candidate is both a strategic planner and a hands-on operator. You can build trust with customers, coordinate complex projects across teams and markets, use data to improve programs, and make it straightforward for customers to participate.

What you will do

Customer lifecycle marketing

  • Plan and execute customer marketing programs across onboarding, activation, adoption, engagement, retention, renewal support, and expansion.

  • Define customer segments, lifecycle stages, journey maps, messaging, and campaign playbooks that can be adapted for EMEA audiences.

  • Partner with Customer Success and Customer Enablement to promote onboarding, education, product engagement, and other programs that help customers achieve meaningful outcomes.

  • Develop proactive re-engagement programs for at-risk or under-engaged accounts using customer health, product usage, support, engagement, and renewal signals.

  • Create signal-based campaigns tied to customer needs, product usage, account changes, renewal timing, and expansion fit. Route qualified opportunities to the appropriate Customer Success Managers and account executives.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and Product to translate customer feedback into product communications, release messaging, educational content, and lifecycle campaigns.

  • Equip Sales and Customer Success with customer-centric messaging, adoption resources, executive business review materials, playbooks, and clear follow-up paths.

Customer advocacy and proof

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of EMEA customer advocates based on customer outcomes, engagement, use cases, and willingness to participate.

  • Partner with Customer Success Managers and account teams to identify customers for case studies, video testimonials, customer quotes, social content, references, and events.

  • Manage customer participation from outreach through briefing, approvals, production, publication, and follow-up. Coordinate logo rights, quotes, and other customer permissions with the appropriate internal teams.

  • Create and manage a practical customer reference program that supports sales opportunities, renewals, expansions, and strategic marketing needs. Maintain an organized reference pool and manage requests from intake and matching through scheduling, follow-up, and recognition.

  • Own day-to-day Peerbound administration and adoption, including customer profiles, advocacy requests, reference activity, permissions, and reporting. Help Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success use the platform consistently and make fuller use of its capabilities.

  • Develop and execute a focused third-party review strategy across relevant platforms, such as G2 and Gartner Peer Insights. Coordinate authentic customer outreach and track review volume, ratings, sentiment, category placement, competitor positioning, and progress against award criteria.

  • Maintain a qualified pipeline of customer speakers for webinars, user groups, events, panels, and other marketing programs. Confirm speakers early enough to include them in event promotions, landing pages, emails, and social campaigns, and manage briefing, preparation, logistics, approvals, and follow-up.

  • Own the customer invitation process for Customer Advisory Board opportunities and support customer recruitment for analyst interviews, research, awards, and other strategic initiatives.

  • Work with Content, Product Marketing, Social, Events, Communications, Analyst Relations, and Creative to elevate customers alongside the Horizon3.ai brand and turn customer outcomes into reusable marketing assets.

Program operations and measurement

  • Build annual and quarterly customer marketing plans for EMEA, manage budgets and resources, and lead cross-functional execution.

  • Work with Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, and Customer Success Operations to improve segmentation, data quality, trigger detection, nurture, automation, attribution, and reporting.

  • Establish dashboards and operating rhythms that connect program engagement to adoption, customer advocacy, renewal health, retention, expansion pipeline, and influenced revenue.

  • Define success measures, analyze results, identify opportunities to improve, and iterate on program strategy, messaging, and execution.

  • Communicate timelines, owners, status, risks, and next steps clearly across teams. Create practical templates, trackers, and workflows that make customer marketing easier to execute and scale.

What you bring

  • 7+ years of marketing experience, including 3+ years in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, customer advocacy, customer success enablement, or a related discipline.

  • Experience building customer journeys and programs across adoption, engagement, retention, renewal, expansion, or advocacy.

  • A track record of managing customer stories, references, reviews, speakers, or other advocacy programs, ideally alongside lifecycle marketing responsibilities.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and confidence communicating with customers and internal stakeholders.

  • Experience partnering with Customer Success, Sales, Product Marketing, Product, Marketing Operations, and Revenue Operations.

  • Strong project management and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple programs and deadlines across teams and markets.

  • Analytical and operational skills, including the ability to connect customer behavior and program performance to business outcomes.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the judgment to represent customer perspectives accurately and authentically.

  • Familiarity with customer advocacy, reference, review, CRM, or marketing automation platforms. Peerbound experience is a plus.

  • Understanding of B2B SaaS or cybersecurity customer environments is a plus.

  • Ability to work effectively across EMEA markets and time zones. Additional language skills are a plus.

How success is measured

  • Lifecycle program engagement and contribution to customer adoption, retention, renewal health, and expansion.

  • Growth and health of the EMEA customer advocate and reference pool, including references fulfilled and customer participation.

  • Customer proof produced, including case studies, videos, quotes, approved logos, and social or event participation.

  • Customer speakers confirmed in time to support event and webinar promotion.

  • Peerbound adoption, data quality, and program activity.

  • Review volume, ratings, sentiment, and progress against award criteria.

  • Customer experience and internal stakeholder satisfaction.

jobs.title: Junior Business Controller (Data specialist)
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy working with numbers, analysing data and finding out what is really happening behind the figures? As Junior Business Controller at HG, you will support our Controllers and Group Financial Controller with financial analyses, reporting and increasingly data-driven insights.

At HG, you will work in a compact organisation with an international reach. You will get the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues, take responsibility early and turn financial and business data into insights that help us make better decisions. We value people who are curious, take initiative and have the energy to turn ideas into action.

About the role

As Junior Business Controller, you will support our Controllers and gradually build your own areas of responsibility. The role combines financial activities with a strong focus on data, analysis and improving management information.

You will:

  • support the Business Controllers with financial analyses, reporting and recurring control activities;

  • own and maintain the data model

  • analyse financial and business data and translate it into useful insights;

  • investigate differences, trends and developments and help explain what is happening behind the numbers;

  • build, review and improve data models used for reporting and analysis;

  • use various tools including Excel and Power BI to make information clearer and easier to use;

  • investigate how data flows from source to report and identify opportunities to improve data quality and reporting;

  • help reduce manual work by finding smarter and more reliable ways of working;

  • contribute to improvements in management information and financial processes;

  • translate questions from colleagues into practical analyses and insights.

An important part of the role is conceptual thinking about data. You understand how information should be structured, see connections between different data points and can think about how a data model can be improved to provide better business insights.

Your development in data

Next to your finance responsibilities, you will grow step by step into the data side of the role, coached by our current Data Specialist. You do not need to master these areas from day one: together we will set up a development path in which you learn to:

  • contribute to HG's Business Intelligence and data strategy, making sure data supports our company goals;

  • design and maintain data models (such as star schemas) and database/Lakehouse structures, so that data is accurate, reliable and accessible;

  • integrate data from different sources and systems in a medallion model (Bronze for raw data, Silver for engineering, Gold for consumption);

  • manage the HG Data Dictionary, data repositories and the underlying data architecture;

  • apply data governance and data quality practices, including audit trails, data privacy requirements and best-practice frameworks such as DAMA;

  • map business processes (BPMN 2.0) and translate business requirements into practical data solutions;

  • work with tools such as SQL, Python (pandas), Power Query, Power Automate and Microsoft Fabric, and over time explore AI techniques;

  • document data models and data processes, and monitor data systems for performance and reliability.

This gives you a strong combination of finance and data expertise, which is becoming increasingly valuable in modern Business Control.

Collaboration & positioning

You will be part of the Finance team and work closely with our Business Controllers. This gives you the opportunity to learn from experienced colleagues while contributing your own analytical and data-driven perspective.

Because HG is a relatively compact organisation, you will have direct contact with colleagues across different disciplines. This means you can quickly see how your analyses and improvements are being used in the business. At the same time, you will work within an international organisation, with colleagues and markets across Europe.

The role is based at our head office in Almere.

HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.


What you bring

We are looking for someone who is analytical, energetic and curious. You enjoy getting to the bottom of a question rather than simply producing a report. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do and how the underlying data can provide better insights.

You bring:

  • willingness to learn

  • around 3–5 years of relevant work experience, for example as a big 4 auditor, Finance Analyst, Data Analyst or Junior Business Controller;

  • solid knowledge of finance and accounting, preferably gained through an education in Accountancy, Finance & Control, Business Information Management, Data Analytics);

  • experience with or a strong interest in Power BI;

  • strong analytical skills;

  • the ability to think conceptually about data, reporting and data models;

  • a curious and proactive approach to solving problems;

  • the confidence to ask questions and challenge existing ways of working;

  • an energetic mindset and the drive to learn and improve;

  • a genuine eagerness to learn and to keep developing yourself, both in finance and in data;

  • fluent English; knowledge of Dutch is desirable.

  • experience with AI tools, such as Copilot.

    Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit

What we offer

This is a role where you can build a strong foundation in modern Business Control while developing further in data and analytics. You will not only work with existing reports and figures, but also have the opportunity to improve how information is structured, analysed and used.

You can expect:

  • a monthly salary between €4.000 and €5.200 (excluding holiday allowance), depending on your experience.

  • an annual on-target bonus of 10% of your gross annual salary; 

  • full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave; 

  • a pension scheme; 

  • a commuting allowance; 

  • a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued;

  • the opportunity to grow towards a broader Business Controller role as your knowledge, experience and responsibilities develop;

  • structured coaching by our Data Specialist to develop your data skills alongside your finance role;

  • a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks.

We are HG

HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products.

We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems.

HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance.

We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact.

HG does what it promises.


Do you have any questions?

Our colleague Ilse de Groot, Corporate Recruiter, will be happy to answer any questions. You can contact her at

Would you like to apply for the junior business controller position at HG? You can apply directly by uploading your CV. We aim to respond within 5 working days.

Arkemme on lounas- ja iltavuoroja, joita maustaa erilaiset sesongit ja tapahtumat. Tutustut myös kokouspalveluidemme rakentamiseen sekä työskentelet kokousten ja muiden tilaisuuksien parissa.Tehtävä on vakituinen ja osa-aikainen (vähintään keskimäärin 60 h/3vko).Haemme tiimiimme asiakaspalveluhenkistä tarjoilijaa, joka tuo persoonallaan iloa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja juhlaan. Koulutus ja kokemus luo pohjan työlle, mutta meillä iloinen ja reipas asenne voittaa ansioluettelon.Osuuskauppa Maakunta huolehtii työntekijöiden hyvinvoinnista ja työturvallisuudesta: Meillä on poikkeuksellisen kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten alennukset S-ryhmän kaupoissa, ravintoloissa ja hotelleissa. Käytössäsi ovat laajat työterveyshuollon palvelut, vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutus, mahdollisuus henkilöstörahastoon sekä ePassin tuoma tuki liikuntaan, kulttuuriin ja hyvinvointiin.Panostus henkilöstön hyvinvointiin näkyy myös tunnustuksina: Osuuskauppa Maakunta on tänä vuonna palkittu Suomen Innostavimmat työpaikat -kilpailun keskisuurten yritysten sarjassa, sijoituksen perustuessa henkilökunnan työtyytyväisyyskyselyn tuloksiin.Palkka perustuu matkailu- ja ravitsemisalan työehtosopimukseen ja on kokemusvuosiin perustuen 13,70-15,04 €/tunti. Vuorotyössä peruspalkan päälle maksetaan ilta-, lauantai- ja sunnuntai -lisät. Meillä työryhmillä on mahdollisuus myös tulospalkkioon, joka voi olla jopa 1 €/tehty työtunti.Lisätietoja antaa ravintolapäällikkö Hannemari Kautto puh. 010 763 7053 tai hannemari.kautto@sok.fiHae pian, viimeistään 13.12.2026 mennessä.Osuuskauppa Maakunta on kainuulaisten asiakasomistajien omistama alueosuuskauppa. Toimialamme ovat päivittäis- ja erikoistavarakauppa, liikennekauppa sekä matkailu- ja ravitsemiskauppa. Myyntimme v. 2025 oli 265 milj. euroa ja työllistämme Kainuussa noin 500 ihmistä.

jobs.title: Kom og bliv en del af Danmarks bedste krisecenter
jobs.description:
Krisecenter Guldborgsund søger en socialrådgiver til en fast stilling på 37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse den 1. februar 2027.

Brænder du for at gøre en reel forskel for mennesker, der har været udsat for vold i nære relationer? Kan du kombinere høj socialfaglighed med empati, struktur og handlekraft – og trives du i en hverdag, hvor ikke to dage er ens?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

På Krisecenter Guldborgsund arbejder vi hver dag for at skabe sikkerhed, tryghed, nye handlemuligheder og en vej videre for mennesker, der har været udsat for vold i nære relationer. Vi er et hus i rivende udvikling, og vi har høje ambitioner – både på vores beboeres og vores fagligheds vegne.

Hvem er vi?

Krisecenter Guldborgsund er et krisecenter efter servicelovens § 109. Vi har 21 lejligheder med plads til kvinder og mænd samt op mod 30 medfølgende børn – og sommetider også familiens kæledyr.

Fælles for vores beboere er, at de har været udsat for vold i nære relationer og derfor har søgt ophold hos os.

Vi er et stort hus, hvor der sker meget i løbet af en dag. Det kræver, at du kan bevare overblikket, være fleksibel og samtidig holde fast i struktur, faglighed og dokumentation.

Hos os arbejder vi tæt sammen på tværs af fagligheder, fordi vi tror på, at den bedste indsats skabes, når forskellige faglige perspektiver bringes i spil.

Din rolle som rådgiver

Som rådgiver får du en central rolle i den enkelte borgers ophold og forløb på krisecenteret.

Arbejdet spænder fra den første visitation og vurdering af sikkerhedsbehov til samtaler, risikovurderinger, koordinering, myndighedssamarbejde og støtte til at skabe en ny tilværelse efter volden.

Dine arbejdsopgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • Åben rådgivning til borgere, som ikke er indskrevet på krisecenteret.

  • Visitationssamtaler og vurdering af indskrivningsgrundlag og sikkerhedsbehov.

  • Udarbejdelse og løbende opfølgning på risikovurderinger og relevante sikkerhedstiltag.

  • Ugentlige samtaler med de borgere, du er kontaktperson for.

  • Rådgivning og vejledning omkring blandt andet bolig, økonomi, sociale ydelser, bopæl og forældremyndighed.

  • Koordinering af borgernes sager på tværs af myndigheder og øvrige samarbejdspartnere.

  • Handleplansmøder med borgere og betalingskommuner.

  • Udarbejdelse af lovpligtige opholdsplaner.

  • Bisidderfunktion ved eksempelvis møder med kommune, politi, læge, Familieretshuset og Familieretten.

  • Tværfagligt samarbejde omkring både voksne og medfølgende børn.

  • Journalføring, notatpligt og øvrig relevant socialfaglig dokumentation.

Rådgiverfunktionen indebærer dermed både relationsarbejde, myndighedssamarbejde, praktisk socialrådgivning og en betydelig koordinerende funktion omkring den enkelte borgers samlede forløb.

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger en erfaren socialrådgiver, som hviler i sin faglighed, kan arbejde selvstændigt og har lyst til at udvikle sig inden for det specialiserede voldsfaglige område.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet socialrådgiver

  • Har minimum to års relevant erhvervserfaring.

  • Har solid socialfaglig erfaring og gerne erfaring med udsatte borgere, vold i nære relationer, myndighedsarbejde, familieområdet eller lignende.

  • Er stærk både mundtligt og skriftligt.

  • Kan skabe en professionel og tillidsfuld relation til mennesker, der befinder sig i en krisesituation.

  • Kan arbejde struktureret, prioritere dine opgaver og bevare overblikket, også når planerne pludselig ændrer sig.

  • Forstår betydningen af grundig og rettidig dokumentation.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt, men samtidig ser tværfagligt samarbejde som en naturlig del af arbejdet.

  • Er åben over for faglig sparring, feedback og udvikling af egen praksis.

  • Har mod på at være en aktiv del af huset og beboernes hverdag – vi er et krisecenter, ikke en traditionel kontorarbejdsplads.

Vi lægger vægt på faglighed og erfaring, men også på, hvem du er som menneske. Vi bruger mange timer sammen, og derfor betyder humor, engagement, fleksibilitet og lysten til at bidrage til fællesskabet også noget for os.

Team og organisering

Krisecenter Guldborgsund er kendetegnet ved et tæt og tværfagligt samarbejde.

Du bliver en del af et engageret team bestående af leder, faglig koordinator, socialrådgivere, pædagoger, psykoterapeut, psykolog, nattevagter, administrativ medarbejder, pedel og øvrigt personale

Vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af faggrupper og forventer, at alle bidrager til huset, fællesskabet og den fælles kerneopgave.

Stillingen er en fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer ugentligt.

Rådgivernes arbejdstid er som udgangspunkt placeret i dagtimerne, typisk fra kl. 8.00-15.00 og enkelte dage fra kl. 8.00-16.00.

Derudover har den enkelte rådgiver én fast ugentlig aftenvagt fra kl. 11.00-21.00.

Rådgiverne indgår desuden i:

  • Weekendvagt hver 8. weekend, hvor arbejdstiden er lørdag og søndag fra kl. 10.00-16.00.

  • Helligdagsvagter

Personalegruppen planlægger i høj grad selv fordelingen af sommerferie og helligdagsvagter.

Det fungerer rigtig godt i praksis, og medarbejderne er gode til at koordinere indbyrdes og tage hensyn til både hinandens ønsker og krisecenterets behov for bemanding.

Vi tilbyder

  • En fast stilling på en arbejdsplads, hvor dit arbejde har reel betydning for mennesker i en vanskelig livssituation.

  • Et stærkt og engageret tværfagligt miljø.

  • En arbejdsplads med høje faglige ambitioner og fokus på det specialiserede voldsfaglige område.

  • Mulighed for løbende kompetenceudvikling og efteruddannelse.

  • Faglig sparring og supervision.

  • En hverdag med stor selvstændighed, ansvar og tydelige rammer.

  • En organisation i udvikling, hvor der ikke er langt fra idé til handling.

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor vi prioriterer faglighed, samarbejde, respekt, humor (også den sorte) og et godt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Og ikke mindst – de bedste og sjoveste kollegaer, som er en god blanding af både mænd og kvinder.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Ansættelsesform: Fast stilling.

Arbejdstid: 37 timer ugentligt.

Tiltrædelse: 1. februar 2027.

Ansøgning og ansættelsessamtaler

Ansøgningsfrist: Tirsdag den 15. december 2026.

Ansættelsessamtaler afholdes mandag den 21. december 2026.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte:

Linda MøllgrenLeder, Krisecenter GuldborgsundTelefon: 51 93 07 82 mellem kl. 11.00-13.00Mail: linda@krisecenterguldborgsund.dk

Vi søger ikke bare en socialrådgiver, der kan løse en række opgaver. Vi søger en ny kollega, som har lyst til at være en aktiv del af vores hus, vores fællesskab, vores faglige udvikling og den forskel, vi hver eneste dag arbejder for at skabe for mennesker udsat for vold i nære relationer.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: SMD Operators for a New Evening Shift
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced SMD Operator with a keen eye for quality, stable processes and precision-driven electronics manufacturing? Do you thrive in a technical environment where you take responsibility, work in a structured manner and actively contribute to a strong team? Then you could be our next experienced SMD Operator at NECAS A/S.About the positionAs an SMD Operator at NECAS, you will play a key role in the operation of our SMD lines – the heart of our electronics manufacturing. You will be responsible for setting up, monitoring and optimising processes, ensuring that production meets our high quality standards.The electronics you help produce are used in everything from industrial and marine applications to defence and aerospace – industries where precision and reliability are essential.You will become part of a highly skilled team and report to the Team Leader.Your responsibilitiesSMD line operation and preparation
  • Operate and monitor SMD equipment, including solder paste printer, SPI, pick-and-place, AOI and reflow oven
  • Prepare the line for production changeovers, including programmes, materials, feeder setup and documentation
  • Ensure stable operation in accordance with production plans and work instructions
  • Work with supporting processes such as the washing machine and stencil cleaner
Quality and inspection
  • Carry out process and quality inspections, including visual inspection and First Article Inspection
  • Analyse AOI results and respond to deviations
  • Ensure the correct handling of materials and components, including batch control, traceability and shelf life
  • Work in accordance with the IPC-A-610 standard (certification provided where required)
  • Record defects and deviations in the quality management system
Collaboration and continuous improvement
  • Ensure good communication and effective handovers between shifts
  • Share knowledge and support colleagues in their daily work
  • Contribute suggestions for improving processes and workflows
  • Maintain order and structure in the SMD area in accordance with 5S principles
About youWe are looking for a candidate who already has solid experience in SMD production and is able to work independently in a technically demanding role.We expect you to:
  • Have a minimum of 3 years' experience with SMD equipment or electronics manufacturing
  • Be structured and able to maintain an overview, even during busy periods
  • Take responsibility and respond quickly when something deviates from the standard
  • Be a team player who contributes positively to the team
  • Have a technical understanding and an interest in working with advanced equipment
  • Language: good command of English, spoken and written
What we offerAt NECAS, you will become part of a growing company where quality and professional expertise are at the heart of what we do. You will receive:
  • A thorough introduction to our processes and equipment
  • Opportunities for relevant training and certifications, such as IPC-A-610
  • A strong team environment and an informal culture with a high level of professional expertise
  • A workplace in Støvring's newest industrial area, close to the E45 motorway
  • Competitive terms of employment, including pension and health insurance
About NECASNECAS is one of Denmark's leading EMS companies, manufacturing electronics for the industrial, marine/offshore, defence, aerospace and scientific sectors – industries where quality and precision are essential.We are one of the few EMS manufacturers in Denmark with AS9100 certification for the aerospace industry. At NECAS, you will become part of a company experiencing significant growth, where you can develop your professional skills and help push the boundaries of Danish electronics manufacturing.As we say: Built for trust.How to applyThe position will be filled as soon as possible. We are inviting candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send your application and CV as soon as possible. We read all applications and will contact candidates we would like to get to know better.If you have any questions, please contact Team Leader Mariana Surleac on +45 92 92 76 20.

From Policies and Disclosures to Training, Hotline, and Analytics, our agents work together to drive smarter, faster, human-led decision-making. We're passionate about the work we do, love feedback, and lead with high agency and accountability. When we see something that could be better, we step up to the plate and do something about it. We take our work seriously, but are careful not to take ourselves too seriously. Because doing great work should be fun.

Our workforce is fully remote, and your personal working hours can be based on your own timezone. All team-wide meetings are scheduled to be inclusive of all North American time zones.

Who we're looking for

At Ethena, we're an AI platform that's revolutionizing the Compliance space. Our product and engineering teams ship fastâreally fast. Build cycles are shrinking, product offerings are expanding, and our roadmap evolves to meet the needs of a changing workplace.

Why You'll Love This Role

A Product Thatâs Actually Fun to Demo: You won't be demoing clunky 90s software. Ethenaâs product is modern, fast-moving, AI-infused, and constantly improving.

Scope Beyond the Demo: Youâll get to own projects outside standard RFPsâbuilding sales enablement, testing out vibe coding ideas, building interactive proofs-of-concept, and crafting technical narratives.

What you'll do

Partner with Account Executives (AEs) and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) during discovery and demo stages to map Ethena's technical strengths to customer pain points.

2. Build, Prototype & "Vibe Code"

Bring a hands-on technical curiosity to the teamâwhether thatâs experimenting with APIs, testing automated demo setups, or vibe coding custom tools to help win deals.

3. Handle Technical Due Diligence & Enablement

What makes a great candidate

If you're coming from an adjacent background, you should have already run technical discovery and delivered tailored demos inside live deals, not just after the sale.

Startup Mindset: You thrive in fast-paced environments where polish takes a backseat to clarity, fast execution, and rapid iteration.

IC Trajectory Focus: You are energized by mastering the craft of Sales Engineering, solving customer problems, and deepening your technical mastery.

Environmental Familiarity: You have experience in a startup, growth-stage SaaS company, or similarly fast-moving environment where priorities shift quickly and there aren't always established processes or specialist resources to lean on.

The Hardest Part of the Role

Our product moves fast, and our roadmap evolves continuously. The hardest part of this job is staying ahead of a rapidly innovating platform and translating those technical changes on the fly into crisp, high-impact customer narratives. If last-minute roadmap shifts excite you rather than stress you out, youâre going to love it here.

jobs.title: Udlejningskonsulent søges til vores afdeling i Thisted
jobs.description:
Brænder du for at arbejde med udlejning, salg og kundeservice? Og vil du være en del af et lille, tæt team, hvor alle giver en hånd med? Så er det måske dig, der er vores nye kollega i Thisted.

Hvem er viNordjysk Lift er en del af Renta Group - en af Nordens førende udlejningsvirksomheder inden for maskiner og materiel. Det betyder, at du får det bedste fra to verdener: en lokal afdeling med kort vej fra idé til handling og en stærk koncern i ryggen med stor faglighed, erfaring og gode udviklingsmuligheder.

Om jobbetSom udlejningskonsulent i Thisted bliver du en del af en afdeling med 4 medarbejdere, hvor vi hjælper hinanden på tværs af opgaverne - uanset om det gælder en kunde, klargøring af en maskine eller noget helt tredje. Du bliver ansvarlig for udlejning af materiel til erhvervskunder, og dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Personligt og telefonisk salg og rådgivning til kunder

  • Udarbejdelse af tilbud, lejekontrakter og andre administrative opgaver

  • Udlevering af maskiner og værktøj samt håndtering af indleveret materiel

  • Klargøring af maskiner og praktiske opgaver i afdelingen

Stillingen er på fuld tid, 41,5 timer om ugen.

Om digDu har erfaring med udlejning, kundeservice og kundekontakt og har flair for at skabe og vedligeholde gode kunderelationer. Det er en fordel, hvis du har maskinkendskab eller er god til at bruge dine hænder, men det er ikke et krav. Det er en forudsætning, at du har kørekort, og det er en fordel, hvis du har truckcertifikat.

Som person er du imødekommende og løsningsorienteret, og du trives i et travlt miljø med skiftende opgaver. Da vi er en lille afdeling, lægger vi stor vægt på, at du er en positiv og hjælpsom kollega, som giver en hånd med, hvor der er brug for det.

Vi tilbyder

  • Et spændende job og en varieret hverdag

  • Et lille, tæt team med en uformel og humoristisk tone

  • Gode muligheder for personlig og faglig udvikling som en del af Renta Group

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn efter kvalifikationer

Interesseret?Kan du se dig selv som en del af holdet i Thisted? Ansøg hurtigst muligt via formularen eller send en mail til job@nordjysklift.dk med "Udlejningskonsulent Thisted" i emnefeltet.

Vi ønsker opstart hurtigst muligt og holder samtaler løbende. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Jesper Pedersen på telefon 30 85 85 55.

jobs.title: Koordinerende klubmedarbejder
jobs.description:
SPOT 8380 søger to klubmedarbejdere/koordinatorer

Brænder du for at gøre en forskel for unge, og er du god til at skabe relationer, tage initiativ og få idéer til at blive til virkelighed? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Hvem er vi?

SPOT 8380 er en mindre, men ambitiøs ungdomsklub i Trige for unge mellem 13 og 18 år. Vi har åbent torsdag og søndag kl. 19–22 og arbejder seriøst med at skabe et frirum med fællesskaber, aktiviteter og plads til at være ung.

Vi har store ambitioner om at udvikle klubben, styrke samarbejdet med lokale aktører og få endnu flere unge til at blive en del af fællesskabet.

Vi søger to forskellige profiler

Vi har to ledige stillinger og søger medarbejdere, der med forskellige kompetencer kan bidrage til klubbens drift og udvikling.

Den koordinerende profil

Du arbejder bag kulisserne, aflaster personalegruppen, etablerer lokale samarbejder og sikrer, at vores idéer og initiativer bliver ført ud i livet.

Den kombinerede klubmedarbejder- og koordinatorprofil

Du bidrager både til de koordinerende opgaver og arbejder direkte med de unge i klubbens åbningstid. Her er du med til at skabe gode relationer, spændende aktiviteter og trygge fællesskaber.

Den konkrete sammensætning af opgaver og timer afhænger af din profil, dine kompetencer og interesser.

Dine arbejdsopgaver kan blandt andet være

  • Etablere og udvikle samarbejder med professionelle og frivillige hos lokale foreninger, institutioner og andre aktører.

  • Undersøge nye samarbejdsmuligheder, der kan få flere unge til at bruge klubben.

  • Bistå med planlægning og koordinering af større aktiviteter i samarbejde med personalet.

  • Aflaste personalegruppen med praktiske og koordinerende opgaver.

  • Følge op på aftaler og sikre, at idéer og beslutninger bliver omsat til handling.

  • Bidrage med egne idéer til udviklingen af klubben.

  • Arbejde direkte med de unge i klubbens åbningstid, afhængigt af din profil.

Opgaverne defineres og prioriteres i samarbejde med personalegruppen, men der er også plads til egne idéer og selvstændige initiativer.

Hvem er du?

Først og fremmest brænder du for at gøre en forskel for unge og har lyst til at bidrage til stærke lokale fællesskaber.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er selvstændig, opsøgende og god til at skabe relationer.

  • Har overblik og er god til at koordinere.

  • Tager ansvar og følger opgaver helt til dørs.

  • Er idérig og ser muligheder i samarbejdet med andre.

Det er en stor fordel, hvis du bor i Trige eller har et godt kendskab til lokalområdet. Erfaring med boligsociale indsatser, sociale tilbud, ungdomsarbejde eller foreningssamarbejde er ligeledes en fordel.

Du behøver ikke have en bestemt uddannelse. Det vigtigste er dit engagement, dine samarbejdsevner og din evne til at få ting til at ske.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Du bliver en del af en engageret personalegruppe i en klub med højt til loftet og store ambitioner på de unges vegne.

Du får en fleksibel og varieret hverdag med mulighed for at præge klubbens udvikling og gøre en konkret forskel for unge i lokalområdet.

Praktisk information

  • Antal ledige stillinger: 2.

  • Arbejdstid: 5–10 timer om ugen afhængigt af din profil.

  • Ansættelse: Tidsbegrænset til ét år.

  • Fleksjob: Vi er også åbne over for ansøgninger fra fleksjobbere med en arbejdstid på maksimalt 6 timer om ugen.

  • Fleksibilitet: Du tilrettelægger i høj grad selv dine koordineringsopgaver. Møder med samarbejdspartnere ligger typisk i dagtimerne eller om eftermiddagen.

  • Klubvagter: Torsdag og søndag kl. 19–22, afhængigt af din profil.

  • Personalemøder: Cirka én gang om måneden, typisk fra kl. 17.

  • Organisering: Du refererer formelt til SPOT 8380's bestyrelse, men indgår i det daglige i tæt samarbejde med den øvrige personalegruppe.

  • Arbejdssted: Smedebroen 21B, 8380 Trige.

Vil du være med?

Vi leder efter mennesker, der deler vores ambitioner for de unge og kan hjælpe os med at få tingene til at ske.

Mere handling, mindre snak og endnu flere unge i klubben!

Send din ansøgning til spotungdomsklub@gmail.com med ansøgning og CV senest den 4. december 2026.

Fortæl gerne i din ansøgning, hvilken af de to profiler du bedst kan se dig selv i.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Anders Mondrup på telefon 93 98 19 06.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

SPOT 8380

jobs.title: IT Service Desk Technician
jobs.description:
Location: Oslo, Norway

About the role

At Schibsted, reliable IT services are essential to helping our employees do their best work.

We are looking for an IT Service Desk Technician to join our Service Desk team in Oslo, providing high-quality technical support to employees across our organisation, primarily in Norway and Sweden.

Our Service Desk is more than a traditional first-line support function. We resolve approximately 80% of all incoming IT requests and incidents within the team, which means you will have the opportunity to work with a wide range of technical challenges, take ownership of issues and develop your troubleshooting skills.

You will work in an international environment where customer satisfaction, technical expertise and continuous improvement are key priorities. Our IT operations follow IT Service Management (ITSM) principles and ITIL practices, with a strong focus on efficient problem-solving, knowledge sharing and improving the employee IT experience.

Your responsibilities

As an IT Service Desk Technician, your main responsibilities will include:

  • Deliver high-quality IT support: Provide professional, friendly and solution-oriented technical support to employees through phone, email and other support channels.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues: Investigate and resolve incidents involving computers, operating systems, applications, user accounts, access and other workplace technologies.

  • Own incidents and service requests: Register, prioritise, investigate, document and follow up on cases in our ITSM platform (ServiceNow/Halo), taking responsibility for driving issues towards resolution.

  • Ensure a great user experience: Communicate clearly with users, provide regular updates and manage expectations throughout the support process.

  • Drive efficient resolution and knowledge sharing: Contribute to our high resolution rate by developing technical knowledge, documenting solutions and supporting a shift-left approach.

  • Collaborate and continuously improve: Work closely with colleagues and other IT teams to resolve complex issues and improve processes related to Incident, Problem, Change and Knowledge Management.

  • Manage IT equipment and suppliers: Support ordering, inventory management and distribution of IT equipment and accessories, including coordination with external suppliers.

What we're looking for

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges, takes ownership of problems and genuinely likes helping people.

You are curious about technology, comfortable investigating unfamiliar issues and motivated by finding solutions rather than simply passing problems on to someone else.

You enjoy working in an environment where priorities can change quickly and where teamwork, knowledge sharing and customer satisfaction are essential.

Skills and knowledge

To succeed in this role, we believe you have:

  • A good understanding of computers, operating systems, software and common workplace IT technologies.

  • The ability to troubleshoot technical issues in a structured and logical way.

  • Familiarity with, or an interest in learning, technologies such as Windows, macOS, Microsoft 365, Google Workspace and Microsoft Entra ID.

  • An understanding of the importance of documenting incidents, solutions and technical information.

  • The ability to communicate technical information clearly to users with different levels of IT knowledge.

  • Professional proficiency in Norwegian or Swedish, as well as English, both written and spoken.

Nice to have

The following qualifications are an advantage, but not essential:

  • Previous experience working in an IT Service Desk, IT Support or similar technical support role.

  • Around two years of relevant technical experience or education.

  • Experience working with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow or Halo.

  • Knowledge of ITIL principles and IT Service Management processes.

  • Relevant IT certifications or technical training.

  • Experience with IT equipment management, inventory control or supplier coordination.

  • Experience with AI tools and technologies, particularly using AI to improve IT support, automate tasks, enhance troubleshooting or streamline workflows.

We value practical skills, curiosity and a willingness to learn. You do not need to meet every preferred qualification to be considered for the role.

Who you are

We believe the following qualities will help you succeed:

  • Customer oriented: You enjoy helping others, understand their needs and take pride in delivering excellent service.

  • Problem-solving: You approach technical challenges with curiosity, persistence and a structured mindset, taking responsibility for finding solutions.

  • Communication: You explain technical issues clearly, listen actively and keep users informed throughout the support process.

  • Adaptable: You are comfortable handling changing priorities, learning new technologies and working in a dynamic IT environment.

  • Collaborative: You enjoy sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues and contributing to a positive and supportive team environment.

Why join us?

You will join a Service Desk team in Oslo where technical problem-solving, collaboration and high-quality service go hand in hand.

Unlike traditional first-line support roles, our team handles and resolves the majority of incoming IT issues, giving you the opportunity to work with a broad range of technologies and technical challenges.

You will support colleagues across Norway and Sweden, work with modern workplace technologies and contribute to continuously improving how IT services are delivered.

We believe great IT support is about more than fixing technical problems. It is about taking ownership, building trust and making people's working lives easier.

Vil du være en del af en organisation, som går forrest i udviklingen af idrætsforeningerne? Har du en faglighed inden for svømning og et stærkt foreningskendskab? Så er du måske vores nye kollega i DGI Nordsjælland. 

Svømning bliver dit primære fagområde, men vi forventer også, at du er nysgerrig på, hvordan vi kan udvikle nye aktiviteter og fællesskaber i, på og omkring vand. Det kan fx være vinterbadning og andre nye vandaktiviteter. Du skal kunne spotte muligheder og tendenser og omsætte dem til aktiviteter og samarbejder med idrætsforeninger, frivillige og andre relevante aktører. 

Med udgangspunkt i din faglige viden og erfaring skal du samarbejde med foreninger, sikre udvikling af aktiviteter samt udbyde kurser/uddannelse for trænere og ledere. Du understøtter foreningerne i deres dagligdag og er deres sparringspartner.  

Udover et tæt makkerskab med den administrative koordinator vil du indgå i teams med kolleger, som dækker andre idrætter og projekter på tværs af huset. Generelt søger vi at skabe et godt arbejdsfællesskab med masser af mulighed for sparring og samarbejde. 

Ansvarsområder:  

  • Være svømmeforeningers foretrukne go-to person og samarbejdspartnere og sikre jævnlig kontakt.  
  • Etablere stærke relationer og netværk til foreningslivet i Nordsjælland.  
  • Sikre løbende opfølgning på svømmeklubbernes behov og formidle relevante tilbud til klubberne.
  • Drive resultatorienterede og involverende udviklingsprocesser med svømmeklubberne i centrum.  
  • Planlægge aktiviteter og indsatser med afsæt i DGI's formål, mål og værdier. 
  • Opsøge nye tendenser og muligheder inden for fx vinterbadning, saunagus og andre vandaktiviteter og omsætte dem til relevante initiativer i samarbejde med foreninger og andre aktører. 
  • Skabe og understøtte nye samarbejder mellem foreninger og andre lokale aktører om fælles dagsordener og udvikling i lokalsamfundet. 
  • Bidrage proaktivt til koordination, samarbejde og udvikling i afdelingen og på tværs af huset. 
  • Være ansvarlig for budget og regnskabsopfølgning.

Vi har følgende ønskeliste til din profil: 

  • Stor idrætsfaglig viden. Det er en fordel hvis du har særlig indsigt i svømning/aktiviteter i vand.  
  • Er nysgerrig, initiativrig og har blik for nye tendenser og muligheder inden for idræt, bevægelse og fællesskaber. 
  • Kendskab til foreningslivet og DGI gennem frivilligt virke og/eller ansættelse i en forening.  
  • Kompetencer indenfor udvikling, problemløsning, procesfacilitering og behovsanalyse.  
  • Stærke relations-, samarbejds- og kommunikationsevner.  
  • Evner at arbejde selvstændigt og i teams.  
  • Evner at arbejde i løbende forandringer.  
  • Trives godt med målorienteret og struktureret arbejde.  

 Er du den erfarne konsulent der kan skabe resultater så læs mere om DGI Svømning. 

Vi tilbyder dig: 

  • En mulighed for at arbejde med svømning, vinterbadning og øvrige vandaktiviteter i DGI Nordsjælland. 
  • Et skrivebord i et kollegialt og fagligt kontormiljø med frokost som en del af arbejdstiden. 
  • Mulighed for hjemmearbejde når opgaven eller privatlivet kræver det.  
  • En alsidig hverdag der både består af kontorarbejde og fyraftensmøder hos foreningerne.   
  • Fuld flextid og 1-1 afspadsering – arbejder du lang tid den ene dag, skal du have noget mere frihed en anden dag.  
  • Maksimal frihed under ansvar og stor mulighed for indflydelse på dine arbejdsopgaver.  
  • Gode muligheder for at vokse i jobbet via efteruddannelse og kompetent sparring.  

Praktiske forhold:  Stillingen er på 37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse 1. februar 2027. Der skal forventes aften- og weekendarbejde i stillingen.  Vi forventer 1. runde samtaler mandag den 14. december 2026 samt evt. 2. runde samtale den 17. december 2026.

jobs.title: Lähihoitajia lapsiperhepalveluihin/ SAATAVUUSLISÄ
jobs.description: **Työn kuvaus**ANNU sosiaalipalvelut hakee nyt joukkoonsa lähihoitajaa luomaan kanssamme parempaa huomista ihanille asiakkaillemme.Lähihoitajan työ ANNU sosiaalipalveluilla on monipuolista ja palkitsevaa. Sinun on mahdollista työskennellä lapsiperheiden kotipalvelussa tai omaishoidon tuen palvelussa asiakasperheidemme parissa.Tiimimme kaipaa iloista ja sosiaalista työhönsä heittäytyjää, joille lasten ja lapsiperheiden hyvinvointi on sydämen asia. Meillä työssä menestyy ihminen, joka kykenee työskentelemään asiakastyössä omatoimisesti ja ammattitaitoisesti. Etsimme lähihoitajaa, jolla on kokemusta lasten parissa työskentelystä. Kerro rohkeasti osaamisesi. Kaikki ammatilliset erikoisosaamiset katsomme eduksi työhön.Työpäiväsi lähihoitajana sisältää esimerkiksi hoidettavan lapsen perustarpeista huolehtimista; hygieniasta ja ruokailuista huolehtimisesta, leikkimistä, ulkoilua tai harrastuksissa tukemista. Saatat hoitaa myös erityistä tukea tarvitsevia lapsia, sekä auttaa perhettä esimerkiksi kodinhoidossa yhdessä vanhemman kanssa. Työ toteutuu pääasiassa arkisin klo 7-19 välillä, sovittaessa ilta- tai viikonloppuvuorot voivat myös olla mahdollisia. Pitkien asiakasvälimatkojen vuoksi katsomme oman auton käytön eduksi työhön, maksamme asiakkaiden välisiltä matkoilta kilometrikorvauksen. Myös ruotsin kielen taito huomioidaan suureksi eduksi työhön.Tarjoamme joustavan, merkityksellisen palkkatyön:- Työ sopii opiskeluiden tai toisen työn ohessa tehtäväksi. - ANNU sosiaalipalveluilla sinulla on työntekoasi tukeva esihenkilö. - Maksamme palkan valintasi mukaan joko kerran tai kahdesti kuukaudessa. - Tarjoamme kattavan perehdytyksen ennen työtehtävien alkamista, perehdytys on palkallinen ja se maksetaan ensimmäisen palkanmaksun yhteydessä. - Noudatamme yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimusta ja maksamme työstä työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan (palkkaluokka G20C). - Olemme ottaneet käyttöömme rekrytointilisän - kokemuksestasi riippuen alueen saatavuuslisä on 3,18- 1,97 euroa peruspalkan päälle Itä-Uudenmaan asiakkuuksiin. ANNU sosiaalipalvelut on ystävänpäivänä 2023 perustettu, sote-alan ammattilaisten luotsaama yritys. Tarjoamme palveluita lapsiperheille, nuorille ja aikuisille ympäri Suomen!Tervetuloa mukaamme luomaan Suomen parasta sosiaalialan työpaikkaa!**Työssä vaadittavat rikosrekisteriotteet**- Lasten kanssa työskentelyyn vaaditaan rikosrekisteriote, joka perustuu lakiin lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä (504/2002).

jobs.description:

Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:Â

â¢ Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

â¢ Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and weâre committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.
Â 
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether itâs signing up new artists; ensuring we provide the right data to Spotify, YouTube, and other digital service providers; or helping artists use the latest AI tools and make thoughtful decisions with data-driven insights â technology plays an invaluable role in our success. The engineering team at Warner Music Group makes all of it a reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog!
Â 
WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
Â 
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds â an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

Your role:

Technology is one of the most important parts of Warner Music Groupâs business. Whether it is supporting artists and songwriters, delivering accurate royalty and performance data to global partners, or giving creative and business teams modern data and AI tools, engineering makes it possible.

As Director of Software Engineering you will lead an engineering organization responsible for building and running reliable, secure, and scalable software. You set technical direction and operating standards for your organization, develop leaders, and partner with Product, Design, Data, Security, and business stakeholders to turn strategy into shipped outcomes. You are accountable for results across multiple teams and for the long-term health of the systems and people in your charge.

Here youâll get to:

Strategy and delivery: Own the technical vision, roadmap, and delivery for a multi-team engineering organization, aligned to business priorities. Partner with Product and business leaders to shape priorities, make trade-offs between new features and foundational work, and communicate commitments clearly. Drive predictable, high-quality delivery; set and track engineering metrics (delivery, reliability, quality, cost) and act on them.

Technical leadership: Set architecture direction and engineering standards (design reviews, testing, CI/CD, observability, security, reuse), and ensure teams follow them. Ensure systems are operationally excellent: reliability, incident response, on-call health, and cost transparency (cloud, vendor, and AI/tooling spend). Evaluate and adopt modern tooling, including AI-assisted development and automation, with appropriate security and governance.

People and organization: Hire, develop, and retain engineering managers and senior engineers; build a diverse, inclusive, high-performing culture. Lead performance management, career growth, succession planning, and talent reviews through your managers. Design team structure, ownership boundaries, and staffing plans as the business evolves.

Cross-functional influence: Represent engineering to senior leadership and key business stakeholders; communicate status, risk, and investment needs in business terms. Partner with Security, Privacy, Legal, Data, and Infrastructure teams to meet compliance and governance requirements. Manage budget, headcount, and vendor/contractor relationships for your organization as applicable.Â 

About you:

10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering teams and 2+ years managing managers (adjust to your bar).

Track record of delivering complex, business-critical software systems at scale with multiple teams. You are pragmatic and you know how to get stuff done.

Strong technical judgment across system design, cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP), APIs, data platforms, and modern delivery practices.

Proven ability to hire, coach, and grow managers and engineers, and to handle performance issues with care and clarity.

Excellent communication and influencing skills with executives, product partners, and non-technical stakeholders.

Experience setting strategy and running an operating rhythm (planning, metrics, reviews) across teams.

Experience managing budget, vendors, and cost of cloud/AI usage.

Bachelorâs degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

Weâd love it if you also had:

Experience in media, music, or entertainment, or in rights, royalties, or data-heavy products.

Experience with data and ML platforms (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks) and applying AI/agentic tooling in engineering workflows.

Experience leading globally distributed teams.

Experience in matrixed enterprise environments partnering with multiple business units.

As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the worldâs premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.
Â 
Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.
Â 
Love this job and want to apply?
Â 
Click the âApplyâ link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.
Â 
Donât be discouraged if you donât hear from us right away. Weâre taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.
Â 
Thanks for your interest in working for WMG.Â  We love it here, and think you will, too.
Â 
WMG is committed to inclusion and diversity in all aspects of our business. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and will evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, marital status, medical condition as defined by state law (genetic characteristics or cancer), physical or mental disability, military service or veteran status, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law.
