jobs.title: Galena Pharma: Kunnossapitopäällikkö
jobs.description: **Työsopimuksen tyyppi:** vakituinen, kokoaikainen**Sijainti:** Sammonkatu 10, 70500 Kuopio**Hakuaika päättyy:** 10.12.2026Haluatko vastata kunnossapidon sujuvuudesta kasvuyhtiössä, jossa työlläsi on suora vaikutus tuotannon toimintavarmuuteen ja liiketoiminnan kasvuun?Suomalainen lääketehdas Galena Pharma Oy on merkittävässä kasvussa ja etsii nyt teknisesti vahvaa ja kehittämishaluista **kunnossapitopäällikköä** osaksi Kuopion tuotanto-organisaatiotaan! Galena Pharmalla on omia MDR-hyväksyttyjä lääkinnällisiä laitteita, minkä lisäksi yritys on erikoistunut muun muassa sopimusvalmistukseen ja pakkauspalveluihin.**Mitä työ pitää sisällään?**Tehtävässä vastaat Galena Pharman kahden Kuopiossa sijaitsevan tuotantolaitoksen kunnossapidosta. Huolehdit laitteiden toimintavarmuudesta sekä pääset kehittämään toimintatapoja ja suunnittelemaan tulevia investointeja kasvavan tuotannon tarpeisiin.Työtehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa:- Tuotantolaitteiden ja kiinteistötekniikan kunnossapidon johtaminen sekä käytännön huolto- ja vianratkaisutehtävät - Ennakkohuoltojen, kunnossapidon mittaroinnin ja dokumentoinnin kehittäminen - Kunnossapidon asiantuntijan esihenkilötyö sekä yhteistyön koordinointi ulkoisten huoltokumppanien ja laitetoimittajien kanssa - Kunnossapidon budjetointi, kustannusten seuranta ja investointitarpeiden suunnittelu - Tuotantolaitteiden, -linjastojen ja tilojen muutostöihin sekä uusien laitteiden käyttöönottoihin osallistuminen Pääset työskentelemään lähellä tuotannon arkea, noin puolet työajastasi kuluu käytännön huoltotehtävissä ja tukenasi on kokenut kunnossapidon asiantuntija. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä erityisesti tuotannon, laadunvarmistuksen ja tuotekehityksen kanssa huolehtien siitä, että kunnossapito vastaa laatuohjatun tuotantoympäristön vaatimuksia.**Millaista osaajaa etsimme?**Etsimme kokenutta ja teknisesti vahvaa kunnossapidon ammattilaista, jolla on kokemusta teollisuuden tuotantolaitteista ja tiimin vetämisestä. Viihdyt tehtävässä, jossa yhdistyvät käytännön tekeminen, suunnittelu ja yhteistyö eri sidosryhmien kanssa.Osaat hahmottaa kokonaisuuksia, priorisoida kiireellisiä tilanteita ja tehdä perusteltuja päätöksiä myös kustannukset huomioiden. Työotteeltasi olet oma-aloitteinen ja järjestelmällinen, ja viet asioita aktiivisesti eteenpäin. Arvostamme hyviä yhteistyötaitoja, uteliaisuutta ja halua löytää entistä toimivampia ratkaisuja.**Hakijalta odotetaan:**- Soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta ja vahvaa kokemusta teollisuuden tuotantolaitteiden kunnossapidosta - Kokemusta valmistus- ja pakkauslaitteista sekä käytännön osaamista mekaanisten, sähkö- ja paineilmatoimisten sekä logiikkaohjattujen laitteiden huollosta ja vianratkaisusta - Kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä tai tiiminvetovastuusta sekä halua johtaa ja kehittää kunnossapidon toimintaa - Kokemusta ennakkohuoltojen, huoltokumppanien ja kustannusten hallinnasta sekä investointien suunnittelusta - Hyviä yhteistyö- ja organisointitaitoja sekä hyvää suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa **Lisäksi eduksi katsotaan:**- Kokemus lääke- tai lääkinnällisten laitteiden teollisuudesta sekä GMP-vaatimusten ja auditointien tuntemus - Automaatio-, sähkö- tai instrumentointiosaaminen sekä teknisen piirtämisen, esimerkiksi AutoCADin, tuntemus - Kokemus tekoälyn hyödyntämisestä esimerkiksi teknisessä suunnittelussa, varaosien selvittämisessä ja kunnossapidon kehittämisessä **Tarjoamme sinulle:**- Mahdollisuuden kehittää kunnossapitoa kasvavassa yrityksessä ja vaikuttaa siihen, miten tuotannon toimintavarmuutta parannetaan - Tiiviin yhteistyön laajan asiantuntijaverkoston kanssa tuotannosta tuotekehitykseen ja kansainvälisiin toimittajiin - Modernit tekoälytyökalut, joiden avulla voit tehostaa suunnittelua ja löytää uusia ratkaisuja teknisiin haasteisiin - Matalan hierarkian työyhteisön, jossa ideat viedään nopeasti käytäntöön ja oma kädenjälkesi näkyy aidosti - Kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten, kuten liikunta- ja kulttuurietu, laajan työterveyshuollon sekä mahdollisuuden hyödyntää kuukausittaisia CaPS:n henkilöstöetuja; lisäksi käytössä on tulokseen perustuva ryhmäeläkevakuutus **Käytännön asiat:**Tässä vakituisessa ja kokoaikaisessa tehtävässä työllistyt suoraan Galena Pharman palvelukseen. Tehtävä sijoittuu Kuopioon ja tehtävä edellyttää paikan päällä työskentelyä. Yksittäiset etätyöpäivät onnistuvat tarpeen mukaan työtehtävistä riippuen. Tehtävä edellyttää myös ajoittaista matkustusvalmiutta.Toivottu aloitusajankohta on mahdollisimman pian, mutta tarkempi aikataulu sovitaan joustavasti valittavan henkilön kanssa. jobs.title: Partner Solution Architect, Partner Center of Excellence
jobs.description:
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloftâs certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that âEX = CXâ: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview

Â 

Agiloft's customers rely on our Ecosystem of System Integration (SI) partners to help them design, build and deliver solutions on the Agiloft platform. This role is designed to help our partners build robust capabilities within their organization and ultimately ensure our customers are realizing maximum value from the platform.

As Partner Solution Architect, you'll support the partners as a technical advisor for partner-led implementations from kickoff through go-live. You'll guide SIs on architecture, integrations, data sync, and configuration. When something breaks, you'll figure out whether it's a configuration issue, an integration issue, or a real product defect, and get it to the right owner.

You'll sit in the Partner Center of Excellence, the team responsible for making partner delivery repeatable and high quality. Our Partner Alliance Managers own the overall relationship with each partner and this role will be responsible for the successful technical outcome and capability development. You'll work daily with Sales, Professional Services, Product, Engineering, and Support, and you'll turn what you learn on each project into playbooks the whole ecosystem can use.

Â 

Job Responsibilities

What you'll do

Guide Partners to Go-live

Serve as the product & technical point of contact for SI partners and their customers during the implementation project and through go-live. Advise on solution architecture, integration design, data synchronization, and configuration best practices across Agiloft's platform: core CLM, procurement and source-to-pay workflows, ERP sync (such as SAP S/4HANA), APIs and MCP-based orchestration, and AI and analytics capabilities. Help partners separate out-of-the-box capability from custom implementation work so each fix lands with the right owner.

Own the Technical Escalation Path

Act as the Tier 3 technical resource for partner-led projects. Triage and reproduce issues, document them clearly, and log true defects and enhancement requests to Product and Engineering in Jira. Join partner and customer working sessions when a blocker needs Agiloft in the room. Hand accounts off cleanly to Support at transition, with documented configuration and open items.

Enable the Ecosystem

Build and deliver partner training, webinars, and learning content with Product and go-to-market teams. Work with Product and Engineering to stand up and maintain partner sandboxes, test environments, and knowledge base access. Support the change management and promote the value of monthly releases into the partner ecosystem.

Build the Playbook

Create and maintain implementation playbooks, a known-issue library, escalation runbooks, and environment setup guides. Feed patterns from real projects back into enablement, documentation, and the product roadmap.

What Success Looks Like in Year One

Partner-led go-lives land on schedule, with fewer slipping because of unresolved technical blockers. Technical escalations from partners reach a clear owner quickly, with reproducible detail, and resolve faster. Product and Engineering receive structured, prioritized signal from partner projects instead of ad hoc pulls. Product and Engineering receive a steady, well-documented stream of implementation feedback that shapes the roadmap. A working go-live toolkit exists and partners actually use it: playbooks, known-issue library, runbooks, reference architectures, and environment guides. Support inherits cleaner, better-documented accounts at handoff. Target metrics: e.g. on-time go-live rate, median time to resolve partner escalations, escalations per quarter, training events delivered. Other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

What you'll bring

5+ years in a technical, customer- or partner-facing implementation role: solution architecture, professional services, implementation or integration consulting, or sales engineering with post-sale delivery. Agiloft certification, or relevant platform certifications (Salesforce, SAP, cloud). Hands-on experience designing and troubleshooting enterprise integrations including REST APIs, webhooks, authentication patterns (OAuth, JWT), and data sync between systems of record. Working knowledge of the systems CLM connects to, such as Salesforce, ERP (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite), and Procurement relevant ISVs Strong troubleshooting instincts. You can isolate whether an issue is configuration, integration, or product defect, and explain it precisely to engineers and executives alike. Solution design skills: you can translate business requirements into a technical design and explain the trade-offs to both technical and business stakeholders. Experience guiding external partners or customers while working across Product, Engineering, and Support. Exposure to AI-enabled workflows, LLM tooling, or MCP-based integrations. A builder's habit of turning one-off fixes into reusable documentation and process.

Preferred Qualifications

Nice to have

Integration middleware experience: Workato, MuleSoft, or Boomi. Background in CLM, procurement or source-to-pay, CPQ, or related enterprise workflow platforms; hands-on experience implementing a CLM platform is a strong plus. Prior work at or alongside SI and consulting partners. Exposure to ISV/managed-package delivery, versioning, and enterprise deployment considerations. Prior experience working directly with or inside SI or consulting partners.
Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace is our priority. We are committed to an environment of acceptance where you are free to bring your full self to work. All employment decisions at Agiloft are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national or social ethnic origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, parental status, marital status, Veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. If you have a need that requires accommodation during the recruiting process, please let us know by contacting Director, Talent Acquisition, Brad Toothman at brad.toothman@agiloft.com.
Â 
Applicants from underrepresented groups such as minorities, veterans, or individuals with disabilities encouraged to apply.

Applications will be reviewed as submitted. There will be no application deadline for this opportunity.

adunaglobal.com

Youâll grow and engage developer audiences across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud and independent communities including GitHub, Stack Overflow, YouTube and Discord, using technical content, events, demos and hands-on engagement to take developers from curiosity to their first successful API call.

What You'll Do

  • Grow an engaged developer audience for network APIs across your own and Aduna's channels: technical videos, livestreams, blog posts, social media and newsletters.

Why Join Aduna?

jobs.title: HR-Stagiair(e)
jobs.description:
Als HR‑Stagiair(e) draai je bij ons mee in het HR‑team en krijg je de kans om veel te leren, met een duidelijke focus op Learning & Development. Je werkt mee aan verschillende HR- en L&D‑activiteiten en krijgt daarnaast de ruimte om je stage zelf vorm te geven en te ontdekken welke andere HR‑onderwerpen jou aanspreken. Zo doe je brede praktijkervaring op in een omgeving waar veel gebeurt en waar je actief kunt bijdragen.


Jouw stage:

Je werkt mee in ons team van 10 HR‑professionals met expertise in o.a. onboarding, L&D, verzuim, recruitment, employer branding en HR‑advies. Je krijgt veel vrijheid én goede begeleiding om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Waar draag je aan bij?

  • Het versterken van vaardigheden en ontwikkeling binnen de organisatie door mee te werken aan L&D‑projecten.

  • Het soepel laten verlopen van soft skills trainingen, door ondersteuning bij voorbereiding, communicatie en coördinatie.

  • De verbetering van HR‑processen door het initiëren en uitvoeren van eigen HR‑projecten (bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van onboarding, recruitment of procesoptimalisatie).

  • Events rondom arbeidsmarktcommunicatie, workshops rond duurzame inzetbaarheid en onboardingsactiviteiten.

  • Een correcte en overzichtelijke HR‑administratie, zoals het opstellen van contracten, brieven en personele mutaties.

  • Continue verbetering binnen HR door actieve deelname aan HR‑overleggen en het meedenken over verbeteringen.

Onze organisatie beweegt snel: er gebeurt veel en geen week is hetzelfde. Dat biedt enorm veel leerkansen, maar vraagt ook dat jij zelf richting geeft aan je stage en je weg vindt in een dynamische omgeving. Je krijgt van ons goede begeleiding, maar het is aan jou om kansen te zien en initiatief te tonen.

Wat breng je mee?

We zoeken een stagiair(e) die:

Over Benchmark

Benchmark in Almelo maakt onderdeel uit van de multinational Benchmark Electronics Inc., een beursgenoteerde onderneming op het gebied van het vervaardigen van elektronica en het leveren van diensten richting original equipment manufacturers (OEM’s).

Wereldwijd heeft Benchmark Electronics Inc. momenteel 23 vestigingen. Op onze vestiging in Almelo werken we samen met zo’n 675 collega’s.

jobs.title: Android Engineer
jobs.description:
Who are we?

We're a smart hydration company rebuilding an industry that still runs on sugar water and single-use packaging.
Filtered water, functional flavors, zero bottles. Still, sparkling, cold, and hot. All poured from one tap. We create hydration people want to reach for, starting with the workplace where we help teams thrive.

As an AI-native company, we build at speed. In 2025, Aquablu ranked 2nd in the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 (Netherlands) and 30th in the Sifted 250 (Europe), both rankings of the fastest-growing companies by revenue growth. In 2026 we were named a winner of Maya's Culture 100 Europe Awards as one of the best workplaces to thrive in.

Growing that fast and thriving comes down to our people. Our team is our biggest asset and one that we’re proud of. We’re committed to maintaining our vibrant culture as we continue to grow.

About the role

Aquablu's products run Android in more places than your pocket. Our dispensing systems ship with Android-powered on-device software that hundreds of thousands of people touch every day, and our mobile apps put hydration in users' hands. As our Android Engineer, you work across that whole surface.

Your main arena is on-device: the software running on the hardware itself, where Android meets the physical world. Screens people tap on a machine, software that talks to firmware, updates that roll out to hundreds of deployed systems in the field. Alongside that, you contribute to our mobile development where the products need it. Few Android roles give you this range.

This is a hands-on engineering role in a small, fast team. You own features end to end and deliver them reliably, reaching out to your manager when support is needed to unblock you. You build with AI agents as your default collaborator, you work cross-functionally with hardware, firmware, and product, proactively identifying and reaching out to key players that can help filling any gaps.

This role reports into our Head of Digital Product, and is part of Aquablu’s Software & Intelligence Engineering team.


What You'll Build & Own

  • On-device Android software: Features on the user-facing software running on our dispensing systems — UI, device behaviour, and the integration layer where software meets hardware. You own your features end to end.

  • Fleet-ready releases: Contribute to releases that update reliably across hundreds of deployed devices in the field, where a broken release means a technician visit. The riskiest releases get a second pair of senior eyes — and you learn what makes them safe.

  • Hardware & firmware integration: Work with embedded and firmware engineers to define and implement serial APIs (UART), that expose device state and trigger mechanical actions.

  • Mobile contribution: Support Android development on our consumer app where the roadmap needs it.

  • AI-native development: Build with AI agents every day and keep pushing what that lets you ship.

What You Bring

  • Solid Android engineering experience: A minimum of 3-5 years building and shipping Android apps in Kotlin, with a solid grasp of the platform (lifecycle, concurrency). You should be able to judge which Android patterns fit a non-standard system, and to design features that contribute to a scalable, reliable system.

  • Curiosity for Android beyond the traditional mobile world: kiosk, embedded, or AOSP work is a strong plus. Pragmatic problem solver who’s comfortable working outside of familiar mobile patterns.

  • Work independently on well-scoped tasks. When scope is unclear, flag it, reach out to the right people, and get the answers and support you need to unblock yourself. Plan the work, communicate progress early, and deliver end to end.

  • AI-native coding is how you work. You build with AI agents daily, you have a sharp setup, and your output shows it. If your last six months of work doesn't look meaningfully different because of AI, this isn't your role.

✨ Why join us?

  • 💰 A salary between 66-89k yearly (incl. 8% holiday allowance)

  • 📈 Equity through our Aquablu for All plan: it's not just about shares, it's about shared success.

  • 🏋️ Urban Sports Club Membership

  • 🌱 Healthy (heavily discounted) lunches

  • 🎯 Purpose with Impact: shape how the world hydrates while wiping out single-use plastics.

  • 📋 Scale-up pace means fresh challenges (and new skills) every quarter.

  • 🤝 Join an ambitious, bold, and fun crew that's always got your back.

  • 🌱 Company-sponsored gym membership keeps mind and body in sync.

  • 💰 Pension plan with Zwitserleven (50/50 split) so you grow while your savings do, too.

  • 🎵 What kind of vibe can you expect at our office? Check out our very own Spotify playlist "Akwablues"

  • 🎬 Curious about our story & culture? Check our documentaries on Youtube!

jobs.title: Bliv vores nye serviceleder – sammen skaber vi tryghed og kvalitet
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at være den leder, der både har blik for mennesker, kvalitet og den gode kundeoplevelse?

Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Som serviceleder hos Coor får du en vigtig rolle i hverdagen på vores forskellige lokationer i København. Du bliver den, der får tingene til at hænge sammen, og som samtidig er tæt på både medarbejdere og kunder.

Det er et job med ansvar, variation og masser af menneskelig kontakt. Vi tror nemlig på, at god service starter med, at vores medarbejdere trives og føler sig set.

Din hverdag hos os

Som serviceleder får du ansvar for ca. 40 medarbejdere, og du bliver en vigtig sparringspartner for dem i deres hverdag.

Du kommer blandt andet til at:

  • følge op på, at arbejdet udføres i den aftalte kvalitet og efter arbejdsplanerne

  • sikre, at den planlagte arbejdstid overholdes

  • træne og udvikle dine medarbejdere

  • sørge for den daglige arbejdsfordeling ved sygdom og andet fravær

  • være med til at rekruttere, ansætte og afskedige servicemedarbejdere

  • stå for ferieplanlægning, time- og lønregistrering samt andre administrative opgaver

  • have løbende dialog med vores kunder og være med til at skabe stærke og tillidsfulde relationer

Du får en hverdag, hvor ikke to dage nødvendigvis er ens. Derfor skal du trives med at tage ansvar, finde løsninger og bevare overblikket, også når planer pludselig ændrer sig.

Et job med kørsel og frihed.

Arbejdssted: KøbenhavnArbejdstid: Fuldtid

Du bliver en del af et stærkt fællesskab

Hos os kommer du ikke til at stå alene.

Du bliver en del af en afdeling med dygtige og fagligt stærke kolleger, hvor vi har en uformel tone og lægger vægt på, at vi hjælper hinanden.

Som leder bliver du tæt på dine medarbejdere, og vi forventer, at du er en leder, der ser mennesket bag medarbejderen.

For os handler god ledelse ikke kun om planer, kvalitet og drift. Det handler også om at være tilgængelig, lytte, følge op og skabe en hverdag, hvor medarbejderne ved, hvad der forventes af dem - og hvor de føler sig værdsat.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du har erfaring med ledelse og gerne fra rengøringsbranchen. Du behøver ikke kunne alt fra første dag – det vigtigste er, at du har lysten, engagementet og evnen til at få mennesker med dig.

Vi lægger blandt andet vægt på, at du:

  • har erfaring inden for rengøringsfaget

  • har ledelseserfaring eller lyst og mod på at tage næste skridt som leder

  • er god til mennesker og naturligt skaber tillid og relationer

  • har et højt servicegen og sætter en ære i at levere kvalitet

  • kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • kan bevare overblikket, når hverdagen bliver travl

  • har gode IT-kompetencer og kan sætte dig ind i nye systemer

  • har erfaring med MS Office

  • er omstillingsparat og trives i en driftsorienteret hverdag

  • har kørekort til kategori B

Det er en forudsætning for ansættelse, at du kan opnå den nødvendige sikkerhedsgodkendelse. Som en del af rekrutteringsprocessen skal du derfor være indstillet på at gennemgå den relevante sikkerhedsprocedure. Derudover skal vi kunne indhente din straffeattest og, hvor det er relevant, børneattest.

jobs.title: Kantineassistent til vores hovedkontor - skab gode frokostoplevelser på 37 timer om ugen
jobs.description:
Kokkenes Køkken · Vores hovedkontor · Kantineassistent · 37 timer om ugen

En god frokost giver kollegerne et velsmagende måltid og et pusterum i arbejdsdagen. Vi søger en kantineassistent til vores hovedkontor, der har lyst til at bidrage til både maden, servicen og de praktiske opgaver, som får kantinen til at fungere.

Din hverdag

Du får en hverdag med forskellige opgaver omkring klargøring, frokostservering og oprydning. Du bidrager til, at kantinen er indbydende, og at vores kolleger bliver mødt med venlighed og god service.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Klargøring og tilberedning. Du hjælper med at skylle og snitte grøntsager, klargøre råvarer og tilberede enkle retter efter køkkenets anvisninger.

  • Anretning og opfyldning. Du hjælper med at gøre frokosten klar, anrette maden og fylde op under serveringen, så den fremstår frisk og indbydende.

  • Service i kantinen. Du møder vores kolleger venligt og hjælper med praktiske spørgsmål omkring dagens frokost.

  • Opvask og oprydning. Du vasker service og køkkenudstyr op og sørger for, at det kommer på plads og er klar til brug.

  • Rengøring og hygiejne. Du rengør de aftalte arbejdsområder og følger køkkenets anvisninger for fødevarehygiejne og håndtering af råvarer.

I en kantine skal flere opgaver være færdige på samme tid. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du kan holde overblik, samarbejde og tilpasse dig dagens opgaver uden at gå på kompromis med kvalitet og hygiejne.

Det får du hos os

  • En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.

  • En arbejdsplads på vores hovedkontor, hvor du bidrager direkte til kollegernes hverdag.

  • En rolle med både praktiske køkkenopgaver og kontakt med kantinens gæster.

Det kommer du med

  • Du arbejder omhyggeligt og har forståelse for god køkkenhygiejne.

  • Du tager ansvar for dine opgaver og samarbejder om at få dagens arbejde til at lykkes.

  • Du møder stabilt og møder kolleger og gæster med venlighed og respekt.

Erfaring fra kantine, køkken eller lignende servicearbejde er en fordel. Du har lyst til at arbejde med mad og mennesker og giver en hånd med, hvor der er brug for det.

Løn og vilkår

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen. Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger Kantineoverenskomsten.

Om os

Kokkenes Køkken er en del af Forenede Service. Vi driver kantiner med fokus på smag, madhåndværk og gæsternes måltidsoplevelse.

Vores værdier udgør fundamentet for vores kultur og er: Ansvar - Engagement - Omtanke

Det betyder, at vi tager ansvar for at levere velsmagende mad, god service og ordentlig hygiejne, så vores gæster får en god måltidsoplevelse. Vi viser engagement ved at have et professionelt udtryk, fremstå ordentligt og præsentabelt og bruge de metoder, vi bliver oplært i. Vi bruger omtanke ved at vise hensyn og respekt for vores gæster og kolleger og ved at passe på de råvarer, det udstyr og de omgivelser, vi arbejder med hver dag.

Sådan søger du

Du søger ved at klikke på knappen Ansøg og uploade dit CV og din ansøgning.

Vi holder løbende samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Kotihoidon yrittäjäksi Alinaan
jobs.description: Miltä kuulostaisi päästä rakentamaan omaa hoitoalan huipputiimiä ja menestyvää yritystä? Haluaisitko kehittää kotihoidon palveluita arvojesi mukaiseen suuntaan? Kiehtooko yrittäjyys, mutta et halua hypätä yksin tyhjän päälle? Siinä tapauksessa Alina-yrittäjyys voisi olla juuri sinua varten!**Miten Alina-yrittäjyys toimii?****Alina on Suomen ensimmäinen hoiva-alan franchising-ketju, jonka asiakkaita ovat muun muassa ikäihmiset ja lapsiperheet. Alina-yrittäjänä tarjoat koteihin korkealaatuisia palveluita, joiden avulla asiakkaat saavat elää hyvää ja turvallista elämää omassa kodissaan. Yrittäjänä saat todella auttaa asiakkaita omaan tyyliisi, sydän edellä. Tällä hetkellä etsimme useampia Alina-yrittäjiä eri puolille Suomea.****Miksi Alina-yrittäjäksi ryhtyminen kannattaa?**Kotihoidon palveluiden kysyntä on kasvussa. Saat kehittää yritystäsi arvojesi mukaisesti tunnetussa hoiva-alan ketjussa, joka mahdollistaa asiakkaille arvokkaan elämän omassa kodissa.- Saat käyttöösi vahvan brändimme sekä valmiit, laatusertifioidut palvelutuotteemme. - Tarjoamme lisäksi modernit työkalut ja järjestelmät toimintasi kehittämisen ja kasvattamisen tueksi. - Pääset vaikuttamaan omien työpäiviesi sisältöön ja tulotasoosi. - Ketju ja ammattitaitoiset kenttäpäällikkömme tukevat ja kouluttavat sinua liiketoimintasi eri vaiheissa. **Sovinko Alina-yrittäjäksi?**Sinun ei tarvitse olla kokenut yrittäjä meillä menestyäksesi – riittää, että sinulta löytyy- Sairaanhoitajan, sosionomin, terveydenhoitajan tai lähihoitajan tutkinto. - Aitoa innostusta kehittyä hoiva-alan yrittäjänä ja tiimisi sekä liiketoimintasi johtajana. - Taloudelliset valmiudet ryhtyä yrittäjäksi. - Innostusta tehdä merkityksellistä työtä ihmisten hyvinvoinnin parissa. **Kiinnostuin hakemaan! Miten homma etenee?**Hienoa! Jätä hakemuksesi, jonka jälkeen olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovimme jatkohaastattelun.Voit myös lukea lisää yrittäjyydestä **verkkosivuiltamme**.Jos jokin jäi askarruttamaan mieltäsi, rekrytointivastaava Annamari Tuominen vastaa kysymyksiisi mielellään: 044 755 6901, **annamari.tuominen@norlandia.com.****Tietoa Alina-ketjusta**- Ensimmäinen Alina yritys perustettiin jo vuonna 1993 - Alina-yrittäjät toimivat yli 50 paikkakunnalla Suomessa - Vuoden 2025 Alina-yrittäjä Sari Körkkö valittiin Euroopan parhaaksi franchising-yrittäjäksi 2025 - Vuoden Franchisingketju vuonna 2025, 2023 ja 2019 - Alina yritysten henkilöstötyytyväisyys 4.2/5 - Alina yritysten asiakastyytyväisyys 83 % - Alina oli ehdolla vuoden 2025 eurooppalaiseksi franchisingketjuksi European Franchise Awardissa Alina on osa Norlandiaa, joka tarjoaa innovatiivisia ja monipuolisia hyvinvointi- ja terveyspalveluita kaikille vauvasta vaariin sekä nelijalkaisille ystävillemme. Suomessa Norlandian toimintoihin kuuluvat hoivakodit YHDESSÄ palvelukortteleissa, Tampereella sijaitseva potilashotelli, Norlandia Päiväkodit ja Aberia.

Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work.

We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference.

Job Highlights:

  • Role: Paid Media Manager

Today, we're looking for a Paid Media Manager to join our growing team. Our new Paid Media Manager will serve as a subject matter expert in all things related to Paid Media. You will play both the lead role & support on a portfolio of Paid Media client strategies, build & maintain great client relationships, manage timelines and deliverables, and directly grow clientsâ marketing performance through your work.

Â 

The Paid Media Manager will independently lead account strategy for a select few of their own clients, while also working closely with Senior Paid Media Managers and Associate Directors to support on account strategy & tactical execution for larger clients as needed. This role is ideal for a Paid Media pro with 3+ years of experience who is driven and hungry to bring their media strategy & client ownership chops to the next level. Youâll work on a team of top-notch digital marketing SMEs, and will collaborate with counterparts on SEO, Measurement, and Creative teams to successfully execute client delivery.

Â 

Hereâs what we expect from our Paid Media Manager.

âWhat You'll Doâ

Client Ownership: Responsible for the strategy development, innovation, and tactical execution + performance of small-but-impactful portfolio Paid Media client accounts. (3-5 clients)

Hitting Client Goals: Plan, implement and audit paid media campaigns & strategies that align with client KPIs, marketing, and business goals

Testing & Innovation: Support channel innovation efforts, ensuring clients' Paid Media strategies are following evolving best practices and using performance data to identify opportunities for new campaigns, optimizations, and testing

Reporting: Regularly create, analyze, and present insightful and actionable Paid Media performance reports directly to clients

Project Management: Accurately communicate project timelines to clients; manage client expectations and proactively update clients as things change

Creative Strategy: Collaborate with Silverback's Creative Director and Design team on ad creation and testing plans; assist with creative strategy and briefs as needed

Know Your Client's Business: Understand your clientsâ industries, audience, and goals while staying on top of industry changes, trends, and best practices

Teamwork & Collaboration: Join in creative brainstorming sessions with other members of the Paid Media team to promote a culture of collaboration and innovation

Professional Growth: Accept feedback and coaching from the Associate Director of Media to ensure our clients are receiving a best-in-class experience & top-notch performance.

âWhat Weâre Looking Forâ

  • Years of Experience: A minimum of 3+ years of paid media agency experience - ideal candidate has 3-5 YOE. Previous performance agency experience is a MUST-HAVE!

  • Paid Search and Social Expertise: Must-have experience managing both Paid Search and Social campaigns. (Main platforms are Google & Meta; secondary platforms are LinkedIn and TikTok)

  • Client-Facing Comfortability: This role is not a good fit for someone who doesnât want to talk directly to clients. You must be comfortable building rapport, establishing expertise / credibility, and serving as the face of the Paid Media engagement with your assigned clients.

  • Business Acumen: Being able to build & execute winning Paid Media strategies across multiple industries is crucial â but your ability to tie Media wins to a measurable impact on the clientsâ business, revenue, etc is what will make you a superstar.

  • Ownership of Work: In this role, you'll fully own the success of your 3-5 clients from strategy development, to tactical execution, to reporting & client-facing communication. You MUST have prior experience taking "full ownership" of client(s) in a similar vein in order to succeed at Silverback.

  • Curiosity & âGet Sh*t Doneâ Mentality: Youâd rather take a big swing and miss than sit around twiddling your thumbs. Youâre energized by & thrive in an environment where no two days are the same, and results are king. Youâre relentlessly curious, eager to learn, and willing to make mistakes in the name of progress & growth.

  • Data Analysis: You're a whiz in Excel and/or Google Sheets. Complex sets of data don't throw you, and you're comfortable analyzing & breaking down data using GA4 and other tools to produce clear, insightful, and meaningful reports for clients.

  • Adaptability & Growth: Feedback fuels you. You lean into change, sharpen your skills, and push yourself and your team to get better every day.

  • Project & Time Management: You run a clean calendar and keep priorities straight. Competing demands don't throw you.Â 

âWhy Silverback?â

Silverback isnât for everybody. If youâre an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If youâre a B player, you will be miserable.

Work with the A team: We are ruthless about putting the best possible team on the field.

Get paid: We hire the best and pay them generously.

Do cool sh*t: From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works.

âBenefits & Perksâ

Great work deserves great support. Thatâs why we offer a competitive total compensation package, with benefits built around how our people actually live and work.

Fully remote team

âWork Environmentâ

  • We're a fully remote agency with employees working across the U.S., and our culture is built for it. At Silverback, you'll be part of a remote work culture that emphasizes smooth, productive online communication so work moves forward and no one is left guessing.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Everfield: Senior Data Engineer

The Company

Everfield is a platform with a mission in acquiring, building, and operating vertical market and specialist software companies, focused on European businesses. We invest in and provide support and best practices to software companies in order for them to live up to their full potential by offering a very established approach to promote growth.

Everfield is looking to be the leader in European Vertical and specialist software solutions across myriad niche industries who provide mission-critical applications, service, and support to their clients.

Everfield seeks to deliver innovation and growth to its acquired companies by providing best practices and operational support to help identify opportunities and install proven methodologies to accelerate customer and market share. Everfield is located throughout Europe, with offices in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, France, Poland, Spain, and Latvia.

The Position

As a Senior Data Engineer at Everfield, you will leverage your expertise and experience to:

  • Continuously improve scalability and stability of our data platform called the Lakehouse

  • Create new data pipeline solutions on various data sources (ERP, CRMs, etc.)

  • Design and model data in a common data model and Kimball-style dimensional models, making it ready for consumption in Power BI and other tools

  • Further developing Lakehouse Lumen, our MCP server that makes Lakehouse data available to Claude for end users

  • Improve existing solutions to improve value add for various stakeholders

You’ll be working as part of the Business Intelligence (BI) team. Currently the team consists of a Lead Data Engineer, three Data Analysts and a hands-on team lead. The BI team creates value for various stakeholders (CEO, Finance, COO, Sales, Marketing, and Everfield’sportfolio companies), by creating insights, delivering analysis, automating reporting processes and improving data quality.

The team builds pipelines with Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics to ingest the data into our data platform, uses Azure Databricks for data transformation, Power BI for data visualization and Azure Container Apps to expose data via a MCP server to Claude. For most solutions, the team uses Python and SQL.

For many use cases we work in an agentic way, using Claude to plan and implement them. To support this, we built the "Lakehouse DevKit". A set of agents and skills that we plan to keep extending and improving.

This role is hybrid from Amsterdam area.

Responsibilities

Adhere to the DevOps methodology by:

  • Collaborate with the Lead Data Engineer and Team Lead to plan and prioritize tasks.

  • Develop data pipelines in Azure Databricks and Azure Synapse Analytics, along with data ingestion and process scripts using PySpark and Pandas, while managing version control through Git.

  • Improve and extend the MCP server that provides data to Claude.

  • Create unit tests, test your own work and review work of colleagues (via Pull Requests), to ensure quality control.

  • Extend the Lakehouse DevKit to support and accelerate agentic development workflows.

  • Enhance and maintain deployment pipelines to facilitate smooth releases to end users.

  • Monitor the data platform (including data pipelines, ingestion/processing jobs, and alerts), while continuously improving logging and monitoring practices.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Hard Skills

Required:

  • 3+ year of experience as Data Engineer, and 5+ years of professional experience within Data or related fields.

  • Expert in PySpark and Pandas for data processing.

  • Experience with Databricks for advanced analytics.

  • Strong knowledge of SQL and data modeling (especially star schema).

  • Familiarity with financial systems (ERP, NetSuite, SAP) and/or experience with CRM systems and customer data.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Claude Code (agents, skills)

  • Knowledge of Power Query and Power BI for data visualization.

  • Experience deploying Azure resources like Azure Container Apps.

Soft Skills

  • Independent Worker: Ability to operate autonomously while contributing effectively to team goals.

  • Business Acumen: Strong understanding of business and economic principles, with an ability to apply them in a data context.

  • Analytical Mindset: Excellent problem-solving and critical thinking skills.

  • Collaborative: Actively seeks alignment with team members and participates in planning sessions.

  • Quality-Focused: Committed to reviewing both your own work and that of others to maintain high standards.

  • Strategic Planner: Consider alternative solutions and refine features before implementation.

  • Purpose-Driven: Demonstrates a deep understanding of tasks, ensuring they align with business objectives.

What’s in it for you?

  • Grow your career in a fast-paced and growing organization.

  • Enable growth by building a robust and scalable data platform.

  • Working with the latest Data Engineering & Data Modeling technologies.

  • Long term career opportunities.

  • Working from home for up to 4 days per week.

  • Flexible work environment with offices around Europe (Netherlands, UK, Spain, France, Poland, Germany).

Continue the Conversation

Interested? We would love to hear from you!

Apply now with your CV, and if you are selected, our Talent Manager will contact you to schedule the first call and start our hiring process.

jobs.title: Client Account Executive
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Client Account Executive based in the United States.

As a Client Account Executive, you will drive revenue growth and new customer acquisition by developing and executing strategic sales plans across an assigned territory. You will manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and opportunity qualification to negotiation and contract closure, focusing on large enterprise customers. Combining software, professional services, and support solutions, you will help organizations address complex data challenges and achieve measurable business outcomes. You will build trusted relationships with senior industry executives, customers, and strategic partners while identifying opportunities to expand existing accounts. Working closely with Marketing, Presales, and Consulting teams, you will develop a sustainable sales pipeline and deliver against ambitious revenue targets. This is a fully remote opportunity offering autonomy, professional growth, and the chance to contribute to a collaborative, innovation-driven environment.

Accountabilities:

Develop and execute a comprehensive territory sales strategy focused on acquiring new enterprise customers, expanding existing accounts, and consistently achieving revenue objectives. Manage complex, consultative sales cycles while positioning integrated software, services, and support solutions that address customers' business and data management needs.

Identify, prospect, develop, and close new business opportunities while maintaining strong customer satisfaction and building referenceable client relationships.

Sell integrated software, professional services, and support solutions to drive customer success and long-term value.

Manage assigned territories strategically by targeting key accounts and collaborating with selected partners to generate additional pipeline opportunities.

Lead complex, enterprise-wide sales cycles and effectively communicate the value proposition to senior decision-makers.

Collaborate with Marketing to develop territory strategies and target account plans, building a healthy rolling four-quarter pipeline.

Coordinate team-selling activities with Presales and Consulting Services to deliver comprehensive customer solutions.

Identify opportunities to acquire new customers and expand business within existing accounts in competitive markets.

Build and maintain relationships with senior industry executives, enterprise customers, strategic partners, and system integrators.

Develop in-depth knowledge of products, customer accounts, competitors, and industry trends, particularly across Data Migration, Master Data Management, Data Quality, and Data Governance.

Understand customer requirements, industry-specific challenges, business priorities, operational constraints, and evolving market conditions.

Leverage executive support and partner leadership engagement to advance sales strategies and resolve field-level challenges.

Manage sales activities against quarterly and annual targets, consistently working to achieve and exceed assigned quotas.

Maintain accurate pipeline records, forecast revenue, and track sales activities using Salesforce.

Participate in individual and team meetings, training sessions, and industry conferences.

Travel as required to support customer relationships and business development activities.

Requirements:

You are a highly motivated and results-oriented sales professional with a proven ability to acquire enterprise customers, manage complex sales cycles, and consistently exceed revenue targets. You combine strong commercial judgment with consultative selling expertise, excellent relationship-building skills, and the discipline needed to manage a strategic territory independently. You are also a collaborative team player who embraces continuous learning, accountability, innovation, and shared success.

Ideally 7+ years of proven direct and/or indirect sales experience, preferably selling software and professional services to large enterprise customers.

Experience with the Sandler sales methodology or comparable structured sales frameworks is preferred.

Demonstrated expertise in territory and pipeline management, including prospecting, opportunity development, deal orchestration, and closing complex sales cycles.

Strong background in value-based and solutions-oriented selling.

Established relationships with industry decision-makers, enterprise customers, strategic partners, SAP partners, and system integrators.

Proven track record of consistently exceeding sales objectives, with achievements such as President's Club or Sales Representative of the Year recognition preferred.

Highly driven, ambitious, and motivated by achieving challenging business objectives.

Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize activities, manage resources effectively, and qualify opportunities strategically.

Ability to learn quickly, understand complex solutions, and establish credibility with customers and stakeholders.

Strong attention to detail when negotiating commercial agreements, contracts, and terms.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, or a related discipline is an advantage.

Strong work ethic and a proactive, hands-on approach to responsibilities.

Collaborative mindset, entrepreneurial spirit, and commitment to team success.

Excellent written, verbal, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.

Alignment with core professional values:

Think Big: Demonstrate ambition, courage, and a forward-thinking mindset while pursuing innovation and creating meaningful customer impact.

Be Curious: Embrace continuous learning, explore new ideas, understand market developments, and challenge conventional approaches.

Take Action: Take ownership, demonstrate initiative, make informed decisions, and turn opportunities into measurable results.

Stronger Together: Build trust, respect diverse perspectives, collaborate openly, and contribute to an inclusive and supportive team environment.

Benefits:

Competitive annual base salary ranging from $125,000 to $175,000, depending on qualifications, experience, skills, and other relevant factors.

Eligibility for additional variable compensation, bonuses, and commissions.

Medical, dental, and vision insurance.

401(k) retirement plan.

Paid time off.

Fully remote working arrangement within the United States.

Supportive and autonomous working environment that emphasizes trust and individual ownership rather than micromanagement.

Access to learning resources and opportunities for continuous professional development.

Opportunities to contribute to a rapidly growing organization and help shape its future direction.

Collaborative team culture with strong peer support and shared accountability.

Recognition of individual and collective achievements.

Open organizational culture where employees are encouraged to share ideas, contribute perspectives, and have their work valued.

Inclusive workplace committed to equal opportunities, diversity, and professional development.

jobs.description: SD-26155- POST-DOC SOIL HEALTH AND REMEDIATIONFixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 MonthsAre you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defense technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute?As part of LIST's SUSTAIN unit (Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity), the Environmental Policies (EPS) group provides science-based input to the definition and implementation of environmental policies at national and EU level, in particular policies around chemical safety, soil pollution, circular (bio-)economy (e.g. construction, textile, water), and climate - and feeds, at the interface of science, technologies and policies, the regulatory perspective into RDI projects around these topics. As postdoc (R&T Scientist), you will further strengthen the activities around soil health and the management of contaminated sites via contributing to:• The further development (implementation-phase) of an Urban Soil Living Lab in Luxembourg (Horizon Europe project URSOILL - Innovative Solutions for Sustainable Urban Soil Restoration Through Living Labs) and participation in a working group on soil remediation and stabilization with nature-based solutions, especially phytoremediation and phytomanagement. Main tasks: literature review; design of field experiments and monitoring protocols across multiple urban sites; support and supervision of fieldwork; data analysis and interpretation; stakeholder engagement in the Living Lab; and scientific publications and project deliverables.• The establishment of a cross-border network of ‘Lighthouses' of phytomanagement for soil remediation, biodiversity and the regenerative economy in the Greater Region (Interreg project Light4Green),• Scientific and regulatory support, e.g. via bibliography and the preparation of a review article, on nature-based remediation solutions for Persistent organic pollutants (POPs) contamination (Interreg project Naturem),• The set-up of a laboratory for testing and evaluating soil remediation technologies (especially bioremediation and phytoremediation),• Support the definition, submission and implementation of research and collaborative project proposals of the group, and participate to the network of LIST's different activities around soil protection. Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!Education• You hold a Master's degree and a PhD in soil or environmental sciences/engineering, or another relevant natural science or engineering domain.• You have practical and solid experience in the design, testing, evaluation and application of nature-based soil remediation technologies, e.g. phytoremediation, bioremediation, mycoremediation.• Interdisciplinary thinking, well-developed communication skills (oral and written) and team spirit to successfully integrate into the multicultural, multilingual and multidisciplinary work environment at LIST and effectively communicate with LIST's partners,• Client orientation mindset and great sense of service are required. The candidate should be highly motivated, pro-active and open for new challenges and can work independently,• Not mandatory but considered an asset:o First experience in an RTO/academic environment, scientific/technical consulting, authorities, or industry on contaminated site management, pollution risk assessment or remediationo Knowledge of Luxembourg and the Greater RegionLanguage skills• Fluency in English, both oral and written. Other relevant languages, especially French, German, or Luxembourgish are a strong asset. Your LIST benefits• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchersApply onlineYour application must include:• A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience• A scientific CV with contact details• List of publications (and patents, if applicable)• Contact details of 2 referencesPlease apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.Application procedure and conditionsWe kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on national origin, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.This position offers a gross monthly salary between €6094 and €6678, paid over 13 months (€79.222–€86.814 annually) based on full time employment. jobs.description: Clinical Laboratory Geneticist/Cytogeneticist/Biologist (m/f) ref°543TYPE DE CONTRAT : CDI - temps pleinWe are currently looking for a Clinical Laboratory Geneticist/Cytogeneticist/Biologist (m/f) for our department “National Center of Genetics” for a permanent position on a full-time basis (40h/week).RESPONSIBILITIESParticipating in the daily management of the laboratory;Participating in a regular rotation between the hematooncogenetics and constitutional cytogenetics activities within the Hematooncogenetics and Cytogenetics Unit;Performing genetic diagnostics, interpretation and reporting in constitutional cytogenetics (pre- und postnatal);Performing cytogenetic and molecular cytogenetic analyses, including metaphase evaluation, FISH and Bionano, and preparing comprehensive, integrated diagnostic reports for hematological malignancies by consolidating these findings with bone marrow morphology (myelogram), flow cytometry, molecular genetics, and other relevant laboratory and clinical results;Participate in the development of research projects and applying scientific knowledge in expanding the diagnostic and research portfolio of the NCG;Seek funding from national (FNR) and international funding bodies including writing scientific proposals;Optimizing existing methods and developing new ones;Planning, interpretation and reporting of molecular genetic examinationsParticipation in the development and maintenance of a quality system based on (ISO 15189);Participating in external quality control trials;Training and supervision of the technicians;Participating to clinical staff meeting at National Center of Genetics and in other multidisciplinary meeting.Communicate cytogenetic findings to referring physicians when appropriate.Keep up to date with the latest scientific, technological, and clinical developments in constitutional and hemato-oncology cytogenetics. PROFILEPhD/Master sciences in Genetics or other similar qualification in clinical genetics;Several years of experience in a diagnostic cytogenetics laboratory, including independent interpretation and reporting in both constitutional cytogenetics (pre- and postnatal) and cancer cytogenetics/hematological neoplasia, as well as experience in preparing integrated hemato-oncology reports combining cytogenetic, morphological, immunophenotypic, molecular, and relevant clinical findings, is mandatory;Knowledge of specific chromosomal aberrations in leukemia and their detection also on preparations with metaphases that are very difficult to analyze;Application of different methods of in situ hybridization (interphase nucleus diagnostics, metaphase analysis with directly labeled probes);Experience in the interpretation of Bionano datasets would be desirable;Willingness to take on responsibility;Ability to work in a team, resilience, flexibility, ability to work under pressure and high commitment characterize you;You have a strong interest in genetic/medical issues and an exceptionally high level of motivation;Willingness to establish new methods for diagnostic application;Experience in quality management (ISO15189) is an advantage;Good knowledge of MS-Office, especially Excel. Experience with Laboratory Information and Management Systems (LIMS) and bioinformatics tools is appreciated;Advanced English knowledge in spoken and written is required; knowledge of German is an advantage.If you meet the above profile and wish to apply, please submit your application (CV and Cover letter) via our website. Your application will be treated confidentiality.At the final stages of the recruitment process, the successful candidate will be asked to provide supporting documentation such as, copies of diplomas and certificates of employment. An official criminal record (bulletin no.3) will also be required for consultation purpose.

Leveraging advanced expertise and leadership acumen, you will help define the next era of digitalization by crafting groundbreaking strategies and transformation roadmaps for Siemens and its global customers. The role entails direct responsibility for shaping business success, managing high-value projects, and serving as a trusted advisor for customer executives at C-level.Building on Siemens Advanta’s legacy as a global management consultancy powerhouse, the (Associate) Vice President role combines strategic depth, operational ownership, and cultural leadership—providing exposure to innovation-driven industries such as electrification, automation, and digitalization. **Ready to take your vision to the next level? Be part of a team where strategy meets technology, and innovation drives global impact.**How you will make an impact with us:- Delivery Excellence:- Act as a trusted advisor to our customers, shaping strategic agendas and transformation roadmaps with your thought leadership.- Take operational and financial responsibility for acquiring and delivering high quality projects.- Oversee multidisciplinary teams in complex consulting engagements and large-scale programs to deliver innovative, tailored digital and organizational solutions for global industrial customers.- Business Growth:- Shape strategic customer opportunities through thought leadership, innovative methodologies, and differentiated consulting approaches at the intersection of strategy, digitalization, and technology.- Lead the development of compelling value propositions, proposals, and solution concepts for complex transformation initiatives in close collaboration with Customer Partners and senior customer stakeholders.- Build trusted relationships with C-level executives, acting as a strategic advisor and fostering long-term partnerships across complex stakeholder environments.- Leverage Siemens’ unique expertise in industrial technology, automation, digitalization, and AI to create measurable value for customers and strengthen Siemens Advanta’s market positioning and growth.- People & Capability Building- Develop differentiating methodologies, foster team growth, mentor employees, and build Consulting Excellence within the organization.- Inspire, coach, and grow high-performing, diverse teams ensuring an inclusive, performance-oriented consulting culture.What you bring:- Education: - Master’s degree or MBA from a top-tier university is desirable.- Backgrounds in engineering, physics, natural sciences, or strategic management are highly valued.- Experience & Skills- Extensive consulting experience (8 - 12+ years), with a proven track record as Principal, (Associate) Partner or VP at a top-tier strategy consultancy, or equivalent experience in corporate strategy roles.- Track record in driving significant business growth**,** leading large-scale transformation programs, and building executive-level customer relationships.- Proven track record in leading digital transformation projects for Siemens’ customer base, focusing on industries like automotive and power & utilities.- AI expertise: Strong familiarity with AI-based strategy development and execution, leveraging AI to create impactful industry transformations.- End-to-end experience, ranging from strategy development to hands-on execution for technology-driven and industry-specific transformation projects.- Methodological depth in areas such as Target Operating Model (TOM), cost reduction initiatives, sustainability, and AI transformation.- Working Style & Personality- Ability to thrive in a matrix organization, fostering strong internal partnerships and cross-functional collaboration.- Extensive experience leading international teams and actively creating an inclusive environment.- A leader who develops people, enjoys leading employees, brings diverse perspectives, thinks creatively, and goes beyond standard consulting approaches.- An entrepreneurial mindset and strong analytical acumen.- Languages: The position can be filled in either Munich,Germany or Barcelona,Spain.- Pathway 1: For candidates working in Munich and supporting primarily German-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in English is mandatory, while German is an advantage.- Pathway 2: For candidates working in Barcelona and supporting primarily Spanish- and Portuguese-speaking customers, business-level proficiency in Spanish is mandatory, with proficiency in Portugese preferred.What we offer you- Attractive Compensation Package: A competitive salary that recognizes your expertise and performance.- Flexible Working Models: Enjoy time for yourself and your family through our flexible working hour models.- Continuous Learning: Benefit from specialized training and daily challenges to keep your expert knowledge up-to-date.- Innovative Environment: Become part of a team that values innovation and continuous improvement.Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.At Siemens, we believe that feeling valued and included is the foundation for doing great work. That’s why we aim to create an inclusive workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging, and where individual perspectives and experiences are celebrated. Our commitment to fairness and respect extends to every applicant.As an equal opportunity employer (http://www.siemens.com/global/en/company/sustainability/social-commitments/belonging.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.About usSiemens Advanta provides consulting services in the fields of strategy, operations, AI, and data analytics, as well as solution implementation services, to enable the digital and sustainability transformation of Siemens customers. Leveraging Siemens’ expertise, resources, and its ecosystem of businesses and partners, customers are empowered to unlock the full potential of Siemens technologies. Siemens Advanta elevates customer engagements to an enterprise level, leading transformations through strategic insight and holistic solutions. With pioneering projects bridging across Siemens’ entire portfolio, customers are enabled to leverage the full value of Siemens technologies. With this, Siemens Advanta develops repeatable, scalable and proven solutions that maximize customer value across the entire value chain. Headquartered in Munich, Germany, Siemens Advanta operates through a global network of around 800 employees across 18 countries.www.siemens.de/careers (http://www.siemens.de/careers) – if you would like to find out more about jobs & careers at Siemens.FAQ (http://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/karrieren-entdecken.html)  – if you need further information on the application process.

jobs.title: Closure of applications - Managing Director (m/f/d) SCHOTTEL France S.A.R.L. (Re..., SCHOTTEL France (Art-Director)
jobs.description: Welcome on board at SCHOTTEL France S.A.R.L. Please note: Due to the overwhelming number of applications received, we have closed the application process for this position. Applications submitted on or after 26 October 2026 will therefore no longer be considered . We greatly appreciate the strong interest in joining SCHOTTEL France S.A.R.L. SCHOTTEL France S.A.R.L. is the French subsidiary of SCHOTTEL GmbH, one of the world's leading manufacturers of propulsion and manoeuvring solutions for the maritime industry. Since 1971, the company has been serving customers in commercial shipping, naval defence, offshore and inland waterway markets, combining local market expertise with the technological strength of the global SCHOTTEL Group. With a strong focus on customer proximity and lifecycle support, SCHOTTEL France delivers complete propulsion solutions for newbuild and retrofit projects, including engineering, technical consulting and project management. The company furthermore provides comprehensive aftermarket services, ranging from spare parts supply and technical support to upgrades, commissioning, diagnostics and the deployment of highly qualified service technicians. Backed by SCHOTTEL's global network and expertise, SCHOTTEL France is committed to ensuring reliable, efficient and sustainable vessel operations throughout the entire product lifecycle. We offer: A key leadership position with a high level of entrepreneurial responsibility Significant scope for shaping and developing the business An international working environment with short decision-making paths Attractive compensation and benefits package with long-term career perspective within a stable and successful group Your key responsibilities include: Overall management of SCHOTTEL France S.A.R.L., leading a small, high-performing team Full responsibility for achieving the strategic and operational targets, including utilization, cost efficiency and overall profitability Leading and developing a small local team through strong strategic and hands-on leadership Managing and developing customer relationships and customer processes in line with corporate guidelines and in close coordination with the board Ensuring efficient, goal-oriented, and cost-effective operational processes while complying with industry standards and corporate policies Planning and implementing local marketing and sales initiatives, such as customer events Ensure alignment with the company's global strategy and collaborate closely with other international subsidiaries Report directly to the Headquarters in Germany Foster a culture of teamwork, accountability and continuous improvement Your profile: Successfully completed a technical degree in Engineering or a commercial degree in Business Administration or a comparable qualification Several years of professional experience in a senior management role, e.g. Branch Manager, Sales Director or Site Manager In-depth knowledge of the maritime industry, including markets, suppliers and customers Proven experience in people management as well as strong knowledge of controlling instruments and P&L responsibility Strong leadership skills with the ability to motivate and develop employees Excellent communication skills and a confident, professional and approachable manner when dealing with employees, customers and suppliers Fluent in English (required) Native French language skills are required Strong communication and negotiation skill Ability to work effectively in an international and intercultural environment Strategic thinker with hands-on mentality   A BOOST FOR CAREERS | SCHOTTEL.DE Have we sparked your interest? If so, we look forward to meeting you.

jobs.employer: Základní škola a Mateřská škola Tábor, náměstí Mikuláše z Husi 45
jobs.description: Hledáme školního psychologa / psycholožku – kotvu v rozbouřených vodách (přímo v srdci Tábora)Jsme Základní škola a Mateřská škola Tábor na náměstí Mikuláše z Husi 45 a hledáme k sobě parťáka/parťačku – člověka mladého duchem, klidně trochu alternativního, s otevřenou hlavou a nadhledem. Někoho, pro koho je respektující a partnerský přístup naprostým základem, a kdo nás podrží ve chvílích, kdy máme pocit, že jsme u konce svých sil.Proč se u nás rozhodně nebudeš nudit?Jsme velká škola s neuvěřitelně pestrou a širokou „klientelou“. Pod jednou střechou (a v našich školkách) tu potkáš mrňata řešící ztracenou bačkoru, puberťáky hledající smysl života (a sebe sama), děti se specifickými potřebami i zvídavé osobnosti. A k tomu partu učitelů, kteří svou práci dělají srdcem, staví na partnerské komunikaci, ale občas prostě potřebují někoho, kdo jim pomůže se zhluboka nadechnout a nabrat nový dech. Nuda? To slovo u nás neznáme!!!Co bude tvůj denní chleba (a občas i dort)?•    Být bezpečným přístavem pro děti: Naslouchat jim bez hodnocení, podpořit je a hledat s nimi cestu, když se jim zrovna hroutí svět (nebo jen písemka z matiky).•    Být oporou pro dospělé: Provázet učitele i rodiče v náročných situacích, kultivovat vzájemný dialog a ulevit jim od tlaku ve chvílích, kdy už neví kudy kam.•    Tmelit kolektivy: Vymýšlet a vést preventivní programy, adaptáky a aktivity, díky kterým budou třídy bezpečným místem postaveným na vzájemném respektu.•    Tvořit vlastní projekty: Máš nápad na mindfulness, arteterapii nebo jinou „alternativu“? Sem s tím! U nás máš zelenou.Koho si u nás dokážeme představit?•    Máš v kapse magisterský titul z psychologie (přes tohle bohužel vlak nejede, zákon je zákon).•    Věříš v partnerskou komunikaci – s dětmi, rodiči i kolegy jednáš jako rovný s rovným.•    Dokážeš zachovat klidnou hlavu, když kolem tebe lítají emoce, ale zároveň se nebereš smrtelně vážně.•    Umíš se naladit na svět generace Z, malých předškoláků i vyčerpaných dospěláků.•    Praxe je super, ale pokud jsi čerstvý absolvent/ka s chutí se učit a empatií na rozdávání, rádi ti dáme prostor.Co za to hodíme do placu my?•    Skvělou partu lidí: Přátelský kolektiv, kde se nikdo na nic nehraje a kde se mluví otevřeně. Sborovna u nás není zakázaná zóna, ale místo, kde se fakt rádi potkáváme.•    Svobodu a důvěru: Vedení školy ví, že psycholog není luxus, ale nutnost. Nebudeme ti stát za zády se stopkami, dostaneš důvěru i prostor pro vlastní vizi.•    Férové podmínky: Úvazek 1,0 nebo dle domluvy, plat dle tabulek (12. platová třída) + osobní ohodnocení, které dává smysl.•    Dobíjení baterek: 8 týdnů dovolené, 12 dní studijního volna, podpora dalšího vzdělávání, supervize a další školní benefity.Kdy můžeš naskočit?Ideálně ihned / dle dohody, ale na člověka, se kterým si sedneme, si rádi počkáme.Zní to jako tvůj šálek kávy (nebo matchy)?Pošli nám svůj životopis a pár řádků o tom, kdo jsi a co tě baví, na reditel@zsmikulasezhusi.cz. Žádné formální slohovky, napiš to tak, jak to cítíš.Pracovní poměr na 1 rok s možností prodloužení. Budeme se těšit na viděnou. Kateřina Burian Reif, ředitelka školy

jobs.title: Dutch speaking Support Specialist
jobs.description:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

As part of Lightspeed’s Support team, you will be the first point of contact for our customers who need assistance, helping with a wide variety of requests all the way from general education to hardware/software investigation and everything in between.

Working closely with various global teams at Lightspeed, you will investigate, troubleshoot, test and resolve issues that our hospitality customers may be facing during service.

 

What you’ll be doing:

  • Working with a truly global, multi-language 24x7 team across APAC, EMEA and NOAM

  • Flexibility on working days and shifts (weekends included)

  • Have enthusiastic, positive and knowledgeable interactions with our Hospitality customers, partners and Lightspeed team members, maintaining Lightspeed's Gold Class standard for support via phone, chat and email.

  • Use consistent troubleshooting techniques to quickly and efficiently identify the source of customer issues and provide a prompt and appropriate solution

  • Work within our customer support platforms to document, track and resolve interactions

  • Assist with the identification, reproduction and escalation of product issues and bugs to the Quality Assurance team, tracking through to resolution with each customer, partner and Lightspeed team member

  • Advocate and promote improvements to our products and services

  • Operating within a roster/schedule to ensure high availability of our assistance for our customers (In collaboration with your manager)

 

What you’ll be bringing to the team:

  • Previous customer service experience and/or technical support Strong attention to detail with an emphasis on providing an exceptional customer experience

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in Dutch & English

  • Basic experience using common online, mobile and desktop platforms; iOS, Android, OSX, Windows

Even better if you have, but not necessary:

  • Experience interacting with customers through Phone, Email, Ticketing and Live Chat platforms

  • Experience or knowledge of the Hospitality industry

  • Experience supporting a SaaS product

  • Experience supporting an iOS application

  • Computer networking experience or interest

 

Even better if you have, but not necessary

  • Passion in technology;

  • Working knowledge of Mac OS and basic knowledge of HTML/CSS;

  • Hospitality experience;

  • French written and verbal communication skills;

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!


Please make sure to apply with a CV in English.


What’s in it for you:

  • PTO scheme

  • 400€ annually towards Health and Wellbeing

  • Dental cover

  • Private healthcare

  • Optical cover

  • Opportunity to join a growing team, in a fast-paced, high-growth company

  • Work with a team of incredibly talented and forward-thinking people!

  • Work for a team that values hard work, and knows how to celebrate the wins

  • Amazing benefits & perks, including equity for all Lightspeeders

In short, an opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed family, a true Canadian tech success story.

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.
