jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Agents
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

An AI agent is only as useful as what it knows about your company. For many of the world's leading companies, that knowledge lives in Notion. The AI Knowledge & Capabilities team makes sure every agent working in Notion – built by Notion, by customers, or by other AI companies – finds the right answer, quickly and at a cost that makes sense.

We own the systems that make this work: search, knowledge, and memory. We also own the agent harness – the tools, context, and model choices that turn a model into a working agent. We decide what to build using evals, customer feedback, and product judgment. Our work reaches users directly, and other AI teams at Notion build on it.

We recently shipped Memories, so Notion AI, Custom Agents, and agents connected through MCP can learn and remember across platforms. We also shipped Auto, a model router that delivers frontier quality at 90% lower cost. Next, we're bringing memory, search, and the harness together into one system. Nobody has figured out how to package that yet – we want any company to get a great knowledge system for its agents with a click or a few questions.

You will be a technical leader for the team. You'll set direction across search, knowledge, and the harness, starting hands-on with making agents better and cheaper, and help define how Notion measures AI quality.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Set technical direction for search, knowledge, and the agent harness – make the architecture calls, run design reviews, and decide what the team builds next.

 - Make Notion's agents better, faster, and cheaper – starting with the harness: which tools an agent can call, what context it gets, and which model handles each request.

 - Lead how we measure agent quality – evolve the metrics and evals that reflect real usage, and use them to choose what ships.

 - Turn company data into answers agents can use – build agentic search and memory that give every agent the context it needs, at the right latency and cost.

 - Work closely with research – partner with Notion's model research team on evals, model choice, and models trained for agentic work, and get what works into production. You'll also work with search platform and AI product teams on work that spans teams.

 - Grow the team – mentor engineers, review designs, and develop the next tech leads.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Production applied AI: You've shipped and iterated on production LLM or agent systems used by real users. You owned how their quality was measured, and you changed course based on what you found.

 - Quality, latency, and cost tradeoffs: You've traded quality against latency and cost in a production system, measured the result, and can explain what you gave up and why.

 - Technical leadership: You've owned the technical direction of a complex system, often across teams, and kept it sound as it grew. You don't wait for a roadmap – you find the problems worth solving, make the case for them, and go deep on the hardest ones yourself.

 - Product sense: You've shipped quality improvements users noticed, and you've shaped new products from scratch – from the data model to what users see. You can explain why they mattered.

 - Shipping something new: You've taken an idea from nothing to a product people use. You try new models and tools early, form your own views, and turn them into product decisions.

 - Making other engineers better: You mentor engineers at every level, guide their designs, and share what you know so it scales past you. Multiple engineers have grown by working with you.

 - Clear communication: You write clearly about tradeoffs, disagree directly, and change your mind when the evidence says to.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You've improved LLM cost and quality directly – e.g. model routing, eval-driven harness or prompt tuning, or token efficiency in long-running agents.

 - You've founded a company or been an early engineer at a startup, and built systems that hold up at large scale.

 - Experience working closely with research or model training teams.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Töö kirjeldusKas elektroonika paneb Sul silma särama ja tehnilised väljakutsed hoopis käed sügelema? Kui Sa ei karda kruvikeerajat, multimeeter pole Sulle võõras ning rikkis seadme peale ei teki tahtmist põgeneda, vaid hoopis välja selgitada, miks see ei tööta, siis võime otsida just Sind! Asematic OÜ otsib oma meeskonda nutikat, kohusetundlikku ja hea tehnilise taibuga automaatik-tehnikut, kellele meeldib oma kätega midagi korda saata, iseseisvalt mõelda ning vajadusel ka kastist välja vaadata. Meie juures ei tähenda töö päevast päeva samade juhtmete ühendamist. Iga objekt, seade ja projekt võib pakkuda midagi uut. Igavuse üle meil üldjuhul kurta ei saa! Omalt poolt pakume: * Väga ägedat ja kokkuhoidvat meeskonda! Meil tehakse tõsist tööd, aga ennast liiga tõsiselt ei võeta. Hea huumor kuulub asja juurde.* Praktiliselt lõputuid arenguvõimalusi! Meie tegevusvaldkond on lai ja tehnoloogia areneb pidevalt. Kui Sul on huvi, pealehakkamist ja häid ideid, siis Sinu arengule me piire ei sea. * Kaasaegseid ja kvaliteetseid töövahendeid. Meie põhimõte on lihtne – korralikku tööd peab saama teha korralike vahenditega. * Mitmekülgset ja põnevat tööelu. Erinevad objektid, kliendid, seadmed ja tehnilised väljakutsed muudavad iga töönädala omanäoliseks. * Kokkupuudet maailma tipptasemel tehnoloogiatega. Töötad rahvusvaheliste tootjate professionaalsete seadmete ja uusimate tehniliste lahendustega. * Võimalust kaasa rääkida ja ise midagi paremaks muuta. Head ideed on meil alati oodatud, olenemata sellest, kellelt need tulevad. * Võimalust õppida, areneda ja kasvada koos ettevõttega. Soovi ja võimekuse korral saad võtta järjest suuremat vastutust ning osaleda keerukamate ja rahvusvaheliste projektide elluviimisel. * Stabiilset täiskoormusega töökohta. Otsime pikaajalist meeskonnaliiget, mitte ajutist abikätt. * Konkurentsivõimelist töötasu, mis arvestab Sinu oskusi, kogemusi ja panust. * Tasustatud lisatööd, kui tehnika otsustab tööajast mitte kinni pidada! Meie juures on töö ja eraelu tasakaal paigas – aga kui mõni tõkkepuu, turnikee, kaamera või muu tehniline seade otsustab just nädalavahetusel iseloomu näidata, siis tema taltsutamine ei käi ainult suure tänu ja õlalepatsutuse eest. Lisatöö eest on loomulikult ette nähtud täiendav tasu! ? Selliseid olukordi tuleb ette siiski harva. * Ja mis peamine – meie juures ei pea Sa olema lihtsalt kätepaar. Sinu mõtted, ideed ja arvamus loevad! Pakutavad hüved ja soodustused * Erialased arenguvõimalused * Iseseisvus oma töö korraldamisel * Kaasaegne töökeskkond * Motiveeriv lisahüvede pakett * Tööaja osas arvestatakse töötajate arvamusega

Muud nõuded: Ootused kandidaadileMe ei otsi inimest, kes lihtsalt tööl käib. Otsime inimest, kellele tema töö päriselt meeldib! Meie jaoks on olulised: * Tehniline taip ja huvi elektroonika vastu. Sulle meeldib aru saada, kuidas ja miks seadmed töötavad. * Iseseisev mõtlemine. Sa ei oota iga probleemi korral detailset juhendit, vaid oskad ise lahendusi otsida ja otsuseid langetada. * Loovus ja leidlikkus. Kui tavapärane lahendus ei tööta, suudad mõelda välja midagi paremat. * Korrektsus ja vastutustunne. Sulle läheb korda, et tehtud töö oleks kvaliteetne ja lõpptulemus korralik. * Ausus, lojaalsus ja usaldusväärsus. Pead oma sõna ning Sinu peale saab kindel olla. * Praktilised oskused. Oskad seadmeid paigaldada, remontida ja hooldada ning tunned rõõmu sellest, kui kõik lõpuks laitmatult töötab. * Hea suhtlemisoskus ja huumorimeel. Meile meeldivad inimesed, kes oskavad nii tööd teha kui ka elust rõõmu tunda.

jobs.title: Head of Global Security Assurance
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Trust is essential to how organizations choose and use Notion. As Head of Global Security Assurance, you will build and lead a global, customer-facing pillar of our GRCP function. Your team will help customers understand and trust how Notion protects their data, meets security and compliance expectations, and approaches privacy across our products and services.



You will lead regional customer assurance leaders and partner closely with Privacy, GRC and Security leadership to establish a clear, scalable model for customer trust. You’ll work directly with customers and go-to-market teams on complex security and privacy questions, while turning what you learn into better products, stronger processes and more transparent communications. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can set a global strategy, empower experienced regional experts and navigate the details when it matters most.



This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead global customer trust. Set the strategy, priorities and operating model for customer security assurance and customer-facing privacy engagement across the Americas, EMEA and APAC. Balance consistent global standards with regional customer and regulatory needs.

 - Build and grow the team. Lead, coach and develop regional assurance leaders and other specialists. Give them the autonomy, context and executive access to represent Notion confidently with customers; plan coverage, capacity and hiring as demand grows.

 - Earn customer confidence. Serve as a senior security and privacy counterpart for strategic and regulated customers. Lead complex due diligence, executive conversations and escalations, and help teams navigate procurement, renewals and expansion without overstating our controls or commitments.

 - Scale assurance operations. Establish clear intake, prioritization, handoffs and escalation paths for questionnaires, customer calls, security reviews and other requests. Partner with Legal on contractual security and privacy terms, and with subject-matter owners on accurate, timely responses.

 - Make trust understandable. Own the customer assurance content strategy, including the Trust Center, evidence-sharing practices, reusable response libraries, playbooks and go-to-market enablement. Keep materials accurate, consistent and appropriate for the audience.

 - Connect privacy to customer trust. Partner with Privacy and Legal leaders to translate privacy practices, data handling, AI and subprocessor questions into clear customer-facing guidance. Define decision rights and route legal interpretations, privacy assessments and commitments to their accountable owners.

 - Strengthen regional assurance. Work with regional leaders and the compliance team on customer and market requirements, including relevant assessments such as K-FSI, ISMAP, SOC 2, ISO 27001 and BSI C5. Coordinate customer-facing and regional engagement while partnering with compliance owners on controls, evidence and audits.

 - Turn customer feedback into action. Identify recurring security, privacy and product gaps; bring customer impact and regional context to Product, Engineering, Security and leadership; and track decisions and follow-through.

 - Support trust through incidents. Partner with incident command, Security, Privacy, Legal and Communications on accurate, timely customer responses and escalations. Build reusable processes that help the team respond consistently while respecting established incident ownership.

 - Improve how the work scales. Use thoughtful automation and AI-assisted workflows to improve intake, knowledge reuse and reporting, with human review, access controls and clear accountability. Track request volume, responsiveness, quality, customer impact and capacity; use the results to guide investment.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience leading and developing security assurance, customer trust, privacy, GRC or related teams, including experienced individual contributors and regional leaders.

 - Experience serving enterprise customers in security or privacy due diligence, including customer conversations, questionnaires, contract security reviews and complex escalations.

 - Ability to translate cloud security architecture, security controls, audit evidence and privacy practices into clear, accurate language for technical and executive audiences.

 - Working knowledge of security assurance frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001, and the ability to navigate regional or industry-specific requirements with specialists.

 - Experience partnering with Privacy and Legal on customer data protection questions, contractual commitments and escalation. Sound judgment about when to involve legal, technical and regulatory subject-matter experts.

 - Demonstrated ability to build scalable operating models, manage competing priorities and use metrics to improve service quality and capacity.

 - Strong cross-functional leadership across Security, Product, Engineering, Legal, Privacy, Sales and customer-facing teams; an empathetic, direct communication style.

 - A builder’s mindset: comfort working hands-on in ambiguity, improving workflows and using automation responsibly while maintaining a high bar for accuracy and confidentiality.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience leading distributed or follow-the-sun teams across the Americas, EMEA and APAC.

 - Experience with regional assurance programs such as K-FSI, ISMAP or BSI C5, or supporting highly regulated customers.

 - Experience building customer trust centers, assurance knowledge bases, AI-assisted response workflows or field security advisory programs.

 - Familiarity with privacy and third-party risk, including customer-facing subprocessor transparency and shared accountability for vendor assurance.

 - Experience at a growing SaaS or cloud company, or relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM or CIPP.




EARLY PRIORITIES 

 - Meet regional assurance and privacy leaders, GTM and partner teams; understand customer demand, current workflows and the most important trust gaps.

 - Agree with GRC, Privacy, Legal and Security on ownership, decision rights, escalation paths and how customer assurance interfaces with audits and third-party risk.

 - Establish a global coverage and capacity plan that protects regional autonomy, supports strategic customers and provides clear leadership escalation.

 - Assess the Trust Center, response library and intake process; identify opportunities to improve quality, speed and reuse without compromising accuracy.

 - Create an initial roadmap and baseline metrics for customer experience, request volume, response times, recurring product gaps and team health.

jobs.title: VP, Communication
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


VP of Communications, Replit

Replit is changing who gets to build software. As an agentic software creation platform, Replit enables anyone, from individual creators to teams inside the world’s largest companies, to turn natural language into applications, internal tools, dashboards, workflows, websites, and software that solves real problems.

We are looking for a Director or VP of Communications to lead Replit’s next chapter of storytelling, trust building, and market leadership.

This is a senior communications role for a creative, strategic, and hands-on leader who can build and scale the communications function as Replit grows from a beloved developer platform into a defining company in AI, software creation, and enterprise transformation. This person will own Replit’s external and internal communications strategy, including strategic positioning and company narrative, media relations, analyst relations, executive communications, internal communications, crisis communications, customer storytelling, flagship thought leadership, policy-related communications, and global awareness.

The role requires someone who can push through the noise, make the Replit story heard, and keep it part of the conversation. The Director / VP of Communications will develop a compelling narrative that evolves with the company, the product, and the market, and deliver it across media, policymakers, partners, customers, prospects, and employees. The role will also support Replit’s international awareness, with a focus on key markets in Europe and Asia.

This person must be both strategic and execution-oriented. They should have built or helped lead a communications function at a fast-growing technology company, or led communications and positioning for a leading institution. This is not a traditional press office role of adopting another company’s playbook in its entirety.

The person must be creative, scrappy, maybe even spiky: able to take what they know works as a foundation and build on it to make Replit a unique player that punches above its weight in a crowded, competitive marketplace.

Role

 - Lead and scale Replit’s communications function, including communications strategy, team structure, agency management, operating rhythms, and execution standards.

 - Build an AI-native communications function, with agents running repeatable work so a lean team focuses on judgment, relationships, and creative leaps.

 - Develop and evolve Replit’s corporate narrative as the company expands across AI, developer tools, enterprise, consumer, education, and global markets.

 - Own Replit’s strategic positioning: the upstream frameworks and intellectual capital that make every launch, stage, and story land better.

 - Lead communications programs across company announcements, product launches, enterprise momentum, customer stories, partnerships, policy-related issues, executive visibility, awards, events, and thought leadership.

 - Shape how the market understands Replit as an agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language.

 - Build clear, credible narratives around AI-powered software creation, developer productivity, enterprise adoption, security, governance, education, and the future of work.

 - Develop flagship thought leadership, signature reports, and third-party validator relationships that build enterprise and institutional trust.

 - Partner with the CEO, executive team, and functional leaders on positioning, reputation, media strategy, internal communications, and high-stakes company moments.

 - Build and maintain strong relationships with technology, business, AI, enterprise, developer, policy, and international media.

 - Partner closely with product, engineering, marketing, sales, partnerships, legal, policy, people, and finance to create coordinated communications programs that support company priorities.

 - Lead or support internal communications, including company meetings, leadership messaging, employee announcements, change communications, and moments that help the company stay aligned as it scales.

 - Manage proactive and reactive communications, including rapid response, issues management, crisis communications, and sensitive topics.

 - Prepare executives and spokespeople for media interviews, podcasts, conferences, customer events, internal moments, and industry presentations, and earn premier stages for Replit’s leaders.

 - Support Replit’s global communications strategy, with particular focus on expanding awareness in Europe and Asia.

 - Track the AI, software, developer, enterprise, startup, and policy landscape to identify where Replit should lead, respond, or reframe the conversation.

 - Build a communications culture that values speed, clarity, creativity, judgment, and proof.

Qualifications

 - BA/BS degree or equivalent practical experience.

 - 12+ years of experience in communications, PR, media, corporate affairs, or related fields for Director level; 15+ years for VP level.

 - Experience building, scaling, or significantly expanding a communications or strategic positioning function at a fast-growing technology company or leading institution.

 - Proven experience working directly with founders, CEOs, executives, and senior cross-functional leaders.

 - Strong relationships with technology, business, enterprise, AI, developer, and/or policy media.

 - Experience managing external agencies and cross-functional communications programs on a global level.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messages for users, developers, enterprise buyers, employees, policymakers, partners, and the press.

 - Strong understanding of the AI landscape and how AI is changing software development, enterprise productivity, and the future of work.

 - Hands-on fluency with AI and agentic tools, with a vision for AI-native communications operations.

 - Track record of flagship thought leadership: signature reports, executive platforms, and ideas that shape an industry’s conversation.

 - Experience earning third-party validation from leading institutions and policy communities for a scrutinized or emerging technology.

 - Experience guiding communications through major inflection points: public-company transitions, landmark policy moments, category creation.

 - Experience across several communications disciplines, including external communications, internal communications, media relations, executive communications, crisis communications, and strategic messaging.

 - Ability to translate complex technical ideas into clear, compelling stories without losing substance.

 - Cross-functional leadership experience, with the ability to influence and collaborate across product, engineering, sales, marketing, legal, policy, finance, and people teams.

 - Ability to see the big picture while operating in execution mode.

 - Passionate about their craft and the impact they can have.

 - Strong judgment in fast-moving, high-pressure environments.

 - A creative, resourceful, “do more with less” mindset.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

jobs.title: Legal Trainees @ Nokia Technologies Oy
jobs.description: Hey, law student with a genuine interest in IPR and the tech industry!- Are you halfway through your legal studies and ready to jump into a year-long traineeship? - Do you have previous experience working in a legal or commercial environment? - Are you enthusiastic about intellectual property rights and contract law, with studies or previous work experience to back it up? - Do you have top-notch English skills? If you answered **YES,** continue reading, as this could be the position for you!**We are now looking for several trainees** to join Nokia Technologies' Technology Standards (TS) Legal and Licensing Excellence teams starting at the beginning of either April or September 2027. As a legal trainee in TS Legal or Licensing Excellence, you will work 3-5 days a week, depending on your preference, for a fixed term of 12 months. The position is based at Nokia Technologies' headquarters in Karaportti, Espoo. However, hybrid work in accordance with Nokia hybrid work policy is possible.**Nokia Technologies** is focused on licensing valuable Nokia intellectual property, particularly its world-class patent portfolio. Nokia is a technology leader building on decades of innovation and R&D leadership in technologies used in virtually all mobile devices used today. Nokia continues to pioneer and develop the technologies that power the smartphone industry, consumer electronics, video streaming, connected vehicles, and the wider internet of things. Read more about Nokia at **www.nokia.com**._"I originally joined Nokia Technologies as a legal trainee over a decade ago. What has made me want to stay all these years is having the opportunity to work with wonderful colleagues on challenging IP matters globally. This has enabled me to challenge myself, develop my skills, and progress in my career." – Teemu Itälä, Head of Legal & Compliance for Technology Standards, Nokia Technologies_**As a legal trainee**, you will join either Nokia Technologies' TS Legal team of approximately 8 professionals or the Licensing Excellence team of approximately 14 professionals. Your responsibilities will vary depending on which team you join. In both teams, your day-to-day work will involve assisting your team with various legal, licensing and contractual matters relating to, for example, non-disclosure agreements, different types of IP license agreements, assignments and transactions as well as working with contract management. You will also have a chance to contribute to improving and automating legal processes through the use of AI.- In TS Legal, you will assist legal professionals in various legal and contractual matters, including non-disclosure agreements, open-source software and the management of Nokia's patent portfolio. jobs.title: Senior Brand Manager Biodermal
jobs.description:
Karo Healthcare, a dynamic and growing personal-care retail company, is all about making smart choices for everyday healthcare. With a wide-ranging portfolio across seven categories including medical products, we own and sell over 80 brands in about 90 countries. Our portfolio includes such brands as E45, Pevaryl, Lamisil, Nutravita, Decubal and many others. Our core belief in empowering people to make intelligent health decisions drives our growth strategy, blending organic expansion and M&A.

Join us at Karo Healthcare on our exciting journey. We're currently looking for a Senior Brand Manager – Biodermal for our office in Rotterdam, Netherlands.

What's in it for you?

Ready to take ownership of an iconic skincare brand and make a real commercial impact?

This is your opportunity to shape the future of Biodermal in the Netherlands, combining brand strategy, innovation and hands-on execution in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial environment.

You'll have the freedom to turn consumer insights into bold ideas, drive profitable growth and collaborate with international teams to bring exciting innovations to market. With real ownership, high visibility and plenty of room to develop, this is a role where your ideas can make a difference.

What you'll be doing

  • Shape the brand strategy: Partner with the Marketing Manager to develop Biodermal's three-year strategy and translate it into ambitious, commercially focused annual brand plans for the Netherlands.
  • Own brand performance: Manage the brand P&L, marketing budgets and A&P investment, identifying opportunities to accelerate profitable growth and maximise ROI.
  • Champion the consumer: Turn consumer, shopper and market insights into compelling brand propositions, campaigns and growth opportunities.
  • Bring innovation to life: Collaborate with Global Skincare Portfolio and Innovation teams to launch relevant new products and renovations, from concept through to in-market execution.
  • Drive impactful brand activation: Lead integrated marketing campaigns across digital, media, content, retail and e-commerce, ensuring a consistent and distinctive brand experience.
  • Win in the market: Partner with Sales, Shopper Marketing and e-commerce teams to strengthen brand visibility, distribution, customer engagement and conversion.
  • Stay ahead of the competition: Monitor category trends, competitor activity and campaign performance, translating insights into clear commercial actions.
  • Make things happen: Lead cross-functional projects with internal stakeholders and external agencies, ensuring effective execution, regulatory compliance and measurable results.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of brand marketing experience, ideally within FMCG, consumer healthcare, beauty, personal care or skincare.
  • A degree in Marketing, Business or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Proven experience developing and executing integrated brand strategies and marketing plans, with clear commercial results.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including hands-on experience with P&L ownership, budget management and brand performance analysis.
  • Experience bringing product innovation or renovation to market, from strategic planning through to launch.
  • A solid understanding of modern brand building across digital marketing, e-commerce, retail, media and consumer activation.
  • A consumer-first mindset, with the ability to turn market insights and data into actionable growth opportunities.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with experience leading agencies and collaborating across commercial and international teams.
  • A proactive, entrepreneurial approach, comfortable taking ownership, challenging ideas and delivering results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills and an interest in leveraging AI and new technologies to improve ways of working.
  • Fluency in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

Benefits

  • Opportunity to create, grow, and encourage.
  • Apart from a competitive salary package, there are plenty of growth opportunities to support your personal ambitions.
  • Flexible working arrangements and a healthy work-life balance.
  • Responsibility for exciting and challenging projects with a direct, visible impact on our customers and the industry.
  • A positive working environment within an international, collaborative and motivated team.
  • An entrepreneurial, start-up spirit combined with the opportunities and resources of a large international organisation with strong values.

Karo Healthcare has a Diverse & Inclusive environment. We are looking for qualified candidates irrespective of gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, religion, national origin, disability or age.

jobs.title: SEO - Manager
jobs.description:
Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-driven products, platforms, and processes. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building.
Job Role: SEO / AEO Manager
Job Type: Contract - USA

Job Description

About This Role

Bounteous is leading the charge in dynamic digital experiences and is looking for forward-thinking search experts to help drive measurable impact for some of the world's most recognizable and ambitious brands. In today's AI-driven, zero-click search landscape, our approach helps brands envision, harness, and enable their digital presence across traditional search engines, AI-powered discovery platforms, and emerging search experiences.

We are seeking a SEO / AEO Manager to lead holistic search strategy across our client portfolio, spanning traditional SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO), and AI search visibility across platforms including Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Copilot. This individual will drive performance across traditional SEO, AEO, and AI-powered search experiences. The ideal candidate understands how search has evolved beyond rankings- into entities, AI Overviews, generative search, and full-SERP ownership, and can translate that evolution into business growth. The ideal candidate has already built or scaled an AI-search-visibility practice, not just a traditional SEO program with AI terminology added on top.

This contractor will work cross-functionally with internal teams and client stakeholders to develop and execute advanced search strategies that drive visibility, authority, and measurable ROI, defined jointly with each client at engagement kickoff (see Success Metrics below).

Role & Responsibilities

As the SEO & AEO Manager, you will lead strategic search initiatives across enterprise client accounts, driving business growth and client success as a key member of our search practice.

You will own strategy development, execution oversight, and performance measurement across traditional SEO and AI-driven search ecosystems.

Â 

Key Responsibilities

Search & AEO Strategy Leadership

  • Lead holistic search strategy development, including traditional SEO, AEO, and AI search optimization, to drive full-funnel growth.

  • Develop strategies to capture and optimize for AI Overviews, Featured Snippets, People Also Ask, zero-click search experiences, and conversational queries.

  • Drive entity-based optimization strategies to strengthen brand authority and knowledge graph presence.

  • Partner with content and digital teams to align SEO strategy with E-E-A-T best practices.

AI & Emerging Search Optimization

  • Optimize content and technical implementations for AI-driven search environments, including generative search engines and LLM discovery platforms, specifically ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, Gemini, and Copilot.

  • Develop structured data and schema strategies to enhance visibility in rich results, AI summaries, and enhanced SERP features.

  • Stand up and manage AI-visibility monitoring using a dedicated citation-tracking platform â track share of AI citations, sentiment, and source attribution across client brands and named competitors.

  • Monitor evolving search engine algorithms and AI search trends, proactively adjusting strategy to maintain competitive advantage.

  • Establish processes for measuring AI search visibility and zero-click performance impact.

Technical & Content SEO Execution

  • Perform and present comprehensive technical, content, competitive, local, and app SEO audits.

  • Develop SEO functional specifications for technical enhancements, partnering with developers to implement, QA, and UAT updates.

  • Conduct advanced keyword, topic cluster, and entity research to inform scalable content strategies.

  • Identify opportunities for content optimization, consolidation, pruning, and authority building.

Cross-Functional & Client Collaboration

  • Collaborate closely with paid search, analytics, UX, product, and development teams to drive integrated search performance.

  • Present insights and recommendations to internal and client stakeholders, translating complex SEO and AI-search concepts into business-focused outcomes.

  • Align search strategies with broader omnichannel marketing and digital transformation initiatives.

Data, Measurement & Automation

  • Take a data-driven approach to measuring SEO and AEO ROI against the metrics defined in Success Metrics below.

  • Develop reporting frameworks that account for traditional traffic, zero-click engagement, SERP feature ownership, and AI search visibility.

  • Leverage automation tools, APIs, AI workflows, and scripting (e.g., Python, Google Apps Script, or SQL) to improve efficiency and scalability. ~~advanced Excel or scripting capabilities~~

  • Use reporting and visualization platforms (e.g., Looker Studio, Tableau) to communicate performance insights and strategic opportunities.

Project Management & Delivery

  • Manage project timelines and deliverables within project management systems (e.g., JIRA), ensuring deadlines and quality standards are met.

  • Operate effectively in a contractor capacity, managing priorities across multiple accounts while maintaining strategic clarity and execution rigor.

Qualifications

Required

  • 6-8years of experience driving SEO performance for enterprise or large-scale brands, including client-facing or agency experience

  • Demonstrated ownership of both traditional SEO and AEO/GEO initiatives, including having built an AI-search-visibility measurement practice from scratch â not just applied AEO terminology to an existing SEO program.

  • AI Overviews and generative search experiences

  • Structured data and schema implementation

  • Entity-based optimization and knowledge graph strategy

  • E-E-A-T frameworks and authority-building strategies

  • Hands-on experience with leading SEO platforms: SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Lumar (DeepCrawl), Yext, Lighthouse, and Google Business Profile.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one dedicated AI-visibility/citation-tracking platform (e.g., Profound, Peec AI, Scrunch AI, AthenaHQ, or the AI-visibility modules within Semrush/Ahrefs).

  • Experience managing project timelines and deliverables within a PM system (e.g., JIRA).

  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights and business recommendations.

  • Excellent communication skills, with experience presenting to senior stakeholders and client leadership teams.

Â 

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • Familiarity with AI-powered workflows, automation tools, APIs, and scripting (Python, SQL, or Google Apps Script) for reporting automation.

  • Prior experience managing search strategy across multiple concurrent client accounts in an agency or consultancy setting.

Information Security Responsibilities

  • Promote and enforce awareness of key information security practices, including acceptable use of information assets, malware protection, and password security protocols
  • Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets
  • Understand and evaluate how data is stored, processed, or transmitted, ensuring compliance with data privacy and protection standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
  • Ensure data protection measures are integrated throughout the information lifecycle to safeguard sensitive information

Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteensosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. jobs.title: Creative Director
jobs.description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 100,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

The Opportunity

We build the platform that helps high-performing real estate agents stand out in their market. Our own brand has to be the best example of an agent's aspiration for brand design. As we enter our next stage of growth, we're looking for a Creative Director to lead our in-house brand design team and set the creative standard for everything our customers and the market see from us.

You'll lead the design team and decide what great looks like on every surface. You'll have the authority to say a piece isn't ready, and the judgment to explain why in terms a designer can act on. You'll report to the SVP of Partnerships, Brand, and Community, and you'll work with our CEO on the work that carries the brand.

You'll do well here if you can spot the gap between good and great, close it with clear feedback, and still ship on the committed date. You use AI to get more out of a small team, and you hold every asset to the same standard whether an employee, a freelancer, or an agency made it.

What You'll Own

The creative standard

  • Write and publish a quality standard with real examples for each surface, including web, email, video, social, and events, within your first 90 days.
  • Review work and give specific feedback that raises it in a single round of revisions.
  • By day 90, the CEO and SVP, Brand review your team's output and agree that 90% of randomly selected pieces meet the bar.

A brand system that morphs

  • Own a brand system that flexes to the standards of each channel and context, so what good looks like differs by surface while the brand remains unmistakably one brand.
  • Bring every surface up to the new standard by month 6, from website and product imagery to newsletters, YouTube, and our offices.

The team

  • Lead, coach, and grow a small design team of fewer than five direct reports.
  • Decide where in-house talent, freelancers, and outside firms each fit, and hold all of them to the same bar.

Predictable, well-run delivery

  • Run design intake and delivery so requesters always know what is coming and when. By month 6, at least 90% of requests ship by the committed date.
  • Get at least 85% of assets approved within one round of revisions, and end day-before creative notes on delivered work.
  • Keep the team aligned to business priorities, and flag requests that are not aligned early and often.

How You'll Work

You'll work closely with Brand, Growth Marketing, Product Marketing, and Product. You'll take feedback from senior leadership and partner teams, and you'll give it back just as directly. Politics have no place here, and the best work wins the argument.

What We're Looking For

Experience

  • 8+ years in design, with experience leading design teams.
  • A portfolio of luxury or premium brand work that spans web, brand, and motion.

Leadership and mindset

  • Exacting taste and the judgment to tell great work from good work.
  • The ability to define a quality bar, explain it, and coach others to it.
  • Full ownership of the output of the entire design function, including vendors and freelancers.
  • Comfort influencing senior stakeholders, including the CEO.

Technical foundation

  • Command of brand systems across web, email, video, social, and events.
  • Strong process and operational habits for intake, prioritization, and review.

Location

This is a remote role open to candidates in the United States, with a preference for New York, Los Angeles, or Austin.

We're a team of agile and tenacious innovators working collaboratively to drive the industry forward. Together, we build game-changing products that empower modern real estate entrepreneurs to dominate their markets. From award-winning web design to agile SEO solutions to cutting-edge AI tools, we deliver tech that anticipates market shifts and keeps our clients ahead of their competition.

Founded in 2016 by Stanford Business School alum Malte Kramer, Luxury Presence has grown to a global team ranked on the Inc. 5000 fastest-growing companies list three years in a row. More than 20,000 real estate businesses rely on our platform, including 30% of the Wall Street Journal RealTrends top agents and teams. Additionally, many of the industry's most powerful brokerages rely on Luxury Presence as a trusted business partner.

Our founder and CEO was named a 2024 HousingWire Tech Trendsetter, and weâve won multiple Tech100 Awards. jobs.title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Employment type: Full-time
Experience: 4+ years
Reports to: Chris Stella, VP Growth

About Lifeforce

We are in the early stages of a generational shift in how people approach their health. No longer satisfied with the reactive, fragmented care offered by the traditional healthcare system, millions of people are taking a more proactive approach. They want to understand how their bodies work, take control of how they feel and perform, and invest in living longer, healthier lives. Lifeforce is leading this shift as the world's largest longevity medicine program.

Founded alongside clinical and scientific leaders from Cleveland Clinic, Massachusetts General Hospital, and Harvard Medical School, Lifeforce brings together the diagnostics, expertise, and treatments people need to understand and optimize their health, both today and for decades to come. Our comprehensive program combines advanced diagnostics, expert clinicians, dedicated health coaches, and personalized supplement, pharmaceutical, and lifestyle protocols. All delivered from home, at the price of a gym membership.

Overview

Lifeforce is hiring a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own every message a lead or member gets from us after the first click. You'll run email, SMS, push, and in-app messaging across the full journey: turning leads into members, getting new members through their first diagnostics and clinician visit, keeping members engaged with their protocols, and bringing back the ones who drift.

This is a hands-on role. You will build the journeys, write and test the messages, set up the segments, and read the results yourself. You'll use AI tools to move faster on copy, personalization, and analysis, and you'll build a lifecycle program that scales as our membership, clinician network, and Ultimate Longevity Center (ULC) locations grow.

You'll work closely with growth, product, clinical, coaching, and member experience teams. Paid acquisition brings people to the door. You make sure they walk in, stay, and get results.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Nurture & Conversion

Build and run nurture journeys that turn leads from paid, organic, and referral channels into members. Work with the growth team to match messaging to the ads, landing pages, and offers that brought each lead in. Test offers, timing, and content to raise lead-to-member conversion.

Onboarding & Activation

Own the new-member journey from sign-up through first lab draw, results review, and first clinician and coach visits. Cut drop-off at each step by finding where members get stuck and fixing it with clear, timely messages. Partner with member experience and operations so messages match what members actually see and do.

Retention, Engagement & Win-Back

Build programs that keep members engaged with their protocols, follow-up diagnostics, and coaching. Drive adoption of supplements, prescriptions, and other offerings where they fit a member's plan. Run churn-prevention, win-back, and referral programs.

Segmentation, Testing & Analytics

Build segments and triggers from member behavior, lifecycle stage, and program data. Run a steady testing roadmap across subject lines, content, channels, timing, and offers. Own lifecycle reporting: conversion, activation, retention, churn, and revenue by journey. Use AI tools like Claude to draft and personalize content, analyze results, and speed up production.

Platform & Compliance

Own our lifecycle platform setup, data flows, templates, and deliverability. Work with clinical and compliance teams to keep every message accurate and compliant with HIPAA, TCPA, and CAN-SPAM. Document journeys and processes so the program can scale without adding headcount.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with growth on full-funnel strategy and shared conversion goals. Work with product on in-app messaging, onboarding flows, and member data. Bring member insights back to marketing, product, and clinical teams.

What Success Looks Like

  • In your first 90 days: you've audited our current journeys and data, launched a rebuilt lead nurture and new-member onboarding journey, and set up clear reporting on conversion and activation by stage.
  • In your first year: you're running a full lifecycle program from lead to long-term member, with a steady testing cadence, measurable gains in lead-to-member conversion, activation, and retention, and journeys that scale to new markets and ULC locations.

Qualifications

Required

4+ years of lifecycle, CRM, or retention marketing experience in a consumer subscription, DTC, or membership business.   • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar.

  • Er tryg ved at arbejde alene og kan lide at have ansvar.

  • Har gode IT-kundskaber

  • Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale.

Det vigtigste er dog, at du har lyst til at give vores gæster en god oplevelse – også når klokken er mange.

  • En spændende arbejdsplads med gode kolleger.

  • En selvstændig stilling med ansvar og frihed.

  • En hverdag, hvor ikke to nætter nødvendigvis er ens.

  • En del af Milling Hotels, hvor vi arbejder efter værdien om at drive hoteller med sjæl.

Vi glæder os til at byde vores nye natportier velkommen på Milling Hotel Park i Middelfart!

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Revenue Enablement
jobs.description:
Software development is changing fast, and code is no longer written by humans alone. Secure Code Warrior is the AI Software Governance platform that gives organizations visibility into how their software is created, strengthens developer capability, and reduces risk before code reaches production. Built on a decade as the world's leading secure coding training platform, we're trusted by enterprises worldwide. We're a venture-backed company with offices in Australia, the United States, Belgium, Iceland, and the United Kingdom.
Â

We're looking for a self-starter to own revenue enablement for our global go-to-market team across the US, EMEA and APAC. You'll make sure every seller, BDR, sales engineer and customer success manager can explain what we do, run a sharp discovery conversation with a CISO or VP of Engineering, handle the tough objections, and win against the competition.

This role sits in Product Marketing, so you won't just run programs â you'll build the content yourself: product and competitive enablement, objection handling, onboarding and sales plays. You'll work within a small, fast-moving product marketing team where your work shows up in the field within days, not quarters.

What you'll do

Get the field ready for every launch. Turn new products and capabilities into talk tracks, demo paths, short videos and AI-driven self-training modules, so the field knows the story before customers ask.

Make discovery and objection handling a strength. Build discovery guides for the three people in every deal: the CISO or Head of AppSec, the CTO or VP of Engineering, and the Head of AI Governance. Keep a living objection library grounded in real calls, and run the practice that makes it stick.

Track the competition and find where we win. Follow competitor moves and market trends, mine win/loss data and call recordings, and bring that evidence to Product Marketing to sharpen our messaging. Build battlecards and sales plays backed by proof we can show a customer.

Build learning paths and certifications. Create role-based learning paths and certifications for AEs, SEs and CSMs, so everyone is ready before they pitch something new.

Own onboarding, globally. Run one onboarding program for every new GTM hire, from Sydney to San Francisco to Belgium. Set clear ramp milestones and keep making it faster.

Listen first, then build. Spend time with sellers, BDRs, sales leaders, SEs and customer success to understand what they actually need. Test drafts early, ask for feedback and iterate. Measure what gets used and what helps win deals, and retire what doesn't.

Show up at the big moments. Help shape enablement for Revenue Kickoff and product launches across all three regions.

Who you are

A self-starter. You see what needs doing and do it. You don't need a detailed brief or a big team behind you, and you're happiest building something from a blank page.

A collaborator who asks before building. You'd rather spend an hour with a seller than a week guessing. You ask for feedback early and often, you deliver what the team needs, and you never build in a vacuum and hand it down.

Decisive, with conviction. Listening doesn't mean building by committee. You know which feedback to act on and which to set aside, and you'll move on instinct with limited input rather than wait for consensus. Strong opinions don't knock you off course: you stick with what you know will work, and you say no, kindly and clearly, to what won't.

Crisp and clear. You can turn a complex technical product into something a seller can say in 30 seconds and a CISO will care about. You write tight and cut what doesn't earn its place.

Energized by pace. Our market moves every week. Priorities shift, new competitors appear, AI changes the rules. You find that exciting, not overwhelming, and you know how to ship something good fast and improve it later.

Curious about AI. You don't need to be an expert today, but you're excited to make AI part of how you work. We'll invest in your skills, and you'll help us figure out how AI can make enablement faster and better.

What you bring

6â9 years in revenue or sales enablement, sales engineering, product marketing or another customer-facing role at a B2B software company

3+ years in cybersecurity, application security or DevSecOps, with a real understanding of how CISOs, AppSec leaders and engineering executives evaluate and buy

A portfolio of enablement content you built yourself â talk tracks, demo scripts, battlecards, training â and evidence of what it changed

Experience building onboarding and discovery or objection-handling programs for Enterprise and mid-market sales teams

Comfort with technical topics: the software development lifecycle, code security and AI/LLMs

Experience enabling teams across time zones, with a strong instinct for content people can use on their own

Familiarity with a qualification methodology such as MEDDPICC or Command of the Message, and tools like Salesforce and Clari

Nice to have

Competitive intelligence or product marketing experience

A background as a sales engineer or seller

Experience at a fast-growing company where you were the first or only person in your function

Why you'll like it here

Wide scope, real impact. You'll own enablement end to end and see your work change deals quickly.

A direct line to messaging. What you learn in the field shapes how SCW talks about itself.

Backup when you need it. You'll work alongside a Product Marketing team and SCW's AI Center of Excellence, which will help you build your AI skills and workflows.

A market that matters. AI is changing how software gets built, and security leaders need help keeping up. You'll be helping them do it.

Location

This is a remote role based in the US. We strongly prefer candidates in the Pacific Time zone, so you can work with teams in EMEA in the morning and APAC in the afternoon. Some travel for Revenue Kickoff and regional events.

You're joining us at an exciting stage of our journey, and youâre a key piece to what comes next. Expect real room to create impact and deliver on your ideas. The pace is quick and the bar is high; in return, you get genuine ownership and the kind of growth that only comes from building something that matters.

We also know you do your best work when you're rested and energized. Flexibility here runs on trust: we trust you to deliver when it counts, and we trust you to take the time you need to recharge. With teammates around the world, your hours can flex to fit your life, backed by generous leave and work-from-home options that help you make work work for you.

You'll join a tight-knit team that values humility and giving back, both to the community and to each other. Making the world a little brighter as we make it more secure is part of being a Warrior.

We live and work by the Warrior Code. It means getting feedback you can trust, shared without fear. It means no genius jerks: how you treat people counts as much as what you deliver. We do what we say we'll do, we celebrate the wins properly, and we do the right thing even when no one's watching. Come as you are, bring your best, and we'll do the same.

jobs.title: Director, Global Platforms
jobs.description: Nokian Tyres is a Finnish company that as the first in the world invented the winter tire in 1934. Through your solution owners, own the roadmaps, solution quality and full lifecycle, from design and delivery through operation, upgrades and retirement. Align platform designs and roadmaps with the standards governed by Enterprise Architecture.- Oversee platform-specific security, privacy, continuity and audit readiness. Work with IT Operations and Information Security on readiness, resilience, incidents and controls. Application management services partners carry out day-to-day support, maintenance and agreed changes for contracted applications.- Plan portfolio finances and manage lifecycle costs and strategic suppliers within your delegated authority.- Use measures of business value, adoption, delivery, cost, risk and service performance to guide priorities and improve results.To be successful in this role, you will have- Experience leading enterprise application or platform portfolios and developing teams in a global matrix organization.- A track record of modernizing and integrating enterprise applications and managing them through their lifecycle.- Experience managing budgets and outsourced application delivery.- The ability to explain investment and delivery options to business and technical leaders.Experience in manufacturing or another industrial environment is an advantage.Key competenciesYou take ownership of outcomes and make clear decisions when priorities compete. You work across functions and regions to build agreement, and you coach solution owners to make decisions and follow through.- Strategic and operational leadership- Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills- Ability to lead change and drive continuous improvement- Resilient, analytical, and solution-oriented mindsetOur way of workingOur talented people, energizing collaboration, and agile way of working ensure that we achieve great results together. We believe in involvement and active ownership. Nokian Tyres wants everyone to have both the power and the opportunity to influence matters and we support your professional growth. We value different experiences and competencies. They play a key role in the development of the company as well as our new, innovative solutions.Are you interested in joining our team?Please submit your application, including your CV and salary request, by December 14, 2026.We will start interviews as applications are received, so we encourage you to apply early.For further information please contact:Timmy McLellan, email timmy.mclellan@nokiantyres.com.Location / CountryNokia/Helsinki, Finland.

jobs.title: Horticulture worker
jobs.description: **We Are Hiring 1–2 Experienced Plant Nursery Workers for the 2027 Growing Season**We are looking for 1–2 experienced plant nursery workers to join our team for the 2027 growing season. Employment is expected to begin in April and continue until October 2027. The exact starting date will be agreed upon later.Our plant nursery is located in the beautiful, peaceful countryside of Karstula, near the border between Central Finland and South Ostrobothnia. Here, you can enjoy working with plants in a natural, rural setting, far from the hustle and bustle of city life.**What Does the Job Involve?**The main duties include picking and packing customers' online orders and preparing plants for dispatch. During the summer months, the work also involves potting, plant care, weeding and other general nursery duties.We grow and sell a wide variety of garden plants, including coniferous and deciduous trees, apple trees and other fruit trees, herbaceous perennials and various shrubs.Good knowledge of plants and cultivars is essential, including the ability to identify different species and varieties. Selecting the correct plants and handling customer orders carefully are important parts of the daily work. The pace can be busy during peak season, so we value people who work efficiently and take a practical, hands-on approach.**What Are We Looking For?**- Previous work experience and practical skills in horticulture or plant nursery work - Good knowledge of plants and cultivars - A genuine interest in plants and a willingness to expand your plant knowledge - An efficient, careful and self-motivated approach to work - The ability to work both independently and as part of a team - The ability to communicate in either Finnish or English We are primarily looking for people who already have practical experience working with plants and are comfortable working efficiently during busy periods.**What Do We Offer?**We offer varied, hands-on work in a plant nursery with a team of approximately 15 people. You will have the opportunity to use your existing skills while expanding your knowledge of a wide range of plants.We provide training and guidance to help new employees become familiar with their duties.This is a seasonal position, expected to run from April to October 2027.The successful applicant must have the right to work in Finland as a plant nursery worker by the start date.**Working Hours and Pay**Normal working hours are:- Monday to Thursday: 7:30 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. - Friday: 7:30 a.m. – 2:00 p.m. Employment terms and conditions are based on the **Finnish collective agreement for the horticultural sector (puutarha-alan työehtosopimus, TES)**, negotiated between Maaseudun Työnantajaliitto (Rural Employers' Association) and Teollisuusliitto (Finnish Industrial Union).The provisional hourly wage is **€9.87–€10.78**, depending on qualifications and previous work experience. Pay and other employment conditions will be determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement.**Accommodation and Transportation**Accommodation can be arranged near the nursery if needed, starting from April 2027. A small accommodation fee applies.The nursery is located in a rural area, approximately 18 kilometres from the nearest shops and services. Having access to your own car makes travelling and running errands easier.Seasonal employees may also borrow a **manual-transmission car** for shopping trips.If you have experience in horticulture, good plant knowledge and a practical, hardworking attitude, we would be happy to hear from you!**Join our team for the 2027 growing season!**

jobs.title: DIAS Fellow in Integrated Photonics for Computing and Quantum Technologies
jobs.description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS) and SDU Microelectronics, part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME), Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) seek an outstanding candidate to fill a tenure track Fellow (Assistant Professor level) position in the field of Integrated Photonics for Computing and Quantum Technologies. The candidate is expected to start on September 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter, in agreement with the successful candidate. 

We are looking for a researcher with clear potential for research excellence who thrives in and is inspired by interdisciplinary collaboration. The ideal candidate will be expected to contribute to high-quality research in their field while embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven inquiry and interdisciplinary dialogue. The successful candidate should have a strong and promising research profile, with potential for attracting external research funding, and a demonstrated ability to work across disciplines. The candidate will be attached to both IME and DIAS and should be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU. Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard assistant professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities. 

 

Who are we looking for

We seek an experimental researcher whose core expertise is photonic integrated circuits (PICs) and chip-scale photonic technologies. The Fellow will establish an independent, internationally competitive research programme that advances integrated photonic devices, circuits and platforms and uses them to explore emerging computing and quantum technologies.

The position is intentionally anchored in photonic chip technology rather than in a single application domain. Depending on the candidate’s expertise and research vision, the programme may address photonic AI and optical computing, programmable photonic processors, optical interconnects and chip-to-chip communication, quantum photonic circuits and photonic quantum computing, or closely related directions. Candidates are not expected to cover all of these areas.

The Fellow will be based at SDU’s main campus in Odense and will be jointly embedded in SDU Microelectronics at IME and the interdisciplinary environment of DIAS.

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue.

  • A strong commitment to interdisciplinary collaboration, contributing to research that bridges multiple fields. 

  • Strong interest in driving internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Engagement in various forms of research dissemination, including interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

 

Research Focus Areas 

The scientific core of the position is the design, realization and experimental validation of integrated photonic technologies. We are particularly interested in candidates who can connect device- and circuit-level innovation to new computing architectures or quantum systems.

Relevant research directions may include, but are not limited to:

  • Photonic integrated circuits (PIC) on silicon, silicon nitride, III–V, thin-film lithium niobate, or other emerging and heterogeneous photonic platforms.

  • Programmable photonic circuits, reconfigurable interferometric or resonator-based networks, nonlinear photonic devices, and integrated sources, modulators and detectors.

  • Photonic and optical computing, including photonic neural networks, optical matrix operations, neuromorphic photonics, analog optical computing, or other hardware approaches for AI and scientific computing.

  • Optical I/O, chip-to-chip optical links, photonic chiplets, co-packaged optics, and energy-efficient interconnects for future computing systems.

  • Quantum photonic integrated circuits, including integrated generation, manipulation, routing and detection of non-classical light, programmable quantum photonics, quantum interconnects, or photonic approaches to quantum information processing and computing.

  • Electronic-photonic co-design, control and readout, packaging and heterogeneous integration linking PICs with CMOS or other electronic technologies.

  • A successful candidate may be strongest in only part of this landscape. The central requirement is a convincing research identity in integrated photonic chip technology and a clear vision for how that expertise can open new scientific questions in computing, quantum technologies, or both.

 

Qualifications

We are looking for a researcher with a clear trajectory toward international research excellence and with the curiosity to build bridges between disciplines. The successful candidate should be able to formulate an independent scientific agenda while engaging constructively with both engineering and fundamental-science environments.

Applicants should demonstrate:

  • A PhD or equivalent qualification in electrical engineering, photonics, applied physics, quantum engineering, materials science, or another closely related field, obtained by the application deadline.

  • Demonstrated research experience gained in diverse institutional and international environments, with a track record of establishing an independent research profile and collaborations beyond the candidate’s current institutional setting.

  • A strong experimental research profile in photonic integrated circuits or closely related chip-scale photonic technologies.

  • Evidence of expertise in PIC design, fabrication or foundry-based realization, experimental characterization, heterogeneous integration, or a closely related photonic-chip workflow.

  • High-quality research output appropriate to career stage and a clear potential to establish an independent and internationally visible research programme.

  • A credible vision for applying integrated photonics to emerging computing and/or quantum technologies.

  • Potential to attract competitive external research funding and to develop international academic and industrial collaborations.

  • A genuine interest in boundary-crossing research and in contributing actively to the intellectual life of DIAS.

  • Strong communication skills and fluency in written and spoken English.

  • Experience with electronic-photonic co-design, advanced packaging, nonlinear photonics, quantum photonics, photonic computing, optical interconnects, or semiconductor foundry ecosystems will be considered an advantage where relevant to the candidate’s proposed programme.

 

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally.   

 

About SDU Microelectronics:

SDU Microelectronics is a growing research section within the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering. The section develops integrated circuits and hardware systems for emerging applications and brings together expertise in analog and mixed-signal IC design, neuromorphic and AI hardware, spintronics, sensing, cryogenic electronics and advanced computing systems.

The new Fellow will add a strong photonic-chip dimension to this environment. This creates direct opportunities for joint research in electronic-photonic co-design, photonic accelerators, optical interfaces for AI systems, cryogenic and quantum interfaces, heterogeneous integration, and new computing architectures that combine electronic, photonic and other emerging technologies.

The environment provides access to electronic design, measurement and system-prototyping capabilities and to national and international research and industry networks in semiconductors, photonics and quantum technologies. The Fellow will be encouraged to build an independent group and external funding portfolio while contributing to the long-term development of integrated photonics at SDU.

Read more: SDU Microelectronics (SDU)

 

Additional information

For further information about being a fellow at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk.

For questions about the scientific profile and SDU Microelectronics, please contact Professor Farshad Moradi, Head of SDU Microelectronics: email: moradi@sdu.dk or +45 5386 9444.

 

Application, salary, and employment terms

The position is based at SDU Microelectronics, Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME), in Odense and includes regular participation in DIAS and interdisciplinary collaboration in Odense regularly.

Employment is governed by the collective agreement between the Danish Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC) and the provisions for tenure track assistant professor as described herein. Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

The salary comprises a seniority-based base salary and a centrally agreed supplement.

Additional supplements may be negotiated locally.

As of 1 August 2026, the annual salary for an Assistant Professor is DKK 480,224.96 (salary level 6), consisting of a base salary of DKK 417,456 and a supplement of DKK 62,768.96.

All amounts are stated before tax, before added pension (18.07%), and any additional supplements. Pension contributions are paid by SDU, and both salary components (the annual salary and the supplement) are pensionable. For more details on salary and taxation, please see Further information on salary and taxation.

 

 

The tenure track programme is aimed at the most talented scholars who have established a high level in their current research and other professional work, and those who possess exceptional potential to achieve the highest international level within their research area. 

Candidates enter at the assistant professor level (up to six years) and, upon successful completion, will be promoted to a permanent position as associate professor, subject to a positive assessment by an expert committee.  This evaluation is based on an overall assessment of the candidate's academic achievements and potential. 

Indicators of relevant scholarly merits include documented ability to develop an independent and internationally recognized research profile, deliver high-quality teaching and supervision, contribute actively to the academic community, and demonstrate the potential to secure competitive external research funding and build an ambitious research programme. The evaluation may also consider the candidate's contributions to the strategic and organizational development of the department, including a willingness to engage in academic leadership and administrative responsibilities. 

As part of the tenure-track programme, the Assistant Professor is expected to complete SDU's Lecturer Training Programme before the evaluation, unless an equivalent university-level programme has already been completed at another institution.

The programme includes annual performance reviews, a midterm evaluation by an expert panel, and a final academic assessment. If the final assessment is positive, the candidate will progress to a permanent position as associate professor. If the final evaluation is negative, the assistant professor may request one additional assessment within the last six months of employment. The tenure track period may be extended in connection with maternity, paternity, or adoption leave.

Equal opportunity employmentThe University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

Please go to our website for full information on how to apply.

The application deadline is 28th of February 2027 at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST)
