jobs.title: Knowledge Engineer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Knowledge Engineer based in the United States.

The Knowledge Engineer will play a pivotal role in building the knowledge infrastructure and AI-powered systems that support business operations and customer experiences. In this role, you will design and maintain trusted knowledge repositories, intelligent AI agents, and automated workflows that help teams access accurate information and streamline everyday tasks. Working across departments such as Support, Customer Success, Finance, Product, and Engineering, you will transform fragmented business knowledge into structured, AI-accessible resources. You will also develop secure integrations and intelligent automation solutions that enable AI systems to perform routine activities while maintaining appropriate human oversight. By combining expertise in AI engineering, data architecture, and knowledge management, you will help establish scalable and reliable AI capabilities across the organization. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to an AI-first transformation within a collaborative, technology-driven environment.

Accountabilities:

Design, develop, and maintain a centralized, trusted knowledge infrastructure that makes product documentation, technical resources, business policies, operational procedures, and training materials accessible to AI systems. Consolidate and organize knowledge from multiple platforms, including Google Drive, Confluence, Jira, Salesforce, Snowflake, Omni, HubSpot, Zendesk, Highspot, and Slack, ensuring that each source has clear ownership and scheduled review dates. Collaborate with Data and Business Insights teams to make existing business data AI-ready by providing curated, read-only Snowflake views and standardized metric definitions that align with established reporting systems. Build, deploy, and maintain AI agents and automated workflows for business functions such as customer support ticket triage, renewal research, accounts payable processing, and software reviews. Develop and manage connectors, APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, and automation integrations that allow AI agents to interact securely with business systems while enforcing appropriate permissions, human approvals, and audit trails. Create automated pipelines that identify changes in documentation, business systems, and operational processes, ensuring that knowledge repositories, AI agents, and workflows remain accurate and up to date. Structure and optimize information for AI retrieval through taxonomy development, metadata management, content chunking, tagging, embeddings, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques. Establish evaluation frameworks and quality assurance processes to measure AI agent accuracy, detect outdated or conflicting information, and minimize hallucinations before and after deployment. Maintain a centralized registry of approved AI connectors, prompts, plugins, reusable skills, and workflows to ensure that AI solutions remain secure, standardized, and company-owned. Implement and manage access controls, data permissions, and security practices to protect sensitive information and ensure compliance with internal IT and security requirements. Document technical architecture, workflows, integration standards, and operational processes while staying informed about emerging AI technologies and industry best practices. Monitor AI usage, operational costs, adoption, and feedback to identify knowledge gaps, improve answer quality, and prioritize future enhancements. Partner with subject-matter experts across Support, Customer Success, Finance, Accounting, Revenue Operations, Product, and Engineering to capture institutional knowledge, map business processes, and establish content ownership. Collaborate with training teams, Product Marketing, and departmental AI champions to transform product documentation, customer support resources, and training materials into AI-accessible knowledge for internal teams and external customers. Integrate AI-powered tools into employee and customer training programs to improve knowledge sharing, self-service capabilities, and operational efficiency.

Requirements:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. At least 5 years of experience in knowledge engineering, AI/ML engineering, data engineering, analytics engineering, solutions engineering, or technical knowledge management. Hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-ready AI agents and agentic workflows using large language model platforms and APIs such as Claude, OpenAI, or Gemini. Practical knowledge of agent frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and AI-driven automation architectures. Strong experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), GraphRAG, vector databases, embeddings, prompt engineering, data pipelines, and AI output evaluation. Proficiency in Python or JavaScript and SQL, with a solid understanding of APIs, system integrations, and automation platforms such as Zapier, Workato, or n8n. Experience working with cloud data warehouses and semantic data layers, particularly Snowflake, dbt, or business intelligence platforms such as Omni. Familiarity with knowledge management platforms and enterprise SaaS applications, including Confluence, Notion, Google Workspace, Jira, Salesforce, NetSuite, or Zendesk. Strong information architecture and knowledge organization skills, with exceptional attention to detail and content accuracy. Understanding of data privacy, information security, and access control principles for AI systems, including human-in-the-loop approval processes and audit logging. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Ability to understand business processes, collaborate with subject-matter experts, and translate operational needs into practical technical solutions. Familiarity with lead generation, marketing technology (MarTech), or data products is considered an advantage. Experience developing customer-facing knowledge bases, technical product documentation, or training content is a plus. Willingness to travel approximately 5â10% of the time.

Benefits:

Full-time remote working arrangement. Opportunity to contribute to a company-wide AI transformation and help establish the foundations of an AI-first operating model. High-impact technical role with the opportunity to design and implement production AI agents and intelligent automation workflows. Exposure to modern AI technologies, including large language models, RAG, GraphRAG, MCP, and advanced data integration solutions. Cross-functional collaboration with experienced professionals across engineering, data, finance, product, and customer-facing teams. Coordinate emergency preparedness and response arrangements, ensuring appropriate plans and procedures are in place. - Provide expert EHS advice and guidance to senior management, construction teams and subcontractors. - Promote environmental awareness and ensure appropriate management of environmental risks and impacts arising from project activities. Represent the project in EHS-related discussions with clients, senior management, regulatory authorities and other relevant stakeholders.**Requirements**- Extensive professional experience (10+ years) in Environment, Health and Safety management within large-scale construction, industrial or infrastructure projects. - Experience in managing EHS requirements throughout construction and commissioning phases. - Good understanding of occupational health, environmental management and applicable regulatory requirements. - Experience in conducting audits, inspections, incident investigations and performance reviews. - Ability to interpret regulatory and contractual requirements and translate them into practical project-level EHS procedures and plans. - Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence and engage personnel at all organisational levels. - Ability to work effectively in an international, multidisciplinary project environment. **Fluent professional English, both written and spoken.**- Desirable Qualifications and Experience - Experience in construction-related environmental management and sustainability initiatives. - Recognised professional qualifications in occupational health and safety, such as NEBOSH Diploma or equivalent. - The position is limited to 4 years.

The research unit

The Research Unit of Orthopaedic Surgery provides a dynamic and multidisciplinary research environment and is engaged in a broad range of research activities. Our research spans clinical and experimental as well as epidemiological research, including registry-based research and accident analysis.

Our team consists of both scientific and technical/administrative staff, including professors, postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, research nurses, secretaries and a laboratory technician.

We have extensive collaborations with other medical specialties and research groups, both nationally and internationally, fostering interdisciplinary research and knowledge exchange.

Research tasks

  • Serve as project lead for the REPLAN research project, with responsibility for its scientific direction, coordination, and overall progress. The REPLAN project investigates whether routine patellar resurfacing reduces patient dissatisfaction and knee pain compared with non-resurfacing in contemporary primary total knee arthroplasty. 

  • Supervise a PhD student, including providing scientific guidance and supporting the progress and completion of the PhD project.

  • Prepare and publish scientific manuscripts in peer-reviewed international journals and present research findings at national and international conferences.

Teaching tasks

  • Contribute to teaching medical students and clinical biomechanics students within orthopaedic surgery, with particular emphasis on knee surgery. 

Expectations and qualifications

The job involves research, professional development, research education, research-based teaching, including exams, supervision within the field of knee surgery. 

The candidate who is hired must complete a Lecturer Training Programme during the period of employment.

The assistant professor must have documented research experience within the area of knee arthroplasty. 

In addition, good cooperation skills are expected in order to further the development of research in the areas mentioned above, both interdisciplinary as well as nationally and internationally. International partners are an advantage, but not a requirement.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information

Further information about the position can be obtained from Head of Research at The Research Unit of Orthopaedic Surgery, Martin Lindberg-Larsen, e-mail: martin.lindberg-larsen@rsyd.dk, phone: +45 2521 3900 or Head of Department of Clinical Research, Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 6550 3477.

Application deadline

December 08, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Assistant Professor is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed assistant professor allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Odense University Hospital, J.B. Winsløws Vej 4, 5000 Odense C.   

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (MsC and Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

  • An explanation other qualification relevant to the post

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Drømmer du om et sabbatår i udlandet i 2027? Vi betaler din flybillet - Book et kald i dag.
jobs.description:
Drømmer du om et sabbatår i udlandet? Vi betaler din flybillet hvis du vil afsted i februar 2027.

Et sabbatår i udlandet er for mange en livsforandrende oplevelse. Du får mulighed for at arbejde i et nyt land, møde mennesker fra hele verden, udvikle dig personligt og styrke dit CV med international erfaring. Men det, som de fleste ikke ved, er hvor tidligt processen faktisk bør starte.

Hvis du drømmer om at rejse ud i vinteren 2027, så er det allerede nu, du skal tage de første skridt. De bedste jobmuligheder, de mest stabile projekter og de mest attraktive destinationer bliver nemlig fyldt langt før afrejse. Samtidig tager det tid at finde det rette match, gennemføre interviews og få styr på alle praktiske detaljer.

Hvorfor starte processen nu – hvis du vil afsted i 2027?

1. Du får adgang til de bedste stillinger

Virksomhederne vi samarbejder med rekrutterer løbende, og mange stillinger bliver besat flere måneder før opstart. Starter du processen nu, øger du chancen for at få præcis den rolle og det land, du ønsker.

2. Du sikrer en glidende overgang efter studiet

Når du starter i god tid, kan du planlægge dit sabbatår uden tidspres. Du får ro til at afslutte dit studie, nyde efteråret og samtidig være klar til at rejse ud i januar — uden at skulle haste gennem interviews og praktiske forberedelser.

3. Vi kan matche dig med den helt rigtige virksomhed

Vi arbejder ikke med “første og bedste” løsning. Vi matcher dig med virksomheder, der passer til dine ønsker, dine styrker og dine mål for sabbatåret. Det kræver tid — og det er en klar fordel at starte før alle andre.

4. Du får fuld rådgivning hele vejen

Fra første samtale til du står på flyet, hjælper vi dig med:

  • Jobmuligheder

  • Kontrakt og løn

  • Bolig og økonomi

  • Kultur og hverdagsliv

  • Interviewforberedelse

  • Praktiske forhold som bank, skat og relocation

Jo tidligere du starter, desto mere ro og overblik får du.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Du kan se hele oversigten her: https://www.jobhuntworldwide.com/sabbataar-udlandet-gode-tips

Kort sagt får du:

  • Gratis og uforpligtende samtale

  • Hjælp til at finde det rette job i udlandet

  • Professionel interviewforberedelse

  • Rådgivning om bolig, økonomi og kontrakt

  • Relocation‑support (fly, hotel, firmabolig m.m.)

  • Løbende kontakt med relevante virksomheder

  • Tryghed og støtte hele vejen til afrejse

Du kan booke en samtale med os allerede i dag, og så starter vi løbende interviews op med de virksomheder, der passer til dine ønsker og din profil.

Book en samtale her: Book et kald

jobs.title: Varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja / ECEC Teacher
jobs.description: Sinä uusia mahdollisuuksia tutkaileva varhaiskasvatuksen opettaja,Sunshine Early Learning Centren uusi Hervantajärven päiväkoti etsii kahta uutta varhaiskasvatuksen opettajaa liittymään kansainväliseen tiimiimme, sekä englanninkieliseen että suomenkieliseen kielirikasteiseen ryhmään.Olisitko sinä etsimämme innostunut tiimipelaaja ja työstäsi ylpeä ammattilainen? Omaatko erinomaisen englannin kielen taidon, jota haluat hyödyntää ammatillisesti?Me Sunshinessa etsimme joukkoomme varhaiskasvatusalan ammattilaisia, jotka nauttivat aidosti työskentelystä lasten ja perheiden kanssa, arvostavat tiimityötä, edistävät positiivista ja turvallista työilmapiiriä sekä ovat kunnianhimoisia laadukkaan pedagogisen toiminnan ja oppimisympäristön kehittäjiä.Yrityksemme arvot laatu, yhteisöllisyys ja ilo ohjaavat kaikkea toimintaamme ja vuorovaikutustamme henkilöstön, lasten ja perheiden kanssa.Varhaiskasvatuksen opettajana ja tiiminvetäjänä vastaat pedagogisen toiminnan suunnittelusta, toteuttamisesta ja arvioinnista, lasten kasvun, oppimisen ja hyvinvoinnin tukemisesta sekä tiimisi päivittäisen pedagogisen työn ohjaamisesta. Varhaiskasvatussuunnitelman perusteiden syvällinen tuntemus on erittäin tärkeää.Työsi tukena toimivat moniammatillinen tiimi, muut opettajat sekä päiväkodin johtaja.Hervantajärven päiväkodissa toimitaan sekä suomeksi että englanniksi. Päiväkodissa toimii täysin englanninkielisiä ryhmiä, joissa työskentelevillä opettajilla tulee olla erinomainen englannin kielen taito. Kielirikasteisissa ryhmissä englannin kieltä tuodaan arkeen esimerkiksi laulaen, leikkien ja lorutellen, toiminnan ollessa muutoin suomenkielistä.Kaikki yksikössä työskentelevät tarvitsevat sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa myös päivittäisissä kohtaamisissa asiakasperheiden kanssa sekä kansainvälisessä työyhteisössä toimittaessa.Hervantajärven päiväkoti on aloittanut toimintansa elokuussa 2026. Varhaiskasvatustoiminnan ehdoilla suunniteltu hirsirakenteinen aistiystävällinen rakennus tukee korkealaatuisen varhaiskasvatustoiminnan toteuttamista. jobs.title: Thon Gruppen søker Kategorisjef til innkjøpsavdelingen
jobs.description:
Thon Gruppen søker en erfaren, analytisk og kommersielt sterk Kategorisjef innkjøp til vår sentrale innkjøpsavdeling. Du blir en del av et team på åtte personer som arbeider med strategisk innkjøp på tvers av konsernets virksomhetsområder. Hovedvekten av innkjøpsaktiviteten er i Norge, men enkelte avtaler og innkjøpsprosesser berører også våre virksomheter i Sverige, Belgia og Nederland.

Om rollen

Som kategorisjef innkjøp leder du strategiske innkjøpsprosesser fra analyse og strategi, til konkurranse, forhandling og implementering. Du får hovedansvar for Mat & Drikke, et område med et innkjøpsvolum på rundt 400 MNOK, og en sentral rolle i å videreutvikle kategorien på tvers av konsernet. Du skal følge opp og videreutvikle kategoristrategien i tett samarbeid med F&B, relevante brukermiljøer og leverandører.

Dine ansvarsområder vil blant annet innebære:

  • Utvikle og følge opp kategoristrategien for mat og drikke, samt lede strategiske innkjøpsprosesser, konkurranser og forhandlinger

  • Forvalte og videreutvikle eksisterende avtaler og leverandørsamarbeid

  • Analysere priser, volum, kostnadsdrivere og markedsutvikling og identifisere og realisere kommersielle forbedringer og besparelser

  • Lede innkjøpsprosjekter i samarbeid med interne fagmiljøer og eksterne aktører

  • Bidra til økt avtalelojalitet og ansvarlige og bærekraftige innkjøp

Mat og drikke vil være ditt viktigste ansvarsområde, men ikke det eneste. Innkjøpsavdelingen arbeider med et bredt spekter av kategorier, og du vil også få mulighet til å lede innkjøpsprosesser innen andre områder.

Muligheter i rollen

I denne rollen får du jobbe med store innkjøpsvolumer og problemstillinger som berører flere deler av konsernet. Innkjøpsavdelingen har en bred kontaktflate, og stillingen gir derfor et godt innblikk i Thon Gruppen og de ulike virksomhetsområdene. Du får samtidig faglig ansvar og handlingsrom til å drive egne prosesser og påvirke hvordan kategorien utvikles videre. Som en del av et kompetent fagmiljø med god samarbeidskultur får du en variert arbeidshverdag med korte beslutningsveier.

Hvem vi ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som har solid erfaring med strategisk og kommersielt innkjøp. Du forstår hvordan priser og prismodeller bygges opp, hvilke faktorer som driver kostnadene og hvor de kommersielle handlingsrommene ligger. Du har god forståelse for råvarepriser, volum, logistikk og markedsutvikling og bruker denne innsikten aktivt i konkurranser, forhandlinger og avtaleoppfølging. Kjennskap til mat- og drikkebransjen og relevante leverandørmarkeder er en fordel. Du er analytisk og strukturert, samtidig som du er nysgjerrig, initiativrik og fleksibel. Du tar eierskap, driver prosesser og bygger gode relasjoner med både leverandører og interne fagmiljøer. Du har gode kommunikasjonsferdigheter på norsk og engelsk.

Relevant høyere utdanning innen økonomi, innkjøp, logistikk eller tilsvarende er ønskelig, men relevant erfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning. Interesse for hvordan AI og digitale verktøy kan brukes til bedre analyser og mer effektive innkjøpsprosesser er en fordel.

Interessert?

GreatPeople bistår Thon Gruppen i denne rekrutteringen. Ta kontakt med Christina Waale Salomaa (cws@greatpeople.no) eller Henriette Warme Drake (hwd@greatpeople.no) dersom du har spørsmål eller behov for tilrettelegging i rekrutteringsprosessen.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Våre virksomhetsområder

Thon Gruppen er et av Norges største privateide konsern, eid av Thon Stiftelsen. Vi driver innen hotell, eiendom, og servering, og har rundt 3 000 årsverk.

Vi er engasjert i:

Thon Hotels: En av Norges største hotellkjeder, med over 90 hoteller i Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Belgia og Nederland.

Thon Eiendom: Norges største private eiendomsaktør med utleie og salg av bolig- og næringseiendom, samt drift av over 80 kjøpesentre i Norge og Sverige.

Resthon: Vår serveringsvirksomhet med barer og restauranter – fra gastropuber til spillkonsepter – med fokus på god mat og god stemning. Les mer

    Omsetningen i 2024 var ca. 13,9 milliarder kroner. Les mer om konsernet her: thon.no/om

    Hvorfor jobbe hos oss?
    • Et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med fokus på bærekraft og langsiktighet
    • Gode utviklings- og karrieremuligheter, med fokus på intern rekruttering
    • Mulighet til å jobbe i et konsern med stor bredde og mange ulike roller

    Vi er opptatt av mangfold og likestilling, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke – uansett alder, kjønn, bakgrunn eller funksjonsevne.

    Les mer om hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss: thon.no/karriere

    Samfunnsansvar og bærekraft

    Gjennom Thon Stiftelsen og i vår daglige drift jobber vi aktivt med:

    • Deltakelse i FNs Global Compact
    • Miljøfyrtårn-sertifisering av våre hoteller
    • Reduksjon av matsvinn
    • Fokus på likestilling og mangfold
    • Støtte til forskning og allmennyttige formål

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn AI ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re someone who loves helping customers build workflows that solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

jobs.title: Bokförare / Kirjanpitäjä, Korsholm
jobs.description: Haemme kokenutta ja tilinpäätöstaitoista kirjanpitäjää vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Mustasaareen – tarjolla joustava työaika (sovittavissa 3–5 pv/vko), laaja etätyömahdollisuus, palkkaus 2 500–4 000 €/kk kokopäivätyössä (neuvoteltavissa osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan) sekä Epassi-henkilöstöetu!Tehtävän työaika on sovittavissa 3–5 päivää viikossa valittavan tekijän tilanteen ja toiveiden mukaan. Työtä tehdään pääosin etänä, ja Mustasaaren konttorilla työskennellään silloin tällöin muutamina päivinä. Työkielenä on ruotsi, ja suomen kielen taito katsotaan selkeäksi eduksi.Odotamme sinulta: * Vankkaa kokemusta kirjanpidon tehtävistä sekä itsenäistä tilinpäätöstaitoa * Sujuvaa ruotsin kielen taitoa (suomen kielen taito katsotaan mielellään eduksi) * Kokemusta sähköisistä taloushallinnon ohjelmistoista – käytössä ovat Netvisor, Fennoa ja EasorTarjoamme sinulle: * Vakituisen työsuhteen (toistaiseksi voimassa oleva) * Joustavan työajan (sovittavissa 3–5 pv/vko) * Laajan etätyömahdollisuuden yhdistettynä satunnaisiin konttoripäiviin Mustasaaressa * Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen: Kokopäivätyöntekijälle 2 500–4 000 €/kk, neuvotellaan kokemuksen ja osaamisen mukaan (Henkilöstöalan TES / HELA) * Henkilöstöedut: Epassi-henkilöstöetu ja luotettavan työnantajan tuen * Sijainti: Mustasaari (etätyömahdollisuus, joitain päiviä konttorilla silloin tällöin) * Työsuhde: Vakituinen (toistaiseksi voimassa oleva), työaika sovittavissa 3–5 pv/vko * Palkkaus: 2 500–4 000 €/kk (kokopäivätyö) / neuvoteltavissa (Henkilöstöalan TES / HELA) * Edut: Epassi-henkilöstöetu * Aloitus: Sopimuksen mukaan / mahdollisimman pianTyöstä ja Duuri-tiimistä työnantajana (sekä tarjoamistamme henkilöstöeduista, mm. Epassi) kuulet lisää haastattelussa.Täytä hakemus oheisen linkin kautta, niin olemme sinuun yhteydessä ja sovitaan aika työhaastattelulle. Haastattelut aloitetaan heti ja valinta saatetaan tehdä jo hakuaikana. Odotamme hakemustasi!Bokförare – KorsholmVi söker en erfaren och bokslutskunnig bokförare för en tillsvidareanställning i Korsholm – vi erbjuder flexibel arbetstid (enligt överenskommelse 3–5 dagar/vecka), goda möjligheter till distansarbete, en lön på 2 500–4 000 €/mån för heltidsarbete (förhandlingsbar enligt erfarenhet och kompetens) samt Epassi-personalförmån!Arbetstiden är enligt överenskommelse 3–5 dagar i veckan utifrån den valda personens situation och önskemål. Arbetet utförs huvudsakligen på distans, med enstaka dagar på kontoret i Korsholm då och då. Arbetsspråket är svenska, och kunskaper i finska ses som en klar fördel.Vi förväntar oss av dig: * Gedigen erfarenhet av bokföringsuppgifter samt självständig bokslutskompetens * Flytande kunskaper i svenska (kunskaper i finska ses gärna som en fördel) * Erfarenhet av digitala ekonomiförvaltningsprogram – vi använder Netvisor, Fennoa och EasorVi erbjuder dig: * En tillsvidareanställning (fast anställning) * Flexibel arbetstid (enligt överenskommelse 3–5 dagar/vecka) * Goda möjligheter till distansarbete kombinerat med enstaka kontorsdagar i Korsholm * Konkurrenskraftig lön: 2 500–4 000 €/mån för heltidsanställd, förhandlas enligt erfarenhet och kompetens (kollektivavtalet för personalbranschen / HELA) * Personalförmåner: Epassi-personalförmån och stöd från en pålitlig arbetsgivare * Plats: Korsholm (möjlighet till distansarbete, enstaka dagar på kontoret då och då) * Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning, arbetstid enligt överenskommelse 3–5 dagar/vecka * Lön: 2 500–4 000 €/mån (heltid) / förhandlingsbar (kollektivavtalet för personalbranschen / HELA) * Förmåner: Epassi-personalförmån * Start: Enligt överenskommelse / så snart som möjligtDu får höra mer om arbetet och Duuri-tiimi som arbetsgivare (samt våra personalförmåner, bl.a. Epassi) under intervjun.Fyll i ansökan via länken intill, så kontaktar vi dig för att boka en tid för anställningsintervju. Intervjuerna inleds omgående och valet kan göras redan under ansökningstiden. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Jos koet, että osaamisesi täsmää tähän paikkaan, mutta mielessä on kysymyksiä, voit kysyä niistä suoraan Whatsappilla tai tavallisella tekstiviestillä. Numero on 050 542 1894 (finnish and english).--- Voit hakea matalalla kynnyksellä. Hakulomakkeen kaikkia kohtia ei ole pakko täyttää.Mikä on Duuri-tiimi?9,49/10 suosittelee meitä työnantajina. Lähde: 6/2025 anonyymi henkilöstökyselyMuutama vuosi sitten syntyi hurja idea: voisiko olla vuokratyöfirma, jonka työntekijät olisivat niin tyytyväisiä siihen alustana tehdä töitä, että se voisi tuntua vähintään yhtä houkuttelevalta vaihtoehdolta kuin suora työsuhde.Tavoite tuntui tuoreelle yrittäjäpariskunnalle utopistiselta - vaikka alan maine onkin paljon parantunut viime vuosina - mutta siltä pohjalta lähdettiin rakentamaan. Sittemmin Duuri-tiimiin on työllistynyt kymmeniä ihmisiä, joista osa on päättänyt rakentaa uraa työllistämällä muita Duuri-tiimin toimihenkilöinä.Strategia on yksinkertainen: hoidetaan rekrytointi ja työsuhteet niin hyvin ja suoraselkäisesti, että ihmiset haluavat jäädä meille töihin ja toivottavasti suosittelevat myös tutuilleen. Kasvu onkin ollut vauhdikasta ja käytännön alojen lisäksi olemme rekrytoineet myös päällikkötason tehtäviin ja monille eri aloille.Toimimme ympäri Suomen. Henkilöstökyselyn tuloksena päätimme hiljattain investoida työntekijöillemme Epassin työsuhde-etuna.Kyselytulosten mukaan näyttää siltä, että jotain on tehty ilmeisesti oikein ja useammat ovat jopa päättäneet mielummin jäädä meidän kirjoillemme, mikä on koskettava luottamuksen osoitus.Tule mukaamme tuomaan lisää Duuria työelämään. Meidän alustalla voit tehdä käytännössä mitä vain töitä ja tilaajalle malli on yksinkertainen. Me maksamme palkan, kuten yleensäkin työsuhteissa ja tilaaja saa kustannukset kätevästi laskutuksella.Kauttamme saa sekä keikka- että vakihommaa.

jobs.description: Risk Officer – UCITS (m/f) Fundsight is looking for a Risk Officer to join its UCITS Risk Management team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the risk management framework for a portfolio of UCITS clients. Your role • Assist the UCITS Risk Management team with the implementation and ongoing enhancement of the risk management framework. • Prepare periodic risk reports on a daily, weekly and monthly basis. • Perform risk assessments for existing and new UCITS, determine their risk profiles and monitor applicable risk limits, including market risk (commitment and VaR), credit risk, liquidity risk, counterparty risk and operational risk indicators (including TER, PTR and NAV errors). • Contribute to the integration and monitoring of sustainability risks, including ESG, SFDR and EU Taxonomy considerations, within the risk management process. • Support the Head of Risk Management on a range of risk management matters. • Review the existing risk management framework against regulatory and internal requirements, in close cooperation with other departments. • Monitor UCITS liquidity and analyse the results of liquidity stress tests. • Provide regular updates to the Head of Risk Management and the relevant governing bodies. jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description: SD-27033 RESEARCH SCIENTIST IN GAME THEORY FOR MULTI-AGENT AI GOVERNANCEFixed term contract | Belval | 24 MonthsAre you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute? You will join the AI Readiness and Assessment (AIRA) group of LIST's Human-centered AI, Data and Software (HANDS) unit as the main researcher of AI-LIGNMENT, a 24-month project funded by the Luxembourg National Research Fund (FNR) under the CORE programme.AI is shifting from systems that answer prompts to agents that plan, decide and act, increasingly combined into multi-agent systems whose behaviour emerges from interaction rather than from any single model. This strains the human oversight, transparency and explainability that the EU AI Act requires. AI-LIGNMENT responds with a governance framework grounded in game theory: it translates regulatory and organisational requirements into a machine-readable admissible action space, interprets collective agent behaviour as trajectories in that space, detects drift towards undesirable regimes before violations occur, and recalibrates incentives, communication, agent identities and information conditions under human oversight. Working closely with the Principal Investigator, a research engineer and an academic mentor from the University of Cambridge, you will be mainly in charge of:•     Formalising alignment and explainability as system-level properties of interaction dynamics in LLM-based multi-agent systems, across collaborative, competitive and parallel-execution architectures.•     Developing a conceptual and formal model that translates regulatory, organisational and domain-specific requirements (notably the EU AI Act) into a machine-readable admissible action space, in connection with a domain-specific language.•     Formalising the observation–evaluation–recalibration governance loop with game-theoretic concepts: trajectory-based evaluation, regime stability, equilibrium selection and early detection of directional drift.•     Designing and running controlled, reproducible experiments and simulations with LLM-based agents to test the project hypotheses and validate system-level indicators.•     Contributing, together with the project's research engineer, to the research prototype: specifying and implementing the game-theoretic analysis module and the recalibration engine that adjusts incentives, communication and identity parameters.•     Validating the framework and prototype on a use case drawn from public administration, through baseline and recalibration experiments, and analysing their effects on system trajectories, compliance and robustness.•     Publishing your results in leading journals and conferences (e.g. IJCAI, ECAI, AIJ, JAIR, FAccT, AIES), presenting them to the research community, and contributing to the open-source release of the framework with its data and reproducibility artefacts.•     Contributing to project deliverables and reports, exchanging with regulatory authorities and public and private partners, supporting PhD students and trainees working on related topics, and helping to identify and prepare new funding opportunities. Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!Education•     PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, or a closely related field.Experience and skills•     Research experience in game theory and/or multi-agent systems acquired during the PhD;•     Strong mathematical foundations in game theory (equilibrium analysis and selection, repeated and evolutionary games, mechanism design), probability and statistics.•     Experience in modelling, simulating and analysing multi-agent systems; hands-on experience with LLM-based agents or agentic frameworks is a strong asset.•     Solid programming skills in Python and scientific computing, with good practices for reproducible research (version control, documented experiments).•     A publication record in recognised international venues, commensurate with your career stage.•     Knowledge of AI alignment and safety, explainability, AI governance or the EU AI Act, and of domain-specific languages or model-driven engineering, is an asset.•     Good project management skills: you organise your work autonomously to meet objectives and deadlines; knowledge of research funding and an interest in contributing to project proposals are a plus.•     Team spirit, scientific rigour and critical thinking, with clear communication and presentation skills towards both scientific and non-technical audiences (e.g. regulators and public administrations). Language skills•     Fluency in English, both oral and written.•     French or German languages are an asset. La figura seguirà il percorso dal primo contatto all'attivazione sulla piattaforma e collaborerà con i team interni per favorire la crescita delle vendite dei partner. Di cosa ti occuperai? Individuare e contattare potenziali venditori attraverso campagne outbound multicanale, utilizzando e-mail, telefono e social media. Qualificare i prospect e condurre i primi colloqui commerciali, comprendendone esigenze e obiettivi. Presentare i vantaggi della piattaforma con proposte commerciali personalizzate. Uz predaju ponude koja sadrži kontakt podatke (broj telefona ili mobitela, e-mail adresa) kandidati trebaju obvezno priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta, kako slijedi: • životopis s opisom dosadašnjeg rada • dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja u skladu s uvjetima iz javnog natječaja (presliku svjedodžbe, odnosno rješenje o priznavanju inozemne stručne kvalifikacije koju je izdalo nadležno tijelo) • dokaz o radnom iskustvu (elektronički zapis/potvrda o radnom stažu Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje ne stariji od 7 dana od dana prijave na natječaj) • uvjerenje da se ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave natječaja) • presliku važeće vozačke dozvole Ponude na javni natječaj podnose se elektroničkim putem. jobs.title: SAVJETNIK / SAVJETNICA ZA ODRŽAVANJE I GRAĐENJE KOMUNALNE INFRASTRUKTURE
jobs.description:
OGLAS za prijem u službu na određeno vrijeme u Upravnom odjelu za komunalno gospodarstvo i investicije na radno mjesto :

Savjetnik za održavanje i građenje komunalne infrastrukture- (1) jedan izvršitelj/ica na određeno vrijeme uz obvezni probni rad u trajanju od dva mjeseca.

Opći uvjeti za prijem u službu, propisani u članku 12. ZSN-a: punoljetnost, hrvatsko državljanstvo, zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta

Posebni uvjeti : Sveučilišni diplomski studij ili sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij ili stručni diplomski studij građevinske ili tehničke struke, najmanje 3 (tri) godine radnog iskustva na odgovarajućim poslovima, državni ispit II. razine, poznavanje rada na računalu.

Služba se zasniva na određeno vrijeme od šest mjeseci, uz obvezni probni rad u trajanju od dva mjeseca. Sukladno članku 28. stavak 2. ZSN-a, služba na određeno vrijeme za obavljanje poslova čiji se opseg privremeno povećao može trajati najduže šest mjeseci i može se produžiti za još šest mjeseci. Sukladno članku 28. stavak 7. ZSN-a, služba na određeno vrijeme ne može postati služba na neodređeno vrijeme. Izrazi koji se, u ovom oglasu koriste u muškom rodu neutralni su i odnose se jednako na muški i ženski spol. Na oglas mogu se javiti osobe oba spola. Za prijem u službu osobe koja je strani državljanin ili osobe bez državljanstva, osim ispunjavanja uvjeta propisanih posebnim zakonom, potrebno je prethodno odobriti tijela državne uprave nadležnog za službene odnose. Prijava na oglas mora obvezno sadržavati: ime i prezime, datum rođenja, adresu podnositelja prijave, broj telefona/mobitela, po mogućnosti adresu e pošte, uz točno navođenje radnog mjesta za koje se prijava podnositelja životopis dokaz o hrvatskom državljanstvu (osobna iskaznica, putovnica ili domovnica) dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja (diploma) dokaz o radnom iskustvu na poslovima odgovarajuće stručne spreme i struke u trajanju od najmanje tri godine potrebno je kao dokaz zajedno dostaviti sljedeće dokumente navedene u točkama a) ib): a) elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje, a koji između ostalih podataka, mora sadržavati i podatke o poslodavcu, osnovi osiguranja, početku i prestanku osiguranja, radnom vremenu, stvarnoj i potrebnoj stručnoj spremi, općini rada-prebivališta te trajanju staža osiguranja - ne starije od 30 dana od posljednjeg dana roka za podnošenje prijave b) dokaz o postojanju radnog iskustva iz kojeg se nedvojbeno može utvrditi radno iskustvo na poslovima odgovarajuće stručne spreme i struke od najmanje tri godine (potvrda poslodavca, ugovor o radu, rješenje o rasporedu ili slično) koji sadrži vrstu poslova, potreban stupanj stručne spreme i razdoblje u kojem je kandidat obavljao navedene poslove,a koje radno iskustvo je evidentirano u elektroničkom zapisu/potvrdi o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a vlastoručno potpisanu izjavu o nepostojanju zapreke iz članaka 15. i 16. ZSN-a koju nije potrebno ovjeravati (obrazac izjave bit će objavljen na web stranici Grada Trogira uz tekst oglasa) vlastoručno potpisanu izjavu o poznavanju rada na računalu koju nije potrebno ovjeravati ili drugi dokaz (preslik indeksa, svjedodžbu srednje škole, odgovarajuće potvrde koje nije potrebno ovjeravati, obrazac izjave bit će objavljen na webu stranici Grada Trogira uz tekst oglasa ) dokaz o položenom državnom ispitu II. razine ako posjeduje dokaz o promjeni osobnog imena ili prezimena ako je ono mijenjano u odnosu na priložene isprave (presliku vjenčanog lista ili rodnog lista i sl.). Natjecati se mogu i kandidati koji nemaju položen državni ispit propisane razine, uz obvezu da se državni ispit polaže u roku od godine dana od dana početka rada u službi utvrđenog rješenja o rasporedu. U službu ne može biti primljena osoba za koju postoji zapreka iz članaka 15. i 16. Zakona o službenicima i namještenicima u lokalnoj i područnoj (regionalnoj) samoupravi (Narodne novine br. 86/08., 61/11., 4/18., 112/19. i 17/25.), a što će po službenoj dužnosti provjeriti Upravni odjel za lokalnu samoupravu i imovinu grada. Vodi upravni postupak i rješava o upravnim stvarima za koje ima vlast, prema Odluci o ustrojstvu i djelokrugu rada upravnih tijela Grada, za koje ga zaduži pročelnik. Sudjeluje u vođenju poslova tehničke pripreme izrade kapitalnih projekata, te s tim u vezi sudjeluje u pripremi, organiziranju, praćenju ili nadzire ostvarenje kapitalnih projekata u području komunalnog gospodarstva uključujući poslove u vezi gradnje i održavanja objekata i uređaja radi gospodarenja otpadom, osobito odlagališta i reciklažnog dvorišta koje se potpuno ili djelomično financiraju iz proračuna grada; priprema stručne podloge. Surađuje sa tijelima, ustanovama i trgovačkim društvima u čijoj je vlasti razvoj i održavanje i izgradnja objekata i uređaja komunalne infrastrukture sukladno Zakonu o komunalnom gospodarstvu; izrađuje nacrte općih i pojedinačnih akata iz nadležnosti odjela; obavlja poslove koji se odnose na komunalno gospodarstvo. Sudjeluje u stvaranju uvjeta za korištenje nekretnina u vlasništvu Grada u funkciji razvojnih programa. Sudjeluje u izradi programa održavanja i izgradnje objekata i uređaja komunalne infrastrukture sukladno Zakonu o komunalnom gospodarstvu. Sudjeluje u povjeravanju poslova na temelju koncesije i prati realizaciju ugovora; sudjeluje u pripremi nacrta odluka i drugih pravnih akata iz djelokruga gospodarenja imovinom; sudjeluje u imovinsko-pravnim poslovima vezanim uz izgradnju i korištenje objekata i uređaja komunalne infrastrukture. Priprema suglasnosti i posebne uvjete za ishođenje akata o građenju. Izrađuje da potvrde i utvrđuje posebne uvijete za prokope i druge radove na nerazvrstanim cestama i javnim površinama; provodi radnje u svrhu zaštite nerazvrstanih cesta i javnih površina (suradnja s geodetom). Izrađuje i donosi rješenja o utvrđivanju komunalnog doprinosa, naknade za zadržavanje nezakonito izgrađene zgrade u prostoru i/ili spomeničke rente sukladno rasporedu predmeta od pročelnika. Obavlja druge poslove koje mu povjeri pročelnik.

jobs.title: MATERIĀLU UZSKAITES GRĀMATVEDIS
jobs.description:

Aicinām komandai pievienoties precīzu, atbildīgu un uz detaļām orientētu Noliktavas grāmatvedi, kurš/-a nodrošinās noliktavas krājumu un ar tiem saistītās dokumentācijas precīzu uzskaiti

Galvenie pienākumi:

  • Nodrošināt noliktavas preču, rezerves daļu, materiālu un aprīkojuma uzskaiti grāmatvedības un noliktavas sistēmās.
  • Apstrādāt un reģistrēt preču saņemšanas, izsniegšanas un pārvietošanas dokumentus.
  • Pārbaudīt preču pavaddokumentus, piegādātāju rēķinus un pavadzīmes.
  • Veikt noliktavas dokumentu un grāmatvedības datu salīdzināšanu.
  • Sekot līdzi noliktavas atlikumiem un identificēt iespējamās neatbilstības.
  • Piedalīties plānoto un ārkārtas inventarizāciju organizēšanā un rezultātu apkopošanā.
  • Nodrošināt savlaicīgu un korektu dokumentu apriti starp noliktavu, grāmatvedību, iepirkumu un citām uzņēmuma struktūrvienībām.
  • Sekot līdzi rezerves daļu un materiālu uzskaites precizitātei un dokumentācijas atbilstībai uzņēmuma iekšējām procedūrām.
  • Sagatavot nepieciešamos pārskatus un atskaites par noliktavas krājumiem.

Prasības kandidātiem:

  • Vidējā profesionālā vai augstākā izglītība grāmatvedībā, finansēs, ekonomikā vai loģistikā.
  • Iepriekšēja pieredze noliktavas uzskaitē, grāmatvedībā vai līdzīgā amatā.
  • Izpratne par noliktavas uzskaites un grāmatvedības pamatprincipiem.
  • Labas iemaņas darbā ar MS Excel un citām datorprogrammām.
  • Spēja strādāt ar lielu informācijas un dokumentu apjomu.
  • Augsta precizitāte, organizētība un atbildības sajūta.
  • Spēja patstāvīgi organizēt savu darbu un ievē

jobs.title: VHDL Developer - Try & Hire
jobs.description:
We are looking for a VHDL Designer to join our clients FPGA development team in Helsinki, Finland. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, simulating, and testing VHDL-based FPGA solutions. Strong expertise in VHDL, FPGA development workflows, and verification activities is essential.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

The work involves developing FPGA implementations, creating simulation environments and testbenches, and working with timing analysis, registers, signals, pipelined architectures, and integer/fixed-point arithmetic. The development environment includes both Intel/Altera and AMD FPGA platforms.

Required Skills:
 Proficiency in VHDL
 FPGA development environments (Intel/Altera Quartus, AMD Vivado/Vitis)
 Simulation tools (ModelSim, Vivado/Vitis, GHDL)
 Testbench development, including AI-assisted approaches
 Git version control
 Understanding of timing analysis
 Registers and signals
 Pipelined architectures
 Integer and fixed-point arithmetic
 Use of DSP and RAM blocks

Preferred Skills:
 Knowledge of the VUnit testing framework
 High-Level Synthesis (HLS)
 PWM modulation
 PI/PID control
 Digital FIR and IIR filters
 Clarke transformation (ABC XYZ)
 Analog-to-Digital Converters (ADCs)
 Serial communication
 CRC and line coding
 Clock recovery

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have hands-on experience developing FPGA solutions using VHDL?*
- Have you worked with Intel/Altera Quartus or AMD Vivado/Vitis development environments?*
- Do you have experience creating and maintaining FPGA simulation testbenches?*
- Are you comfortable working with timing analysis, pipelined architectures, and fixed-point arithmetic in FPGA designs?*

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role.

Location: Hybrid, Pitäjänmäki (Helsinki), 50 % on-site
Start: ASAP, no later than January 2027
Duration: 6 months, with possible permanent employment thereafter (try & hire)
Workload: Full-time, 37.5 h/week

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application! 

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi 

Explore Lokki, through our blog and website: https://www.lokki.fi/  .

Lokki Henkilöstöpalvelut Oy (Finnish for Seagull Recruitment Services) has been active in providing recruitment services since 2005 and we belong to The Private Employment Agencies Association HPL. Our vision is to provide the best customer experience with our reliable, humane and effortless service around Finland. Our most important asset is a person who, as we know, thrives in a reliable and supportive atmosphere. At Loki you will be supported by your own human resources consultant throughout your employment relationship. At Lokki, we believe in a partnership achieved as a result of flexible service. Explore us and our vacancies: https://www.lokki.fi/.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Enterprise
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Over the past year, hundreds of thousands of non-technical knowledge workers from startups to the worlds’ largest companies have used Replit to build apps, dashboards, and other critical tools that help them do their jobs better.



Our early enterprise success has led us to a more ambitious vision: building the operating system for self-driving companies https://replit.com/blog/rise-of-self-driving-company. We believe the shift already underway in software engineering will soon extend to every business function: people will set the vision, and teams of AI agents will work together to carry it out.



We are hiring a Staff/Senior Engineer to join the Enterprise product team and build the platform for companies to create, manage, and govern their own AI teammates. You’ll help build the primitives that allow Agents to work proactively, collaboratively, and learn over time, all while respecting the strict governance and security requirements of enterprise customers.



This is a tiger team that combines complex backend platform engineering with enterprise product needs and touches every major Replit launch. You’ll help decide what products we ship, not just how they are built, and you’ll see your work impact real teams at the largest organizations in the world.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Talk to customers and shape the product. Own technical design and delivery for enterprise-facing features end-to-end, from ideation to delivery.

 - Work on a frontier coding agent. Contribute to the harness and build core primitives that let Replit Agent operate reliably and securely on real-world enterprise systems and data.

 - Define the UX for multiplayer agents. Balance the needs of users and enterprise admins while constructing entirely new, multiplayer AI experiences. No one knows what the ideal collaboration model for agentic work is; you will help us discover it.

 - Build the habitat for enterprise agents. Design and build the permissions, governance, and administration capabilities that enterprises need to trust Replit with mission-critical data and systems. Architect the platform where enterprise customers can build maximally capable, autonomous agents, without sacrificing control.

 - Use the product you build every day. We exclusively use Replit to build Replit. Our industry and tooling is changing rapidly; you get to experience the future before everyone else does.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Full-stack systems thinking. You’re comfortable across the stack - from databases and APIs to frontend frameworks. You need not have experience in any particular language (Agents write the code anyway 🙂), but your fundamentals must be rock-solid.

 - Personal and technical excellence. You hold a high bar for yourself and expect the others around you to do the same. You sweat the small stuff, because you know the micro-decisions compound into delightful user experiences.

 - Extreme ownership. You have a record of shipping high-impact features on aggressive timelines because you refuse to be blocked. Nothing is “someone else’s job”. If it’s broken, you fix it.

 - Product judgement. You can distill ambiguous customer needs into well-defined technical solutions. You are comfortable wearing the PM hat when needed and can act decisively, with conviction in your own judgement.

 - Enterprise empathy. You have experience building B2B or enterprise software products. You understand the needs of different personas in F500 companies, and know what it takes to get complex enterprise features deployed at scale.

 - Genuine passion for our mission. You are excited about shaping the future of human<>agent collaboration and the opportunity to transform how billions of people work. You are motivated by extremely ambitious goals and are excited to tackle the hard problems that come with them.




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with enterprise identity, authorization, permissions, or governance systems (SSO, SCIM, RBAC, ReBAC, PBAC).

 - Experience designing distributed services, APIs, and data models, with an understanding of reliability, consistency, scalability, and performance tradeoffs

 - Ex-founder or previous experience in a high-growth startup environment




TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE:

 - Replit




THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF:

 - You prefer working exclusively on backend systems without user interaction

 - You're uncomfortable with the pace and changing priorities of a startup environment

 - You require highly structured requirements and aren't comfortable with ambiguity

 - You were a late adopter of coding agents or are hesitant to trust them with complex scope.

 - You are looking for a comfortable and easy job



This is a full-time role that is held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)



Want to learn more about what we are up to?

 - Self-driving Company https://replit.com/blog/self-driving-company

 - Replit Agent at Scale https://replit.com/blog/evaluating-and-improving-agent-at-scale

 - AI Adoption https://replit.com/blog/ai-adoption

 - Build Open-Source Apps https://replit.com/build/open-source-app-builder
   
    

Interviewing + Culture at Replit

jobs.description:

VERO MODA is seeking a Regional Buying Manager for our international Planning & Buying team in Aarhus. This role is crucial for strategically leading the development of buying strategies, optimizing stock, and curating assortments that meet global ambitions and local market needs. Your advanced analytical expertise and commercial mindset will be instrumental in driving significant sales and support our global retail success.

YOUR TEAMJoin our vibrant International Planning & Buying department. You will collaborate with local retail managers, country teams, and stakeholders across Europe. We craft data-driven collections and strategies in a fast-paced, international setting, valuing collaboration and pushing retail excellence. As a key member of our team, you will contribute significantly to our collective expertise and strategic direction.

YOUR JOBAs Regional Buying Manager, you will take ownership of and proactively develop and execute buying strategies that boost performance across Europe. You will use sharp commercial instincts and robust data to ensure our assortments and sales plans are not only relevant and impactful, but also future-proofed for sustained growth. Your role is key to achieving topline and EBIT targets, optimizing stock, and guiding local teams to align with our global vision and local demands.

Key responsibilities:

  • Being in the front of development and implementation of comprehensive buying strategies, effectively aligning brand and local market needs.

  • Drive the creation of data-driven product assortments and clear sales plans.

  • Oversee and strategically manage stock control for maximum efficiency and impact on financial targets.

  • Provide expert guidance and support to local teams with market performance insights and tools.

  • Ensure collection relevance and commercial viability by expertly balancing global trends and local preferences.

YOUR PROFILEYou are a highly experienced, strategic, and analytical professional with a passion for retail and women's fashion. You leverage data for complex strategic decisions but also understand the creative and commercial aspects of buying. As a strong and influential communicator, you build relations easily in dynamic, international environments. You are adept at navigating diverse market demands and stakeholder expectations.

We imagine you:

  • Have extensive and demonstrable experience in retail buying or planning in fashion at a senior level.

  • Possess a distinguished proven track record in advanced stock control, in-depth analysis, and strategic reporting.

  • Are an expert and highly proficient in Excel, Power BI, and PowerPoint.

  • Have a deep understanding and strong passion for women's fashion trends and consumer demand.

  • Ideally, bring leadership experience or a strong capacity to mentor junior team members.

WHAT WE OFFERAt VERO MODA, you will be part of a global brand with a clear vision and a collaborative culture. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the buying strategy, impact markets worldwide, and grow within a team that values your ideas. Join us in Aarhus to create inspiring and high-performing women's fashion. This is an opportunity to make a significant strategic impact and further your career in a dynamic international environment.

jobs.description: Haluatko johtaa kokeneiden asiantuntijoiden tiimiä, kehittää yritys- ja maatila-asiakkuuksiamme sekä rakentaa entistä vahvempaa myynnillistä tekemistä?Haemme nyt palvelupäällikköä yritys- ja maatilaliiketoimintaan vakituiseen tehtävään.Tässä roolissa pääset johtamaan kokeneista asiantuntijoista koostuvaa tiimiä ja vaikuttamaan siihen, miten palvelemme ja kehitämme nykyisiä yritys- ja maatila-asiakkuuksiamme. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät ihmisten johtaminen, myynnin kehittäminen, sujuvan arjen varmistaminen sekä asiakkuuksien pitkäjänteinen kasvattaminen.Mitä tehtävässä pääset tekemään?Palvelupäällikkönä vastaat yritys- ja maatila-asiakkuuksia hoitavan tiimin johtamisesta ja sen tuloksellisesta toiminnasta.Keskeisiä vastuualueitasi ovat: - tiimin tavoitteellinen ja valmentava johtaminen - nykyisten yritys- ja maatila-asiakkuuksien kehittäminen ja lisämyynnin kasvattaminen - vahinko-, henki- ja sijoitustuotteiden myynnillisen tekemisen edistäminen - päivittäisen monikanavaisen asiakaspalvelun sujuvuuden varmistaminen - asiakkuuksien pysyvyyden vahvistaminen sekä asiakas- ja tuotepoistuman hallinta - uudelleen organisoidun tiimin yhteisten toimintatapojen ja tiimikulttuurin rakentaminen - sujuvan yhteistyön ja yhteisten toimintatapojen rakentaminen uusmyynnin ja muiden keskeisten sidosryhmien kanssa.Tehtävässä onnistuminen näkyy siinä, että tiimillä on selkeä yhteinen suunta, arki toimii sujuvasti ja asiakkuuksiamme kehitetään aktiivisesti sekä asiakkaan että liiketoiminnan näkökulmasta.Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?Saat johdettavaksesi kokeneen asiantuntijatiimin ja tehtävän, jossa pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan yritys- ja maatilaliiketoimintamme kehittämiseen.Saat tueksesi osaavan työyhteisön ja kattavan perehdytyksen. Tehtävä tarjoaa mahdollisuuden rakentaa uuden tiimin toimintatapoja, kehittää myynnillistä johtamista ja nähdä oman työsi vaikutukset konkreettisesti asiakkaissa, henkilöstössä ja liiketoiminnan tuloksissa.Tehtävän palkka sijoittuu noin 4 700–5 300 euroon kuukaudessa. Lopullinen palkka määräytyy valittavan henkilön kokemuksen ja osaamisen perusteella.Työskentelypaikkasi voi olla Porvoo tai Järvenpää. Työskentelemme joustavasti hybridimallilla, mutta esihenkilöroolissa säännöllinen läsnäolo tiimin kanssa on tärkeä osa tehtävää.Suunnittelemme ensimmäiset haastattelut järjestettäväksi joulukuun puolivälissä ja jatkohaastattelut ennen joulua. Toivomme uuden palvelupäällikön pääsevän aloittamaan tehtävässä mahdollisimman pian.Tule mukaan rakentamaan yritys- ja maatilaliiketoimintamme seuraavaa vaihetta ja tekemään yhdessä asiakkaidemme arjesta turvallisempaa.LisätietojaJos sinulla on mielessä kysymyksiä tehtävästä tai meillä työskentelystä, lisätietoja antaa myyntijohtaja Sofia Åkermarck, puh. 040 774 6768 (pe 27.11. klo 14-16 sekä ke 2.12. klo 10-12) tai sofia.akermarck@lahitapiola.fiHae tehtävää täyttämällä hakulomake 8.12.2026 mennessä.Tehtävään valittavan henkilön tulee täyttää vakuutusalan hyvämaineisuusvaatimukset ja tämä varmistetaan työsopimuksen allekirjoittamisen yhteydessä.

jobs.title: Kokke til Hotel Strandparken ( Med mulighed for ansvar )
jobs.description:
Vil du være med til at skabe gode madoplevelser, der samler mennesker? 

Kok søges til Hotel Strandparken i Holbæk 

Restaurant Blossom er skabt ud fra et ønske om at skabe et spisested med smag og personlighed. Et sted, hvor vi er nysgerrige på sæsonens råvarer, tør udfordre det velkendte og samtidig værner om traditioner, nærvær og den varme, der får mennesker til at samles omkring et måltid. 

Om jobbet 

Hotel Strandparken er Holbæks foretrukne konferencehus med restaurant, selskaber og events året rundt. Det giver en varieret hverdag med både restaurantservice, møde- og konferenceforplejning samt store og små selskaber. 

Du bliver en del af et team, der arbejder tæt sammen om: 

• Daglig produktion og service • Udvikling af menuer og nye idéer • Sæsonens råvarer, lokale leverandører og mindre madspild • Oplæring og udvikling af vores kokkeelever 

Vi ønsker hele tiden at udvikle os, og derfor er der god plads til at bidrage med idéer og tage medansvar for køkkenets udvikling. 

Vi forestiller os, at du 

• Er faglært kok ellerhar meget erfaring• Har styr på dit håndværk og sætter en ære i kvaliteten • Er nysgerrig på råvarer, smag og sæsoner • Har lyst til at udvikle og udfordre det velkendte, samtidig med at du respekterer de klassiske dyder • Tager ansvar og bidrager positivt til fællesskabet • Møder stabilt, velforberedt og med godt humør 

Det tilbyder vi 

På Hotel Strandparken ønsker vi at skabe oplevelser, som gæsterne husker. Derfor er både maden, værtskabet og samarbejdet mellem kollegaer vigtigt for os. 

• Fast fuldtidsstilling på overenskomstmæssige vilkår • Et ordentligt arbejdsmiljø med gensidig respekt og klare forventninger • En varieret hverdag med restaurant, konferencer og selskaber • Et køkken i udvikling, hvor idéer bliver hørt • Fokus på kvalitet, smag, økologi og lokale råvarer • Dygtige kollegaer, der hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok 

Opstart: Snarest muligt eller efter aftale Arbejdstid: Dag, aften og weekend Ansættelse: Fast fuldtid 

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til Frank@couloir.dk Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

jobs.title: Relokaatiokonsultti
jobs.description: Haluaisitko työn, jossa yhdistyvät kansainvälisyys, käytännön ongelmanratkaisu ja ihmisten auttaminen uuden elämänvaiheen alussa?Haemme KEY Relocation Finlandin tiimiin **relokaatiokonsulttia** kokoaikaiseen tai osa-aikaiseen tehtävään Helsinkiin.Relokaatiokonsulttina autat Suomeen muuttavia kansainvälisiä työntekijöitä ja heidän perheitään asettautumaan uuteen kotimaahansa. Työssäsi tuet heitä muuttoon liittyvissä käytännön asioissa sekä suomalaisen yhteiskunnan, palveluiden, kulttuurin ja arjen toimintatapojen ymmärtämisessä.**Mitä työ sisältää?**Työpäiväsi voivat sisältää esimerkiksi:- asiakkaan ja hänen perheensä tarpeiden kartoittamista ja relokaatioprosessin koordinointia - tukemista suomalaisissa viranomaisasioissa ja muissa asettautumiseen liittyvissä käytännön asioissa - Suomeen, suomalaiseen yhteiskuntaan ja kulttuuriin orientoimista - neuvontaa esimerkiksi liikkumisesta, terveydenhuollosta, kouluista, päiväkodeista ja muista arjen palveluista - asuntohakua, asuntonäyttöjä sekä asumiseen ja muuttoon liittyvien asioiden hoitamista - yhteydenpitoa yritysasiakkaisiin, viranomaisiin ja muihin yhteistyökumppaneihin. Työssä yhdistyvät asiantuntijatyö, kulttuurienvälinen vuorovaikutus ja ihmisläheinen asiakaspalvelu. Tärkeä osa tehtävää on auttaa asiakasta ymmärtämään uutta kotimaataan ja rakentamaan toimiva arki Suomessa.**Mitä toivomme sinulta?**Edellytämme:- soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa (AMK tai yliopisto) - sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa - hyviä asiakaspalvelu-, viestintä- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja - järjestelmällistä, huolellista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta - luontevaa tapaa toimia erilaisista kulttuureista ja taustoista tulevien ihmisten kanssa - B-ajokorttia ja valmiutta liikkua pääkaupunkiseudulla. **Arvostamme lisäksi**- kokemusta relokaatiosta, global mobilitysta, kansainvälisestä HR:stä tai muusta kansainvälisestä asiakastyöstä - kokemusta viisumeista, oleskelu- ja työluvista tai muista kansainväliseen liikkuvuuteen liittyvistä viranomaisprosesseista - alan koulutuksia tai sertifikaatteja, kuten EuRA MIM/MIM+ tai WERC GMS/GMS-T - omakohtaista kokemusta ulkomailla asumisesta ja relokaatiopalveluiden saamisesta kansainvälisen muuton yhteydessä - muuta kielitaitoa suomen ja englannin lisäksi. Aikaisempi kokemus relokaatiotyöstä ei ole välttämätön. Arvostamme kykyä oppia nopeasti, ottaa vastuuta omista asiakkaista ja löytää ratkaisuja heidän erilaisiin tilanteisiinsa.**Mitä tarjoamme?**Tarjoamme sinulle:- monipuolisen ja aidosti kansainvälisen työn - kokeneen tiimin tuen ja hyvän perehdytyksen - itsenäisen roolin ja vastuuta omista asiakkaista sekä toimintamme kehittämisestä - mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi relokaation, lupaprosessien ja kansainvälisen liikkuvuuden parissa työskennellessäsi kiinnostavien kansainvälisten asiakkaiden kanssa - joustavan työn, jossa työskentelet tilanteen mukaan toimistolla, asiakkaiden luona ja osittain etänä. **KEY Relocation Finland työpaikkana**KEY Relocation Finland on osa pohjoismaista KEY Relocation -konsernia. KEY Relocation on toiminut vuodesta 1993, ja organisaatiossamme työskentelee relokaatio-, lupaprosessi- ja global mobility ammattilaisia Suomessa, Ruotsissa ja Tanskassa. Kansainvälisen verkostomme kautta palvelemme asiakkaitamme myös maailmanlaajuisesti.Suomessa työskentelemme monipuolisen ja kiinnostavan asiakaskunnan kanssa kasvuyrityksistä suuriin kansainvälisiin ja pohjoismaisiin yrityksiin.Toimintamme kasvaa nopeasti, mikä tarjoaa mahdollisuuden päästä mukaan kehittämään sekä omaa työtä että tapaamme palvella kansainvälisiä työntekijöitä ja yritysasiakkaita. Saat ympärillesi paikallisen suomalaisen tiimin lisäksi kokeneita pohjoismaisia kollegoita ja mahdollisuuden oppia laajasti kansainvälisen liikkuvuuden eri osa-alueista.Toimistomme sijaitsee Vallilassa Helsingissä hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella. Työtä tehdään joustavasti toimistolla, asiakkaiden luona ja osittain etänä.**Kiinnostuitko?**Tehtävä voidaan sopia kokoaikaiseksi tai osa-aikaiseksi, ja aloitusajankohdasta voidaan sopia joustavasti.Lähetä meille CV:si ja lyhyt hakemus **viimeistään 7.12.2026**, jossa kerrot taustastasi ja siitä, miksi relokaatiotyö kiinnostaa sinua. Kuulemme mielellämme myös kansainvälisestä kokemuksestasi, kielitaidostasi sekä mahdollisesta kokemuksestasi relokaatiopalveluiden parissa tai niiden vastaanottajana.**Käymme hakemuksia läpi ja haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana, joten kannattaa hakea mahdollisimman pian.**Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Tytti Lauhava-Kääriäinen (tytti.lauhava-kaariainen@keyrelocation.com). Puhelimitse tavoitat hänet numerosta +358207118360 perjantaina 27.11. klo 11–13 ja tiistaina 1.12. klo 13–15.

jobs.title: Lektor/Universitetslektor i Marknadsföring (tenure track), Universitetslärare i Marknadsföring (tidsbunden)
jobs.description: Svenska handelshögskolan (Hanken), Institutionen för marknadsföring, söker en lektor, universitetslektor eller en universitetslärare i marknadsföring. Vi välkomnar sökanden med bred kunskap inom ämnet marknadsföring med god förmåga att undervisa och handleda i ämnet marknadsföring på såväl svenska som engelska.Undervisning och forskning inom marknadsföring på HankenUndervisningen inom ämnet marknadsföring utgör en betydande och viktig del av de ekonomistuderandes kompetensutveckling på Hanken. Profileringen i Vasa fokuserar strategisk affärsutveckling, kunddrivna affärsmodeller, ledning av affärsrelationer, ledning av försäljning, kommunikation och destinationsutveckling (turism).
