jobs.title: Development Engineer, Electrical Systems
jobs.description: We are looking for a Development Engineer to join our Electrical Systems team and contribute to the development of electrical and control solutions for Wärtsilä power plants. The role offers a broad technical scope covering areas such as plant electrical systems, control systems, hardware and system integration, functional safety, and engineering tools.At Wärtsilä Energy Technology, our Electrical Systems team is shaping a sustainable energy future through innovative, future-proof electrical and control solutions. We challenge conventional thinking, turn technology into impact, and foster an environment where great ideas and talented people thrive.The preferred location for this position is Vaasa, Finland. Helsinki and Turku may also be considered. We offer the possibility of hybrid work.Your role and responsibilitiesAs a Development Engineer, you will work alongside experienced specialists on the development and implementation of electrical and control solutions for Wärtsilä power plants and product platforms. You will be a member of a dynamic team of development managers and experts, reporting to the General Manager, Electrical Systems.Depending on your experience and interests, your work may focus on different areas within electrical systems, control systems, hardware and system integration, functional safety, or engineering tools. You will have the opportunity to take ownership of specific areas while progressively building broader competence across the field.You will collaborate closely with product owners, electrical and automation experts, project engineers, suppliers, and other internal and external stakeholders.Your work will focus on these responsibilities: * Development of electrical and control system solutions * Electrical and control system design, including control cabinets, wiring, interfaces, and supporting engineering documentation * Hardware and system integration across products, platforms, and plant solutions * Functional safety and safety-related plant solutions * Development and maintenance of engineering standards, methods, data, and tools * Technical coordination with technology expert teams, projects, suppliers, and system integrators * Development of common and standardized solutions for future power plant applications, including data and digitalization features and functionalitiesTo succeed in this position, we expect you to have: * A BSc or MSc degree in electrical engineering, automation, control engineering, or a related field * Around 2–3 years of relevant hands-on experience in electrical systems, control systems, embedded systems, or industrial engineering * Solid understanding of electrical and control system design and drawings, system interfaces, and technical documentation * Interest in developing your competence across electrical and control technologies * A structured and practical approach to solving technical problems * Willingness to take ownership and to work both independently and as part of a team * Good communication, collaboration, and presentation skills in English * A positive, solution-oriented mindset and self-driven approach to learning and development * Experience in power plants, energy, industrial automation, electrification, embedded systems, industrial delivery projects, or functional safety is considered an advantageThe role offers the opportunity to work across several technical areas over time. You are not expected to be an expert in all these areas from the outset. We value relevant experience and solid technical knowledge in some of these fields, together with curiosity and a willingness to learn and grow into a broader role.Why you and us?We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership, and taking responsibility for our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have the courage to see opportunities and take initiative.We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe that by being your own true self, you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking for a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.Contact &amp; next stepsWe hope to hear from you soon and receive your application via our Careers portal. We aim to keep you updated throughout the process.For further information regarding this position, please reach out to Kamal Uddin, General Manager, Electrical Systems, at +358 50 368 2559 (only for questions from direct job applicants; applications sent by email will not be processed or responded to).

jobs.title: 2 hjertevarme pædagogmedhjælpere eller pæd. assistenter til Børnehuset Olympus
jobs.description:
Olympus Børnehuset leder efter verdens bedste pædagogmedhjælper………

 

Brænder du for at skabe en tryg, varm og udviklende hverdag for børnehavebørn? Har du lyst til at arbejde i et miljø, hvor kvalitet og omsorg går hånd i hånd? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Børnehuset Olympus er en sammenlagt institution beliggende på to matrikler på henholdsvis Korevej 2 og Fortunavej 1. Korevej er en lille hyggelig børnehave med 20 børn, og Fortuna er en spændende, integreret institution med 18 vuggestuebørn, og 39 børnehavebørn. Det er i børnehaven i afd. Fortuna,  vi mangler hænder.

Børnehuset Olympus er en institution i udvikling, og derfor er der rig mulighed for at være medskaber af et udviklende læringsmiljø, der understøtter alle børns deltagelse i børnefællesskaber, alt sammen med udgangspunkt i Aalborg kommunes børnesyn.

 

Vi søger to pædagogmedhjælpere/pædagogiske assistenter på 37 timer . Begge stillinger er i vores børnehavegrupper på Fortunavej. Vi forventer du kan tiltræde 1. februar 2027.

 

Til den rette pædagogmedhjælper tilbyder vi

  • Skønne børn, forældre og kolleger
  • En hverdag der udstråler ro, nærvær og en varm, hjemlig stemning  
  • Et fagligt stærkt team, der prioriterer refleksion over egen og andres praksis
  • Et miljø hvor der er fokus på udvikling og kvalitet i det pædagogiske arbejde – både i planlægning og praksis – du arbejder under reference til stuens pædagoger.
  • Gode muligheder for sparring og kompetenceudvikling
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor trivsel og samarbejde vægtes højt, og hvor man mødes med smil og et godt humør

 

Vi ønsker os en pædagogmedhjælper der kan

  • Være med til at skabe trygge og udviklende læringsmiljøer for børn i alderen 0–6 år
  • Arbejde anerkendende og relations baseret med det enkelte barn, og har lyst til at være på gulvet blandt børnene 
  • Være med til at planlægge og gennemføre pædagogiske aktiviteter med høj faglig kvalitet
  • Indgå aktivt i samarbejdet med forældre, og ser dem som vigtige samarbejdspartnere 
  • Tage del i det praktiske arbejde i hverdagen, og ser det som en mulighed for vigtige læringsstunder med børnene
  • Bidrage til en varm og inkluderende kultur i huset

 

Vi forventer, at du

  • Først og fremmest går på arbejde for børnenes skyld
  • Er nærværende, anerkendende, omsorgsfuld og tydelig i din tilgang til børnene
  • Trives i en hverdag med både struktur og fleksibilitet
  • Er mødestabil, og kan møde i hele åbningstiden 6.30-16.50
  • Har lyst til at bidrage til et positivt og udviklende arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi har øje for hinanden og respekterer hinandens forskelligheder
  • Gerne har erfaring fra det pædagogiske område – evt. uddannelse som pædagogisk assistent (ikke et krav)

 

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig!

 

Ansøgning

Send din ansøgning og CV senest den 11. december 2026. Vi forventer at holde ansættelsessamtaler umiddelbart efter ansøgningsfristens udløb. 

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til Foa´s overenskomst.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte pædagogisk leder Gitte Høyrup Christensen, 20638914. Du er ligeledes velkommen til at ringe og aftale et besøg. Forud for ansættelse indhentes reference og børne- og straffeattest.

Arbejdsstedets adresse er Fortunavej 1, 9210 Aalborg SØ.

Send ansøgning

Du sender din ansøgning ved at trykke på knappen "Send ansøgning" og udfylde den formular, som kommer frem. Det er også muligt at vedhæfte bilag som f.eks. ansøgning og CV i begrænset omfang.

Bliv en del af Dobbelt A – få dobbelt op på mulighederHos os bliver du en del af et fedt fællesskab med 17.500 kolleger. Glæd dig til at få dobbelt op på udviklingsmuligheder, gode ansættelsesforhold og fokus på trivsel. Vi tror på, at forskellighed gør os stærkere, og opfordrer alle til at søge – uanset alder, køn, baggrund, religion eller handicap.Se alle fordelene ved et job hos os og bliv klogere på ansættelsesprocessen trin-for-trin.

jobs.title: Myymäläpäällikkö, Sale Suomusjärvi & Sale Kiikala
jobs.description: Primary location:SALOEtsimme MYYMÄLÄPÄÄLLIKKÖÄ vastaamaan Sale Suomusjärvestä ja Sale Kiikalasta! Tehtävä sopii sinulle, joka innostut ihmisten johtamisesta, hyvästä asiakaskokemuksesta ja tuloksellisesta kaupan tekemisestä.Meillä SSO:ssa ihmiset ovat pääroolissa ja tärkein tehtäväsi onkin auttaa ihmisiä onnistumaan työssään: olet läsnä arjessa, annat palautetta ja asetat tavoitteita. Samalla pidät molempien kauppojen pyörät pyörimässä. Vastaat niiden päivittäisestä toiminnasta, tuloksesta ja asiakaskokemuksesta. Seuraat muun muassa myyntiä, hävikkiä, työtunteja ja kustannuksia ja reagoit poikkeamiin ripeästi. Huolehdit, että tuotteita on saatavilla, myymälät ovat siistejä ja asiakkaan on mukava tehdä meillä ostoksia. Ja koska hyvä kauppa voi aina olla vielä vähän parempi, yksi tärkeä tehtäväsi myymälöiden kehittäminen. Tunnistat kehityskohteita, osallistat tiimisi mukaan ja viet yhdessä sovitut parannukset käytäntöön.Mitä odotamme sinulta?Osaat johtaa ihmisiä. Olet läsnä, oikeudenmukainen ja selkeä esihenkilö. Osaat valmentaa, kannustaa ja antaa palautetta sekä auttaa erilaisia ihmisiä onnistumaan työssään.Sinulla on kaupallista silmää. Ymmärrät päivittäistavarakaupan toimintaa ja hahmotat, mistä hyvä tulos syntyy. Seuraat tunnuslukuja ja osaat muuttaa havainnot käytännön tekemiseksi.Asiakas on sinulle tärkeä. Huolehdit yhdessä tiimisi kanssa palvelusta, saatavuudesta, laadusta, siisteydestä ja kaupallisesta ilmeestä joka päivä.Saat arjen toimimaan. Osaat priorisoida, organisoida ja tehdä päätöksiä myös vauhdikkaissa tilanteissa. Huolehdit resursseista, työvuoroista, prosesseista ja turvallisesta työskentelystä.Haluat kehittää. Et tyydy vain ylläpitämään nykyistä, vaan tunnistat mahdollisuuksia tehdä asioita fiksummin ja viet muutoksia eteenpäin yhdessä henkilöstön kanssa.Eduksi katsomme aiemman kokemuksen esihenkilötyöstä ja päivittäistavarakaupasta sekä kaupallisen koulutuksen.Työskentelet vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa myymälän aukioloaikojen puitteissa, myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin.Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?💎 Vastuullisen ja monipuolisen esihenkilötehtävän, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan aidosti oman myymäläsi arkeen, henkilöstöön ja tulokseen.💎 Poikkeuksellisen hyvät henkilöstöedut. Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai -15 % alennus käyttötavaroista mm. Prismoista ja Sokokselta? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakua täältä.💎Kuukausipalkkasi tulee sijoittumaan 3500–4200 euron välille. Lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus vuosittaiseen tulospalkkioon.💎Työn ja vapaa-ajan sujuvamman yhteensovittamisen vaikuttamalla itse omiin työvuoroihisi. Suomusjärven ja Kiikalan Saleissa, kuten yhä useammassa SSO:n toimipisteessä, on otettu käyttöön yhteisöllinen työvuorosuunnittelu. Uudessa mallissa työntekijät voivat valita itselleen sopivia työvuoroja sovittujen pelisääntöjen mukaisesti.💎Mahdollisuuksia kehittyä esihenkilönä. Tuemme osaamistasi koulutuksilla ja valmennuksilla sekä tarjoamme ympärillesi muiden esihenkilöiden ja SSO:n asiantuntijoiden tuen.Lisätietoja ja hakeminenTyösuhteen tyyppi: vakituinenTyöaika: kokoaikainen, 37,5 h/vkoHaku päättyy: 1.12.2026Työ alkaa: sopimuksen mukaan alkuvuodesta 2027Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa arkisin klo 8–16 välillä ryhmäpäällikkö Joni Toivonen,joni.toivonen@sok.fi, p. 0447705452.📍Käytämme rekrytoinnissa soveltuvuusarviota. Saatamme haastatella hakijoita jo hakuajalla, ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.👉Valintapäätös saattaa johtaa päälliköiden työnkiertoon Suur-Seudun Osuuskaupassa, joten mahdollisesti avautuva paikka voidaan täyttää myös tämän haun kautta.💚Me SSO:ssa olemme sitoutuneet työskentelemään monimuotoisen ja syrjimättömän työympäristön puolesta, jossa kunnioitetaan ja arvostetaan kaikkien työntekijöidemme ainutlaatuisia taustoja, taitoja ja näkemyksiä.TyönantajakuvausMe SSO:ssa arvostamme ihan tavallisia töitä, mutta vielä enemmän arvostamme niitä epätavallisen upeita ihmisiä töiden takana. Uskomme, että ihmiset ratkaisevat onnistumisen. Myyjä, tarjoilija, asiantuntija ja tuhat muuta – me kaikki teemme yhdessä kotiseudustamme parempaa paikkaa elää. Siksi meidät valittiinkin yhdeksi Suomen Innostavimmista työpaikoista vuonna 2025. Työllistämme noin 1200 ammattilaista neljällä eri toimialalla, 80 eri toimipaikassa läntisellä Uudellamaalla ja Salon seudulla.Lue lisää ihan tavallisista töistä ja epätavallisen hyvistä eduista osoitteessa sso.fi/toihinmeille

jobs.title: Associate Professor in Power System Flexibility and Energy Markets
jobs.description:
At AAU Energy, a full-time position as Associate Professor in Power System Flexibility and Energy Markets is open for appointment from April 2027 or soon thereafter

Your work tasksYou will join the Intelligent Energy Systems and Flexible Markets (iGRIDS) research group in the Section for Electric Power Systems and Microgrids at AAU Energy, Aalborg University. You will actively contribute to the group’s collaborative research, teaching, and broader academic activities.

Your research will address modelling, optimisation and intelligent management of power and integrated energy systems, with emphasis on electricity markets, demand flexibility, uncertainty-aware scheduling and active distribution networks. You will develop computational and data-driven approaches for flexibility across sectors, including power–heat and power–mobility applications.

You will develop and lead research projects, secure external funding and collaborate with academic, industrial and public-sector partners. You will teach and supervise students at bachelor’s, master’s and PhD levels and support AAU’s problem-based learning (PBL) environment. It is also expected that you will be able to undertake teaching in Danish within the first few years of employment.

Your competenciesApplicants should have Associate Professor-level qualifications in electrical power engineering, energy systems or a related field, with a documented record of original research and teaching. Relevant competencies include:

  • Energy systems and markets: Expertise in modelling, optimisation, and control of integrated energy systems, including energy hubs, sector coupling, electricity markets, energy economics, demand response, flexibility aggregation, and uncertainty-aware scheduling.
  • Grid integration: Experience in integrating renewable energy, storage, and flexible demand into active distribution networks, addressing voltage regulation, congestion management, grid stability, and coordinated flexibility services.
  • Research excellence and leadership: Strong publication record and demonstrated ability to develop research directions, secure competitive funding, and lead national and international collaborative projects, particularly EU-funded initiatives.
  • Teaching and collaboration: Documented experience in university teaching at bachelor's, master's and doctoral levels. Experience in teaching within Flexible Master's Programmes, particularly for industry professionals, is considered an advantage. Ability to contribute to Problem-Based Learning (PBL), communicate effectively in English and collaborate constructively with students, colleagues and external partners.
  • Additional strengths: Experience in experimental validation, hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing and industry-oriented research or teaching is advantageous.

Who we areAAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real-world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday work.

New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters. Aalborg University offers general onboarding support to all new employees, as well as dedicated support for international staff through its International Staff Unit (ISU). You can read more about relocation support and services here: https://www.en.hr.aau.dk/relocation-support

Aalborg University also offers Danish language courses to support international employees in settling into both the workplace and Danish society. International employees typically can attend Danish language courses during their first years in Denmark (depending on individual eligibility and national schemes).

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirementsAppointment as an associate professor requires research and teaching qualifications at the level that can be achieved through the satisfactory completion of a period of employment as an assistant professor but may also be obtained in other ways.  

It is a precondition that applicants have documented research at an international standard. In addition, applicants are assumed to have received supervision and pedagogical skills development and to have obtained a positive written assessment of their teaching qualifications.

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of ten publications. 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see The Faculty of Engineering and Science. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this   
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here  

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Associate professor.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Offensive Security
jobs.description:
Role Description

As anÂ Offensive Security Engineer within Dropbox Security, you will investigate how attackers could compromise our products and infrastructure, including AI-enabled applications and agentic systems. You will help identify meaningful attack paths and improve the controls intended to prevent, detect or contain them.

This is a hands-on offensive security and threat research role with broad scope and meaningful impact. You will contribute to investigations and multi-phase red team exercises, help prioritize work based on risk, develop attack techniques, and build tooling and automation that expand the reach of our security testing. You will apply practical AI security knowledge alongside broader offensive security skills across applications, cloud infrastructure, and identity systems. Working closely with experienced researchers and partners across Product Security, Detection & Response, Threat Intelligence, Privacy, and engineering, you will help translate technical findings into clear business risk, recommend practical improvements, and validate their effectiveness through retesting. Sound judgment, clear communication, responsible execution, and ownership of your work are essential to the role. You will contribute to the Red Teamâs tools, research methods, and testing practices while developing your own areas of expertise, investigating emerging technologies, and helping advance Dropboxâs offensive security capabilities. You will have opportunities to deepen your skills, publish research, take on increasingly complex projects, and see your work influence security decisions across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes whatâs expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Plan and execute offensive security assessments by defining objectives, scope, rules of engagement, and safeguards, adapting your approach as new evidence emerges.
  • Investigate unfamiliar applications, infrastructure, APIs, and trust boundaries to identify and trace meaningful attack paths.
  • Develop and safely demonstrate exploits and attack chains that clearly establish potential impact to Dropbox.
  • Build and improve offensive security tools, agents, automation, and testing harnesses, ensuring results are reliable, repeatable, and appropriately validated.
  • Assess security risks across AI-enabled applications, agents, tool integrations, and supporting infrastructure, including the responsible use of AI-assisted research techniques.
  • Partner with security, privacy, legal, and engineering teams to communicate risk, strengthen prevention and detection capabilities, address root causes, and verify improvements through retesting.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in offensive security, vulnerability research, red teaming or closely related security engineering, or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • A track record of independently leading complex investigations or engagements and discovering and exploiting non-trivial vulnerabilities.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication and authorisation, cloud infrastructure, APIs and software supply chains, with deep practical expertise in one or more areas and the ability to trace attack paths across systems and trust boundaries.
  • Hands-on experience attacking or evaluating LLMs, AI agents, ML systems, AI-enabled applications, or agentic architectures.
  • Familiarity with security risks in AI-enabled applications, agents and tool integrations, and the ability to investigate unfamiliar technologies.
  • Ability to write code to build or adapt offensive tools and automation, and to read and investigate unfamiliar production codebases.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing novel attacks, repeatable security evaluations or testing frameworks for AI-enabled systems, or building and validating AI-assisted offensive research capabilities.
  • Expertise across multiple attack surfaces, or advanced specialist capability in areas such as exploit development, reverse engineering, endpoint security, cloud exploitation or software supply-chain attacks.
  • Experience developing automated vulnerability discovery, fuzzing, program analysis or evaluation systems across large codebases or complex environments.
  • Experience conducting coordinated exercises with defenders to measure detection and response effectiveness and validate improvements against realistic attack techniques.
  • Contributions through original research, vulnerability disclosures, open-source tools, technical publications, internal training or mentoring.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

jobs.title: Site Manager – new biogas plants in Denmark and abroad
jobs.description:
Site Manager – new biogas plants in Denmark and abroad

Bigadan is built by people with deep professional expertise and a shared ambition: to create the circular energy solutions of the future. We have been building biogas plants for more than 40 years, in Denmark and abroad, and the coming years are busy. We have expansion and greenfield projects lined up in Denmark and Scandinavia, plus support projects for our clients in Germany and the UK. That is why we are looking for an experienced Site Manager for our Projects team.

Anywhere from 10 to 50+ people from different contractors on site, all needing to deliver at the same time. You are the one holding it all together. And when you hand over, you leave behind a plant that produces biogas for decades.

The role

You lead the site day to day from ground-breaking through commissioning and handover to operations. The people on site are mainly contractors in civil, mechanical, electrical, piping and process works. You report formally to Head of Projects Luke Morris, while Head of Site Managers Stefan Wussow is your manager in day-to-day operations. You work closely with the individual Project Managers and the Site team.

You spend around 80% of your time on site and 20% in the office. Our construction site office and workshop are based in Husum, Germany. Ideally, we would like you to be based in southern Denmark near Kliplev or Husum, but as the role involves a lot of travel, we are recruiting across Denmark and northern Germany. Our projects are spread across Denmark and abroad, including Sweden, Germany, Finland and the UK.

We expect you to be ready for periods of 3–4 weeks living near the site. Employment can be in Denmark or in Germany.

What you do

Site leadership. You coordinate daily activities and contractor progress, plan access, deliveries and lifting operations, and solve problems before they become delays.

Safety. You lead site inspections and toolbox talks and approve risk assessments and method statements. You set the standard on site.

Quality and documentation. You make sure the work follows drawings and specifications, including welding, and keep track of inspections and documentation.

Handover. You manage punch lists and close-out, so we hand over a plant that works from day one.

What makes this role specific

With us, you are not building for a client you will never see again. We operate the plants ourselves afterwards, and our own colleagues will live with what you build for many years. You succeed in this role when you have led the next builds safely to completion, made the right decisions along the way, kept the budget on track, and made both the collaboration and the construction succeed.

We imagine that you:

• have a technical education, e.g. as a mechanical engineer, or a trade background (civil, mechanical or electrical) with hands-on experience

• have at least 5 years' experience as a site manager on industrial, energy, utility or process projects

• know civil, mechanical and electrical works and the health and safety rules on a construction site

• speak and write English and either Danish or German

Experience in biogas or anaerobic digestion is an advantage, but not a requirement. It is also an advantage if you hold a Danish construction safety coordinator certificate (AMK-B), first aid, knowledge of ATEX zones, or experience with welding coordination.

As a person, you are visible on site and make decisions when they need to be made. You can push back on a contractor and still have a good working relationship the next day.

We offer

A central role in a growing company, where you are involved from ground-breaking until the plant is running. You get a competitive salary, either mileage at the official Danish rates or a company van, accommodation and per diem on projects, pension and health insurance, ongoing training and support for relevant certifications. The position is full-time, starting 1 February or 1 March 2027.

About Bigadan

We develop, build, operate and own biogas plants and work across the entire value chain, from sourcing organic residues to producing energy, biogenic CO₂ and biofertiliser. We are around 200 colleagues and have built more than 40 biogas plants in Denmark and abroad.

Every day, we turn manure, food waste and other organic residues into products of value for the energy, agriculture and industrial sectors. This supports security of supply, makes better use of resources and returns nutrients to the soil.

Interested?

The application deadline is Wednesday 30 December 2026. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis, so please send your application and CV as soon as possible. If you have questions, please contact Head of Projects Luke Morris on +45 3073 6851 or lm@bigadan.dk.

jobs.title: Er du klar til at skifte gear?
jobs.employer: Hundested Auto- og Dækcenter v/Braneslava Dan
jobs.description:
Automekaniker / Automontør søges – Bliv en del af et værksted i udvikling!

Er du klar til næste skridt i din karriere, og ønsker du en arbejdsplads, hvor der er plads til både faglig og personlig udvikling?

Hos Hundested Auto & Dækcenter er vi i udvikling, og vi søger derfor en dygtig automekaniker eller automontør, der har lyst til at blive en del af vores team og være med på rejsen.

Bilbranchen udvikler sig hurtigt, og det gør vi også. Vi ønsker at investere i vores medarbejdere og skabe en arbejdsplads, hvor du har mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer gennem relevante kurser, efteruddannelse og faglig sparring.

Hos os får du en varieret arbejdsdag med spændende opgaver på tværs af bilmærker, modeller og teknologier.

Hvad tilbyder vi dig?

  • En fast fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

  • Mulighed for relevante kurser og efteruddannelse.

  • Gode muligheder for faglig og personlig udvikling.

  • En spændende og varieret hverdag med forskellige arbejdsopgaver.

  • Dygtige kolleger, faglig sparring og et stærkt fællesskab.

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med plads til humor.

  • En arbejdsplads i udvikling, hvor du har mulighed for at gøre en forskel.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Service og vedligeholdelse af person- og varebiler.

  • Reparationer på tværs af forskellige bilmærker.

  • Fejlfinding og diagnosticering.

  • Dæk- og hjulskifte.

  • Øvrige værkstedsrelaterede opgaver.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er uddannet automekaniker eller har relevant erfaring som automontør.

  • Har interesse for biler, teknik og den teknologiske udvikling i bilbranchen.

  • Har lyst til at lære nyt og udvikle dine kompetencer.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for kvaliteten af dit arbejde.

  • Er mødestabil, fleksibel og bidrager til det gode kollegiale fællesskab.

  • Har kørekort til kategori B.

Det vigtigste for os er din faglige interesse, dit engagement og din lyst til at levere et godt stykke arbejde.

Din kommende arbejdsplads

Dit primære arbejdssted vil være hos Hundested Auto & Dækcenter. Som en del af en større organisation samarbejder vi på tværs af vores afdelinger, og du kan derfor lejlighedsvis blive spurgt, om du har mulighed for at hjælpe til på vores lokationer i Hillerød eller Frederikssund.

Hundested Auto & DækcenterUllerup Skovvej 53390 Hundested

Skal du være en del af vores fremtid?

Uanset om du søger nye udfordringer, ønsker at udvikle dig fagligt eller blot trænger til et skifte i din arbejdshverdag, vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job@brdr-danbiler.dk.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, eller er du nysgerrig på, hvad vi kan tilbyde dig? Så er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Jon på telefon 27 80 45 20 til en uforpligtende snak.

Vi afholder løbende samtaler og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at byde vores nye kollega velkommen!

jobs.title: Tarjoilija Hesburger Leppäkaarre Siilinjärvi
jobs.description: Primary location:SIILINJÄRVIHaluatko olla mukana rakentamassa kokonaan uuden Hesburgerin työyhteisöä alusta alkaen? Siilinjärvelle avautuu helmi–maaliskuun vaihteessa 2027 uusi, ympäri vuorokauden palveleva Hesburger Leppäkaarre. Haemme ravintolaan noin 15 työntekijää vakituisiin työsuhteisiin.Emme tarjoa yllätyksiä, vaan ihan tavallisia töitä.Aloitetaan olennaisesta: tämä on asiakaspalvelutyötä, ja olet koko vuoron ihmisten keskellä. Meillä se tarkoittaa ihan arkisia asioita – tervehditään, hymyillään, pidetään paikat kunnossa ja autetaan kaveria, kun tulee kiire. Näin asiakas saa paitsi ruokansa myös hyvän mielen.Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos olet reipas, palveluhenkinen ja yhteistyötaitoinen – ja jos arvostat hyviä henkilökuntaetuja, mutkatonta työporukkaa ja sitä pientä ylpeyden tunnetta, kun asiakas poistuu tyytyväisenä.Haemme työkaveria, joka tarttuu hommiin innolla ja energialla – ja jolla on halua työskennellä vuorotöissä. Työvuorot sijoittuvat maanantaista sunnuntaihin aamuvuorosta yövuoroon.Hesburgerissa päiväsi koostuvat monipuolisista tehtävistä: asiakaspalvelusta, tuotteiden valmistuksesta sekä ravintolan siisteydestä huolehtimisesta. Tilauksia tulee kassalta, automaateilta ja sovelluksesta, ja jokaisessa tavoitteena on sama: hyvää ruokaa, hyvää palvelua ja siisti ravintola.Kokemuksen karttuessa opit myös omavalvontaa ja varastonhallintaa. Perehdytämme sinut huolellisesti – aiempaa kokemusta et tarvitse, asenne ratkaisee. Oppiminen ei silti pääty perehdytykseen: kampanjatuotteet vaihtuvat, ohjeet päivittyvät ja osaamisesi karttuu matkan varrella. Utelias ote on siis plussaa.Työsuhde ja työajatTarjoilijat: yhteensä 15, joista kokoaikaisia 2 ja osa-aikaisia 13.Työsuhteet ovat vakituisia.Työsopimuksen tuntimäärä sovitaan tilanteen mukaan, 24 – 112,5 tuntia / 3 viikkoa.Ravintola palvelee ympäri vuorokauden, joten työvuoroja on kaikkina vuorokaudenaikoina, myös iltaisin, öisin ja viikonloppuisin.Työ alkaa ennen ravintolan avautumista järjestettävällä perehdytyksellä. Perehdytyksen tarkempi ajankohta ilmoitetaan valituille myöhemmin.MITÄ TARJOAMME?- Henkilökuntaetuja: alennuksia ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista, pankkipalveluista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta.- Epassin etuja: jopa 250 € arvosta vuodessa.- Rahaa: MaRaVa-työehtosopimuksen mukainen palkkaryhmä 2 palkka, 9,77 €/h – 13,58 €/h kokemuksesta riippuen. Lisät tuovat kivasti extraa, ja ne maksetaan myös TES:n mukaisesti.- Tulospalkkaus: mahdollisuus ansaita ylimääräinen jopa 2 kuukauden palkka vuodessa.- Työpaikka, johon on kiva tulla ja olla. Ei tarvitse olla yhtä iloista perhettä, mutta älä ylläty, jos työkavereista tulee ihan vaan kavereita.- Kehittymismahdollisuuksia: voit kasvaa tehtävässäsi tai siirtyä muihin PeeÄssän toimipaikkoihin.MIKÄ ON OSUUSKAUPPA PEEÄSSÄ?Olemme huomanneet, että työtä ja sen tekemistä kuvataan usein erilaisilla korulauseilla, mutta meidän mielestämme tavallisuudessa ei ole mitään pahaa. Täällä Osuuskauppa PeeÄssällä me sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä.Osuuskauppa PeeÄssä on yli 136 000 asiakasomistajan omistama palvelualan yritys Pohjois-Savossa. Tavoitteenamme on olla Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa. Meille se tarkoittaa merkityksellistä työtä, reilua työnantajuutta ja arjen sujuvuutta.Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että voimme tuottaa osuustoiminnallista hyötyä ja kehittää sitä jatkuvasti arvojemme mukaisesti: #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä.Kiinnostuitko?Täytä hakemus viimeistään 13.12.2026.Lisätietoja tehtävistä antaa ravintolapäällikkö Nina Korhonen, puh. 050 313 5461, nina.m.korhonen@sok.fi

jobs.title: Experienced farm team leaders for the harvest 2027
jobs.description:
Hyldetoftegaard A/S is looking for several experienced, reliable and motivated Farm Team Leaders to join our team for the 2027 fruit harvest season in Denmark, we employ approximately 200–220 employees.

We are looking for people with practical experience in agriculture, horticulture or fruit production who can lead and organize teams of fruit pickers and make sure that the daily work is well planned and carried out efficiently.

RECRUITMENT DAYS – CRAIOVA, ROMANIA – JANUARY 2027

RAMADA PLAZA CRAIOVA, Craiova, Romania

Recruitment dates:

·        Tuesday, 26 January 2027

·        Wednesday, 27 January 2027

Selected candidates will be invited to attend a short information meeting followed by individual employment interviews.

IMPORTANT – INVITATION ONLY

Attendance is strictly by individual invitation from Hyldetoftegaard A/S.

Only pre-selected candidates with a confirmed invitation will be admitted.

Unannounced visits and attendance without an invitation will be refused.

Applying does not guarantee an interview or an invitation.

English is the working language within the company.

YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

·        Lead and organize a team of fruit pickers.

·        Plan and distribute the daily work among the workers.

·        Give clear instructions and make sure that tasks are understood.

·        Follow up on the team's daily work, progress and productivity.

·        Make sure that fruit picking is carried out efficiently and correctly.

·        Support the team and solve practical problems during the working day.

·        Register and report the team's daily harvest and output.

·        Keep simple and accurate records of workers, working hours and daily production.

·        Communicate daily information clearly to farm management.

·        Help ensure that safety, hygiene and company rules are followed.

ADMINISTRATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES

The Team Leaders will also have simple administrative responsibilities. You must be comfortable recording daily information and reporting it to management.

·        Register the team's daily fruit harvest/output.

·        Keep track of daily work and working hours.

·        Prepare simple daily reports.

·        Report relevant information and issues to farm management.

ENGLISH – REQUIRED

You must be able to communicate in English with management, understand information and handle everyday communication.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

·        Previous experience as a team leader, supervisor, foreman or similar position.

·        Experience from agriculture, horticulture, fruit production or another relevant field.

·        Experience leading, motivating and organizing a team of workers.

·        Good communication and organizational skills.

·        Ability to take responsibility and work independently.

·        A positive and respectful approach to working with people from different countries.

·        Good English communication skills – required.

·        Good physical condition and willingness to work alongside the team when necessary.

WORKING PERIOD

The 2027 fruit harvest season runs from early May to mid-September or the end of October, depending on the harvest, we prefer you start in February and until Mid – end of October

The exact employment period will be agreed according to the farm's needs and your availability.

WORKING HOURS

·        Work normally starts at 05:00 or 06:00.

·        Approximately 6–7 working hours per day.

·        6 working days per week, with one changing day off.

·        Flexibility is required during busy periods of the harvest.

SALARY

Farm Team Leaders are employed on a fixed monthly salary.

The starting salary is a minimum of DKK 24.000.

The salary will be agreed according to qualifications, previous experience and the responsibilities of the position.

IBAN bank account:

You can only register one IBAN bank account in your own name for salary payments during your employment period.

ACCOMMODATION

Indoor accommodation is available on or near the farm, for the day’s price. Dkr.70,00 will be deducted from salary.

Shared kitchen, bathroom and laundry facilities. The company provides free access to a washing machine, tumble dryer, electricity, water, heating, internet, and cleaning products for the maintenance of the accommodation provided.

 TAX CARD AND HEALTH INSURANCE CARD

The company will apply for your tax card and health insurance card in accordance with your employment contract. These cards will be valid for the agreed employment period. If you are married, you must provide documentation of your marital status.

TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR FOREIGN EMPLOYEES

Foreign employees working temporarily in Denmark may be eligible for certain tax deductions, depending on their individual tax situation.

 Travel between your home country and Denmark

If you maintain your permanent home in your home country and your personal and financial ties remain there, you may be eligible for a deduction for travel between your home country and your workplace in Denmark. Eligibility depends on your Danish tax status. You must keep documentation of your journeys, such as tickets and receipts. The amount shown for 2026 is approximately DKK 6,000.

Double-household deduction

If your employment in Denmark is temporary and you maintain a home both in Denmark and in your home country, you may, under certain conditions, qualify for a deduction for additional household expenses. This may apply when your work requires you to live away from your permanent home.

To qualify, your employment must generally be temporary, and the distance between the two homes must make daily travel unreasonable. The deduction may be available for up to two years.

For 2026, the standard deduction for double housekeeping is DKK 400 per week without documentation. A higher deduction may be possible if you can document your actual expenses. The total deduction for food, accommodation and double housekeeping is subject to an annual maximum of DKK 34,400 for 2026. 

Important: These deductions are not automatic. You are responsible for checking whether you qualify and for entering the relevant deductions on your Danish tax assessment. Keep your documentation in case the Danish Tax Agency requests it.

TRANSPORT TO DENMARK

You must arrange and pay for your own transport to Denmark.

 If possible, bring your own car. A car can make your stay easier and more convenient, as you may need to travel between different farm locations and your accommodation in nearby houses. It will also give you more freedom to explore the local area.

TRACTOR DRIVING & FORKLIFT CERTIFICATE – ADVANTAGES, NOT REQUIREMENTS

These qualifications are wishes from the company and will be considered positively. However, our main priority is to employ good Team Leaders who can lead people, organize the daily work and take responsibility.

HOW TO APPLY:

If you wish to apply, send an email to job@hyldetoftegaard.dk and you will receive an application form. See more at www.hyldetoftegaard.dk

Applicants wishing to attend an employment interview in Craiova must submit their completed application form and a copy of their ID card in advance.

You will then receive a separate invitation, which must be brought to the interview together with documentation of your previous work experience, as outlined in the instructions

 Important – Application Feedback

Only qualified applicants will be contacted.

If you do not receive a response from the company within 14 days of submitting your application, please consider that your application has not been successful and that you have not been selected to proceed to the next stage of the recruitment process.

Thank you for your interest and understanding.

RAMADA PLAZA CRAIOVA, Craiova, Romania

jobs.title: Researcher to join the Autonomous Work Machines research program
jobs.description: Centre for Research and Innovation in focus area Digital Solutions is now looking for a Doctoral Researcher to join the Autonomous Work Machines research program at Oulu University of Applied Sciences (Oamk). The work is for a fixed term 11.1.-31.12.2027.You will study how machine control strategies and charging approaches in off-road machines affect battery performance. Your research will be conducted within the Autonomous Work Machines research program, utilizing the testing and simulation facilities of NuveLab, and will form the basis of your doctoral thesis.Main responsibilitiesAs part of the Autonomous Work Machines research program, you will design and conduct charge and discharge tests on battery packs. Using current, voltage and temperature measurements, you will characterize usable capacity, internal resistance and charge acceptance. Working together with researchers from LUT University and Tampere University, you will evaluate how well cell-level estimates of state of charge (SoC) and state of health (SoH) perform at battery-pack level. Through battery-pack testing and battery emulation, you will assess the impact of these estimation methods on charging time, temperature rise and battery lifetime. Your work combines experimental battery research, data analysis and modelling, contributing to the development of energy-efficient electric and hybrid work machines.The person we're looking forYou hold a masters degree in electrical engineering, automation, or a related field and are motivated to pursue doctoral studies in experimental research. You understand the principles of electric drivetrains or lithium-ion batteries. Through your masters thesis, laboratory work, or industrial projects, you have planned and carried out experiments, analyzed measurement data, and evaluated the reliability of results. You can document experimental procedures so that they can be repeated by other researchers and communicate your findings effectively in English with both academic and industrial partners.Relevant experience includes:- Battery testing and cycling- Capacity and internal resistance estimation from measurement data- Interpretation of battery management system (BMS) outputs- State-of-charge (SoC) and state-of-health (SoH) estimation methods- MATLAB, Simulink, or Python for time-series data analysis and model validationExperience in one or more of these areas is considered an advantage.Research environmentThe Autonomous Work Machines research programme develops energy-efficient machinery for forestry, agriculture, mining and logistics together with industrial partners.The programme's research and testing activities are supported by NuveLab, a unique laboratory environment located on Oamks Linnanmaa campus. NuveLab includes a four-wheel chassis dynamometer, real-time simulation capabilities, and battery emulation systems, enabling the evaluation of electric and hybrid powertrains under repeatable and realistic operating conditions.The research focuses on electric and hybrid powertrains, energy storage technologies, intelligent machine control, and autonomous operation methods that improve energy efficiency and sustainability in mobile machinery.Additional informationSalary and other terms of employment are determined in accordance with the collective agreement for Universities of Applied Sciences: Sivistystyönanatajat ry (for expert and support staff). The application period is 24.11.-8.12.2026. Please, note that applications sent via email will not be processed.For more information: Jukka Säkkinen, Head of development, tel. +358 50 595 7951, jukka.sakkinen@oamk.fi and Tuomas Paaso, Team Leader, tel. + 358 50 512 4370, tuomas.paaso@oamk.fiAt Oulu University of Applied Sciences, we succeed because we boldly try new things and arent afraid to fail. We train experts to meet the needs of the future workforce.Through our research, development, and innovation work, we support Northern Finland in particular and, in line with our priority areas, focus on low-carbon solutions, digital solutions, and business development. jobs.title: Research Assistant followed by a Double Degree PhD position in Urban Design and Pedestrian Experience with AI and VR
jobs.employer: KU - SCIENCE - IGN frb campus omr. 3
jobs.description:
Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen Within the European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Action (MSCA), University of Copenhagen is offering a 1-year Research Assistant (RA) position starting 1 April 2027 (or as soon as possible thereafter), which then leads to a 3-year PhD fellowship for a Doctoral Candidate (DC). The combined position is part of the research project STEP-UP (Safe, Thriving, and Engaged Pedestrians in Urban Public Spaces), which is funded by the European Union’s Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA), Doctoral Networks (DN), Call: HORIZON-MSCA-2025-DN-01. The STEP-UP network supports 10 PhD Candidates in investigating pedestrian behaviour and mobility in urban environments. The 10 PhD projects are closely linked, contributing complementary perspectives to a shared research agenda in three areas: individual and interpersonal aspects of pedestrian behaviour, environmental and infrastructural barriers to walking, and interactions between pedestrians and other road users. The aim is to improve the understanding of pedestrian mobility and support the development of safer and more inclusive urban public spaces. STEP-UP brings together academic and non-academic partners to train 10 doctoral candidates through an international Joint Doctorate programme. The candidates benefit from joint supervision by researchers at partner institutions, an integrated doctoral training programme, and opportunities for interdisciplinary and cross-sectoral collaboration, including research secondments at partner organisations. In addition to specialised scientific knowledge, they develop transferable skills in areas such as research communication and dissemination. The programme prepares them for careers in research and other fields related to transport and urban development. For a description of the STEP-UP project and descriptions of all 10 PhD positions, please visit the STEP-UP project’s website https://www.project-stepup.eu/ STEP-UP is based on 4-year double PhD degree programs. This means that the successful applicant will also be enrolled in a partner university’s PhD programme. Job and project description The RA position will entail carrying out a literature review of the research field, identifying current research gaps, and preparing for data collection. The PhD position will entail carrying out the research activities of the research project as described below. Your key tasks as a PhD fellow at the Faculty of SCIENCE are to:
  • Conduct an independent research project under supervision.
  • Complete PhD courses or other equivalent education corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS points.
  • Participate in active research environments including a mandatory stay for a minimum of 12 months at the partner university (see below for further details).
  • Contribute to teaching or other types of dissemination related to your PhD project (e.g., at conferences, meetings, etc.)
  • Write a PhD thesis on the grounds of your project
About the research project The project “Urban space transformation projects for improved and inclusive walkability”. will investigate how planning and design approaches applied in urban space transformation projects impact pedestrians’ behaviour and perceived safety and accessibility (walkability). Urban transformation projects are increasingly proposed to respond to the evolving needs of contemporary cities. Combining urban planning and transport engineering is essential, as planning shapes the spatial and social context of urban spaces while transport engineering ensures safe, efficient and accessible movement. The PhD project will: (1) collect data on goals and practices of urban space transformation projects; pedestrian pedestrians’ behaviours, preferences and perceptions of walkability in relation to the transformation interventions; (2) identify walkability indicators across diverse groups of pedestrians; (3) comprehensively evaluate pedestrians’ perceived impacts of current transformations for enhanced liveability and pedestrianisation; and (4) develop a methodological framework for local adaptation and upscaling of approaches for enhanced perceived walkability. Partner university: National Technical University of Athens (NTUA) Planned secondments at NTUA: M16–M24 and M37–M48. Pricipal supervisor: Assoc. Prof. Trine Agervig Carstensen, University of Copenhagen, email: tac@ign.ku.dk. Co-supervisor: Prof. Konstantinos Kepaptsoglou, National Technical University of Athens (NTUA), email: kkepap@central.ntua.gr Place of employment The primary place of employment will be Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and state-of-the-art hardware and software. More information on the department can be found here: https://ign.ku.dk/english/ During the PhD programme of research the candidate will be on a secondment for minimum 12 months in total at the partner university. Required qualifications As an applicant you must have:
  • To be eligible for the PhD programme at UCPH, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project, e.g. Urban Planning, Geography, Civil Engineering, Psychology, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Sociology, or related-disciplines. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.
  • To be eligible for the PhD programme at the National University of Athens, you are required to fulfil the requirements described here: https://eur02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.survey.ntua.gr%2Fen%2Fstudies%2Fpostgraduate%2Fdoctoral-studies&data=05%7C02%7Ctac%40ign.ku.dk%7Ce197702553f44a00a12308df44a25d10%7Ca3927f91cda14696af898c9f1ceffa91%7C0%7C0%7C639305136264965933%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=62PInKwPpyGrwa3VViUOFLlXisPlz4b7rgs6kdWwhNI%3D&reserved=0
  • Fluency in English and excellent communications skills.
Applicants will also be required to meet the European Commission’s MSCA Doctoral Network eligibility criteria, notably:
  • Mobility Rule - Applicants can be of any nationality and must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before the start of their employment at UCPH. Compulsory national service, short stays such as holidays, and time spent as part of a procedure for obtaining refugee status under the Geneva Convention are not considered.
  • Doctoral Candidate requirement – the applicant must not be in possession of a doctoral degree at the first day of the employment. Researchers who have successfully defended their doctoral thesis, but who have not yet been awarded the doctoral degree are not eligible.
Please note that you will only be considered for the position if you fulfil both above eligibility criteria. Who are we looking for? We are looking for candidates within the field(s) of spatial, engineering, or behavioural sciences. Applicants can have a background in Urban and Regional Planning, Geography, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Psychology, Sociology, or related disciplines. The following experiences and skills will be emphasised. Applicants are encouraged to provide relevant details and supporting evidence, where applicable:
  • Urban design / urban planning
  • Human-environment interactions
  • Qualitative case study methods
  • Data analysis / statistical analysis
Personal attributes that are desirable:
  • Strong motivation for high-quality research
  • Collaborative spirit
  • Systematic approach to research
  • Attention to detail
Key criteria for the assessment of applicants
  • Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project
  • Relevance of studies, coursework, and thesis
  • Relevant work experience (if any)
  • Publications (if any)
  • The grade point average achieved
  • Other professional activities
  • Language skills
  • Quality and relevance of project proposal
  • The successful applicant is also required to be enterprising and to possess good interpersonal skills
Terms of employment The arrangement concerns two separate fixed-term positions: initially as a Research Assistant, leading towards an appointment as a PhD fellow. The respective durations of the two positions are 1 year and 3 years. The position as a PhD fellow is contingent upon the successful enrolment of a suitable candidate in the PhD School at the University of Copenhagen, as well as satisfactory completion of the Research Assistant period. These assessments will be carried out 3-6 months prior to the expiry of the Research Assistant contract. The start date is 1 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The PhD study must be completed in accordance with The Ministerial Order on the PhD programme (2013) and the faculty’s rules on achieving the degree. Salary, pension and terms of employment are in accordance with the requirements from the European Commission related to the MSCA programme and the agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Depending on seniority, the monthly salary starts at approximately 31,850 DKK/roughly 4,260 EUR (August 2026 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18.07 % to your pension fund. Application and assessment procedure Your application, written in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking “Apply now” below and must include the following documents in PDF format:
  • Motivation letter of application (max. one page)
  • A project proposal (max 5 pages where the candidate presents a proposal on how they wish to approach their project including theory and methods)
  • CV incl. education, experience, language skills, publication list (if any), and other skills relevant for the position
  • Certified copy of original master’s diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorised English translation if issued in other language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. As a prerequisite for a PhD position employment, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database. Please note that we might ask you to obtain an assessment of your education performed by the Ministry of Higher Education and Science. Applicants with a master´s degree from abroad should also enclose a short description of the grading scale used. Certified copy of original bachelor’s diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorised English translation if issued in other language than English or Danish. If the applicant has completed a combined bachelor’s and master’s education (e.g. 5-year combined master’s), the applicant should submit the combined diploma, transcript of records, and authorised English translations if issued in other language than English or Danish.
  • Language diplomas or language test results (if any)
The deadline for applications is 20 December 2026, at 23.59pm CET. We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements. The further process After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorised recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. The assessor makes a non-prioritised assessment of the academic qualifications and experience with respect to the above-mentioned area of research, techniques, skills and other requirements listed in the advertisement. Once the assessment work has been completed, each applicant can comment on the part of the assessment that relates to him/herself. The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities. You may read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/ For more information on working and living in Denmark visit http://ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility) and https://www.workindenmark.dk. Interviews are expected to take place in the beginning of February 2027. Questions For specific information about the PhD position, please contact the principal supervisor, Trine Agervig Carstensen. The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and encourages all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Researcher in Human Skin Biology and Wound Healing
jobs.description:
Postdoctoral Researcher in Human Skin Biology and Wound Healing Department of Biology, Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen The Department of Biology at the University of Copenhagen invites applications for a postdoctoral researcher in human skin biology and wound healing. The position is part of a newly established research group investigating how cells coordinate their behaviour to maintain and repair tissues. The position is fully funded for at least 2 years, with the possibility of extension, through generous funding from the LEO Foundation. The earliest possible start date is 1 April 2027. Please clearly state your availability and preferred start date in your cover letter. Information about the Department of Biology is available at https://www1.bio.ku.dk/english/. Information about the specific research section you will be affiliated with is available at https://www1.bio.ku.dk/english/research/cbp/. Project overview The overarching aim is to develop strategies to help people with slow- or non-healing wounds. This project investigates how planar cell polarity (PCP)—the coordinated orientation of cells within a tissue—contributes to human skin organization and wound repair. Although PCP signaling is essential for tissue organization across many organisms, its role in human epidermis remains poorly understood. You will establish reconstructed human epidermis (RHE) as an experimental model to investigate PCP signaling in human skin, then use advanced fluorescence microscopy to characterize PCP clusters, their polarization, and how they change during wound repair and in response to other stressors. The project bridges fundamental questions in cell and developmental biology with potential long-term applications in regenerative medicine and skin repair. It is supported by collaborators with expertise in RHE development and by access to confocal and advanced microscopy, including SIM, TIRF, and STED. The project provides a clear starting point and room to shape the research questions as findings emerge. In your cover letter, please clearly describe what interests you about the project and what related research questions you would be excited to explore. Your role We are seeking a motivated, technically skilled, and scientifically independent postdoctoral researcher to play a central role in establishing this research programme. As one of the first members of a newly established research group, you will have an exceptional opportunity to shape its experimental approaches, contribute to its scientific direction, and help build a collaborative, ambitious research environment. Your primary responsibility will be to establish and optimize experimental systems to investigate PCP signaling in reconstructed human epidermis. You will work closely with the PI while taking substantial ownership of day-to-day experimental development and execution of the project. Your responsibilities will include:
  • Establish and optimize robust, reproducible assays with mature, stratified RHE cultures.
  • Develop and optimize immunostaining, advanced microscopy, and quantitative imaging workflows.
  • Analyze and interpret experimental data, contributing scientific ideas, and identifying promising new research directions.
  • Prepare manuscripts for publication in peer-reviewed journals and presenting findings at local and international conferences.
  • Contribute to the development of a supportive, collaborative, and scientifically rigorous lab environment.
  • Help train and supervise students or other researchers as the group expands.
Profile We are seeking a curious and proactive researcher who can take ownership of their experiments while collaborating constructively with the project team. You do not need experience with every method listed below; training and collaboration will help you develop the techniques needed for the project. Essential experience and skills:
  • PhD in cell biology, developmental biology, skin biology, molecular biology, tissue engineering, biophysics, or a closely related field by the time of appointment.
  • Extensive hands-on experience in mammalian cell culture, with demonstrated ability to independently establish, optimize, and troubleshoot experimental protocols.
  • Demonstrated experience in fluorescence microscopy and immunofluorescence staining.
  • Evidence of scientific independence, initiative, and the ability to advance an experimental research project, including strong organizational skills.
  • A solid publication record appropriate for your career stage.
  • Excellent written and spoken English skills.
In the cover letter, you are encouraged to highlight an example of experimental independence, including situations in which you have established or substantially improved an experimental method, solved a challenging technical problem, or independently advanced a research project. Desirable experience and skills:
  • Experience with human keratinocyte culture, reconstructed human epidermis, organotypic skin cultures, or other 3D epithelial models.
  • Experience establishing new experimental model systems or developing and optimizing complex cell-culture protocols.
  • Experience with quantitative image analysis using Fiji/ImageJ, Python, or other comparable computational tools.
  • Experience with molecular perturbation techniques, including CRISPR/Cas9, RNA interference, and genetic manipulation of mammalian cells.
  • Experience with confocal microscopy or an advanced imaging technique such as SIM, TIRF, or STED.
  • Experience mentoring or supervising students or junior researchers.
Research shows that women and other underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. If you are excited about this position and believe you can contribute, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if your experience does not perfectly match every point. We value curiosity, motivation, and the potential and willingness to learn. What we offer
  • An opportunity to join a newly established research group and meaningfully contribute to its scientific development.
  • A central role in an ambitious, externally funded research project that addresses fundamental and medically relevant questions.
  • Substantial scientific independence and opportunities to develop novel experimental approaches.
  • Close scientific interaction with the PI and opportunities to shape future research directions.
  • Access to the research infrastructure and collaborative environment at the University of Copenhagen.
  • Opportunities for international collaboration, conference participation, publication, and professional development.
The position offers an excellent opportunity for a researcher seeking to develop greater scientific independence and strengthen their qualifications for a future academic or research leadership career. jobs.description: Vi söker en vårdare med närvårdarutbildning till Treklangens servicepunkt. Anställningen är tidsbunden för tiden 4.1.2027-20.10.2027 med eventuell förlängning. Arbetet är i allmän arbetstid, dagtid, i regel måndag-fredag. Arbetsspråket är svenska. Treklangens arbets- och dagverksamhet är en svenspråkig enhet och finns på Kånalavägen i Kånala, Helsingfors. Vi erbjuder arbetsverksamhet samt dagverksamhet för vuxna personer med intellektuella funktionsvariationer. Enheten sysselsätter cirka 55 klienter i sex basgrupper med olika inriktningar. Nu söker vi en vårdare till vårt team inom Stukturverksamheten. Vi söker dig som är pedagogisk, strukturerad och har förmåga att planera och leda en målmedveten verksamhet som engagerar, motiverar och utvecklar klienter. jobs.title: Chauffør til dagdistribution hos NAKA A/S / Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S
jobs.description:
Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S

Chauffør til dagdistribution hos NAKA A/S

NAKA A/S vokser, og vi søger nu en stabil og ansvarsbevidst chauffør til dagdistribution. Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor kvalitet, punktlighed og god kundeservice er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Om NAKA A/S

NAKA Logistics er en transportvirksomhed med hovedsæde i Trekantsområdet. Vores centrale placering og vores dygtige medarbejdere gør os i stand til at løfte både store og små opgaver effektivt.Vi leverer hurtige og præcise løsninger til enhver transportopgave, og med eget værksted holder vi vores biler kørende 24 timer i døgnet – samtidig med at vi holder omkostningerne nede.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en fleksibel og ansvarsfuld chauffør til vores velfungerende team. Hos os er samarbejde vigtigt – vi hjælper hinanden, så dagens opgaver løses effektivt og uden unødige problemer.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Kørsel med lastbil i dagdistribution

  • Levering og aflæsning hos faste kunder

  • Sortering og håndtering af gods ved pålæsning

  • Arbejdstid typisk mellem 06:00–17:00

Du får naturligvis en grundig oplæring, hvor du kører med en af vores erfarne chauffører, så du lærer ruter, procedurer og arbejdspladsen at kende. Vi står altid klar til at hjælpe, hvis der opstår udfordringer undervejs.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har kørekort C og/eller CE

  • Har gennemført lastbilchaufføruddannelsen

  • Er mødestabil, selvstændig og ansvarsbevidst

  • Har god fysik og kan håndtere gods

  • Trives med dagarbejde og faste rutiner

  • Kan kommunikere venligt og professionelt med kunder og disponenter

➕ Det er en fordel, hvis du:

  • Har erfaring med distribution eller lignende kørsel

⭐ Vi tilbyder:

  • En fast stilling i en virksomhed med ordnede forhold

  • Velholdte lastbiler

  • Grundig oplæring i ruter og procedurer

  • Gode kollegaer og en uformel omgangstone

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

Interesseret?

Send din ansøgning og relevante dokumenter til:job@naka.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og ser frem til et godt samarbejde.

Truck Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S

NAKA A/S is growing, and we are now looking for a reliable and responsible truck driver for day distribution. You will become part of a professional team where quality, punctuality, and excellent customer service are a natural part of everyday work.

About NAKA A/S

NAKA Logistics is a transport company headquartered in the Triangle Region of Denmark. Our central location and skilled employees enable us to handle both large and small transport assignments efficiently.

We provide fast and precise solutions for every transport task, and with our own workshop, we keep our fleet running 24 hours a day while maintaining cost efficiency.

About the Position

We are looking for a flexible and responsible driver to join our well-functioning team. Teamwork is important to us, and we help each other ensure that daily tasks are completed efficiently and without unnecessary issues.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Driving a truck on day distribution routes

  • Delivering and unloading goods for regular customers

  • Sorting and handling freight during loading

  • Working hours typically between 06:00 and 17:00

You will receive thorough training alongside one of our experienced drivers, allowing you to become familiar with routes, procedures, and the workplace. We are always available to support you if challenges arise during the workday.

We Expect You To:

  • Hold a Category C and/or CE driving licence

  • Have completed the professional truck driver qualification/training

  • Be reliable, independent, and responsible

  • Be physically fit and able to handle freight

  • Enjoy daytime work and structured routines

  • Communicate politely and professionally with customers and dispatchers

➕ It Is an Advantage If You:

  • Have experience with distribution driving or similar transport work

⭐ We Offer:

  • A permanent position in a company with well-organized working conditions

  • Well-maintained trucks

  • Thorough training in routes and procedures

  • Good colleagues and an informal working environment

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience

Interested?

Please send your application and relevant documents to:

job@naka.dk

We look forward to hearing from you and to a successful future collaboration.

There are 2 vacancies available.
