jobs.title: Restaurantdriftsleder / Restaurant Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Restaurant Operations Manager

About Us

At Bagel Bites, we believe that good food, excellent customer service, and efficient restaurant management go hand in hand.

Following a restructuring of our management team, we are looking for a responsible, motivated, and flexible employee to take charge of the restaurant's daily operations.

The position combines restaurant management, kitchen duties, customer service, purchasing, and administrative responsibilities. The successful candidate must be willing to take an active role in all aspects of the restaurant's operations, including physically working in the kitchen.

Responsibilities

As Restaurant Operations Manager, you will be responsible for the overall daily operation of the restaurant. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Managing and coordinating the restaurant's daily operations.

  • Supervising employees, delegating tasks, preparing work schedules, and ensuring efficient teamwork.

  • Preparing and serving fast food, including sandwiches, burgers, bagels, and other menu items.

  • Actively participating in kitchen activities, food preparation, cleaning, and maintaining hygiene standards.

  • Purchasing raw materials, ingredients, and other necessary supplies for the restaurant.

  • Managing inventory, monitoring stock levels, and ensuring the availability of necessary ingredients.

  • Handling customer service, taking orders, and resolving customer inquiries or complaints.

  • Developing and implementing marketing initiatives to promote the restaurant.

  • Managing the company's social media accounts and online presence.

  • Assisting with financial and administrative tasks, including budgeting, sales monitoring, reporting, and basic accounting.

  • Ensuring compliance with food safety regulations, hygiene requirements, and company procedures.

Qualifications and Skills

We are looking for a candidate who has:

  • Relevant education or practical experience in restaurant management, hospitality, or the food service industry.

  • Experience in kitchen operations and fast-food preparation.

  • Good organizational and leadership skills, with the ability to manage employees and delegate responsibilities.

  • Strong customer service and communication skills.

  • Knowledge of purchasing, inventory management, and supplier coordination.

  • Basic understanding of financial administration and accounting.

  • Ability to work independently, take responsibility, and handle multiple tasks.

  • A flexible and hands-on approach, with willingness to perform both managerial and practical kitchen duties.

Application

If you believe your experience and skills match our requirements, we encourage you to send your application and CV to:

Email: info@sundsult.dk or rkbgaps@gmail.com

Please use the subject line: "Application – Restaurant Operations Manager".

 

 

 

Restaurantdriftsleder

Om os

Hos Bagel Bites mener vi, at god mad, fremragende kundeservice og effektiv restaurantledelse går hånd i hånd.

Efter en mindre omstrukturering af vores ledelsesteam søger vi nu en ansvarsbevidst, motiveret og fleksibel medarbejder, der kan varetage ansvaret for restaurantens daglige drift.

Stillingen omfatter en kombination af restaurantledelse, køkkenarbejde, kundeservice, indkøb og administrative opgaver. Den rette kandidat skal være indstillet på at deltage aktivt i alle dele af restaurantens drift, herunder også praktisk arbejde i køkkenet.

Arbejdsopgaver og ansvarsområder

Som Restaurantdriftsleder får du ansvaret for den overordnede daglige drift af restauranten. Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil omfatte:

  • At lede og koordinere restaurantens daglige drift.

  • At føre tilsyn med medarbejderne, uddelegere arbejdsopgaver, udarbejde arbejdsplaner og sikre et effektivt samarbejde i teamet.

  • At tilberede og servere fastfood, herunder sandwiches, burgere, bagels og andre menuprodukter.

  • At deltage aktivt i køkkenarbejdet, herunder madlavning, klargøring af råvarer, rengøring og overholdelse af hygiejnestandarder.

  • At stå for indkøb af råvarer, ingredienser og øvrige nødvendige forsyninger til restauranten.

  • At administrere lagerbeholdningen, overvåge lagerstatus og sikre, at de nødvendige råvarer altid er tilgængelige.

  • At varetage kundeservice, modtage bestillinger og håndtere kundehenvendelser og eventuelle klager.

  • At udvikle og gennemføre markedsføringsinitiativer med henblik på at promovere restauranten.

  • At administrere virksomhedens sociale medier og online tilstedeværelse.

  • At bidrage til økonomiske og administrative opgaver, herunder budgettering, overvågning af omsætning, rapportering og grundlæggende regnskabsopgaver.

  • At sikre, at gældende fødevaresikkerhedsregler, hygiejnekrav og virksomhedens interne procedurer overholdes.

Kvalifikationer og kompetencer

Vi søger en kandidat, der har følgende kvalifikationer og kompetencer:

  • Relevant uddannelse eller praktisk erfaring inden for restaurantledelse, hotel- og restaurationsbranchen eller fødevarebranchen.

  • Erfaring med køkkendrift og tilberedning af fastfood.

  • Gode organisatoriske og ledelsesmæssige evner samt erfaring med personaleledelse og uddelegering af arbejdsopgaver.

  • Gode kommunikations- og kundeservicekompetencer.

  • Kendskab til indkøb, lagerstyring og koordinering med leverandører.

  • Grundlæggende forståelse for økonomisk administration og regnskab.

  • Evne til at arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar og håndtere flere forskellige arbejdsopgaver.

  • En fleksibel og praktisk tilgang til arbejdet samt villighed til både at varetage ledelsesmæssige opgaver og deltage aktivt i køkkenets daglige arbejde.

Ansøgning

Hvis du mener, at dine erfaringer og kvalifikationer matcher vores krav, opfordrer vi dig til at sende din ansøgning og dit CV til en af følgende e-mailadresser:

E-mail: info@sundsult.dk eller rkbgaps@gmail.com

jobs.title: Mötesbokare (BDR) till Köpenhamn, (45 000sek grundlön)
jobs.description: Vi har en tydlig vision: Att bli Skandinaviens ledande aktör inom förebyggande arbetsmiljöarbete genom digitala videoinstruktioner.Vi har redan etablerat oss på den danska marknaden och nu satsar vi stort på Sverige!Därför söker vi 4 nya mötesbokare (BDR) som vill vara med och utveckla vår svenska verksamhet.Hos oss blir du en del av ett socialt och ambitiöst team där vi arbetar målmedvetet, firar våra framgångar och hjälper varandra att bli bättre varje dag.Vi sitter i Köpenhamn, med smidig pendling från Malmö med tåg.Din lön och dina möjligheterVi tror på att goda prestationer ska belönas.    En konkurrenskraftig fast grundlön baserad på din erfarenhet.    En attraktiv bonusmodell där dina resultat syns direkt på lönebeskedet.    Möjlighet att påverka din egen inkomst genom dina prestationer.Hos oss får du både tryggheten i en fast lön och möjligheten att tjäna mer när du lyckas.Vad erbjuder vi dig?    En spännande tillväxtresa: Bli en del av vår satsning på den svenska marknaden och bidra till att bygga något stort.    En meningsfull produkt: Hjälp företag att skapa säkrare arbetsplatser och ta hand om sina medarbetare.    En stark gemenskap: Vi arbetar tillsammans mot tydliga mål, stöttar varandra och firar våra framgångar.    Individuell utveckling: Vi ser dina styrkor och hjälper dig att utveckla dina kompetenser genom personlig coaching, feedback och löpande utbildning.    En ambitiös säljkultur: Vi har höga mål och arbetar fokuserat för att nå dem, samtidigt som vi värdesätter trivsel, gemenskap och arbetsglädje.    En arbetsplats med energi: Härliga kollegor, god stämning, gemensamma aktiviteter och en vardag där det ska vara roligt att gå till jobbet.    Bra förmåner: God lunch varje dag, kaffe och ett trevligt kontor i Köpenhamn.    Karriärmöjligheter: Vi växer och vill gärna utveckla framtidens specialister, toppsäljare och ledare internt.Vem är du?Vi tror att det finns många olika personligheter som kan lyckas inom försäljning. Det viktigaste för oss är din inställning, ditt engagemang och din vilja att utvecklas.Vi föreställer oss att du:    Har erfarenhet av mötesbokning eller vill utvecklas till att bli riktigt duktig på det.    Är kommunikativ och tycker om att skapa kontakt med nya människor.    Är målmedveten, uthållig och motiveras av att se resultat.    Vill utveckla dina färdigheter och är öppen för feedback och coaching.    Trivs i en miljö där vi arbetar mot gemensamma mål och samtidigt har roligt tillsammans.    Talar flytande svenska och vill arbeta med den svenska marknaden.Du behöver inte vara färdigutvecklad som säljare när du börjar hos oss. Det viktiga är att du har viljan att lära dig och bli bättre.Vad kommer du att göra?Som BDR får du en viktig roll i vår svenska tillväxtresa.Du kommer att kontakta svenska företag, presentera hur man kan hjälpa dem med arbetsmiljö och säkerhet samt boka kvalificerade möten åt våra säljare.Du får en strukturerad introduktion, löpande stöd och personlig coaching för att utvecklas i din roll.Vi arbetar med tydliga mål och följer upp våra resultat, men vi vet också att människor utvecklas på olika sätt. Därför lägger vi stor vikt vid att förstå dina styrkor och hjälpa dig att nå din fulla potential.Arbetsplats: KöpenhamnDu arbetar från vårt kontor i Köpenhamn tillsammans med både danska och svenska kollegor.Bor du i Malmö eller i närheten? Då är det smidigt att pendla över Öresund med tåget.Hos oss får du en internationell arbetsmiljö med höga ambitioner, god gemenskap och kollegor som vill lyckas tillsammans.Vi söker människor som vill bidra, utvecklas och vara en del av vår fortsatta resa.Hos oss finns det plats för olika personligheter, men vi delar samma inställning: Vi sätter höga mål, arbetar för att nå dem och firar när vi lyckas.Vi har ambitionerna. Vi har produkten. Nu vill vi ha dig med på resan!Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

jobs.title: Academic Employee in Coordinated Robotic Shipbuilding
jobs.description:
SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP), part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a fully funded position as Academic Employee in the area of model- and simulation-based planning and control of robotic shipbuilding operations (such as hull welding). Main work location is Odense/Denmark at SDU and Odense Havn (Odense Port).

Research environment

The candidate will be part of SDU’s newly established Center for Large Structure Production (LSP). LSP’s central ambition is to provide a physical “go-to” lab for companies in the sectors maritime, construction and energy to carry out research, development and testing of novel solutions in the production of large structures, such as buildings, ships and offshore platforms. In this context, the candidate is expected to work closely with our industrial partners on application-oriented use cases, while helping to commission and operate the unique set of equipment of the center. 

LSP is closely working together the companies at Odense Havn and similar partners making large structures across Denmark and Europe. LSP is integrated with the Odense Robotics Cluster involving startups and established companies in robotics. We are a team of currently 17 researchers and engineers, specializing in robot solutions involving modelling, simulation, and control of advanced robot technologies (systems and services) for application-oriented industrial applications. 

Our group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team, with flexible work organization and support of individual development.

Job description

The position as Academic Employee is associated with projects in the sectors maritime, construction and energy. The overall objective of the project is to develop, control and demonstrate LSP’s robotic solutions for executing central production operations, such as welding, 3D concrete printing and composite layup. The main activities in the projects will be industrial R&D tasks carried out by LSP’s engineers in close collaboration with company partners. 

The starting point for the candidate to develop their academic profile in LSP will be to work on so-called “zero programming” methods and tools to define a digital workflow from product design to production operations. Based on analyzing digital product descriptions, the candidate will develop detailed mode-, simulation, and data-based control strategies to carry out the required production operations, including multiple robots, tools, and sensors. Facilitating Digital Twins, these control strategies will then be further developed into control of the physical assets in LSP, i.e. its unique multi-purpose/multi-robot gantry system.

Profile and requirements

The candidate is expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Documented education as engineer or technician

  • Documented experience with simulation of industrial robots

  • Strong programming skills (particularly in C/C++ and Python)

  • Ability to work independently as part of an agile team, with a strong sense of responsibility

  • Willingness to engage in application-oriented R&D, by closely interacting with company staff

In close teamwork with our researchers and staff from our industrial partners, the candidate will grow hands-on expertise in robotic production operations, including robots, tools, and sensors. 

Contact information

For further information, please contact Head of Center, Professor Christian Schlette via email (chsch@mmmi.sdu.dk) or on LinkedIn (www.linkedin.com/in/christian-schlette/).

Application deadline: December 2, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

"Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.”

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Projektleder
jobs.description:
Bliv en del af et innovativt miljø! Vær med til at skabe værdi og godt arbejdsmiljø hos vores kunder gennem den nyeste teknologi.

Vi søger en projektleder, der tager ansvar for det samlede projektresultat. Du skaber overblik, får aftaler omsat til handling og sikrer, at kunden får den aftalte leverance til tiden og inden for projektets økonomiske ramme.

Stillingen er relevant for dig, der:

  • Brænder for kommerciel projektledelse og motiveres af at skabe fremdrift og få opgaver, mennesker og aftaler til at hænge sammen.

  • Trives i et tværfagligt team, hvor du samler forskellige fagligheder om et fælles mål.

  • Motiveres af afvekslende projekter med kundetilpassede robotløsninger og ansvar for både forløbet og resultatet.

Stillingen

Som Projektleder har du det samlede ansvar fra overdragelsen fra salg til projektets afslutning og evaluering. Du styrer tidsplan, økonomi og samlet fremdrift og har ansvaret for kunderelationen, ændringsstyringen og projektets samlede risikobillede.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med dine kolleger i salg og de øvrige fagområder. Vores tekniske projektarkitekt er din sparringspartner og afklarer løsningskonceptet og de tekniske risici. Du samler indsatserne og sikrer, at de understøtter projektets mål.

Du definerer projektets ressourcebehov, følger op på milepælene og reagerer, når noget påvirker leverancen.

Eksempler på dine arbejdsopgaver:

  • Sikre en struktureret overdragelse fra salg og afklare projektets omfang, kundekrav, budget, forudsætninger og åbne punkter.

  • Afklare projektets ressourcer, tidsplaner og budget i tæt samarbejde med den tekniske projektarkitekt.

  • Udarbejde og opdatere projektplanen med tydelige milepæle, ansvar og deadlines samt koordinere ressource- og kompetencebehov.

  • Varetage kundedialogen, afstemme forventninger og følge op på kundens beslutninger og leverancer.

  • Håndtere ændringer og deres konsekvenser for tid, økonomi, ressourcer og kunde.

  • Planlægge dokumentationsleverancer fra projekts opstart og følge op på, at de bliver klar som aftalt.

  • Rapportere projektstatus, håndtere projektrisici og sikre rettidig handling.

Du arbejder efter Danrobotics’ projektmodel og bidrager med erfaringer og forbedringsforslag til vores projektgennemførelse.

Din profil

Du har erfaring med projektledelse af tekniske leverancer og med at koordinere flere fagområder gennem et samlet projektforløb.

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Styrer tidsplaner, milepæle og projektøkonomi og følger op på de aftalte mål.

  • Skaber tydelig retning og engagement, så teamet tager ansvar og leverer de aftalte resultater.

  • Har erfaring med kundedialog og sikrer klar forventningsafstemning undervejs.

  • Arbejder systematisk med risici, ændringer og dokumentation.

  • Omsætter projektstatus til konkrete prioriteringer og handlinger.

  • Kommunikerer på dansk og engelsk. Tysk er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Du kombinerer et kommercielt mindset med teknisk forståelse og inddrager specialisternes viden, når du træffer beslutninger i projektet.

Vi tilbyder

Hos Danrobotics får du ansvar for det samlede projektresultat og mandat til at drive projekterne og træffe beslutninger inden for de aftalte rammer. Du får tæt samarbejde med tekniske specialister og kolleger, der udvikler og bygger løsningerne. Samtidig får du mulighed for at påvirke vores projektarbejde og bruge dine erfaringer til at forbedre både samarbejdet og kommende leverancer.

Vi prioriterer fleksibilitet, personlig og faglig udvikling af den enkeltes kompetencer, medarbejderinddragelse og tillidsbaserede relationer – både internt og eksternt. Vi arbejder med frihed under ansvar og tilbyder løbende udvikling og uddannelse.

Lønnen aftales efter dine kvalifikationer.

Praktisk information

Ansøgning og CV sendes til Bodil Koertsen: bk@danrobotics.dk

Du er velkommen til at ringe og høre nærmere om stillingen ved Bodil Koertsen, telefon +45 61 24 33 89.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og afslutter processen, når vi har fundet den rette kollega. Vi ønsker at besætte stillingen hurtigst muligt.

Kort om Danrobotics

Danrobotics har hovedkontor i Middelfart, tæt på motorvejen, og et datterselskab i Neumünster, Tyskland. Vi leverer robotløsninger til industrien – fra simple automatiseringsopgaver til store, komplekse løsninger, der omfatter hele produktionslinjer. Derudover tilbyder vi service og vedligeholdelse af alle typer robotanlæg.

Vi er 38 engagerede medarbejdere, der brænder for at udvikler, installerer og servicerer værdiskabende løsninger inden for robotteknologi og automatisering til industrivirksomheder i både Danmark og udlandet. Vi samarbejder med nogle af branchens førende leverandører for at sikre vores kunder de bedste løsninger. Læs mere om Danrobotics her.

jobs.title: CX Systems & Automation Lead
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As our CX Systems & Automation Lead, you'll own the systems that power Notion's global support organization. Reporting to the Head of AMER & EMEA Direct Support, you'll administer and evolve our CX tools (Zendesk, Decagon, and Assembled) as Notion scales, and help decide what our stack looks like next. This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you'll work closely with CX leadership to shape our systems strategy, then design, build, and ship it yourself.



This role is based in our San Francisco office. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Own administration and architecture of our Helpdesk and CX platforms, design and build routing, automations, macros, SLAs, permissions, customizations, and third-party integrations, and set best practices for how they're used

 - Partner with CX leadership to shape our CX systems strategy and roadmap, then lead delivery from design through implementation, including running system RFPs when needed and advising on the impact of changes on teams, workflows, and customers

 - Partner with our AI team to configure, maintain, and improve our AI support agents, including knowledge inputs, guardrails, and performance tracking, and help CX leaders decide where automation should and shouldn't handle customer conversations

 - Own change management for CX systems, from prioritizing requests to sandbox testing, release planning, access controls, data privacy (e.g., GDPR, PII handling), and communicating changes to global teams

 - Partner with our global (AMER, EMEA, APAC, & Vendor) CX team to be the point of contact for our CX tool stack

 - Partner with CX leaders to drive tool-related reporting and data visibility

 - Identify, diagnose, and resolve issues that arise with CX tooling systems

 - Maintain up-to-date documentation for our CX tools, including key decisions, major changes, and the business reasons behind routing and automation choices




SKILLS YOU'LL BRING

 - You have 7+ years of relevant experience, ideally in SaaS or AI, with deep hands-on administration of an enterprise helpdesk or CRM (e.g., Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, Fin); experience running or migrating between platforms is a plus

 - You're comfortable with APIs, webhooks, and SQL, have built custom integrations, and have partnered with technical teams to deploy AI agents in a support environment; scripting (JavaScript or Python) or integration tools (e.g., Workato, Zapier) are a plus

 - You're as comfortable in a strategy discussion as in the admin console, and you've personally built the configurations and integrations you've recommended

 - You have experience supporting cross-functional programs that relate to CX, operations, engineering, and enablement

 - You can translate business needs and strategy into technical deliverables and clear roadmaps, and keep leaders and stakeholders aligned on status, milestones, and risks

 - You have a metrics mindset: you measure success by outcomes and have built dashboards that tell a clear story with KPIs

 - You have a scaled approach to tool management & implementation

 - You thrive in ambiguity and can manage technical and administrative work independently as priorities change



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $179,000 - $200,000 per year.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Campaign Lead, Brand
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion's Integrated Marketing team connects our brand story to the world—ensuring that every campaign, launch, and experience builds on global awareness of Notion as the intelligent, AI-connected workspace for modern work. We're looking for a senior brand campaign leader who can set the vision for our biggest moments, turn ambiguous business goals into breakthrough campaign strategy, and rally a lean, cross-functional team to deliver work that's both culturally relevant and commercially effective.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

The Campaign Lead, Brand owns the strategy, orchestration, and performance of Notion's largest integrated brand campaigns—the tentpole moments that tell the most important stories about who we are, what we make, and why it matters. You'll be the connective tissue across launches and campaigns, making sure every global brand moment brings a cohesive, inspiring narrative to market across channels, audiences, and regions.

Reporting to the Head of Brand & Integrated Marketing, you'll set the brand campaign roadmap, lead campaigns end-to-end from first brief to performance readout, and raise the bar for how the team plans, builds, and learns. You'll partner closely with Product Marketing, Creative, Comms, Growth Marketing, and Regional Marketing leads, and help develop other campaign managers on the team. Responsibilities include:

 - Define and own the annual brand campaign roadmap, aligning tentpole moments to company priorities, product launches, and business goals

 - Lead Notion's largest cross-functional tentpole campaigns from strategy through execution and measurement, making high-stakes calls on concept, channel mix, and trade-offs

 - Partner with in-house Creative to originate and champion bold, category-defining brand concepts, and know when to push an idea further versus when to ship it

 - Partner with Product Marketing and Comms to unify product and brand narratives into a single, compelling story for each moment

 - Own campaign budgets and agency/vendor relationships, and partner with Growth Marketing on integrated brand and performance media from planning through reporting

 - Build the measurement framework for brand campaigns with Analytics and Growth, connecting awareness and consideration to pipeline and business outcomes

 - Collaborate with regional teams and localization to adapt and scale campaigns across EMEA, APAC, and other key markets

 - Evolve the campaign operating system—briefs, tiering, workback plans, retros, and AI-powered workflows—so the whole team moves faster with more clarity

 - Represent brand campaigns with marketing leadership and executives, presenting strategy, progress, and results with a clear point of view




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 12+ years of experience in integrated or brand marketing, preferably in AI or tech, with a track record of leading large-scale, multi-channel brand campaigns that moved the business

 - Idea catalyst: You bring a concept-led approach and an opinionated point of view, sparking, shaping, and shepherding breakthrough concepts until they're undeniable—and you can sell them up and across the org

 - Strategic owner: You turn ambiguous goals into a clear campaign strategy and roadmap, and you're comfortable owning outcomes, budget, and trade-offs end to end

 - Hybrid brand + performance thinker: You care about craft and tone, and you think rigorously about metrics, media, and sales enablement. You're not a purist in any one discipline

 - AI fluency: You have deep, first-hand experience experimenting with AI tools and agents, and you have a perspective on the balance of human vs. AI in creative generation

 - Speed: You bias toward action and operate with ambition, creating processes that help cross-functional teams do the same

 - Leader without the title: People on the projects you lead become the best versions of themselves by working with you. You influence senior stakeholders, navigate conflicting feedback, and level up the people around you

 - Order agent: You possess strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to run multiple complex workstreams at once while iterating for improvement




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience leading global and/or regionalized campaigns

 - Experience managing creative agencies and large media budgets

 - Familiarity with hybrid audience targeting (individuals, teams, and enterprise)

 - Experience mentoring or managing marketers

 - Experience using Notion—both personally and professionally

jobs.title: Senior / Staff Software Engineer, Connectors Platform
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Connectors let Replit’s agents and applications securely access the tools and data people already use. Behind every connection are hard systems problems: whose identity is being used, what they’re allowed to access, how credentials stay valid, and how those guarantees hold across services and execution environments.



We’re looking for a Senior or Staff Software Engineer with deep experience in authentication, authorization, security, and distributed systems to own this foundation. You’ll build and operate the infrastructure that makes connections work reliably across Replit’s projects, agent conversations, and environment builds.



This is a hands-on engineering role, not a security advisory position or a job focused on adding individual integrations. You’ll trace behavior across service boundaries, make architectural decisions, ship production changes, and simplify an evolving platform. Success means connections are secure and reliable end to end, and the team can confidently build on the systems you own.



YOU WILL

 - Own authentication and authorization across the connection lifecycle. Design how users, agents, applications, and services establish identity, receive access, and act on behalf of others.

 - Build reliable credential infrastructure. Handle OAuth flows, token refresh, revocation, reauthorization, and secure credential storage, including concurrency and partial failures.

 - Make connections work across the platform. Follow requests through application services, credential proxies, agent execution, and environment builds, preserving security guarantees at every boundary.

 - Design and operate distributed systems. Improve service-to-service communication, tenant isolation, failure recovery, and observability across shared and isolated deployments.

 - Handle provider-specific constraints without compromising the platform. Account for differences such as user versus bot credentials, token limits, and source-control authentication.

 - Lead safe migrations and reduce technical debt. Replace fragile or duplicated paths with clearer ownership and simpler designs while keeping existing customer workflows working.

 - Raise the team’s technical judgment. Explain system behavior clearly, lead design discussions, mentor engineers, and partner with security, infrastructure, and product teams.



EXAMPLES OF WHAT YOU COULD DO

 - Fix a token-refresh race that causes connections to fail when multiple services use them concurrently.

 - Trace an authorization failure from an agent request through the credential proxy to the provider, then address the underlying design problem.

 - Design a connection lifecycle that behaves consistently across projects, conversations, and environment builds.

 - Migrate customers to a stronger identity and authorization model without disrupting their applications.

 - Remove legacy connection paths and add end-to-end tests that make future changes safer.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - Deep hands-on experience with authentication and authorization systems, including OAuth 2.0, access scopes, credential lifecycles, and trust boundaries.

 - Strong distributed systems fundamentals, including concurrency, consistency, retries, idempotency, and partial failure.

 - Experience designing, shipping, and operating production backend infrastructure with meaningful security and reliability requirements.

 - Ability to understand an unfamiliar system end to end and debug failures across multiple services and third-party APIs.

 - A track record of owning complex changes through design, implementation, rollout, and production validation.

 - Pragmatic engineering judgment: you improve existing systems incrementally, reduce unnecessary complexity, and know when a provider-specific exception is justified.

 - Clear technical communication and a willingness to help other engineers develop deeper systems understanding.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience with service identity, delegated access, token federation, or credential-management infrastructure.

 - Experience with multi-tenant isolation, enterprise governance, or customer-managed cloud deployments.

 - Experience migrating authentication or authorization systems while preserving existing customer access.

 - Experience leading cross-team architectural work and mentoring engineers.



BONUS POINTS

 - Familiarity with emerging cross-app access standards such as Cross-App Access (XAA), as well as OAuth 2.0 token exchange, OpenID Connect, and identity federation.

 - Experience designing developer-facing APIs, SDKs, or connector-authoring tools.

 - Familiarity with AI agent tool execution or Model Context Protocol (MCP).

 - Experience supporting integrations with complex authentication behavior, including collaboration tools and source-control providers.




LOCATION

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

jobs.title: Driller
jobs.description: Iceland Drilling Company (IDC) is an international leader in geothermal drilling, committed to providing safe and efficient drilling solutions with a focus on sustainability. Currently, we are seeking skilled assistant driller to join our team for a long-term geothermal drilling projects.Position Overview:As a driller, you will be responsible for operating and supervising the drilling operations on the rig. jobs.title: Technical Director

The ideal candidate brings deep game engine expertise across both runtime and tooling, experience in rendering and graphics, a practical belief in AI-assisted development, and a view of open source as both a near-term execution priority and a long-term strategic advantage.Reporting to the Senior Development Director of Core Technology, you will translate product vision and organizational priorities into clear technical direction and execution. jobs.title: DEKO søger en CNC-operatør
jobs.description:
Har du erfaring med CNC-bearbejdning og lyst til at arbejde med moderne produktion? Vil du være en del af en virksomhed, hvor kvalitet, samarbejde og udvikling er i fokus?

DEKO søger en CNC-operatør, der skal arbejde med programmering, opsætning og drift af moderne 5-aksede CNC-maskiner i en højteknologisk produktion.

Om jobbet

Som CNC-operatør hos DEKO bliver du en del af et stærkt produktionsteam, hvor du arbejder med avanceret bearbejdning af aluminiumprofiler til blandt andet karme og døre. Du får en alsidig hverdag med moderne produktionsudstyr, varierende opgaver og mulighed for løbende faglig udvikling.

Dine opgaver:

  • Programmering og opsætning af 5-aksede CNC-maskiner

  • Drift og overvågning af produktionen med fokus på kvalitet og præcision

  • Visuel kvalitetskontrol af emner

  • Optimering og vedligeholdelse af produktionsprocesser

  • Sikring af levering i den rette kvalitet og til aftalt tid

  • Samarbejde med kolleger på tværs af produktionen

  • Deltagelse i en rotationsordning mellem flere arbejdsstationer

Din profil:

  • Du har erfaring som CNC-operatør – evt. uddannet industritekniker

  • Du har gerne erfaring med 3- eller 5-aksede CNC-maskiner

  • Du kan læse tekniske tegninger og arbejde præcist efter mål

  • Du har en god teknisk forståelse og sans for kvalitet

  • Du er fortrolig med IT som en naturlig del af produktionen

Vi tilbyder:

  • Grundig oplæring i produkter, maskiner og arbejdsprocesser

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med dygtige og engagerede kolleger

  • Gode muligheder for både faglig og personlig udvikling

  • Sociale aktiviteter og et stærkt sammenhold

  • Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår i en virksomhed med fokus på kvalitet og udvikling

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig

Hvis du er klar til at blive en del af DEKO og bidrage med din erfaring inden for CNC-bearbejdning, så send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til ja@deko.dk.

Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler, hvor du vil få mange flere informationer og detaljer om stillingen. Ansættelsen sker ligeledes løbende.

Om DEKO

DEKO er en familieejet virksomhed, hvor det familiære og høj performance går hånd i hånd. Her er kort vej fra idé til handling, og nye initiativer bliver mødt med nysgerrighed frem for bureaukrati. Vi tror på, at udvikling kræver mod til at prøve nye ting, og at man lærer mere af at forsøge end af at lade være.

Vi har i mere end 50 år udviklet produkter til indvendigt byggeri og er i dag en af Skandinaviens førende leverandører af glasvægge samt en af Danmarks største tømrer- og snedkervirksomheder inden for indretning af kontor-, erhvervs- og institutionsbyggeri

jobs.title: Driftsleder/Supervisor til produktionen i Birkerød
jobs.description:
Der søges på vegne af vores samarbjedspartner i Birkerød (ENGLISH VERSION BELOW)

Vi er en dansk scale-up i Nordsjælland, der udvikler, producerer og sælger hampbaserede produkter. Vi arbejder med hele processen fra råvare til færdigt produkt og står overfor at udvide med egne produktionsfaciliteter, så vi kan lancere nye produktkategorier og skalere produktionen.Hverdagen er præget af høje krav til kvalitet, sporbarhed, dokumentation og stabile processer.

Om rollen

Vi søger en supervisor, der kan få den daglige drift i produktionen til at hænge sammen. Du skal skabe overblik på gulvet, følge op på opgaverne og være med til at sikre, at produktionen kører som den skal.

Det er en hands-on rolle, hvor du både deltager i arbejdet og har ansvar for den daglige koordinering i produktionen. Du bliver en vigtig del af teamet under Operationschefen og får en central rolle i at holde flow, kvalitet og fremdrift i hverdagen.

Personaleansvar er ikke et krav, men du skal have erfaring med arbejdsledelse eller daglig supervision i en produktionsvirksomhed.

Dine primære opgaver

  • Sikre den daglige koordinering og arbejdsfordeling i produktionen

  • Følge op på, at opgaver bliver løst korrekt og til tiden

  • Holde overblik over flowet på linjerne og reagere hurtigt ved stop, afvigelser eller flaskehalse

  • Deltage aktivt i produktionen, herunder betjening og overvågning af produktions- og fillingsprocedurer

  • Sikre hygiejne, sporbarhed og dokumentation på batch-niveau

  • Udføre og følge op på in-process-kontroller samt sikre, at kvalitetsdata er opdateret i de digitale systemer

  • Bidrage til orden, rengøring, first-level vedligehold på linjerne

  • Samarbejde tæt med lager og logistik om råvareflow og færdigvareafhentning

  • Være med til at forbedre arbejdsgange og skabe mere struktur i takt med, at produktionen udvikler sig

Din profil

  • Du har erfaring fra fødevare-, kosmetik-, pharma- eller anden procesindustri

  • Du har erfaring med arbejdsledelse, koordinering eller daglig supervision i en produktion

  • Du er vant til at arbejde struktureret og holde overblik i en travl hverdag

  • Du har fokus på kvalitet, renlighed og det at følge procedurer

  • Du kan læse og skrive dansk og/eller engelsk

  • Du er tryg ved at arbejde i digitale systemer og kan lære nye processer og værktøjer

  • Du tager ansvar, når noget skal løses, og bidrager naturligt til, at hverdagen fungerer

Vi tilbyder

  • En central rolle i den daglige drift af produktionen

  • Fast daghold med mulighed for fleks efter aftale

  • Grundig oplæring, inkl. træning i vores principper

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn samt frokostordning, pensionsordning og arbejdsgiverbetalt sundhedsforsikring

  • Mulighed for at vokse i takt med, at vi skalerer nye linjer og automatiserer processer

Ansøgning

Send CV og kort motiveret ansøgning til job@chc.dk snarest og senest d. 27. november 2026. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler. Har du spørgsmål, så ring til 71 99 19 55 eller skriv til km@chc.dk.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

______________________________________________________________

Production Supervisor – Hands-on Role

Location: Birkerød, North Zealand, Denmark

Recruitment on behalf of our partner company in Birkerød.

We are a Danish scale-up based in North Zealand, developing, manufacturing and selling hemp-based products. We manage the entire process, from raw materials to finished products, and are preparing to expand our operations with our own production facilities. This will allow us to introduce new product categories and increase production capacity.

Our daily operations require high standards of quality, traceability, documentation and process consistency.

About the Role

We are looking for a Production Supervisor who can help keep our daily production operations running smoothly. You will coordinate work on the production floor, follow up on tasks and help ensure that production runs efficiently and according to plan.

This is a hands-on position, combining active participation in production with responsibility for day-to-day coordination and supervision.

You will work as part of the team reporting to the Head of Operations and play an important role in maintaining production flow, quality and progress.

Formal line management or personnel responsibility is not required, but you must have experience supervising, coordinating or leading daily work in a manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate daily production activities and allocate tasks across the production team.

  • Follow up to ensure tasks are completed correctly and on schedule.

  • Monitor production flow and respond quickly to interruptions, deviations and bottlenecks.

  • Participate directly in production, including operating and monitoring production equipment and filling processes.

  • Ensure hygiene, traceability and batch-level documentation.

  • Perform and follow up on in-process quality checks, ensuring that quality data is accurately recorded in our digital systems.

  • Maintain good housekeeping, cleaning routines and first-level equipment maintenance on the production floor.

  • Work closely with warehouse and logistics colleagues to coordinate raw material supply and the movement of finished goods.

  • Help improve workflows and establish more structured processes as production expands.

Your Profile

  • You have experience in food manufacturing, cosmetics, supplements, pharmaceuticals or another process-based manufacturing industry.

  • You have previous experience with production-floor supervision, work coordination or day-to-day production leadership.

  • You work in a structured manner and can maintain an overview in a busy production environment.

  • You understand the importance of quality, cleanliness and following established procedures.

  • You can read and write in Danish and/or English.

  • You are comfortable using digital systems and willing to learn new processes and tools.

  • You take responsibility, solve problems when they arise and actively contribute to keeping daily operations running smoothly.

What We Offer

  • An important role in the daily operation and development of our production facilities.

  • Fixed daytime working hours, with flexibility by agreement.

  • Thorough onboarding and training, including training in our operational principles and procedures.

  • Competitive salary, a company lunch scheme, an employer pension scheme and employer-paid private health insurance.

  • Opportunities to develop professionally as we expand production lines and introduce further automation.

How to Apply

Please send your CV and a short cover letter to job@chc.dk as soon as possible and no later than the 27th of November 2026.

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions about the position, please call +45 71 99 19 55 or email km@chc.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
jobs.description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are full-time and available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track).

Who we areIn electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model.

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within one or more of the following areas: communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, computing, cyber security, quantum technology, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide.

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Your profile and work tasksWe seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

• Communication• Networks• Antennas• Control systems• Sound• Artifical intelligence• Signal Processing• Computing• Quantum technology • Robotics

The main tasks and responsibilities include:• developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.• providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.• participating in grant application activities• coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment.

Your competenciesYou have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Qualification requirementsApplicants must have academic qualifications at PhD level. The potential of each applicant will be emphasized in the overall assessment

Tenure Track

When appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on: 

  • The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
  • The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
  • The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
  • The candidate is a skilled communicator
  • The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
  • The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process

Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorshipThe assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

  • Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
  • Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
  • Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
  • The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
  • The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 

If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications.Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.title: 1.assistent til SMP - Fyn
jobs.description:
Vi søger en erfaren 1.assistent til Fyn

Er du serviceminded og kan lide et job med meget kørsel?

SMP Rengøringsservice er i rivende udvikling og søger derfor en erfaren medarbejder på fuldtid (37t), til vores i forvejen stærke team på Fyn.

Som 1.assistent er dit ansvar at sikre afviklingen af den daglige rengøring i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

Andre opgaver kan også forekomme.

Du vil have direkte reference til din Serviceinspektør hos SMP rengøringsservice. Jobbet indebærer b.la. følgende arbejdsområder:

•   Skal stå for rengøring af egne pladser og øvrig bemanding iht. rengøringskalenderen

•   Skabe god relation til kunderne

•   Være behjælpelig med afløsning ved. ferie/sygdom

•   Hjælpe ved opstart af nye kunder og opgaver sammen med Serviceinspektør

•   Forefaldne opgaver i samarbejde med din Serviceinspektør

 

Det skal forventes, at timer kan ligge både tidlig morgen, eftermiddag og aften.

 

Hvem er du?

 

Vi søger dig, som trives i en omskiftelig hverdag, hvor opgaverne og dagene aldrig er ens.

Det er ikke vigtigt for dig, at du har faste rammer mandag-fredag fra 8-16, men tværtimod trives du med en flydende hverdag, hvor arbejdsugen kan variere med forskellige tidspunkter på dagen.

Som person kan du nikke genkendende til, at du:

•   Har erfaring med erhvervsrengøring

•   Trives i en til tider hektisk hverdag

•   Står til rådighed for rengøring af egne pladser

•   deler telefonvagt efter forudgående aftale

     står for sidemandsoplæring af rengøringspersonale

•   Kan håndtere og omgås forskellige kulturer

•   Behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale på et rimeligt niveau

•   Har kørekort

•   Kan fremvise straffeattest

Du får stillet en firmabil til rådighed, samt firmatelefon- iPad, og arbejdsbeklædning.

Vi glæder os meget til at lære dig at kende - så hvis du kan se dig selv i denne stilling, bedes du sende din ansøgning til: job@smpservice.dk  - husk at mærke ansøgningen ” 1.assistent Fyn”

 

Samtaler bliver holdt løbende.

 

Har du ikke hørt fra os inden den 30.11.2026, skal du betragte jobbet som besat til anden side.

 

SMP er en velrenommeret virksomhed i rengøringsbranchen, - og det vil vi gerne blive ved med at være

Vi beskæftiger i dag mere end 300 medarbejdere med kunder i en stor del af Danmark. Vi har landsdækkende og lokale aftaler inden for kontor, produktion, skoler, slagterier, bagerier, butikker, supermarkeder mv.

 

SMP har lokale afdelinger både på Fyn, Jylland og Sjælland

jobs.title: Senior Field Marketer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Field Marketing team owns the in-person moments that move our target sales assisted accounts forward. We design world class hosted events, executive experiences, and third-party activations that open new relationships, deepen the ones we have, and turn interest into pipeline.




As a Senior Field Marketing Manager, you will own the strategy and execute tier 1 field events that drive pipeline and contribute meaningfully to Notion’s business.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own end-to-end planning, execution, and measurement of field programs to support our AMER Sales team - encompassing executive experiences, large-format educational events, trade shows, and co-sponsored activations with partners.

 - Drive pipeline goals in partnership with Sales by building field programs that create new opportunities and help advance existing ones. Track and report on pipeline contribution and program ROI.

 - Build out strategies, shape our calendar, and work closely with sales to build out a calendar that touches the evolving sales needs.

 - Manage all event logistics, production, venue sourcing, budget tracking, marketing campaigns, sales enablement, content development, and audience acquisition.

 - Use data to guide field investments, combining quantitative results and qualitative feedback to evaluate what’s working. Measure both pipeline impact and top-of-funnel awareness, including reach and engagement with target audiences, and use those insights to improve future programs.

 - Partner closely with Sales and broader Marketing team to align events and audiences to objectives for top accounts and craft tailored programs that nurture those accounts




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 8+ years of related marketing experience.

 - You’re a leader. You take ownership, bring people together around a clear plan, and keep programs moving from idea through execution. You’re comfortable making decisions, navigating ambiguity, and building trust with partners along the way.

 - You love both strategy and execution. You can turn Sales priorities into a thoughtful field plan and roll up your sleeves to bring each event to life.

 - You're pipeline-obsessed. You understand how your programs connect to revenue and can speak credibly about pipeline contribution, not just top-of-funnel metrics.

 - You're a strong cross-functional collaborator. You know how to work with sales, ops, and creative teams — and you can align people around a shared goal without needing authority to do it.

 - You have a bias for action and experimentation. You'd rather test and learn than wait for consensus, and you know how to balance scrappiness with strategic thinking.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - You're a creative problem-solver who doesn't wait for a perfect playbook. You've built field events from scratch, and you're energized by figuring out what works in new territory.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience in a fast-paced, B2B tech environment

 - You're a Notion user and understand our value to businesses

 - Salesforce, Marketo experience



We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Head of Creative
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Creative is how millions of people first meet Replit, from a first-time builder to a Fortune 500 buyer. Our product lets anyone turn an idea into working software. The creative challenge is making that feel obvious, exciting and human, whether you’re talking to someone who has never written a line of code or a CIO deciding how their company will build. We believe enterprise marketing doesn’t have to look like enterprise marketing, and we’re looking for the creative leader who believes that too.

As Executive Creative Director, you'll own the creative vision for everything Replit puts into the world: brand campaigns, product launches, the website, social and demand generation. You'll lead our in-house team of designers, and partner closely with product, product marketing, enterprise marketing and the executive team. You'll find the big ideas, sell them to leadership, and get them made at Replit's speed.

This is the right role if you’ve led integrated work that shaped culture and moved the business, both at agencies and inside tech companies, and across consumer and B2B brands. You can write and art direct well enough to tell a good idea from a great one, and you’d rather build an in-house creative engine than manage a roster of agencies.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Set the creative vision: Define how Replit looks, sounds and feels across every touchpoint, from major brand moments to product launches to everyday social

 - Lead big ideas end to end: Take integrated campaigns from brief to concept to production across film, OOH, social, web, events and paid, all organized around a single idea

 - Raise the craft bar: Push for higher production value, especially in video and motion, and know when to push for perfect and when to ship

 - Build and lead the team: Manage and develop designers, art directors and copywriters, grow senior talent into leaders, and hire where the team has gaps

 - Run the creative engine: Own intake, briefing and creative review so work comes in early with a clear strategy and goes out on-brand; decide what stays in-house, what goes to freelancers, and when an agency or production partner is worth it

 - Make AI part of the craft: Build AI creative tools into how the team concepts, produces and iterates, with a clear point of view on where human taste matters most

 - Champion the work: Present and defend creative to executives and cross-functional partners with clear strategic rationale and conviction




REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - 12+ years of creative leadership at a top agency and/or an in-house consumer tech brand, with a portfolio of culturally relevant work that drove business results

 - Conceptual and craft range across verbal and visual: campaign ideas, brand platforms, verbal identity and art direction

 - Proven experience at both B2C and B2B brands and businesses, leading integrated campaigns across film, social, OOH, digital and experiential

 - Strong video and motion instincts, including directing higher-production shoots with production partners

 - Track record of building or scaling an in-house creative team, and recruiting, developing and retaining top talent

 - Experience making complex or technical products simple, emotional and accessible

 - Executive presence: you can sell a bold idea to a CEO and explain why it matters to the business

 - Comfort in a fast, lean, ambiguous environment where you set the strategy and stay hands-on in the work

 - Based in or able to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area




BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience at an AI, developer-tool or product-led growth company

 - Hands-on use of generative AI creative tools, with evidence of building them into team workflows

 - Work recognized at Cannes, D&AD or One Show

 - Active Replit user, you've built and shipped something with the product



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.description:

Pravilnika o radu br.359/2023 od 16. 5. 2023.g., Ustanova Zagreb film, Zagreb, Vlaška 70, raspisuje

JAVNI NATJEČAJ za radno mjesto tehničar u održavanju (m/ž) 1 izvršitelj/ica, na neodređeno, puno radno vrijeme, uz probni rad od 2 mjeseca Uvjeti za radno mjesto: • SSS tehničke struke • najmanje 2 godine radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima • koeficijent 3,60.

Opis poslova i radnih zadataka: • obavljanje redovnih obilazaka objekta i opreme i njihov pregled • upravljanje sustavima grijanja, klimatizacije i ventilacije • obavljanje manjih popravaka i domarskih poslova • obavljanje jednostavnijih održavanja, ukoliko ne remete jamstvene uvjete (npr. čišćenje filtera: split klima uređaji, ventilokonvektori, zamjena filtera na rekuperacijskim jedinicama i klima komorama i sl.) • koordinacija vanjskih izvođača prilikom obavljanja radova • redovito tjedno paljenje diesel električnog agregata (DEA) i rad u praznom hodu u trajanju od 10 minuta (ukoliko postoji) • koordinacija dovoza goriva za potrebe Diesel-električnog agregata (DEA) na objektu (ukoliko postoji) • skladištenje zamjenjivih dijelova tehničkog otpada (baterije, toneri i sl.) • obavljanje manjih preseljenja • montaža projekcijskih plata i spajanje prezentacijske opreme • obavljanje svečanog uređenja objekta za praznike • briga oko rasporeda i pripreme soba za sastanke • prilagođavanje pomičnih pregradnih stijena u multifunkcijskim dvoranama • poslovi montaže i demontaže • popravak namještaja • organizacija odvoza i zbrinjavanje dijela otpada (papir, plastika) s objekta • obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu ravnatelja.

Probni rad: 2 mjeseca.

Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi upotrijebljeni u ovom javnom natječaju, a koji imaju rodno značenje, odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod, bez obzira na to u kojem su rodu navedeni.

Dokumentacija koju su kandidati, u elektroničkom obliku, obvezni priložiti: - prijava (mora sadržavati osnovne informacije o kandidatu – ime, prezime, kontakt podaci: adresa, telefon, adresa elektroničke pošte) - dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi (presliku svjedodžbe) - dokaz o radnom iskustvu (elektronički zapis ili potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje zajedno sa potvrdom o vrsti poslova i razdoblju njihovog obavljanja, ugovori o radu, ugovori o djelu i ostali odgovarajući dokazi) - uvjerenje pribavljeno od nadležnog suda ili sustavom e-Građani da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 30 dana od dana raspisivanja natječaja) - životopis s opisom dosadašnjeg rada (potpisan od strane prijavitelja/prijaviteljice).

U slučaju da kandidat sve potrebne podatke iz prijave dostavi u tekstu elektroničke pošte prilikom slanja dokumentacije uz prijavu na natječaj, smatrat će se da je kandidat poslao potpunu prijavu. Obveznu dokumentaciju potrebno je priložiti u PDF formatu, svaki dokument kao zasebni prilog. Dokazi koji se dostavljaju moraju biti na hrvatskom jeziku i latiničnom pismu, odnosno kandidati koji dostavljaju dokumentaciju na stranom jeziku, dužni su uz istu dostaviti i ovjereni prijevod na hrvatski jezik. Iz priložene dokumentacije mora biti nedvojbeno jasno ispunjenje uvjeta propisanih natječajem. Ukoliko kandidat uz prijavu priloži dokumente u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (presliku vjenčanog ili rodnog lista).

Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine br. 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavkom 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti dokaze iz članka 49. stavka 1. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Potpunom prijavom smatra se ona koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u ovom natječaju. Osoba čija je prijava nepravodobna ili nepotpuna odnosno osoba koja ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na javni natječaj, niti će biti pozvana na dopunu istih.

Kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete bit će pozvani na kvalifikacijski razgovor s Povjerenstvom za provedbu natječaja u cilju utvrđivanja organizacijskih vještina te snalažljivosti kandidata u zadanim okolnostima, o čemu će biti obaviješteni e-poštom.

Prijave na natječaj s traženom obveznom dokumentacijom poslati elektroničkom poštom na mail adresu: antonela.copo@zagrebfilm.hr

Naslov: NATJEČAJ ZA RADNO MJESTO TEHNIČAR U ODRŽAVANJU Elektronička pošta s prijavom i svom dokumentacijom ne smije biti veća od 25 MB. Kandidati će dobiti povratnu elektroničku poruku s potvrdom zaprimanja prijave.

Rok za podnošenje prijava je petnaest (15) dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje te na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Ustanove Zagreb film.

Primitak prijave u propisanom roku utvrđuje se uvidom u vrijeme primitka elektroničke pošte . Prijavom na natječaj prijavitelji su izričito suglasni da Ustanova Zagreb film kao voditelj obrade može prikupljati, koristiti se i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provođenja natječajne procedure, sukladno odredbama Opće uredbe (EU) 2016/679 o zaštiti osobnih podataka i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (NN 42/18).

O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni elektroničkom poštom a Odluka o rezultatima bit će objavljena i na mrežnim stranicama Ustanove Zagreb film sukladno članku 10. stavku 1. točka 10. Zakona o pravu na pristup informacijama (Narodne novine broj: 25/13, 85/15, 69/22).

Provoditelj natječaja zadržava pravo ne izabrati nijednog kandidata i poništiti natječaj.

jobs.description:
Lokacija: Dubrovnik (mogućnost povremenog remote rada) Industrija: Turizam / Kratkoročni najam smještaja Vrsta zaposlenja: Puno radno vrijeme

Tvoja uloga u Direct Bookeru

Tražimo ambicioznu i prodajno orijentiranu osobu koja zna prepoznati priliku, izgraditi povjerenje i zatvoriti suradnju koja donosi stvarnu vrijednost. Kao Prodajni Menadžer, tvoj zadatak bit će širenje naše mreže privatnog smještaja u Hrvatskoj – uz maksimalnu podršku iskusnog tima i fleksibilnost rada od kuće.

Ovo je prilika da aktivno oblikuješ budućnost turizma, a istovremeno izgradiš karijeru u rastućoj globalnoj kompaniji.

Što ćeš raditi:

? Proaktivno pronalaziti i kontaktirati vlasnike apartmana, vila i kuća za odmor putem poziva, preporuka, društvenih mreža, sajmova i drugih kanala. ? Jasno i uvjerljivo predstaviti prednosti partnerstva s Direct Bookerom – uz korištenje komercijalnih analiza i konkretnih benefita. ? Voditi pregovore i izrađivati ponude koje zadovoljavaju obje strane. ? Graditi dugoročne odnose s partnerima i biti njihova kontakt osoba od povjerenja.

✅ Tražimo te ako:

? Imaš iskustva u B2C/B2B prodaji (idealno u turizmu, ugostiteljstvu ili najmu smještaja). ? Uspješno si razvijao/la partnerske odnose i ostvarivao/la prodajne ciljeve. ? Odlično komuniciraš i znaš prepoznati što je važno klijentima. ? Vješt/a si u samostalnom radu i donošenju strateških odluka.

Što nudimo:

✨ Ravnotežu između privatnog i poslovnog života ✨ Ugovor na određeno s mogućnošću stalnog zaposlenja ✨ Podršku i mentorstvo unutar pozitivne, motivirajuće radne okoline ✨ Bonusi za rezultate – bez gornje granice!

Zašto Direct Booker?

Direct Booker je dio međunarodnog brenda Belvilla by OYO / PRISM, lidera u upravljanju kratkoročnim najmom. Radit ćeš lokalno, ali kao dio velike globalne mreže. Zajedno mijenjamo način na koji ljudi putuju i iznajmljuju – budi dio te promjene!

Zainteresiran/a?

Prijavi se danas i napravi korak prema karijeri u kojoj tvoja energija i ideje čine razliku. Direct Booker čeka tebe!
