jobs.title: Program Manager, Office of the CEO (PMO)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a hands-on Program Manager to operationalize the CEO's external presence and growth work: founder-led marketing, founder-led sales, investor relations, and strategic go-to-market (GTM) efforts around the world. Reporting to the Chief of Staff and working on strategic special projects, you will turn the CEO's priorities into repeatable systems, clear workplans, and completed actions.

This is an execution-heavy role. You should be equally comfortable building a founder-led sales playbook, preparing an investor update, and following up on an overdue deliverable. Success requires strong judgment, attention to detail, discretion, and a willingness to take on both high-impact initiatives and the routine work that keeps them moving.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



FOUNDER-LED MARKETING

 - Build and run the operating system for the CEO's marketing presence: content calendar, speaking and event schedule, media and podcast opportunities, and social channels.

 - Turn the CEO's ideas, conversations, and public moments into repeatable content, working with Brand, Comms, and Content teams.

 - Set up intake, approval, and review workflows so the CEO's time goes to the highest-leverage appearances and posts.

 - Track reach, engagement, and pipeline influence, and report what is working.



FOUNDER-LED SALES

 - Operationalize the CEO's role in the sales motion: target account lists, executive outreach, customer and partner meetings, and follow-up.

 - Partner with Sales, Partnerships, and RevOps to prepare briefs, talking points, and next steps for every CEO-involved deal.

 - Maintain a tracker of CEO-sourced and CEO-assisted opportunities with owners, stages, and commitments.

 - Document the playbook so founder involvement scales without adding burden to the CEO.



INVESTOR RELATIONS SUPPORT

 - Support the preparation of investor updates, board materials, and fundraising and diligence materials.

 - Maintain the investor and stakeholder tracker: relationships, meetings, asks, and follow-ups.

 - Coordinate data requests across Finance, Legal, and functional leaders, and check inputs for accuracy and consistency before review.

 - Prepare briefing documents for investor meetings and other external engagements.



STRATEGIC GTM, GLOBALLY

 - Support GTM strategy and execution across regions, including market entry, partnerships, government and ecosystem engagement, and regional events.

 - Coordinate with regional teams and partners across time zones, local requirements, and travel logistics.

 - Translate initiatives into workplans with defined scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, and success measures.

 - Surface cross-regional insights and delivery risks early, with clear recommendations.



STRATEGIC SPECIAL PROJECTS AND OPERATING CADENCE

 - Own time-sensitive special projects assigned by the Chief of Staff, from scoping through close-out.

 - Run project check-ins, maintain issue and decision logs, and escalate missed commitments or unresolved dependencies.

 - Build agendas, collect pre-reads, and document decisions and action items for recurring leadership and planning meetings.

 - Maintain trackers, dashboards, and scorecards for priorities, programs, and milestones, reporting to the Chief of Staff.

 - Document standard operating procedures, and replace repetitive manual work with templates, tools, and AI-enabled automation.



QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years of experience in program management, business operations, chief of staff or executive operations, GTM operations, or a comparable execution-focused role.

 - Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional projects and recurring operational processes.

 - Strong organizational skills, with the ability to maintain detailed trackers and manage competing deadlines.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex inputs into concise executive materials.

 - Proficiency with AI. Ability to work independently, adapt quickly, and make practical decisions with incomplete information.

 - Discretion with confidential investor, customer, and company information.

 - Willingness to perform hands-on administrative and logistical work alongside program management responsibilities.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

 - Experience supporting a founder, CEO, or Chief of Staff.

 - Experience in marketing, sales, or investor relations at a fast-paced or high-growth company.

 - Experience working across regions or with international teams and partners.

 - Experience preparing board and investor materials.

 - Experience improving workflows through automation and AI-enabled tools.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - The CEO's marketing and sales activity runs on clear systems, with consistent output and few last-minute scrambles.

 - Every founder-involved deal has a brief, an owner, and tracked follow-up.

 - Investor materials are accurate, on time, and consistent across audiences.

 - Global GTM initiatives have clear ownership and steady progress against agreed milestones.

 - The Chief of Staff has a clear, current view of priorities, risks, and decisions needed.

 - Routine requests and operational issues are resolved with minimal CEO involvement.

 

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

WHO WE ARE

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Demand Generation
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

Enterprise Marketing is responsible for driving B2B pipeline and revenue at Replit. The team partners closely with Sales, RevOps, Product Marketing, and Growth to engage enterprise buyers and turn demand into qualified opportunities. With millions of individual users already in the product, Replit has a unique opportunity to connect product-led adoption with enterprise growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re seeking a strategic, execution-oriented Senior Manager, Demand Generation to lead integrated campaigns that accelerate enterprise pipeline and revenue growth at Replit. You’ll own the strategy, execution, and optimization of full-funnel programs that win new customers and expand adoption within existing accounts.

Reporting to the Director / Sr. Director of Demand and Digital, you’ll partner with Product Marketing to translate Replit’s AI capabilities, positioning, and customer use cases into compelling campaigns for technical and business audiences. You’ll build account-based programs, launch targeted campaigns, and work closely with Sales to turn engagement into qualified opportunities.

You’ll bring deep channel expertise and partner with channel owners to optimize spend, improve conversion, and allocate budget toward programs that deliver the strongest pipeline and revenue impact. This is a hands-on role that combines strategic planning with detailed execution.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own campaign strategy and pipeline results. Build and execute enterprise demand generation programs with clear audiences, offers, pipeline goals, and measures of success.

 - Build enterprise campaign playbooks. Create repeatable programs across account-based marketing, webinars, content syndication, email nurture, and integrated field marketing.

 - Develop account-based programs. Partner with Sales to select high-value accounts, identify buying groups, and coordinate multi-touch campaigns with relevant sales outreach.

 - Own land-and-expand campaigns. Develop and execute integrated programs across new customer acquisition and account expansion. Partner with Sales to prioritize target accounts and buying groups, tailor campaigns to customer use cases, and generate qualified pipeline for new business, upsell, and cross-sell opportunities.

 - Shape campaign messaging and creative. Collaborate with Product Marketing, Content, and Design to develop compelling assets and offers across the buyer journey, from awareness through opportunity progression.

 - Test and improve performance. Experiment with audiences, messaging, creative formats, calls to action, and landing pages to improve conversion and pipeline quality. Partner with the paid media optimization team to apply findings across campaigns.

 - Connect product-led growth with enterprise sales. Identify expansion signals within Replit’s individual user base and build programs that nurture high-potential users and accounts toward enterprise adoption.

 - Strengthen lead management and sales handoff. Work with Sales, SDRs, and RevOps on targeting, lead scoring, qualification, routing, and follow-up. Partner with Product and Analytics on product-qualified lead signals.

 - Measure and communicate business impact. Track campaign contribution, funnel conversion, and program efficiency. Bring clear insights and recommendations to business reviews, including where to scale, adjust, or stop investment.

 - Deliver high-quality execution. Manage campaign calendars, budgets, and cross-functional dependencies. Coordinate internal teams and external partners to launch programs on time and turn successful experiments into repeatable playbooks.



WHAT YOU’LL BRING

 - A strong desire to learn and apply AI tools to scale campaign execution, automate repetitive work, and improve marketing performance.

 - 10+ years of demand generation experience, including 5+ years in B2B SaaS focused on enterprise customers.

 - A proven track record of building and scaling demand generation programs with measurable pipeline contribution and ROI.

 - Expertise with account-based marketing, including account selection, multi-channel campaigns, engagement measurement, and creative development.

 - Experience developing lead scoring, qualification, and funnel optimization approaches in partnership with Sales and RevOps.

 - Strong analytical skills and a disciplined approach to experimentation—connecting data across sources, interpreting results, and translating findings into action.

 - The ability to provide clear campaign briefs and creative direction while partnering effectively with Content, Product Marketing, and Design.

 - Strong cross-functional communication and project management skills, with the ability to move from strategy to hands-on execution.

 - Must have a strong desire to learn and apply AI tools to scale campaign execution, automate repetitive work, and improve marketing performance.

jobs.title: Enterprise Solutions Consultant (New York, NY)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 8–15+ years of experience selling technical products to technical buyers

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.


NICE TO HAVES

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York, NY, the estimated range for total on-target earnings (including base salary and on-target incentive pay) for this role is $360,000 - $400,000 per year.



This position requires authorization to work in the United States without employer sponsorship now or in the future.


By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite






A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Võimalust töötada erineva toevajadusega täiskasvanutega ja lastega, toetades nende iseseisvust, tegevusvõimet ja igapäevast toimetulekut.

Muud nõuded: Ootame oma meeskonda sooja südamega, empaatilist ja rõõmsameelset inimest, kes väärtustab iga inimese eripära ning oskab märgata ja tunnustada ka väikeseid edusamme. jobs.title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
jobs.description:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

jobs.title: Senior Solutions Architect - UAE
Content Creator - YouTube
jobs.description:
Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered.


Job Overview

Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.


About us

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
  • Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.


What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
  • Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
  • Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
  • AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects
  • Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics
  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work.

At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos.


Compensation
  • Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US) / CA$80,000 per year (Canada)
  • Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly
  • For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed.


Benefits
  • 15 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays
  • 10 paid sick days per year
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • A 401(k) with employer contributions (US)


How to apply

Applications require a short intro video (max. 5 minutes) and your CV. Click "Apply" for all details.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.

You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.

The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption.

 - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale.

 - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation.

 - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value.

 - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback.

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path.

 - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements.

 - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

 - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

 - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively.

 - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role.




WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.
   
   


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.
   
   


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

 - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

 - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.

jobs.title: Kodushooldaja
jobs.description:
Koduhooldustöötaja

Tööülesanded: Aita inimestel elada väärikalt oma kodus!Estkeer otsib oma Tallinna meeskonda hoolivat, usaldusväärset ja vastutustundlikku koduhooldustöötajat. Meie töö eesmärk on toetada eakaid ja abivajavaid inimesi nende igapäevastes tegevustes, et nad saaksid võimalikult kaua, turvaliselt ja väärikalt oma kodus elada. Ootame oma meeskonda inimest, kellele läheb korda teiste heaolu ning kes soovib teha tähendusrikast ja vaheldusrikast tööd. Koduhooldustöötajana abistad kliente nende kodus vastavalt individuaalsele abivajadusele ja kokkulepitud hooldusplaanile. Sinu peamised tööülesanded on: *Abistamine igapäevastes hügieenitoimingutes (pesemine, riietumine, tualetitoimingud, mähkmete vahetamine). *Toidu valmistamine, serveerimine ja vajadusel abistamine söömisel. *Kliendi liikumise ja igapäevase aktiivsuse toetamine, abistamine liikumisel ning jalutuskäikudel. *Kergemad kodused majapidamistööd (koristamine, nõude pesemine, pesu- ja voodipesu vahetamine). *Toiduainete ja muude esmatarbekaupade ostmine. *Kliendi saatmine arsti vastuvõtule ja teistele vajalikele käikudele. *Vestlemine ja kliendi sotsiaalse aktiivsuse toetamine. *Tehtud hooldustoimingute dokumenteerimine. Töö toimub klientide kodudes. Tööpäeva jooksul külastatakse vastavalt graafikule ühte või mitut klienti. Külastuste kestus sõltub kliendi abivajadusest. Töö hõlmab hommikusi, päevaseid ja õhtuseid hoolduskülastusi ning vajalik on valmisolek töötada ka öistes vahetustes kliendi kodus.

Omalt poolt pakume: *Tähendusrikast tööd, kus Sinu panus mõjutab otseselt inimeste igapäevast heaolu.*Toetavat ja kokkuhoidvat meeskonda. *Sisseelamisprogrammi, kohapealset juhendamist ja regulaarseid sisekoolitusi. *Paindlikku töögraafikut ning võimalust töötada täis- või osalise tööajaga. *Mitmekesist ja iseseisvat tööd. *Tööks vajalikke vahendeid ja tööriietust. *Võimalust kasutada tööülesannete täitmiseks ametiautot või kokkuleppel isiklikku autot koos sõidukulude hüvitamisega. *Võimalust areneda ja täiendada oma oskusi hooldusvaldkonnas.

Muud nõuded: Nõudmised kandidaadile:*Vähemalt kutseharidus keskhariduse baasil. *Eesti keele oskus vähemalt B2-tasemel. *B-kategooria juhiluba. *Arvutikasutamise baasoskused ja valmisolek kasutada digitaalset hooldustöö dokumenteerimise süsteemi. *Valmisolek töötada graafiku alusel, sealhulgas õhtuti, nädalavahetustel ja vajadusel öösiti kliendi kodus. *Füüsiline ja vaimne valmisolek hooldustööks. OOTAME ESTKEERIGA LIITUMA KUI... *Oled empaatiline, hooliv ja sõbralik. *Oled kohusetundlik, aus ja usaldusväärne. *Suudad töötada nii iseseisvalt kui ka meeskonnas. *Oskad säilitada rahu ja leida lahendusi ka keerulisemates olukordades. *Oled tähelepanelik ning märkad muutusi kliendi enesetundes ja abivajaduses. *Austad kliendi privaatsust, väärikust ja iseseisvust. *Oled paindlik, hea suhtleja ja valmis õppima. *Sul on siiras soov aidata inimesi ja panustada nende elukvaliteedi parandamisse. Kasuks tuleb varasem hooldustöö kogemus või sotsiaal- ja tervishoiuvaldkonna haridus, kuid ootame kandideerima ka inimesi, kellel on sobivad isikuomadused ja soov valdkonnas töötada.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

Koormus, vahetused: öösiti

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect Manager, MEDIT
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As a first-line leader directly managing a team of Outcomes Architects, you’ll own your team’s execution across workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, expansion qualification, and at-risk account recovery — accountable for both the customer outcomes and the quality of execution that produces them.

This isn’t a traditional Customer Success management role. The best OA Managers are coaches first: they know what great workflow discovery looks like, can review a mutual success plan and identify where value realization is breaking down, can inspect an executive business review and sharpen the value narrative, and can help an OA turn account activity into measurable customer and commercial outcomes.

You’ll run an inspection cadence and cultivate a coaching culture that make consistent execution possible across the team. You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultant leaders, Sales, Services, Support, Product, and RevOps to ensure customers move from workflow design to adoption, value realization, expansion, and renewal readiness.

If you’re a builder who loves developing people as much as driving customer impact — and you want to lead a team in a post-sales motion that’s being redefined for the AI era — this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 

 


WHAT YOU’LL ACHIEVE

 - Own the Net Revenue Growth performance of your team’s book of business, accountable for both headline outcomes and the quality of execution that drives workflow adoption, value realization, renewal readiness, and expansion.

 - Coach OAs on the OA builder motion: AI Transformation Plans, build-beside workshops, value reviews, use-case consultations, and renewal processes.

 - Build and run the operating cadence for the team: metrics reviews, account support sessions, adoption and renewal-risk reviews, call coaching against the OA quality rubric, and forecast calls with senior leadership.

 - Hire, onboard, and certify new OAs to the GTM builder motion, driving readiness from ramp through consistent execution and managing performance with clarity when expectations are not met.

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultant managers and leaders on strategy for expansion and renewal across shared accounts, ensuring clear ownership for flat and at-risk renewals.

 - Partner with Services leadership to identify complex implementation needs early, create clear handoffs, and ensure Services delivery accelerates workflow adoption and measurable value.

 - Set the standard for product, AI, and workflow fluency across the team so OAs can help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion.

 - Represent your team or region in leadership forums with clear signal on what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Uphold excellence by coaching to the global OA methodology, quality rubric, and activity KPIs.
   
    


SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Frontline management experience leading customer-facing GTM teams in B2B software, ideally across Customer Success, Solutions Consulting, Technical Account Management, Professional Services, Account Management, or post-sales strategy.

 - Direct experience coaching teams through customer discovery, workflow design, adoption planning, value realization, renewals, expansion, or technical/workflow implementation.

 - Strong coaching orientation: you can review a customer call, account plan, mutual success plan, or executive value narrative and identify specifically what needs to change — not just whether the outcome was good, but why and how to improve it.

 - Commercial instincts at the team level: able to read account health, renewal risk, adoption depth, expansion potential, and customer sentiment, then drive urgency without micromanaging every account.

 - Deep customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical adoption and implementation plans.

 - Experience operating in a shared account ownership model with Sales, Solutions, Services, Support, or Implementation teams.

 - Operational rigor: you know how to build inspection cadences, coaching rituals, performance standards, and accountability systems that improve execution across a team.

 - Ability to develop talent from onboarding through consistent performance, including hiring to profile, setting clear expectations, coaching skill gaps, and managing performance with clarity.

 - Executive communication skills: able to synthesize account patterns, customer risks, team performance, and cross-functional asks into clear signal for leadership.

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor. You do not need to build every workflow yourself, but you should be able to understand Notion systems, coach workflow design, and help your team troubleshoot adoption blockers.

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious, hands-on, and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and help customers deliver better outcomes.

 - Fluency in Italian or Spanish
   
    


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience managing in a consumption, usage-based, or product-led business where adoption signals matter as much as renewal or expansion outcomes.

 - Track record building high-performing frontline teams from an early stage: hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, coaching, and performance management.

 - Experience leading teams through GTM motion changes, coverage-model shifts, or evolving commercial ownership.

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping teams return customers to a clear value path.

 - Experience partnering closely with Solutions Consulting, Sales, Services, or Implementation teams in a shared customer lifecycle model.

 - Familiarity with AI transformation, workflow automation, agents, or collaboration/work management software.

jobs.title: GTM Recruiter, Singapore
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

 

We’re hiring the first recruiter on the ground in Singapore to build Notion’s GTM team across Southeast Asia. You’ll own GTM hiring end to end and help build the next evolution of our go-to-market organization, recruiting for new and evolving customer-facing roles, including BDRs, Solutions Consultants, Outcomes Architects, Forward Deployed Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and field sales leadership, that bring stronger technical fluency, deeper customer ownership, and fewer handoffs to enterprise selling. You’ll partner closely with the Country Manager, Singapore, sales leadership, and cross-functional teams to turn an emerging business strategy into clear profiles, thoughtful processes, and exceptional hires.

You’ll inherit a global recruiting playbook and develop the operating rhythm for the region. You’ll also have a direct hand in shaping the culture of the SEA team as it forms, and be the subject matter expert on the ground.

You’ll use Notion every day in the same way our customers do, giving you firsthand insight into the workflows and AI transformation behind the roles you are hiring for, and help build a new GTM motion at the intersection of AI, workflow design, enterprise transformation, and customer outcomes. The work requires craft, clarity, speed, and strong judgment, balancing business urgency with a high bar for talent density. We work from our Singapore office on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own Singapore and SEA GTM hiring, from BDRs and Solutions Consultants to Outcomes Architects and field sales leadership, and help shape what the team looks like as it scales.

 - Establish the recruiting motion locally by building the process, systems, stakeholder rhythms, and candidate experience for SEA.

 - Help shape the culture of the SEA team as it forms, setting the hiring bar and the candidate experience that define what it feels like to join Notion here.

 - Partner directly with APAC GTM leadership on org design, role definition, market realities, and hiring decisions, and be the advisor they trust on what is achievable in the market.

 - Own complex and ambiguous searches end to end, setting strategy, diagnosing problems, pivoting when needed, and driving toward an outcome without waiting for direction.

 - Build deep Singapore and APAC talent networks and market intelligence, and use both to improve where and how Notion competes for talent.

 - Navigate high-stakes candidate and stakeholder situations, including compensation and closing conversations, with clarity and strong judgment.

 - Identify patterns across roles and regions and drive solutions that improve how the wider Recruiting team works.

 - Mentor teammates and share repeatable practices as the APAC team scales.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - A strong record of GTM hiring in Singapore and APAC across BDR, sales, solutions consulting, and field leadership roles.

 - Deep recruiting craft across sourcing, assessment, candidate engagement, offer strategy, and close.

 - A strong record of delivering complex, ambiguous, or first-of searches and building the playbook when one does not exist.

 - Experience influencing senior sales leaders as a talent advisor and recruiting subject matter expert.

 - Strong situational awareness and business maturity, with the judgment to navigate competing priorities and know when to push back or escalate.

 - A systems mindset and evidence of improving team practices beyond your own portfolio.

 - Curiosity, learning agility, and a hands-on approach to AI tools that improve recruiting quality and leverage.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience as an early recruiting hire in a market or region, setting up the motion while hiring at pace.

 - Experience owning the end-to-end hiring process at a global SaaS company.

 - Experience hiring across multiple APAC markets.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. jobs.title: Remote Office Assistant
jobs.description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
  • Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

 

New roles for Senior React Full-stack Engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now.

 

Two ways to work with clients

  • Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it.
  • Direct hire: some clients hire engineers full-time, and we support you through the process.

 

Because companies trust our vetting, applying through Lemon.io is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own.

 

What you get

  • Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills
  • We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.
  • Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours.
  • No micromanagement, no screen trackers
  • Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds
  • Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from 75+ countries

 

Who we’re looking for

Senior Data Engineers with:

  • 4+ years of commercial experience as a Data Engineer

  • Experience with Apache Airflow and Snowflake, or Python and SQL, is required

  • Experience with AWS, GCP, or Microsoft Azure is mandatory

  • You own problems end-to-end: you spot the issue in the data or pipeline, design and build the solution, and ship it to production.

  • You can show the business impact of your work with concrete results (e.g., faster data processing, lower infrastructure costs, fresher data for stakeholders, fewer pipeline incidents).

  • Advanced English: you discuss business tasks, explain your technical decisions, raise risks early, and present yourself and your results well on client calls.

  • You work full-time remotely and deliver without supervision.

Work From Home. Pick Your Schedule. Get Paid Weekly. Welcome to ShyftOff!

Tired of traditional jobs that expect you to build your life around a fixed schedule? At ShyftOff, we believe work should fit into your life, not the other way around!

We're changing the way customer service works by connecting independent professionals with exciting opportunities to support established businesses, all from the comfort of home.

Whether you're looking to earn extra income, take greater control of your schedule, or explore a flexible remote opportunity, ShyftOff gives you the freedom to work differently.

Why Choose ShyftOff?

No commute. No traditional fixed schedule. More flexibility. More control.

  • 100% Remote: Forget the commute! Work from the comfort of your own home.
  • Weekly Pay: Get paid every week for eligible completed work.

Important: Applications will only be considered if you apply on the ShyftOff website at https://www.shyftoff.com/agents

The Role

As an independent agent, you take inbound calls for ShyftOff client programs and help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and get what they need. After you join, you choose which programs to apply for based on your qualifications and availability.

One of our newest programs include:

Financial Services Program — $15–$20 per hour plus incentives + $300 certification bonus

Help cardholders manage their money with confidence. You'll take inbound calls from people who rely on their banking cards for everyday life: activating a new card, replacing a lost one, sorting out a disputed charge, or getting a time-sensitive payment through. What you'll do:

  • Help customers with payments, transfers, and disputes, accurately and securely
  • Verify customer identity and follow strict security and compliance protocols on every call
  • Spot and help resolve potential fraud with composure
  • Document every interaction accurately in the account's systems

Who you'll talk to: cardholders and their benefits managers, often at a stressful moment like a lost card or a charge they don't recognize. Your job is to guide them, protect their account, and get them back on solid ground.

  • Communication: you connect over the phone, listen well, and stay empathetic even when the caller isn't calm
  • Security and accuracy: you take protecting sensitive information seriously
  • Tech comfort: you can move between multiple systems and databases at once

  • Remote customer service or contact center experience is a strong plus; 3+ years of customer service experience preferred

What You'll Need (all programs)

  • Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum)

jobs.title: Global Mobility Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Imagine being the person who makes a move across the world feel easy. A candidate in Sydney gets a visa on a timeline they can plan around. A teammate relocating to Tokyo has a clear playbook, a human to talk to, and nothing to chase. A leader opening a brand-new market has a partner who can map the laws, entities, and employment models.



That's the job. At Notion, we build tools that change how people work together, no matter where they are. As our Global Mobility Manager, you'll build the bridges that make that true for our own team: immigration, relocation, and global expansion, all in one program that you shape, own, and scale.



This is a rare chance to take a working foundation, with playbooks, policies, and vendors already in place, and elevate it. You'll shape the policies and run the cases. You'll partner with People, Talent Acquisition, Legal, Finance, Accounting, and Tax, with dotted-line support from our shared services model in People Operations, so you're building alongside a team, not on an island. And you'll use AI and automation to turn a historically manual, paper-heavy function into something elegant. If you love fast-moving environments and turning solid foundations into great systems, you'll feel at home here.



This role is based in San Francisco or New York. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own mobility, end to end
   
   - Own immigration and relocation across hiring, transfers, rotations, and assignments, backed by clear policies and playbooks
   
   - Shorten time-to-visa and time-to-move through streamlined intake, approvals, SLAs, and vendor management
   
   - Guide candidates, employees, and managers with empathetic, concise communication and self-serve resources
   
   Power global expansion
   
   - Support our expansion into new markets by:
     
     - Researching and ensuring compliance with local employment laws and regulations
     
     - Partnering with Legal and Finance to establish new state registrations, entity structures, and employment models
     
     - Helping general managers and People Partners design the strategy and program for talent mobility into new markets
   
   Build the partnerships and the program
   
   - Build deep partnerships with People, Talent Acquisition, Legal, Finance, Accounting, and Tax to ship complex immigration and relocation cases quickly and compliantly
   
   - Be a mobility thought partner and help shape our internal mobility strategy
   
   - Benchmark our policies against internal feedback and external market standards, and spot opportunities to improve
   
   Make it visible and make it automatic
   
   - Build dashboards that show volume, cycle time, cost per move, tax exposure, and compliance posture
   
   - Use technology, AI, and system integrations to eliminate manual work and automate routine tasks




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - You have 6–8+ years in global mobility, immigration, or international HR, across multiple regions

 - You've built and scaled a global mobility strategy that supports cross-border talent

 - You've owned a program end to end: policy design, vendor selection, and measurable outcomes in fast-paced environments

 - You know mobility tax well: shadow payroll, equity implications, and permanent establishment risk

 - You have a systems mindset and are comfortable using AI and automation to remove manual work safely

jobs.title: Külaliskorterite koristaja
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Dream Stay OÜ on pikaajalise kogemusega lühiajalise rendiga tegelev ettevõte, kelle hallata on üle 120 külaliskorteri Tallinnas. Otsime oma meeskonda külaliskorterite koristajaid nii täis- kui osalise koormusega. Võimalik on töötada ka ainult nädalavahetustel (näiteks laupäevast esmaspäevani) — töö sobib hästi lisatööks. Enamik külaliskortereid asub Tallinna vanalinnas ja kesklinnas või nende vahetus läheduses. Pakume tööd külaliskorterites. Palun arvestage, et kõik korterid – kokku umbes 120 – asuvad erinevates hoonetes. Autot tööks vaja ei ole — liikumine objektide vahel toimub ühistranspordiga ning see aeg on samuti tasustatud. Linna peal pesu vedama ei pea: puhta pesu toob kohale meie kuller. Kõik vajalikud puhastusvahendid on olemas apartementides või keldriruumides. Koristaja peab endaga kaasas kandma vaid meilt saadud lappe, kindaid ja mõned švammid. Töö sisaldab vahetusi nädalavahetustel ja pühade ajal — see on turismisektoris töötamise loomulik osa. Esmaspäevast reedeni töögraafikut kahjuks pakkuda ei ole võimalik ning väikeste lastega tööl viibimine ei ole lubatud.

Omalt poolt pakume: * Kaasaegseid töövahendeid* Sõbralikku ning toetavat kollektiivi * Töötulemustele vastavat töötasu

Muud nõuded: Oled sobiv kandidaat, kui sul on olemas töötahe, armastad puhtust ja korrektsust ning oled võimeline töötama iseseisvalt. Varasem töökogemus sarnasel ametikohal on väga hinnatud ja annab eelise. Oluline tingimus on nutitelefoni kasutamise oskus, kuna põhiline suhtlus ja töökorraldus toimub grupivestluses.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

Koormus, vahetused: 0,5-1,0
