jobs.title: Sales Manager – Packaging Equipment and Automated Packaging Solutions
jobs.description:
Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Automated packaging lines and packaging equipment.

Work tasks: Alpina Electronics OÜ is expanding its activities in the field of automated packaging equipment and packaging lines and is looking for a Sales Manager for the Estonian and Finnish markets. Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Our range of solutions includes: Automated packaging lines and equipment in cooperation with the Polish manufacturer RADPAK. Palletizing equipment, including solutions developed by Alpina Electronics. Thermoforming packaging machines for the food industry, primarily for the Finnish market, supplied by Colimatic. Your Key Responsibilities Identifying potential customers and establishing new business relationships in Estonia and Finland. Visiting customers to understand their production processes and packaging requirements. Presenting suitable packaging equipment and automated packaging solutions. Working closely with equipment manufacturers and technical specialists. Managing sales projects from initial customer contact through to order confirmation. Every manufacturing company and project is different. Your role will be to understand each customer's specific needs and work together with our team and the manufacturers' technical specialists to develop the most suitable solution.

We offer: We offer an opportunity to play an active role in establishing a new sales division and developing the market for automated packaging equipment and packaging lines in Estonia and Finland. We offer: A competitive base salary combined with performance-based bonuses. An independent and responsible position with a high degree of autonomy. Flexible working arrangements, including the opportunity to work from home. A company car, computer, mobile phone, and all other necessary work equipment. Comprehensive technical support from equipment manufacturers and our own specialists. Manufacturer-provided training and opportunities to attend international trade fairs. The opportunity to contribute to the development of a new business area and influence the range of solutions we offer. The position involves regular customer visits throughout Estonia and Finland. Administrative and office-based tasks can be carried out from a home office. We prefer a full-time employee but are also open to part-time arrangements for the right candidate.

Other requirements: This position is ideal for someone who values independence, enjoys planning their own work, and wants to see a direct connection between their efforts and achievements.

Option to work from home: Yes

Working load, shifts: 0,5

jobs.title: Senior Raft Guide & Safety Kayaker / Kayak leiðbeinandi
jobs.description: Arctic Rafting is looking for a Senior Raft Guide and Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor for the upcoming summer season of 2027. Our season is May – September, with our high season in the summer time; June – August. There are some operations and preparations to do also before and after, in April and October. In particular, we are looking for someone to come in March, to repair equipment and do admin office work for the river operation, to prepare for the summer. This position will extend to be all year round, working part time over the winter months and taking a long leave (1-3 months). Arctic Rafting has a base camp on the well known tourist circuit of “The Golden Circle” in the southern part of Iceland, in just over an hour drive from Reykjavík capital city. Our operations include family friendly rafting trips on the mighty Hvítá River (class II-III), which is the third longest river in Iceland, originating from Langjökull Glacier. Our base camp has other amenities like a bar, restaurant, sauna and hot tubs, so clients can wind down after an action-packed adventure on the river.The qualities we are looking for is experience with good customer service, and good team work skills. Any added language skills are appreciated, operational skills for safe and high quality river trips, repairing skills for river rafting gear and other equipment, and skills for cooking, cleaning, photography, marketing/office, mechanics and general handy man skills. Job description and responsibilities of a Senior Raft Guide:* Operate safe and entertaining river tours for clients (rafting or kayaking)* Be a team leader and trip lead a group of guides in rafting trips of the size of 100+ clients* Kitchen worker and general work in the restaurant and bar serving clients* Work around the property (repair gear, cleaning, laundry, gardening and handy man jobs)Requirements:* Current WRT (Whitewater Rescue Technician) or similar* Current IRF (International Rafting Federation) certification or similar* Up to date Advanced First Aid training* Minimum 5 seasons of raft guide experience* Good English skills to communicate with clientsExtras, good to have, but not a requirement:* A big bus license to drive the river shuttle (45 seater)* Kitchen and bar experience* Photography skills* Sales / marketing skillsWork arrangements:* We generally have one morning trip and one afternoon trip every day; you either do two trips per day, or one trip and then base work for the rest of the day (cooking, cleaning, repair gear, etc.)* The work days can be anything from 4-12 hours per day, but the normality is generally 8-9 hours* A full time job means 160-170 hours per month, and as the hours vary, the pay is by hourly rates* Normally you would get 2 days off per week, but this can vary to 1-3 days off weeklyHousing and food:* Living arrangements is at an old farm in the countryside 1,5 hour from Reykjavík city, next to the river rafting base / restaurant* Everyone gets their own private room, including shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* We do daily communal dinners and everyone is expected to partake in the cooking and cleaning at the end of the day* We supply breakfast, lunch and dinner; while you are at the raft base for work Rates:* Depending on your skill level and experience the pay would be around 2.500 – 2.900isk per hour* In addition to this we offer free housing and food for your stay during your work periodPlease note that in Iceland we pay around 40% tax, and other fees will be deducted too (union, pension fund etc.)Benefits:* Some great times living in the countryside, being a raft guide for an Icelandic summer season* Private room with shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* Use of base facilities (staff kitchen, hot pots and sauna)* Occasional use of communal work car; we strongly recommend having a valid driver’s license, as public transport in Iceland is quite horrid when you live at an old farm in the middle of nowhere.About the Company:This is one of the oldest adventure activities to do in Iceland, but the first river rafting trip with clients was made here in 1985. Around 1990 they started renovations at the old barn and farm house to make the raft base into what it is today; changing rooms, showers, sauna, hot pots, restaurant, bar and guide facilities; for around 10-12 staff members to live there for the summer season. Our clients are mostly from Iceland, Europe and USA, so the minimal language requirements are good English skills. Owned by a local raft guide and kayaker, and more details can be found on our website: www.arcticrafting.com This video sums up what a normal day in the summer looks like – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQTo apply; please send a CV and cover letter to drumbo@arcticrafting.is before 1st of December 2026Best regards,The Arctic Rafting teamdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.comArctic Rafting leitar að reyndum flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanni (Senior Raft Guide) og öryggiskajakræðara/kajakkennara (Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor) fyrir komandi sumartímabil árið 2027.Starfstímabilið okkar er frá maí til september, en háannatíminn er yfir sumarmánuðina, júní til ágúst. Einnig þarf að sinna ýmsum undirbúnings- og rekstrarverkefnum fyrir og eftir tímabilið, í apríl og október.Við leitum sérstaklega að einstaklingi sem getur hafið störf í mars til að sinna viðgerðum á búnaði og skrifstofu- og stjórnsýsluverkefnum tengdum flúðasiglingarekstrinum, til undirbúnings fyrir sumarið.Starfið mun þróast yfir í heilsársstarf, þar sem unnið verður í hlutastarfi yfir vetrarmánuðina og möguleiki verður á lengra leyfi, í 1–3 mánuði.StarfsumhverfiðArctic Rafting er með bækistöð við hina þekktu ferðamannaleið Gullna hringinn á Suðurlandi, í rúmlega klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík.Starfsemin felur meðal annars í sér fjölskylduvænar flúðasiglingaferðir á hinni mikilfenglegu Hvítá (erfiðleikaflokkur II–III). Hvítá er þriðja lengsta á Íslands og á upptök sín við Langjökul.Á bækistöðinni er einnig bar, veitingastaður, gufubað og heitir pottar þar sem gestir geta slakað á eftir ævintýralega ferð niður ána.Eiginleikar sem við leitum aðVið leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur reynslu af góðri þjónustu við viðskiptavini og býr yfir góðri hæfni í teymisvinnu.Önnur tungumálakunnátta er kostur, sem og færni í að skipuleggja og framkvæma öruggar og vandaðar flúðasiglingaferðir.Einnig er kostur að hafa reynslu af viðgerðum á flúðasiglingabúnaði og öðrum tækjum, matreiðslu, þrifum, ljósmyndun, markaðssetningu, skrifstofustörfum, vélaviðgerðum og almennum viðhaldsverkefnum.Starfslýsing og ábyrgð yfirleiðsögumannsStjórna öruggum og skemmtilegum flúðasiglinga- og kajakferðum fyrir viðskiptavini.Vera leiðtogi teymis og stýra hópi leiðsögumanna í flúðasiglingaferðum með yfir 100 þátttakendum.Vinna í eldhúsi og sinna almennum störfum á veitingastað og bar, þar á meðal þjónustu við gesti.Sinna ýmsum verkefnum á svæðinu, svo sem viðgerðum á búnaði, þrifum, þvotti, garðvinnu og almennu viðhaldi.HæfniskröfurGilt WRT-skírteini (Whitewater Rescue Technician – sérhæfð björgun í straumvatni) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild IRF-réttindi (International Rafting Federation – Alþjóðasamband flúðasiglinga) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild og uppfærð réttindi í ítarlegri skyndihjálp (Advanced First Aid).Að lágmarki fimm tímabils reynsla sem flúðasiglingaleiðsögumaður.Góð enskukunnátta til að eiga samskipti við viðskiptavini.Viðbótarhæfni sem er kostur en ekki skilyrðiÖkuréttindi til að aka stórri rútu (45 farþega) sem notuð er til að flytja gesti til og frá ánni.Reynsla af eldhús- og barstörfum.Hæfni í ljósmyndun.Reynsla af sölu- og markaðsmálum.Vinnutími og starfskjörYfirleitt eru farnar tvær flúðasiglingaferðir á dag, ein að morgni og önnur síðdegis.Starfsmaður fer annaðhvort í tvær ferðir á dag eða eina ferð og sinnir síðan öðrum verkefnum á bækistöðinni, svo sem matreiðslu, þrifum eða viðgerðum á búnaði.Vinnudagar geta verið allt frá 4 upp í 12 klukkustundir, en algengast er að þeir séu um 8–9 klukkustundir.Fullt starf miðast við 160–170 vinnustundir á mánuði. Þar sem vinnustundir eru breytilegar eru laun greidd samkvæmt tímakaupi.Yfirleitt eru tveir frídagar í viku, en þeir geta verið frá einum upp í þrjá eftir aðstæðum.Húsnæði og fæðiStarfsfólk býr á gömlum sveitabæ í um 1,5 klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík, við hliðina á flúðasiglingabækistöðinni og veitingastaðnum.Allir starfsmenn fá sérherbergi en deila sameiginlegri aðstöðu, þar á meðal baðherbergi með sturtu.Sameiginlegur kvöldverður er á hverjum degi og ætlast er til að allir taki þátt í matreiðslu og frágangi í lok dags.Boðið er upp á morgunmat, hádegismat og kvöldmat á meðan starfsfólk er við vinnu á bækistöðinni.LaunTímakaup fer eftir hæfni og reynslu viðkomandi og er á bilinu 2.500–2.900 krónur á klukkustund.Auk launa er boðið upp á ókeypis húsnæði og fæði meðan á starfstímabilinu stendur.Athugið að á Íslandi geta skattar numið um 40% af launum og að önnur gjöld eru einnig dregin frá, svo sem stéttarfélagsgjöld og lífeyrissjóðsiðgjöld.FríðindiEinstakt tækifæri til að upplifa íslenskt sumar í sveitinni og starfa við flúðasiglingar.Sérherbergi með sameiginlegri baðaðstöðu.Aðgangur að aðstöðu á bækistöðinni, þar á meðal starfsmannaeldhúsi, heitum pottum og gufubaði.Stundum er hægt að nýta sameiginlegan starfsmannabíl.Við mælum eindregið með því að umsækjendur hafi gilt ökuskírteini, þar sem almenningssamgöngur á Íslandi eru afar takmarkaðar þegar búið er á gömlum sveitabæ úti í sveit.Um fyrirtækiðFlúðasiglingar eru ein elsta skipulagða ævintýraafþreying sem boðið hefur verið upp á á Íslandi. Fyrsta flúðasiglingaferðin með viðskiptavini á þessu svæði var farin árið 1985.Um 1990 hófst endurnýjun á gamla fjósinu og íbúðarhúsinu á bænum með það að markmiði að útbúa þá aðstöðu sem þar er í dag.Þar er nú að finna búningsklefa, sturtur, gufubað, heita potta, veitingastað, bar og aðstöðu fyrir leiðsögumenn. Á sumrin er aðstaða fyrir um 10–12 starfsmenn til að búa á staðnum.Viðskiptavinir okkar koma að mestu leyti frá Íslandi, Evrópu og Bandaríkjunum og því er góð enskukunnátta lágmarkskrafa.Fyrirtækið er í eigu flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanns og kajakræðara úr heimabyggð.Nánari upplýsingar um fyrirtækið má finna á vefsíðunni:www.arcticrafting.comMyndband sem sýnir dæmigerðan sumardag hjá Arctic Rafting:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQUmsóknir:Áhugasamir eru beðnir um að senda ferilskrá og kynningarbréf á netfangið:drumbo@arcticrafting.isUmsóknarfrestur er til 1. desember 2026.Með bestu kveðju,Starfsfólk Arctic Raftingdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.com

jobs.title: Lead Product Marketing Manager, Core Product
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion's engineering and product teams are shipping faster than ever, which means there's more for customers to discover, understand, and adopt than ever before. We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager to drive awareness of new Notion features and capabilities, and to run the programs that turn early activation into lasting adoption. This is a full-stack role: you'll flex across launches, growth programs, and pricing and packaging. That last one means helping decide how new capabilities map to plans and tiers, and making sure customers can tell what they get and what they pay for. You're a messaging master with a genuine point of view: someone who can build narratives sharp and specific enough to cut through an increasingly noisy market, and a strategic partner to Product from early development all the way through go-to-market.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead launches big and small, coordinating efforts across our Marketing and GTM org to land a successful launch day.

 - Drive continued awareness, growth, and adoption of high-PMF features well after launch day. Launch is the start of the story, not the end of it.

 - Take on pricing and packaging projects for new capabilities, working with Product, Design, and Web to decide whether something becomes a new SKU or tier or joins an existing one, then landing the change on notion.com/pricing http://notion.com/pricing, in-product, and in release comms.

 - Serve as a strategic partner to Product, informing strategy during product development, competitive positioning, and user insights.

 - Collaborate with Enterprise PMMs and Sales to build sales enablement materials that turn product capability into stories reps can use in the field.

 - Partnering with Demand Gen and Lifecycle on sequences, webinars, and more.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 10+ years directly relevant experience in product marketing or adjacent marketing function.

 - A distinctive point of view and the creativity to build narratives that stand out in a crowded, noisy market.

 - Experience running product launches, adoption, or growth programs, ideally at a fast-moving product or technology company.

 - A real point of view on pricing and packaging, or the appetite to build one fast. You can reason about plans, tiers, and value, not just features and launches.

 - Strong cross-functional skills, comfortable coordinating Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing toward one outcome.

 - Genuine passion for shaping the future of work with AI, a growth mindset, and a scrappy, high-ownership approach to getting things done.

 - Sharp writing and storytelling instincts: you know the difference between a headline that's technically accurate and one that actually lands.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You're already a Notion user, fluent in the product and plugged into the community.

 - You look beyond just AI & tech companies for creative inspiration

 - You're a pro at building and using agents, inside Notion and beyond.

 - You've worked through a pricing or packaging change before, such as a new tier, a plan change, or a paywall, and can talk about the tradeoffs.

 - PMM experience at a larger company, though we care more about your instincts and ownership than your resume's logos.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $270,000 per year.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager, Europe
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Field marketing at Linear is just getting started. Its job is to put us in front of the right people in the right room: executive dinners, conferences, partner events, and programs built with our Customer team around named accounts.

We're hiring our first Field Marketing Manager in Europe to take that motion from strategy to execution. You'll own the executive dinner calendar across cities, decide which third-party events and partner programs are worth our time, and build the invitations and follow-up that help our sellers turn a good evening into a real conversation. This is a hands-on role. You'll tap your venue and vendor network, build the run of show for each program, and be on site to run it.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in Europe, with London preferred. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. This role involves frequent travel for events, including evenings.

What you’ll do

 - Own the executive dinner calendar across cities: pick the city, the venue, the date, and the theme for each dinner

 - Build each guest list with our Customer team, equip sellers with invitation sequences, and track RSVPs so every seat goes to someone worth having there

 - Manage venues and vendors, negotiate menus and minimums, and keep per-dinner spend, contracts, and travel logistics within budget

 - Brief our hosts and executives on who's attending and what we want to learn, be on site to run the night, and hand follow-ups to Sales afterward

 - Evaluate conferences and sponsorship offers by audience quality, account coverage, and expected return, then plan how we show up: booth or no booth, side dinners, customer meetings, and speaking slots

 - Co-host dinners, workshops, and meetups with partners, and agree up front on guest lists, costs, and who follows up

 - Sit with Sales each quarter to pick target accounts, build lightweight formats an AE can request for a key account, and report on attendance, meetings held, pipeline influenced, and feedback from attendees and account owners

What we’re looking for

 - 3+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or B2B events, ideally at a software company. Experience in developer tools, SaaS, or another technical product is a plus

 - A track record of running dinners, roundtables, or other small-format events end to end, plus experience planning around conferences: sponsorships, side events, and customer meetings

 - Experience working next to Sales. You know how to build a target account list, get an AE to care about an event, and tell them afterward what happened

 - Strong project management. You can run several cities and events at once without dropping details

 - Comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, and a spreadsheet. Hands-on time with HubSpot and event attribution is a plus

 - Clear writing and an easy way with senior guests, hosts, and partners. Experience marketing to engineering and product leaders is a bonus

 - Experience building an event series from the ground up, including a playbook someone else could run

 - Willingness to travel often, including evenings

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - A story about our mission: Read Me https://linear.app/readme

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - Our CEO and co-founder, Karri at 20VC: How to Grow Capital Efficiently in a World of BS Growth https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vqDYkuzbSM

 - Building our teams: Why and how we do work trials at Linear https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear

 - A video series: Conversations on Quality https://linear.app/quality

 - Read about our recent Series C Fundraise https://linear.app/now/building-our-way and Giving our team liquidity https://linear.app/now/giving-our-team-liquidity-through-linear-s-first-tender-offer

A note on recruitment fraud: all official Linear hiring communication comes from an @linear.app http://linear.app email address, and all open roles are listed at linear.app/careers http://linear.app/careers. We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. Suspicious messages can be reported to security@linear.app.

Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

jobs.title: Principal Strategic Sourcing Lead - Technology
Engineering Manager, Security (Cloud, Infrastructure & Application Security)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the role:

We are looking for an Engineering Manager, Security to lead the teams that secure our cloud, our infrastructure, and the code we ship. You will manage two closely linked groups:

 - Cloud & Infrastructure Security: engineers who own cloud security posture, configuration hardening, and infrastructure vulnerability management across GCP, AWS, and Azure, plus containers, Kubernetes, and SaaS platforms.

 - Application Security & Secure SDLC: engineers who run our SCA, SAST, and IaC scanning programs, drive remediation with engineering teams, and deliver secure development training.

The core responsibility of this role is getting vulnerabilities fixed on time. You will partner with engineering teams across the company to drive remediation of cloud, infrastructure, and code findings within SLA, so that we consistently meet our compliance commitments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, and customer contracts). You will hire and grow a high-performing team, set the strategy and roadmap for vulnerability management from code to cloud, and make secure-by-default the easiest path for every developer. You will not run incident response yourself, but you need to understand it well enough to support the incident response team with context, prioritization, and follow-up fixes.

 

What You'll Do:


TEAM LEADERSHIP & STRATEGY

 - Build, lead, and mentor a team of cloud security, infrastructure vulnerability management, and application security engineers; own hiring, career development, and performance management.

 - Define the multi-year roadmap and quarterly OKRs for cloud security, vulnerability management, and Secure SDLC, balancing risk reduction against developer velocity.

 - Set clear ownership, operating rhythms, and on-call/escalation processes across the team.

 - Report on security posture, risk trends, and program metrics to engineering and executive leadership.


REMEDIATION & COMPLIANCE DELIVERY

 - Own remediation SLAs by severity across cloud, infrastructure, container, and code findings, and make sure they map to our compliance obligations (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, customer contracts).

 - Partner with engineering managers and tech leads to plan, prioritize, and land fixes within SLA without stalling roadmaps.

 - Run a regular remediation review with engineering leadership: open findings, SLA burn-down, upcoming SLA breaches, and owners.

 - Manage the exception and risk-acceptance process: documented justification, compensating controls, expiry dates, and approvals.

 - Build automated workflows that route findings to the right owning team, track them to closure, and escalate before SLAs are breached.

 - Work with Compliance/GRC to produce audit-ready evidence of remediation timeliness, and lead the security side of external audits for vulnerability management controls.

 - Track and report metrics such as SLA attainment, mean time to remediate, backlog age, and exceptions, by team and severity.


CLOUD & INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY

 - Lead infrastructure vulnerability management across cloud workloads, containers, registries, data stores, and platform services, from scanning and contextual risk triage to remediation workflows.

 - Oversee configuration hardening and secure baselines across GCP (primary) and supporting AWS and Azure environments.

 - Own the strategy for Cloud, Kubernetes, and Data Security Posture Management (CSPM, KSPM, DSPM) tooling; make sure findings are accurate, prioritized, and actionable.

 - Secure critical SaaS platforms with sound configurations, access controls, and integrations.

 - Partner with Platform and ML Infrastructure teams to secure multi-tenant and AI infrastructure.


APPLICATION SECURITY & CODE SCANNING

 - Own the SCA, SAST, and IaC scanning programs end to end: tool selection, CI/CD integration, rule tuning, noise reduction, and developer experience.

 - Drive software supply chain security, including dependency management, SBOMs, artifact signing, and progress through SLSA levels.

 - Feed code-scanning findings into the central remediation workflow so they reach the owning team automatically and are tracked against SLA.

 - Shift IaC security left so misconfigurations are caught in pull requests, before they reach production.


SECURE SDLC & DEVELOPER ENABLEMENT

 - Define and run the Secure SDLC program: security requirements, threat modeling, secure design reviews, and release gates proportionate to risk.

 - Build and deliver security training, including onboarding, role-based secure coding training, and targeted sessions driven by real vulnerability trends.

 - Develop paved roads, secure defaults, and guardrails that make the secure path the easiest path for engineers.

 - Grow a Security Champions network across engineering teams.


INCIDENT RESPONSE PARTNERSHIP & COLLABORATION

 - Understand the incident response lifecycle well enough to support the IR team: supply asset, exposure, and vulnerability context, and help assess blast radius.

 - Own follow-up remediation from incidents and postmortems that touch cloud, infrastructure, or code, and track it to closure.

 - Feed incident learnings back into scanning rules, secure baselines, and developer training.

 - Collaborate with Security Monitoring/Detection, Incident Response, Offensive Security, PSIRT, Architecture, DevOps, and Platform Engineering.

 - Help communicate security advisories, best practices, and updates to customers.

 - Tune into threat intelligence alerts to promptly manage patching of critical, exploitable vulnerabilities.

 

Required Skills & Experience:

 - 8+ years in security engineering, cloud security, or DevSecOps, including 2+ years managing security engineers (or 3+ years as a tech lead with formal people-leadership responsibility).

 - Deep, hands-on knowledge of cloud security in GCP plus working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure: IAM, networking, logging, org policies, and security services.

 - Proven track record running vulnerability management programs at scale and driving remediation across many engineering teams to meet SLAs, across cloud infrastructure, containers, and application code.

 - Hands-on experience with CSPM/CNAPP platforms (e.g., Wiz, Orca, Prisma Cloud, Lacework, GCP Security Command Center).

 - Hands-on experience with SCA, SAST, and IaC scanning tools (e.g., Snyk, Semgrep, CodeQL, Checkmarx, Socket, Dependabot, Checkov, tfsec) and integrating them into CI/CD.

 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes and container security, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or similar).

 - Proven track record of building or maturing a Secure SDLC program, including developer security training.

 - Ability to write and review code or automation (Python, Go, TypeScript, or similar).

 - Strong understanding of how remediation SLAs and security controls map to compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, CIS, NIST), and experience producing audit evidence.

 - Working understanding of security incident response in cloud-native environments, enough to partner effectively with IR and detection teams.

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence engineering leaders and explain risk in business terms.



Bonus Qualifications:

 - Experience securing developer platforms, multi-tenant SaaS, or AI/ML infrastructure.

 - Experience with software supply chain frameworks (SLSA, Sigstore, SBOM standards).

 - Experience building a Security Champions program or developer-facing security tooling.

 - Experience leading the security side of external audits (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, or FedRAMP).

 - Relevant certifications (e.g., CCSP, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, OSCP, CSSLP), though not required.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

jobs.title: SOC Engineer
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the role:

We are looking for a SOC Engineer to join our Security Operations team and help defend a fast-moving, cloud-native AI vibe-coding platform. In this role, your primary mandate will be building and evolving our security data lake, engineering reliable security telemetry, and owning high-fidelity detection engineering end-to-end. You will unify cloud, identity, endpoint, and application telemetry, staying on top of emerging threats to rapidly build and tune detections across our environment. Alongside this data and detection mandate, you will support incident investigations as needed to translate real-world threats into stronger automated defenses. This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong technical depth, understanding of modern software engineering and CI/CD systems, familiarity with cloud-native infrastructure (especially GCP), and expertise in security data pipelines and detection workflows.



What You'll Do:

 - Security Data Lake & Detection Engineering: Architect, expand, and maintain our security data lake while designing, testing, and tuning custom detection rules to maximize threat coverage and minimize noise across our cloud-native stack.

 - Threat Awareness & Rapid Assessment: Continuously monitor emerging threats (0-days, bad actor activity, public exploitation campaigns, bug bounty reports, customer security issues) and rapidly assess their applicability to Replit's infrastructure, SaaS services, internal tools, and platform components.

 - Investigation & Impact Analysis: Conduct targeted investigations to determine impact, analyze logs, telemetry, and system behaviors using SIEM, metrics, and Cloud Logging and identify gaps in detection/visibility.



Required Skills & Experience:

 - Building and evolving the security data lake, unifying cloud, identity, endpoint, and application telemetry; hands-on experience with SIEM, Cloud Logging, and log-based investigation workflows.

 - Engineering reliable security infrastructure and automation using infrastructure-as-code to close visibility gaps and perform log-based investigations.

 - Proven expertise in detection engineering end-to-end, specifically developing, testing, and tuning custom detection rules to maximize threat coverage and reduce noise across complex environments.

 - Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals (code structure, build systems, dependencies, package ecosystems).

 - Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows.

 - Solid knowledge of cloud architecture, especially Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services in modern cloud-native deployments.

 - Familiarity with SaaS architectures, identity systems, and integration patterns.



Bonus Qualifications:

 - Experience with threat intelligence, security research, or vulnerability analysis.

 - Familiarity with Kubernetes, containers, serverless infrastructure, or modern distributed systems.

 - Ability to write scripts or small tools for investigation or automation (Python, Go, Bash).

 - Experience working with bug bounty programs or coordinated vulnerability disclosure workflows.

 - Experience in fast-paced, cloud-native, or AI/ML-driven environments.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

jobs.title: Regional Sales Director, Canada
Staff Software Engineer, Financial Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


About the role:

Make Replit the single place where businesses can buy everything they need through their agents. As a Staff Software Engineer on Replit’s Money team, you’ll set technical direction and build the commerce platform that lets users discover, evaluate, purchase, and manage the products and services they need to build and run their businesses—without leaving Replit.

 

Replit already enables businesses to accept payments through integrations such as Stripe. This role builds on that foundation to expand what businesses can buy and accomplish through Replit Agent. You’ll design commerce experiences that combine the simplicity consumers expect with the controls enterprises need, making agent-assisted purchasing useful, trustworthy, and reliable.

 

You’ll own architecture and lead cross-team delivery across merchant and service-provider integrations, agent tools, purchasing workflows, and the lifecycle after a transaction. The challenge goes beyond executing a payment: agents need to understand what a user wants, present clear choices and costs, act within delegated authority, and verify that the purchase delivered the intended outcome. You’ll stay hands-on with design and code while aligning partners, mentoring engineers, and turning an ambitious product vision into incremental customer value.


You will:

 - Set technical direction for Replit’s financial infrastructure, with an immediate focus on enterprise billing, spend controls, and financial correctness.

 - Build shared services for usage-based billing, pricing, credits, subscriptions, and entitlements so product teams can launch without rebuilding billing.

 - Automate enterprise contract lifecycles—from onboarding through amendments and renewals—keeping commercial terms, provisioned credits, and invoices in sync.

 - Build timely budget enforcement, alerts, and overrides that give customers control over spend without disrupting their hosted apps.

 - Make AI usage understandable: attribute costs to the right customer, workspace, user, or agent, including delegated work without double-counting.

 - Build reconciliation and audit trails that make balances and invoices explainable and help Finance catch discrepancies before customers do.

 - Simplify the billing stack through safe migrations that preserve balances, transaction history, and customer access.

 - Own production reliability through testing, observability, incident response, and safe recovery from duplicate events, delayed usage, and partial failures.

 - Stay hands-on while leading cross-team delivery, mentoring engineers, and partnering with Product, Finance, Sales, and Support.


Required skills and experience:

 - A track record of Staff-level technical ownership: setting architecture and delivering complex initiatives across teams.

 - Deep experience building and operating production backend or distributed systems.

 - Strong fundamentals in API design, data modeling, databases, and event-driven architecture.

 - Sound judgment around transactions, consistency, concurrency, idempotency, and failure recovery.

 - Experience evolving live systems and migrating data without compromising correctness or availability.

 - Product judgment that balances customer needs, delivery speed, and long-term system quality.

 - Clear communication with technical and non-technical partners, including translating business requirements into system behavior.

 - Hands-on leadership through implementation, design reviews, mentoring, and production ownership.


Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with billing, payments, subscriptions, credits, entitlements, or other financial systems.

 - Experience with enterprise contracts, negotiated pricing, invoicing, or quote-to-cash automation.

 - Experience with high-volume usage metering, pricing calculations, or low-latency spend controls.

 - Experience building reconciliation, financial reporting, or auditable transaction histories with Finance and Accounting.

 - Experience integrating billing, payment, or CRM platforms, with judgment about what to build versus buy.

 

Bonus Points:

 - Experience with AI or cloud infrastructure billing, including variable costs and attribution across distributed workloads.

 - Experience building customer-facing spend visibility, budgets, or internal tools that reduce manual billing work.

 - Experience with cloud marketplace billing, payment recovery, or fraud and dispute workflows.

 - Familiarity with agentic commerce or delegated spending. These are additional strengths, not requirements.



What we value:

 - Customer outcomes: success means a business can get what it needs through its agent, with clear costs and a verified result—not merely a completed API call.

 - User control and trust: agents act within explicit authority, surface consequential choices, and make purchases and ongoing commitments understandable.

 - Consumer simplicity and enterprise readiness: straightforward experiences should coexist with the controls organizations need.

 - End-to-end ownership: we own the experience from intent through purchase, fulfillment, and ongoing management.

 - Pragmatic technical leadership: we build on what exists, deliver incremental value, and invest in correctness and extensibility where they matter.

 - Clear collaboration: we document decisions, surface risks early, and help other teams and partners succeed.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Web Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Web Infrastructure builds the foundations behind Notion’s web clients so product engineers can ship fast, reliable, accessible experiences. As a junior engineer on the team, you’ll help make those experiences measurably faster and more resilient. You’ll investigate performance bottlenecks, improve how the client loads and responds, and help build tools that catch regressions earlier. You don’t need to arrive as a performance expert; we’re looking for strong fundamentals, curiosity, and a desire to learn by shipping useful work.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Use browser tools and real-world data to investigate page-load and interaction bottlenecks, then turn findings into focused improvements.

 - Help build or improve performance tests, dashboards, and guardrails that make regressions easier to catch during development and rollout.

 - Ship scoped improvements to client loading, rendering, asset delivery, or caching, measuring their impact and checking for regressions.

 - Partner with Web Infrastructure and product engineers to land changes safely across Notion’s web clients.

 - Document what you learn and share clear recommendations so teams can make better performance tradeoffs.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Solid programming fundamentals and some experience building software with JavaScript or TypeScript; familiarity with React or another component-based UI framework is helpful.

 - Curiosity about how browsers work and how code affects page load, rendering, and interaction responsiveness.

 - A thoughtful debugging approach: you can break a problem down, gather evidence, and ask for help when you’re stuck.

 - Clear, kind communication and an interest in collaborating across teams.

 - Intellectual curiosity about AI-enabled engineering tools; you use them thoughtfully and review their output critically.

Experience with performance profiling, browser developer tools, React profiling, bundlers, code splitting, service workers, asset caching, or performance testing is a plus—not a prerequisite. We welcome candidates who are excited about the work even if they don’t match every bullet.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.description:
About Us

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

  • Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually

  • Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

What will you be doing?

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

We are looking for team members who are:

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

  • Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.

  • Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.

  • Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.

  • Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!

  • Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.

  • Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!

You will need:

  • Home office or a quiet place to work.

  • Strong internet connection.

  • Desktop or laptop

(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)

Scheduling

jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

jobs.description:

WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Ship frontend features to real users. Build and launch production UI on Notion’s web client, from marketplace and seller surfaces to permissions and sharing controls, partnering with designers, PMs, and senior engineers.

 - Strengthen the foundation other teams build on. Contribute to shared components, product primitives, and tooling so engineers across Notion can build faster and more consistently.

 - Make Notion performant, scalable, and accessible. Use real metrics to find and fix problems in load time, responsiveness, and accessibility on the web client.

 - Help people discover, install, and use products from Notion and its ecosystem, and control who can see and do what. Work on distribution surfaces for creators, consultants, and partners, and on interfaces for access across pages, databases, teams, groups, and guests.

 - Own a scoped project from design to launch. Measure its impact and present what you learned to your team and partners.




QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Pursuing a bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, or another related field. Must graduate before Summer 2028.

 - Working toward proficiency in React / TypeScript

 - Previous internship experience.

 - You find large challenges exciting and enjoy discovering problems as much as solving them.

 - You are able to problem-solve and adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

This internship will take place from May 24 - August 13 or June 14 - September 3 (based on your summer schedule) and you will need to be able to work out of our SF or NY office during this time.




SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING:

 - Thoughtful problem-solving: For you, problem-solving starts with a clear and accurate understanding of the context. You can decompose tricky problems and work towards a clean solution, by yourself or with teammates. You're comfortable asking for help when you get stuck.

 - Put users first: You think critically about the implications of what you're building, and how it shapes real people's lives. You understand that reach comes with responsibility for our impact—good and bad.

 - Not ideological about technology: To you, technologies and programming languages are about tradeoffs. You may be opinionated, but you're not ideological and can learn new technologies as you go.

 - Empathetic communication: You communicate nuanced ideas clearly, whether you're explaining technical decisions in writing or brainstorming in real time. In disagreements, you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and compromise when needed.

 - Team player: For you, work isn't a solo endeavor. You enjoy collaborating cross-functionally to accomplish shared goals, and you care about learning, growing, and helping others to do the same.

 - AI enthusiast: You have built or prototyped features with AI technologies (LLMs, Embeddings, ML) and are interested in learning more.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - You have expertise with specific technologies that are part of our stack, including TypeScript and React.

 - You've heard of computing pioneers like Ada Lovelace, Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, and others—and understand why we're big fans of their work.

 - You have interests outside of technology, such as in art, history, or social sciences.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Growth (EMEA)
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past few years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become the default tool of choice for many of the world’s best product teams. We are now layering a product-led sales motion on top of our existing self-serve business to further accelerate our ambitions and bring the magic of Linear to even more and larger companies. As an Account Executive at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product and help high-impact companies build better software.

Location & work mode

While Linear is a remote-first company across the US and Europe, this role is specifically based in London. We’re looking for someone who can work from our London office in Shoreditch 3 days per week (Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays), as this role will be closely connected to in-person collaboration with our growing sales presence in the region. 

What you'll do

 - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear effectively; assist prospects through the trial and evaluation phase

 - Generate a strong pipeline and exceed quarterly and annual targets

 - Build relationships with key stakeholders within accounts

 - Stay up to date with our product offering, industry trends, competitive landscape, and market trends to continuously adapt sales strategies and approaches for maximum impact

 - Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customers by surfacing product or adoption blockers to our product team

What we're looking for

 - 5+ years in a quota-carrying sales role

 - Experience selling to a technical audience; bonus if you have previous experience working with a collaboration or developer tool

 - SaaS and startup experience; comfortable working and adapting in a fast-paced and flexible environment

 - Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and product demonstration skills

 - Highly autonomous with a bias for action. Owner’s mindset to quickly come up to speed on product, market, ICP, and unique differentiators

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms 

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

Learn how we think and work

jobs.title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
jobs.description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Mid-Market, DACH
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:



Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

This role will be based in Munich. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.

 - Fluency in German.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €234,000 - €246,000 per year.

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.
